notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.9
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.9. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

Captains!

Our 10th Anniversary update is finally here, but our development team are also already steaming ahead with more new content to come in Update 14.9. It's time for a sneak peek!

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new content coming in 14.9:
[list]
[*][b]Liberty Harbor:[/b] In honor of the 250th birthday of the U.S. Navy, we invite you to build your own Naval Base—Liberty Harbor. Each structure serves a specific purpose, so choose your build order carefully. Complete combat missions, and once the whole base is finished, you can claim new U.S. cruiser [b]Bridgeport[/b] for free, in addition to Commander [b]David Farragut[/b] for assembling a dedicated collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b3fcb30842b20c91e19d9128331dbdf710814f0b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ad9c31eae42f3bafdac95ac4a7d6da0b40ed0563.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Dockyard: Lüshun B:[/b] We're starting Black Friday early this year! You'll soon be able to build the black version of Pan-Asian destroyer [b]Lüshun[/b]—a ship that first graced the Dockyard in the form of her standard version in Update 12.7. Complete 35 shipbuilding phases—30 of which can be finished via combat missions—to unlock this rapid-firing, deepwater torpedo-launching machine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b815c9d816f2bf32fe7e1b4849d7ca8c612d88bc.jpg[/img]

[*][b]German Reunification Event Pass:[/b] Our Event Pass this update is dedicated to the reunification of East and West Germany, a historical event that's celebrated every year in October. The first progression line will net you, among others, statuesque Commander [b]Goldelse[/b]. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4ca024ab2f163e816334dad407dbb4d03c5283bb.png[/img]

The second progression line offers rewards such as the Infernal permanent camouflage for Tier VIII and X ships, and Commander [b]Delphius Ora-cle[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/78031a7a41f541f215020ba9195a1aef043693ca.png[/img]
[/list]

If you want the full, detailed breakdown on these features and more, check out our dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

notes.title: Update 14.8 | A Decade at Sea, New German Cruisers, and Anniversary Celebrations
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a4ac12ceb46233b6fadd46b3ec00aa506089ee46.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=h4vpGT6nS9Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.8. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]A Decade at Sea[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a60e4e0bbc60f19779cd2e9f04be1a4643fce841.jpg[/img]

Celebrate World of Warships' 10th Anniversary with an event packed with rewards!

[list]
[*][i]Battle Performance Bonuses return, giving you the chance to earn Festive Tokens or Steel (for superships).[/i]
[*]Festive Tokens can be exchanged for new Japanese Tier X cruiser Kushiro, bonus packages for Tier X ships, Supercontainers, the "This Is Fine" enemy destruction effect, and containers from historic collections that unlock unique Commanders.
[*][i]Log in during Update 14.8 for a guaranteed Tenth Anniversary Gift container, which drops a Tier VI Premium ship.[/i]
[*]Updated Honorable Service: Players with 5 years in the game receive a Premium Ship VIII Elite container, and those with 10 years receive a Special Ship X Elite container [i](minimum 25 battles required).[/i]
[*]Exclusive thank-you rewards for Alpha and Beta Testers.
[/list]

[h2]Decade Dock Port & Update Navigator[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fe8e55a40aee3d4dc7ab14ecc9fb8e7b03ccbb21.jpg[/img]

Jump into the anniversary celebrations!

[list]
[*][i]Explore the interactive Decade Dock Port, offering tons of Easter eggs and a 10-year commemorative journal.[/i]
[*]The brand-new Update Navigator feature provides a digest of current update content.
[*][i]Your Battle Record appears in the Navigator, showing personalized stats like battles played, most-used ships, and combat performance, with a shareable link.[/i]
[*][u]Available until Update 14.11.[/u]
[/list]

[h2]The Grand Voyage Continues[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6ec28fc7083813f5a475ee154c208b5e2c9bdfc0.jpg[/img]

The multi-update journey goes on!

[list]
[*][i]Earn Voyage Tokens to exchange for Doubloons and Steel.[/i]
[*]Continue progressing toward [u]unlocking GQ Johnny for free.[/u]
[*][i]The Grand Voyage runs until January 1, 2026.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Tenth Anniversary Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ef269e09b1bdf8e74e580f4d63b20a24f608aaa3.jpg[/img]

Packed with anniversary rewards across two progression lines.

[list]
[*][i][u]First progression line:[/u] Earn the "A Decade at Sea" flag, Blue Explosion enemy destruction effect, Commander Mikhail Orlov, and a Premium Ship VII container.[/i]
[*][u]Second progression line[/u] (2,500 Doubloons): Unlocks Commander Doktor von Roth immediately. Rewards include the "Blazing Ray" and "Cold Ray" camouflages, new Italian Tier VII cruiser Optio, and "This Is Fine" enemy destruction effect.
[*][i]Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Blast From the Past[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/73063ca79d0e83bfa45f1eda8bcf2b052b58d073.jpg[/img]

Relive the history of World of Warships in a special battle type!

[list]
[*][i]Six chapters recreate different eras of the game's development: 2015, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2022, and a final modern-restriction chapter.[/i]
[*][b]Surface ships only: [u]No submarines or carriers.[/u][/b]
[*][i]12v12 Domination and Standard battles with year-based restrictions on maps and ships.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]New German Cruisers: Early Access[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/77a79fcb7c8689d9f5ba413af9a11ae092e4eeb4.jpg[/img]

A brand-new cruiser branch arrives!

[list]
[*][i]Deutschland, Admiral Scheer, Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert join Early Access.[/i]
[*]Brawling playstyle with large-caliber, short-range guns and manually controlled secondaries.
[*][i]Heavy armor and improved Hydroacoustic Search, but low agility.[/i]
[*]Permanent camouflages available for Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert.
[*][i]Sequential bundles unlock in the second week of Update 14.8.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Asymmetric Battles Return[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/42604f81a2f933f320424f85eab562f2d1efd862.jpg[/img]

Back and here for longer than ever!

[list]
[*][i]Available from mid-September through Update 15.2 (five months).[/i]
[*]Classic format: 5 human players vs. 12 AI-controlled ships, two tiers lower.
[*][i]Playable on Tier VI–X ships and superships.[/i]
[*]Expanded map pool that includes over 25 maps.
[/list]

[h2]"In the Name of Tomorrow" Continues[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/67af33044ccbadb75298a884dd7e0a23ea3bd33e.jpg[/img]

Narrative Operations return for two more weeks.

[list]
[*][i]Participate in Arctic Convoy, Tokyo Express, and Pacific Offensive Operations (Tier VII–IX ships).[/i]
[*]Earn Stars through tasks to progress the campaign of U.S. Navy officer Robert Adams.
[*][i]Final reward: Tier VIII San Diego.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e30f70131f93f3a373873a590f25e86cafbb93b5.jpg[/img]

Polished mechanics and new options.

[list]
[*][i]Module Damage Rework:[/i] Modules can no longer be permanently destroyed. Instead, they enter a new "Critically Damaged" state before automatically recovering. Reloads now pause instead of resetting.
[*]Submarines are now playable in Operations, with increased mobility, Call Patrol Bomber support, and enabled torpedo shotgunning.
[*][i]Clan Battles Season 31 "Mahi-Mahi" begins, plus Ranked Battles and three new Brawls across September and October.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]The Laffey Dockyard Continues[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg[/img]

Build the iconic destroyer!

[list]
[*][i]20 Dockyard phases (18 via missions, 2 with Doubloons).[/i] 
[*]Available until the start of Update 14.9.
[/list]

[h2]10th Anniversary Wishing Wharf[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/eddf7bb5b98a5ce52e89e991c99eb571170ee38f.jpg[/img]

Try your luck in a limited-time Armory event!

[list]
[*][i]Spend Tries to roll from a large pool of rewards.[/i] 
[*]Available throughout the anniversary celebrations.
[/list]

This is just the beginning, so dive into Update 14.8 and celebrate a decade of World of Warships! Read the full update article here:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Take the Update 14.8 Survey![/h2]

Enjoying the new features? Let us know your thoughts via the survey link below!

[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD14-8 style=button][b]Take Survey[/b][/url]

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.8. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-148/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-148/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-148/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

Captains!

With Update 14.7 now out, Update 14.8 is next in line! And 14.8 is not just any old update—it'll play host to our game's 10th Anniversary megacelebration, complete with fun activities, new ships, and lots and lots of gifts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7c648a06fdd4a732a2f702182371b0cae2bc2d5e.jpg[/img]

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new content coming in 14.8:
[list]
[*][b]A Decade at Sea:[/b] We've got a whole host of activities and rewards ready to go for our 10th Anniversary celebration, including Battle Performance Bonuses that can net you rewards like Tier X Japanese cruiser Kushiro; a new Port and personalized battle record to honor the game's history and the mark you left in it; and expanded log-in rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/17e5eec7be825b8cfa103b8bb09debfdeb6be734.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Blast From the Past:[/b] A new temporary battle type available for all in 14.8 goes out to our most hardened veterans. This nostalgic experience unfolds over six chapters, each representing different epochs in our game's history with the appropriate ship restrictions. In addition to this, the return of Asymmetric Battles will round off the battle types introduced in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f33415856ea472fdc9ac27f3d20a9d0687d008b4.jpg[/img]
[*][b]New German cruisers in Early Access:[/b] Cruisers Deutschland, Admiral Scheer, Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert are entering Early Access! Built for close-quarters combat, these ships stand out for their ability to manually control their secondary batteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e3cf5ed3e6cd41957b810b713d4e0db1c943273a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6e29c353d479bdd8f49bcccbc87c95e74b11bcdc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e00ba68a521c3ca72be32031dc9beaf0ea401e1d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

If you want the full, detailed breakdown on these features and more, you'll have to check out our dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

notes.title: Update 14.7 | In the Name of Tomorrow, Laffey Dockyard, and Grand Voyage!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a0b2d736fbf9571edaa8136b0250346c1204124e.jpg[/img]

Here's an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.7. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[previewyoutube=a4WtG-x72dE;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-14-7-in-the-name-of-tomorrow/#down-content style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-14-7-in-the-name-of-tomorrow/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-14-7-in-the-name-of-tomorrow/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]In the Name of Tomorrow: Special Operations[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4473cd835d7ffee09e657d405f87c86ba973d45.jpg[/img]

Take part in three cinematic, historically inspired Operations with unique rewards and gameplay!

[list]
[*][i]Each Operation runs for a week, with all returning to rotation after 3 weeks.[/i]
[*]Seven-player teams fight waves of bots; no submarines.
[*][i]Tier and nation restrictions apply; rentals available.[/i]
[*]Earn Stars by completing main and secondary objectives.
[*][i]Unlock a narrative campaign featuring Commander Robert Adams, historical story videos, and themed rewards.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/982ae8357622fe319a2651b695f0bdf3b939d46f.jpg[/img]
[*]Grand prize: Tier VIII Premium cruiser [b]San Diego[/b]; compensation in Doubloons if already owned.
[*]Complete the campaign to unlock discounted Missouri bundles in the Armory and her Festive permanent camouflage.
[/list]

[h2]80 Years Since Victory: Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03edf68c956198a287544dafa6563aa0e1f90b8c.jpg[/img]

Two progression lines with WWII-themed rewards.

[list]
[*][i][u]First progression line:[/u] 2x War Is Over containers, the 80 Years Since Victory flag, and the Stormy Sky permanent camouflage for Nebraska.[/i]
[*][u]Second progression line[/u] (2,500 Doubloons): Offers the Traditions of the North permanent camouflage for Skåne, De Grasse with Port slot, the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect, 2x War Is Over Premium containers, and finishes with the Traditions of the North camo for Östergötland.
[*][i]Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).[/i]
[*]Full compensation is provided in Credits if you already own any of the key rewards.
[/list]

[h2]Dockyard: Laffey[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg[/img]

Construct U.S. Tier X destroyer Laffey—"The Ship That Would Not Die."

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2aa9f3b6d7f8bfda6a02003530c5f11eab4a446a.png[/img]
[*][i]20 construction phases; 18 can be completed via missions.[/i]
[*]Starter Packs (2 and 6 phases) available for Doubloons early on.
[*][i]Laffey is a gun-focused destroyer with Burst Fire, strong concealment, a unique Smoke Generator, and an enhanced Specialized Repair Teams consumable.[/i]
[*]Includes the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect.
[*][b]Dockyard ends with the release of Update 14.9.[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Grand Voyage: 10th Anniversary Begins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ca89a16f863a69a0b95b884c194f4815cfebd14c.jpg[/img]

Celebrate the WoWS 10th Anniversary with our long-term event!

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e44834bc6629e186fa955e9d75bcaac1dedc8d7f.jpg[/img]
[*][i]Play daily to earn up to 32,000 Voyage Tokens—exchangeable 1:1 for Doubloons or Steel.[/i]
[*]Earn iconic ship [b]GQ Johnny[/b] (USS Johnston with battle damage) by fighting daily battles.
[*][i]Missed days won't ruin progress—complete at your own pace.[/i]
[*]Special missions and milestones, including Welcome Bonus and Daily Rewards.
[*]Voyage Token exchange available in the Armory and on the event web page.
[/list]

[h2]Aircraft Carrier & Aviation Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7151f253d0bd019b22079ba5440d6c188e2588a1.jpg[/img]

Refinements to detection, fire mechanics, and secondary battery controls.

[list]
[*][i]Fires on ships now increase air detectability by 2 km (was 3 km)[/i]
[*]All aircraft now share detectability of 10 km; spotting range increased to 20 km.
[*][i]Manual control added for carrier secondaries with adjusted stats.[/i]
[*]Standardization of air detectability and spotting across ship types.
[*][i]Fires on carriers burn longer but deal less damage; Damage Control Party cooldown reduced.[/i]
[*]HP lost to aircraft and submarine torpedoes can now be restored by the same amount regardless of hit location.
[/list]

[h2]Ongoing Early Access: American Destroyers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f61b94715366724568bba99c191c2f2ce604215.jpg[/img]

American Token bundles return with artillery–focused destroyers.

[list]
[*][i]Obtain Hughes, Osborne, Christopher, and Burrows via sequential bundles.[/i]
[*]American Tokens are available in Doubloon bundles.
[*][i]Includes permanent camos: "The Righteous" (Christopher) and "The Wanted" (Burrows).[/i]
[*]Unused Tokens will be converted into Credits (1:15,000) in Update 14.8.
[/list]

[h2]Brawls[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3baebf40ccad6ac9b3880670c5e341a63145fb20.jpg[/img]

Three new Brawls with unique formats!

[list]
[*][i][b]Brawl #1:[/b] 3v3; Tier VII; no destroyers, max 2 cruisers per team.[/i]
[*][b]Brawl #2:[/b] 3v3; Tier IX; mixed teams, max 2 of each ship type.
[*][i][b]Brawl #3:[/b] 2v2; Tier X; max 1 battleship + 1 cruiser per team, no carriers or submarines.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Armory Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ca207c9480b2a1297435366ec2d8d7583262c20.jpg[/img]

New additions and major expansion of the content rarity system.

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5ee302c4aaa3d106b21ed7875c72ad47b3214f51.jpg[/img]
[*][i][b]New ship:[/b] Amiral Lartigue (31,000 Steel)—French hybrid with accurate guns and skip bombers.[/i]
[*]Content rarity system expanded to Armory items, Captain's Logbook, and Container Barge rewards.
[*]Filter by rarity added for easier browsing.
[/list]

This is just the beginning—dive into Update 14.7 and explore it all! Read the full update article here:

notes.notes:

Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.6. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[h2]Early Access: American Destroyers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f202711b794b4cc244a205a4168eb0b51e1a1590.png[/img]

Welcome a new line of American destroyers with a focus on main battery firepower!

[list]
[*][i]Tier VII Hughes, Tier VIII Osborne, Tier IX Christopher, and Tier X Burrows feature HE and SAP shells.[/i]
[*]Starting from Tier VIII, they carry high-DPM 137 mm guns and have larger HP pools.
[*][i]Minimal torpedo armament, low concealment capacity. These ships favor mid- to long-range engagements.[/i]
[*]Unique toggleable Smoke Generator mechanic adds tactical flexibility.
[*]Available via sequential bundles for American Tokens and Doubloons during Early Access.
[/list]

[h2]Event Pass: American & French Flair[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/47da375a601b833620f80bf78f7e75695003a1ed.jpg[/img]

Collect new content through this classic two-line Event Pass!

[list]
[*][i][u]First progression line:[/u] 400 American Tokens, 3 days of Premium Account, 2x French Squadron containers, and the "Go Navy!" permanent camouflage for Cleveland.[/i]
[*][u]Second progression line[/u] (2,500 Doubloons): West Virginia permanent camouflage (immediate), West Virginia '41 herself, 4x French Squadron containers, 1x Journey to the West Premium container, and the French Navy permanent camouflage for Le Fantasque..
[*]Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).
[/list]

[h2]Personal Challenges Return[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7a148214a2c0115cc26efee9e408f1bedc27dcea.jpg[/img]

Back as part of Early Access for destroyers!

[list]
[*][i]Runs until Update 14.7, in two sprints of two weeks each.[/i]
[*]Earn American Tokens through Base XP milestones.
[/list]

[h2]Massive Graphics & Interface Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b59be0c5ae79ef70925fe3a679606e12ccd8860.jpg[/img]

Enjoy a smoother, cleaner look!

[list]
[*][i]WG Temporal Super Sampling (TSS) enhances anti-aliasing and image stability.[/i]
[*][b]Container barge now features:[/b]
[*][i]Faster access to container lists from the main screen.[/i]
[*]Reward previews with drop chances.
[*][i]Guaranteed reward counter.[/i]
[*]New options for mass opening with safety confirmations.
[*]Barge animations can now be disabled.
[/list]

[h2]Content Rarity System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/75ca9533865fe7076b2a107f08cebd22874b3ac6.jpg[/img]

Understand exclusivity at a glance!

[list]
[*][i]Ships, camouflages, and effects now show rarity grades: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary.[/i]
[*]Pricing across the game aligns with these categories.
[*]Clarifies effort vs. accessibility, but does not indicate power level.
[/list]

[h2]Ship Rotation System[/h2]

Streamlining the Armory and Premium Shop.

[list]
[*][i]Popular ships stay available; others rotate on a scheduled basis.[/i]
[*]First rotation: Brisbane, Almirante Grau, Nottingham, and Numancia (for Doubloons); Nottingham also for Coal.
[*]San Diego and Leone removed, but San Diego returns in Update 14.7’s event collection; Leone remains in the Italian Destroyers collection.
[/list]

[h2]Final Update: Experimental Ships & Classified Documents[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8961a02e85d40d36971b3188e86d7eb22e315332.jpg[/img]

Closing chapters on temporary mechanics.

[list]
[*][i]Operations with Flagships and experimental ships end with Update 14.6.[/i]
[*]Classified Documents now upgradeable to Level 11.
[*][i]Complete experimental ship research now for final rewards in Update 14.7.[/i]
[*]Leaderboards are live, so check your standings!
[/list]

[h2]Blue Archive Collaboration: Chapter Two[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/19ac4a07d4dd0ca0b921891ccb91fe9db82d75b7.jpg[/img]

Class is back in session on the high seas!

[list]
[*][i]Four new Blue Archive ships and exclusive camouflages.[/i]
[*]Four new themed commanders with individual voiceovers.
[*]Sail in style with Kivotos-themed flair and charm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]

The summer phase continues!

[list]
[*][i]Earn rewards by completing tasks across test phases of Updates 14.6–14.8.[/i]
[*]Main reward for Update 14.6: 1x Soviet Era container and 1x Soviet Era Premium container.

[h2]Summer Festival Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/aaafcf2f1fbdff0959710455955ea3f70d276025.jpg[/img]

Dive into summer with our vibrant new Event Pass!

[list]
[*][u]First line rewards:[/u] 3 days of Premium Account, the "Boom!" enemy destruction effect, and Commander Marina Carmen Fernández with 10 skill points and an individual voiceover.
[*]Unlock the second line for 2,500 Doubloons to instantly receive the Pin-Up Summer permanent camouflage.
[*]Earn Italian Tier VI Premium cruiser Duca d’Aosta and 150 Summer Tokens to spend in the Armory event.
[*]Extra levels award More Signals containers (first line) and Rare Bonuses containers (second line).
[/list]

[h2]Asymmetric Battles Return[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/99db0738249dcbd9e2e9a31d8256dde07b24638c.jpg[/img]

Take on a team of bots in this fan-favorite battle mode!

[list]
[*]5-player teams face off against 12 bots, with a one-tier difference limit.
[*]Playable with Tier VI–X ships and superships.
[*]Bots are two tiers lower than player ships (excluding submarines).
[*]Form Divisions with up to 5 players. Limited to 1 aircraft carrier, 2 battleships, 2 cruisers, 2 destroyers, and 1 submarine.
[/list]

[h2]Unbreakable Line Returns – [u]Now With Tier X![/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e1297f9fe36a4246e6c344ad7cdacf38b05d90c5.jpg[/img]

The action-packed respawn mode is back with changes!

[list]
[*]7v7 battles with Tier IX–X cruisers, battleships, and destroyers.
[*]12-minute battles on smaller maps with respawns 15 seconds after destruction.
[*]Victory by reaching 1,000 points or finishing the battle in the lead. No points are lost for ships sinking!
[*]Temporary buffs on respawn; consumables do not refresh.
[*]Expanded map pool: Big Race, Hotspot, Land of Fire, Sea of Fortune, Trident, Loop, Sleeping Giant, and Greece.
[/list]

[h2]Second Group of Experimental Ships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b6f5d16f8ee65d83b084298c6989cf1c250e788f.jpg[/img]

Three new close-range brawlers enter testing!

[list]
[*]Protector – U.S. Tier VIII cruiser
[*]Hotaka – Japanese Tier IX battleship
[*]Varese – Italian Tier X cruiser
[*]Powerful secondaries gain range and firing rate as HP decreases.
[*]Find out how to unlock the newcomers in a dedicated article on our website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/de4677f5f5ae1881984af289a106682a6a50db19.jpg[/img]

The new Clan Battle season introduces a tactical edge!

[list]
[*]Classified Documents grant specific advantages against enemy ships.
[*]Select up to 2 per ship before battle (fewer for overperforming ships).
[*]Aims to improve balance without banning popular ships.
[/list]

[h2]Updated Operations with Flagships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0c4f6056dfddc4ef2a78be44af49e9e87a711bbe.jpg[/img]

More power, more upgrades!

[list]
[*]Classified Documents can now be upgraded to Level 8.
[*]Earn Intel Tokens from various battle types to level up.
[*]Be more effective against powerful flagship enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Armory Highlights[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ca207c9480b2a1297435366ec2d8d7583262c20.jpg[/img]

Big updates and returning favorites!

[list]
[*]Battle of Paso de Patria containers now available for Coal—get Commander Joaquim Marques Lisboa!
[*]Trade-In event lets you exchange Premium ships for Doubloon discounts.
[*]Get Johnston and her damaged replica, GQ Johnny, via bundles or direct purchase.

[h2]Star Trek Collaboration Returns[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e4e95ffeba3913dfa6eb3ef651528460be50058c.jpg[/img]

Beam aboard new and returning items!

[list]
[*]Earn "To Boldly Go" or Assimilated camouflages, a Star Trek Port, and Premium containers.
[*]Complete missions and browse the Armory and Premium Shop for themed rewards.
[/list]

[h2]Grand Trial – Public Test Challenge[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7a148214a2c0115cc26efee9e408f1bedc27dcea.jpg[/img]

Take part in this year-long Public Test event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e826139d2a753f8a3413e15c58854005a8f6f2e6.jpg[/img]

In this thrilling new battle type, your mission is to escort a damaged Command Ship along a perilous path while defending it from AI attackers. As the Command Ship is repaired, prepare for an epic final showdown!

[list]
[*]Battle type supports 7 players per team in Tier VIII–IX ships.
[*]All ship types [b]except submarines[/b] are allowed.
[*]Each match features two mandatory tasks of scouting, capturing, or engaging enemies. Plus randomized secondary objectives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bd4a10666b18a80697cd5cf256061a09bbcac39b.jpg[/img]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

[h2]Perilous Route: A New PvE Experience [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/406bc2ba2faea46b99e71c5dee961b2fb999f1bf.jpg[/img]

A new temporary battle type hits the Live Servers in Update 14.4! Inspired by the Convoy battle type from past updates, Perilous Route sees you and your team escort a damaged [b]command ship[/b] across the map as it slowly repairs itself.

Along the way, the command ship will make two stops, where your team will receive randomized objectives to complete before continuing the journey.

Stay alert—along the way, you'll encounter hostile bot ships eager to hamper your progress! To aid in your fight against them, you'll have access to the [b]Coordinated Fleet Support[/b] consumable, which restores a portion of all allied ships' HP when activated.

[h2]Dunkirk 1940: A Strategic Card Game Steeped in History[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d7e96ca8084d03f255dd0dd209542be046dce74c.jpg[/img]

As we near the anniversary of one of the most remarkable events of World War II—Operation Dynamo—we invite you to step into the shoes of a fleet commander, managing not just a single ship but an entire fleet of warships and civilian vessels in a new card game that will be available to play in World of Warships.

Advance through the event by completing key missions and fulfilling the operation's objectives. [b]Each mission can be thought of as a puzzle that you need to solve using the available cards[/b]. Each card represents a ship under your command, while enemy cards represent different obstacles like aircraft or coastal artillery.

The activity offers rewards like Credits, Operation Dynamo containers, and British Premium destroyer [b]Gallant[/b] (the final reward).

[h2]And More![/h2]

Take a moment to read more about what we have planned for Update 14.4 in our dedicated article. It has all the details on coming changes to Operations with Flagships, details on the Operation Dynamo Event Pass, and more:

notes.title: Update 14.3 | Dockyard, Unbreakable Line. & More!
notes.notes:
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.3. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-143-dockyard-and-unbreakable-line/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[previewyoutube=hsEhjpWMdQs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Blücher Dockyard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03892ff00170416d370c4351331ae40b695ee230.jpg[/img]

Build mighty German Tier IX cruiser Blücher! Complete 20 Dockyard phases, 18 of which you can finish via combat missions, and earn powerful Commonwealth Tier VII cruiser Gambia along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/402045c3e77aad62eb235d82cd2764e193615c1a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b274d331e1ccf582e6ac2290e194c4c2884bdc7c.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Blücher boasts fearsome guns with improved dispersion, enhanced AP shell performance, and devastating HE shells.
[*]Gambia, Fiji’s sister ship, features AP and HE shells plus Short Burst Smoke Generator to evade enemies and strike back.
[*]Two Starter Pack options are available to accelerate progress.
[*]The Dockyard will stay open throughout Update 14.4 but close its doors with the release of Update 14.5.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=rVeMY3t-uT8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Two Event Passes:[/b] Operation Ten-Go & Golden Month[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/534806e7f48e33d66159bb46f57c4244f5800d22.jpg[/img]

For the first time since Wonders of the Arctic, we’re bringing two consecutive Event Passes! You can earn up to 1,170 Points via daily and weekly missions, and it takes 450 Points to complete one Pass, 900 to complete both. Any remaining Points will go to finishing extra levels!

[h3]Operation Ten-Go[/h3]

Celebrate the 80th anniversary of this historic battle!

[list]
[*][u]First line rewards:[/u] Splinters permanent camouflage, 3 days of Premium Account, and the stunning Final Voyage camouflage for Yamato.
[*]Unlock the second line for 2,000 Doubloons to receive new historical Commander Seiichi Itō with enhanced skills and an individual voiceover.
[*]Claim Tier V Premium cruiser Yahagi and the historic Defender of the Pacific Ocean camouflage for Essex as ultimate rewards.
[/list]

[h3]Golden Month[/h3]

Inspired by Japan’s Golden Week holidays, this pass offers vibrant rewards:

[list]
[*][u]First line rewards:[/u] Splinters permanent camouflage, 3 days of Premium Account, and the stunning Final Voyage camouflage for Yamato.
[*][u]Final reward:[/u] The breathtaking Japanese Lacquer permanent camouflage for Kongō.
[*]Unlock the second line for 2,000 Doubloons to instantly receive the Golden Week permanent camouflage for Mogami.
[*]Earn the Silver Ray enemy destruction effect and British Tier V Premium battleship Agincourt as the final reward.
[/list]

[h2]Unbreakable Line – [u]A New Battle Type![/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/775d5fa8d4f3223f70560ff29bda90e3ef82ebe2.jpg[/img]

Love intense action? In this new 7v7 clash, ships respawn after destruction, keeping the fight going!

[list]
[*]15-minute battles featuring Tier VIII–IX battleships, cruisers, and destroyers.
[*]Domination-style capture points—reach 1,000 points or sink enough enemies to win!
[*]Ships respawn with fully reloaded armaments (excluding torpedoes) but retained cooldowns on consumables.
[*]Temporary buffs to speed, maneuverability, and concealment will help you quickly rejoin the fight.
[/list]

[h2]Efficiency Badges—Show Off Your Skills[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a036c54d88e16cd07c6dcac92d7a3ea329a38a29.jpg[/img]

Earn Efficiency Badges to prove your battle prowess!

[list]
[*]Available for all Tier V and above ships in Random Battles.
[*]Badges are awarded based on Base XP performance compared to global averages.
[*][u]Four Badge tiers:[/u] Expert (Top 1%), 1st Grade (Top 5%), 2nd Grade (Top 20%), 3rd Grade (Top 50%).
[*]Earned [b]Badges cannot be lost![/b]
[*]View Badges on player profiles and the post-battle statistics screen.
[/list]

[h2]Transformers Return![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a51f16284ddf12bbb9ee33be2db17395d3b4eb07.jpg[/img]

Autobots and Decepticons roll out once again! Expect themed camouflages, Commanders, containers, and more as part of this exciting World of Warships x Transformers collaboration! 

This is just the tip of the iceberg! Dive into Update 14.3 and explore everything it has to offer. Read the full update article here:

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

[h2]Unbreakable Line[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/10bb811416e9985cbffc1cf9be94067ade3f3240.jpg[/img]

Update 14.3 introduces a new temporary battle type featuring a novel mechanic in World of Warships: [b]respawning![/b] It means that when your ship gets destroyed, you'll be spared a trip back to Port and will be sent back into action aboard the same ship you sailed into battle.

[b]Format:[/b]
[list]
[*]7v7
[*]Tier VIII and IX; battleships, cruisers, and destroyers
[*]Maximum battle duration: 15 minutes
[*]Battles take place on maps of reduced size
[/list]

[h2]Blücher at the Dockyard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d2c679389bf20236f4b4292fd9d6b79d97980e0.jpg[/img]

Historical [b]German cruiser Blücher[/b] will soon be available to construct at the Dockyard! The ship stands out for her deadly accuracy and strong AP shell performance, which together help her tear through enemy broadsides like a can opener.

The ship's construction consists of 20 Dockyard phases; 18 of these will be completable through in-game combat missions. Individual phases can be purchased for Doubloons, and as usual, there are two starter pack options to get a head start.

At Phase 8, you'll pick up [b]Commonwealth cruiser Gambia[/b] as an intermediate reward. Unlike her sister ship Fiji, Gambia has access to HE shells and Short-Burst Smoke Generator, making her a brutal combatant against enemy battleships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cb1d22eb0ce8ed1366652c95fa23eb9f27de63b1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Efficiency Badges[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/17128fcc2a59fd3af73a25f6bbad11bf40b45acd.jpg[/img]

With Update 14.3, you'll be able to earn Efficiency Badges as a mark of personal pride for your performance aboard individual ships. After each Random Battle you finish, the Base XP you earned is tracked and compared against the recent average performance of other players globally aboard the same ship that you just played. Depending on how well you performed in comparison to your fellow players, you can receive an Efficiency Badge with one of four ranks.

You can view the Efficiency Badges for each of your ships in your profile summary, as well as on the post-battle statistics screen for the ship you sailed into battle. Only the highest-ranked badge for each of your ships will be displayed, meaning that if you upgrade a badge, it will replace the old one.

[b]For more information about these and more features, check out our dedicated article:[/b]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-143/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-143/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-143/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Update 14.2 | New Mechanics, Experimental Ships, and Soviet Submarines!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=sfVW6wPJvq0;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.2. Be sure to check out the detailed article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Experimental Ships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8637aac21c2f5c2aae641bf464491730bf4e72ff.jpg[/img]

Three new ships with unique mechanics are sailing out on our seas! Designed for bold Captains, these vessels bring high-risk, high-reward gameplay:

[list]
[*]These experimental ships start each battle with reduced HP but can heal over time. Where it gets very interesting is that their main battery accuracy and rate of fire improve as their HP decreases. Will you choose the security of HP or the risky but satisfying firepower route?
[*]Armed with a limited stock of AP shells with improved characteristics and Burst Fire mode.
[*]They have no module upgrades, their economic earnings are similar to same-tier Tech Tree ships, and Commanders assigned to experimental ships do not require retraining.
[/list]

You can unlock experimental ships by researching components with Credits and Action Reports from combat missions, and get a special mission chain that offers Coal as a reward.

These ships will be removed with Update 14.7, and commemorative rewards will be bestowed on players who successfully unlock all three.

[h2]Operations with Flagships & Classified Documents[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6bc02d11d8bf491aa338e2fab05395d2aa63cb43.jpg[/img]

Operations with Flagships return with reworked mechanics, introducing varied flagship encounters and greater strategic diversity.

New mechanics have been integrated to enhance combat effectiveness in specific scenarios:

[list]
[*]Equip one Classified Document in Operations with Flagships for survivability and damage boosts.
[*]All Classified Documents have been added to player accounts automatically and can be selected before each battle, with a limited time for changes.
[/list]

[h2]Soviet Submarines & Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b0ef47b6e230dc0aa8e4c254517644a898d624b.jpg[/img]

Comrades, the Red Fleet is growing mightier! The arrival of submarines S-1, L-20, and K-1 introduces a new Soviet playstyle:

[list]
[*]Powerful, fast, and long-range unguided torpedoes, plus homing torpedoes with low damage, speed, and range.
[*]Fast surface speed but limited dive capacity. They are also equipped with long-range Submarine Surveillance and Fast Damage Control Team.
[/list]

Celebrate the Soviet expansion with the Soviet Navy Event Pass!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fb627d56136b4cc04a6a5b895eee0f9d9b645e8c.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]The [b]first progression line[/b] features 5x Soviet Era containers, Commander Aleksey Statsenko, and a Soviet permanent camouflage for Tallinn.
[*]Unlock the [b]second progression line[/b] for 2,500 Doubloons to earn additional rewards, including Soviet permanent camouflages for Riga and Petropavlovsk, 10x Soviet Era containers, and cruiser Molotov. Captains who already own these items will be compensated in Credits.
[/list]

[h2]Pirate-Themed Bounty Hunt[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1a1b1212c2b0875b556472dfdd67d1120d1ad291.jpg[/img]

Hoist the black flag and engage in thrilling Random Battles:

[list]
[*]Play as a Hunter (Tier V–X ships) or Bounty (Tier VI–X battleships, cruisers, and destroyers) to earn Bounty Tokens for themed Commanders and permanent camouflages.
[*]The Bounty status is available for free in the Armory and lasts 24 hours or until the main mission (sink 5 enemy ships) is completed.
[*]Random bundles hold new ship Monmouth, with direct purchase options available until the release of Update 14.3.
[/list]

That's just a glimpse of what's new in this fresh update! Read our full article linked below to learn more.

Starting February 10, 2025, players with multiple Wargaming Accounts sharing credentials across different regions will be required to resolve these login conflicts. You'll need to either link the different accounts under a single login or assign unique credentials to each of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d98f15aa002fa5ea7c97592a6d4fbf9426acda60.jpg[/img]

Please ensure that you resolve any conflicts before the deadline to avoid being locked out. Affected players will receive notices and step-by-step instructions in the Wargaming Game Center or game client. Once resolved, you'll receive a Premium Ship VI Elite container as a reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a375b235ed57bee1c9d889a22b3a0af1748b5055.jpg[/img]

If you have any questions, check the FAQ or contact Player Support. Only accounts registered before October 22, 2024, are eligible for rewards.

Act now to ensure seamless access!

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.1 Round 2.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c6aa57ee0b76275e624e0f94820e310f8afc4362.jpg[/img]

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.1. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-141/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]“Remembrance of Ming's Past” Adventure[/h2]

The Seven Voyages of Zheng He are famous across China. Sent by the Ming dynasty to improve relations with foreign powers and bolster trade, Zheng He commanded huge fleets loaded with expensive gifts and trade goods to such far places as Hormuz in the Persian Gulf and Mogadishu in Africa. We are honoring this famous explorer in a new adventure that will run through Updates 14.1 and 14.2 and will provide many opportunities to earn your own World of Warships riches along the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/15ae6951bde38a9509c4e8c636605ac6add6abe1.jpg[/img]

During this adventure, completing missions will earn you the new "The Ming Legacy" flag and Zheng He's Voyages patch, as well as some Adventure Tokens that you can spend on various containers in the Armory. Alternatively, you can exchange them for Ming's Voyage Tokens that you can use to obtain thematic rewards: new IX Taihang
, the Chinese Treasure Ship permanent camouflage for her, and Commander Zheng He himself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1a442e238f1e0c580480532411a82a388f27bc1f.jpg[/img]

[h2]"The Finest Hour" Collection and a New Unique Dutch Commander[/h2]

Conrad Helfrich was a lieutenant admiral of the Royal Netherlands Navy and overall commander of the Dutch naval forces in Southeast Asia during World War II. In the first stages of the Pacific War, he was one of the most successful Allied commanders in that theater. We honor this military juggernaut with a special collection dedicated to his memory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d79fe6a5c993339fc5c8aebd86867853686f3bbd.jpg[/img]

You can get collection elements from the "The Finest Hour" standard containers, which you can obtain in exchange for Adventure Tokens earned from adventure missions. It’s possible to earn enough Adventure Tokens to complete the collection in its entirety.

Note that you must make a choice to either get the unique Dutch Commander for Adventure Tokens or save them and spend on IX Taihang
after the Adventure ends. Tokens obtainable from missions and bundles for resources in the Armory can’t cover both rewards.

notes.notes:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-140-dutch-cruisers/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-140-dutch-cruisers/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-140-dutch-cruisers/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Early Access to Dutch Cruisers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/490e7cece3ca4faa2579dfe1b7d682a46e2f336a.jpg[/img]

Early Access to a new line of Dutch light cruisers begins with the start of Update 14.0.
Branch highlights
[list]
[*]This line features 128 mm main battery guns with good range and ballistics.
[*]For this caliber, their AP shells can deal good damage, while their HE shells have good penetration capabilities but leave much to be desired in terms of damage and fire-starting chances.
[*]The ships are also armed with a signature Dutch Airstrike with a fast cooldown, long range, and the ability to reach the target relatively quickly. On the flip side, the squadron size is only small.
[*]The line boasts good concealment and strong AA defenses, and the ships also come equipped with Engine Boost and a Repair Party with a short cooldown.
[*]As for their weaknesses, ships of the line have small HP pools and weak armor.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/109b5f888178138c9b8a0a33a6d6aeef03868d1c.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d3278e610a2efc54496b38ae43fb201a0daf86fc.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6036535977907ecb8fc8340621a3bdfb251f6c7a.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9f459a5bea762d8bf16b14d04c1e52a3bdafbfa4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dutch Cruisers Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1fa4f38386fa874e9eb080ba47e25a4e88c3b777.jpg[/img]

To celebrate the arrival of these three beauties in our virtual seas, we've prepared a Dutch-themed Event Pass for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ac8e69c1a7bc9bbb027bc1ca07855c4ff810dc20.jpg[/img]
The first progression line offers rewards like the Flying Dutchman permanent camouflage, Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflages for 
VII Eendracht, VIII Haarlem, and newcomer cruiser VIII Jaarsveld as the final reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1390405db95395f0718db3cdd26a1e8a7d984f99.jpg[/img]
Unlocking the second progression line for 2,500 Doubloons will allow you to claim even more themed items. You’ll immediately receive the Lion's Heart permanent camouflage for 
VIII Jaarsveld, and progressing down the line will bring you Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflages for IX Johan de Witt and X Gouden Leeuw.

[h2]Operations with Flagships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a1b586a4b769f94a38c9dfe4c974cd738d264a30.jpg[/img]

Throughout Update 14.0, you can participate in Operations with flagships, available as a separate battle type. There are three types of flagships—Incendiary Specialist, Torpedo Master, and Iron Fist—all boasting increased HP and provide bots in the nearby area with particular effects.
Taking down these formidable flagships will require you to take advantage of the knowledge that each of them is particularly vulnerable to a certain type of damage. Make sure to choose which ship to deploy in each battle carefully, based on the enemy's weaknesses. When making your choices, keep in mind that you'll only face flagships of a specific type per week for the first 3 weeks. Your most versatile ships will be best suited for the battles of the fourth week, as you'll face all three types of flagships!

[*]The Creatorverse Is Back 
[*]Brawls 
[*]Armory

[h2]Operations With Flagships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/28a585b7fdea98aae1a2b8c8fa8973ab40245ff0.jpg[/img]

After a great year for Operations, get ready for a 2025 with even more exciting additions to the battle type!

Throughout Update 14.0, you can experience special versions of six Operations, now for high-tier ships. They feature [b]new enemies known as "Flagships"[/b], with increased hit points and the ability to influence nearby allies. You'll find these formidable units difficult to take down unless you identify and focus on their specific vulnerabilities.

Three Flagships, each with distinct mechanics, will individually set sail on the virtual seas, one per week, during the first 3 weeks of the update. In the fourth week, things will really heat up when you face all three!

Update 14.0 ushers a new branch of ships into Early Access! Welcome Dutch light cruisers [b]Jaarsveld[/b] (Tier VIII), [b]Menno van Coehoorn[/b] (Tier IX), and [b]Utrecht[/b]  (Tier X).

[*]Improved HE shell penetration and great AP shell damage

[*]Access to Engine Boost and a fast-cooling Repair Party
[*]Weak armor and a small hit point pool

[h2]Adventure of Bjorn Stormbreaker[/h2]

A new adventure awaits you with the release of Update 14.0. Travel with famed adventurer [b]Bjorn Stormbreaker[/b] as he battles six powerful fantastical sea creatures!

notes.title: Update 13.11 | Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d24f978565fa7c2c8dd9e6dd3ee0ce968f928ec7.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.11. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Claim Your Free Ship: Expedition to the North Pole[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4cbef8cfa309186cfee851c654c8256683abedf2.jpg[/img]

Destination reached, Captain! With the arrival of December comes the end of the Expedition to the North Pole event. The next step is claiming your gift! 

If you've actively participated in the Expedition this autumn, you can receive a Tier X Tech Tree ship along with some extra rewards; and if you're only just hearing about it now and haven't earned any Expedition Tokens at all, you can still claim a Tier VIII Tech Tree ship—guaranteed!

To claim it, just log in to the game from December 1. If you choose a ship that you already have in your Port, you'll receive Free XP as compensation instead.

[h2]Wonders of the Arctic[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bdf377c7066b45021f140680ec27479f56fe1c48.jpg[/img]

We’ve prepared a special celebration as another year comes to a close, so you can be sure that Update 13.11 will bring lots of gifts and activities.

[list]
[*][b]Nordlyshavn Port[/b]: a magical new Port will light your way through the new update. Keep an eye out for interactive elements, including a Christmas Tree that you can decorate by completing a set number of battles each day. Hang enough ornaments, and you'll even earn a [b]Santa's Gift container[/b]!
[*][b]Advent Calendar[/b]: From December 1 through 25, you can open one of the Calendar’s cards each day and claim the gift it hides. 
[*][b]Festive Rewards[/b]: A holiday tradition in World of Warships, you can now once again collect rewards for earning Base XP on your Tier V and higher ships. The rewards include Festive Certificates, which you can exchange for both types of Santa's Gifts containers in the Armory!
[*][b]Update to Santa's containers[/b]: Only two types of containers are available this year—Santa’s Gift and Santa’s Mega Gift. We’ve removed 23 older ships from the drop list and added 18 new ones. They can also drop a special new Golden Gift container, which holds ships [b]Chikuma II[/b], [b]Prins van Oranje[/b], and [b]Georg Hoffmann[/b], as well as their golden versions!
[*][b]Niord and Kalmar Dockyard[/b]: The construction of European battleship [b]Niord[/b] has commenced at the Hamburg Dockyard! This year, you can also unlock new European destroyer [b]Kalmar[/b] as an intermediate reward at the 8th shipbuilding phase of the Dockyard!
[/list]

[h2]Event Pass: East and West[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/55852736bb5109723645738e76601481dbf1d451.jpg[/img]

Update 13.11 features two themed Event Pass chapters dedicated to our two explorers, Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren. Each chapter lasts for 3 weeks, features 25 levels, and functions as a standalone Event Pass.

[list]
[*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: In the first progression line, you'll find Commander Li Wei with a unique voiceover, along with the Butterfly Kaleidoscope enemy destruction effect, the Avid Explorer patch, and some Santa's Gift containers. The second line offers the Adventure's Call flag, the Eastbound permanent camouflage, Santa's Gift containers, 1x Santa's Mega Gift container, and Pan-Asian Tier VII battleship Teng She with a festive permanent camouflage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65487271619233b611ebac360f8aa7afb32b5053.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e125092c7d2baca1819270369436d1e5bd444b8f.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Chapter 2[/b]: The first progression line will reward you with the Polar Pursuit patch, Commander Olaf Lundgren with an individual voiceover, the Avalanche enemy destruction effect, and Santa's Gift containers. The second line offers the Echoes of the Past flag, the Westbound permanent camouflage, Santa's Gift containers, 1x Santa's Mega Gift container, and European Tier VII battleship Lugdunum with an icy permanent camouflage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d15b456553c5605f94f49b86eb2cbb523a6e5711.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/94482bd0a9d44a8a3dc0a2287f9130c8871343e8.jpg[/img]
[/list]


[h2][i]STAR TREK[/i]: Final Operation[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e472c1e7f95ab3343eb2e9534e6020b7d5492d26.jpg[/img]

The final of the three [i]STAR TREK[/i] Operations is unfolding during the first two weeks of Update 13.11. 

The invasion is intensifying and the Vulcans are in imminent danger—only through the combined efforts of Starfleet's finest can we ensure their survival. Ready your ships by raising shields and going to red alert, and rally your crews to join the fight and protect Vulcan from assimilation!

If her drone minions fail, the Borg Queen herself will join the battle to crush the united forces of the Federation, Klingons, Romulans, and Vulcans. Will you emerge victorious in the face of her wrath?

[h2]And Much, Much More![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/30c4d268034f7405a72659f455799b6af0c58bc2.jpg[/img]

This is not even close to all of the new features added in this, the most wonderful update of the year! Read our full update article via the link below to learn about:

[list]
[*]The return of [b]Asymmetric Battles[/b]
[*]The [b]removal of the detonation mechanic[/b]
[*]The new [b]Clan Patrols[/b] activity
[*]A new season of [b]Clan Battles[/b]
[*]Five new rounds of [b]Brawls[/b]
[*]The [b]Steel Will[/b] Armory event
[*]And more!
[/list]

[b]Visit the Update 13.11 article at the relevant link:[/b]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 13.11? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!

[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD13-11 style=button][b]Take Survey[/b][/url]

notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.11. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-1311/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-1311/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-1311/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]Wonders of the Arctic[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/e2c0a9f1177b397881e83c01a5dd1f5cdf5a300a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/fe3aba1ac3ec10454a6f269989f8dcc1047a8856.jpg[/img]

13.11 is our New Year update, so we've naturally prepared a festive atmosphere for you to enjoy both in your Port and on the battlefield.

[list]
[*]You'll visit the new Port of [b]Nordlyshavn[/b], where you can decorate your very own Christmas Tree with ornaments that can be unlocked by completing missions.
[*]A special [b]Advent Calendar[/b] will replace the standard daily rewards from December 1 through 25.
[*]You can earn [b]Festive Rewards[/b] for all the Tier V+ ships in your Port!
[*]Unwrap [b]Santa's Gift containers[/b], streamlined to two types—Santa's Gift and Santa's Mega Gift—both stuffed with a new rotation of ships!
[*]Light your enemies up like a Christmas Tree with three new holiday-themed [b]enemy destruction effects[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Removal of Magazine Detonation[/h2]

Based on player feedback, we've decided to change our stance on the magazine detonation mechanic and are going to remove it from the game entirely starting with Update 13.11

This change goes hand-in-hand with another series of changes, including the [b]removal of the Juliet Charlie signal[/b], which will be replaced with the [b]new Charlie Kilo signal[/b], increasing ship HP and squadron HP by +5% and +2.5%, respectively. The [b]Magazine Modification 1[/b] upgrade will be removed entirely, and all of its owners will automatically receive full compensation in Credits.

[h2]Event Pass[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/b66b3c58dbff74de76ffc1ebfd692921ca1fa06b.jpg[/img]

Our heroes [b]Li Wei[/b] and [b]Olaf Lundgren[/b] are nearing the end of their expedition to the North Pole! Update 13.11 features two themed Event Pass chapters, each dedicated to an explorer you’ve already met in a previous update.

Advancing through the Event Pass levels will bring you Commanders Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren, plus various awesome rewards like ships!

Each Event Pass chapter lasts for 3 weeks, features 25 levels and functions as a standalone Pass. This means that once the first chapter ends, you won’t be able to complete it retroactively!

[h2]Star Trek Operation—Queen's Rage[/h2]

The final chapter of our [i]STAR TREK[/i] Operations unfolds in Update 13.11. At the beginning of the Operation, you must defend three control points at risk of falling to the Borg. You’ll face three enemy waves, each led by a powerful minion.

If you successfully defeat all the Borg Queen's minions, she'll have no choice but to join the fight herself…

The third phase of the Star Trek Operation reward track offers Steel, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, special and rare economic bonuses, signals, Star Tokens, and collection items.

[h2]Dockyard: Niord[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/c89af567bd662a85c1412ae40394510b9165266e.jpg[/img]

Construction of European Tier IX battleship [b]Niord[/b] is commencing at the Hamburg Dockyard. The ship features eight accurate 380 mm main battery guns with a fast reload. She also boasts 20 torpedo tubes with a tight spread, fast speed, and long range.

One of the intermediate rewards is European Tier V destroyer [b]Kalmar[/b], which can be found at the 8th shipbuilding phase.

The Dockyard construction process consists of 20 phases, 18 of which you can advance through via combat missions, while the rest can be purchased for Doubloons. Each shipbuilding phase costs 3,000 Doubloons. Starter packs of two and six phases can be purchased for 5,000 and 12,600 Doubloons, respectively. 

[h2]Asymmetric Battles[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/1c29a1317b724297d090ffd56bc1edb663e12453.jpg[/img]

The beloved battle type where you fight as a team of five against superior bot-controlled forces has returned!

[list]
[*]You can play Tier VI–X ships and superships
[*]Five ships to a team on the player side
[*]Maximum difference of one tier between the ships
[*]You can play any ship type
[/list]

[h2]Clan Patrols[/h2]

Update 13.11 also delivers a temporary new activity—Clan Patrols—available for all Clan members. Inside the special Patrol window under the Clan tab, you can choose a battle type for Patrols and receive extra rewards just by playing it!

[list]

[h2]STAR TREK Operations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a303b0dbeaf3be74514e86791d1b15c05256218b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5a459e3bf720b927b8e22e0dd164fab0cb84a522.jpg[/img]

In the second wave of our collaboration with [b]STAR TREK[/b], you can dive into three exciting Operations, each lasting 2 weeks, spanning Updates 13.10 and 13.11.

The Operations unfold on the planet Vulcan during an attack from the Borg Collective. You must take control of ships representing the Federation,  the Federation, Vulcan, Klingon Empire, and Romulan Star Empire factions.

In the new STAR TREK Port, you can follow your reward track progress, upgrade your ships, and explore a [b]themed collection[/b]. Iconic STAR TREK memorabilia will grace your Captain's quarters, and collecting its elements will provide battle bonuses for the event's Operations.

New weapons and shield mechanics are available, with phasers, pulse phasers, and photon torpedoes. The event introduces a [b]unique system for upgrading your ships[/b], with the use of unlockable modules affecting primary weapons, secondary weapons, hulls, and shields. [b]Combining the different modules in various ways will change the configuration[/b] of ship stats, armaments, and consumables; or even unlock Combat Instructions.

[*]The [b]first progression line[/b] brings Black Friday 2024 Premium and standard containers, 3 days of Warships Premium Account, economic rewards, and a new enemy destruction effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/deb0e1190480fae978e9541d3ad305cf948d2233.jpg[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3399151c701193abe1ace8342375f0eba43d94e3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3a9edc7b29fef44b0d3ecdfa05ecc4085b36ece3.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d62d19cc99b04975d8d9256f6f45c03536be3383.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2fbf6df5c9623e82faa1e4797807545e6b4d11aa.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/235d8555aa89a7d73a94180d3c9fc2cb16c35beb.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8ba56319c9d532a429e558cc75ff489b0f2c03a9.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4b5c8c05cd4cf2eb7b1a574ec8412b7b9c5d850d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c972a52532f130908442bf4bca2c4850e7c2e6f5.jpg[/img][/url]

After making the purchase, you can proceed to 3v3 Brawls playing Tier IX battleships, cruisers, and destroyers. Every victory will earn you rewards!

[list]
[*]You must win seven times to complete the mission chain.
[*]You can lose an occasional battle, but no more than three battles in total.
[*]Completing the chain will bring you the final reward—500 Steel.
[*]If you lose more than three times, the chain will break, you'll be rewarded with 3x More Coal containers, and you'll have to start from scratch by purchasing another mission chain.
[/list]

[h2]Mode Shuffle 2.0[/h2]
