The dynamic battle type that randomly places you in one of three different game modes has returned for Update 13.9, with some interesting changes. Alongside [b]Convoy[/b] and [b]Airship Escort[/b], you could land in a game of [b]Epicenter[/b], which has had a fair few tweaks to its points system, and that is taking the place of Arms Race from our previous iteration of Mode Shuffle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9691b8b5ebf6123b31c3fa4d3066974db9e6f5ce.jpg[/img]


[h2]German-Themed Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7841152ad1bcaf5220b04f197b96820bb113a25f.jpg[/img]

Update 13.9's event pass, titled "Unity, Justice, Freedom" pays homage to Germany's Reunification Day both in name and in content:

[list]
[*]The [b]first progression line[/b] includes "Black, Red, and Gold" and "Black, White, Red" permanent camouflages, the German Navy permanent camouflage for Prinz Heinrich, and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Prinz Rupprecht
[*]The [b]second progression line[/b] can be unlocked with 2,500 Doubloons, and grants tier VI destroyer [b]Karl von Schönberg[/b] immediately, followed by the German Navy permanent camouflage for Zieten, Commander Willie Neumann, 1x German Squadron Premium container, and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Schlieffen
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fac4d1f1139f9cfa451fce7645262af2cd46e2cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e4701616d59ef035b35162533f2586aba78cbf70.jpg[/img]


[h2]Red October Bounty Hunt[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3edad7fc65c1ad9fcfa79b2064cb612f75ab6311.jpg[/img]

Will you sign up to be a Bounty, or will you be a dedicated hunter? Either way, you can take home some Soviet-themed rewards for taking part in our latest Bounty Hunt event!

The [b]Bounty status[/b] can be purchased up to 80 times from the Armory for 100,000 Credits, with the first three purchases being free. You lose the Bounty status when your ship gets destroyed or the event ends.

You can get a temporary currency called [b]Red Tokens[/b] if you earn special achievements, as well as for destroying ships while having the Bounty status active. You can spend Red Tokens on variety of rewards including Soviet Era containers, which can drop new Soviet cruiser [b]Kozma Minin[/b] among other things!

[h3]Red October Leaderboard[/h3]

During the first week of the event, we'll be tracking progress on a leaderboard—sink as many Bounties as possible to claim valuable rewards, depending on your final ranking:

[list]
[*]1-10: tier VIII submarine [b]S-189[/b]
[*]11-25: get 3x Soviet Era Premium containers
[*]26-50: 1,000 Steel
[/list]

[h2]The Battle of Leyte Gulf[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/daa15ad7b70d55b997164f5ed739b82da5969550.jpg[/img]

We're marking the 80th anniversary of the largest naval encounter of World War II with an interactive adventure and opportunities to get legendary Tier VIII carrier [b]Enterprise[/b] and new tier VIII battleship [b]Tennessee[/b]!

As you advance through the adventure, you will learn the history of this battle as you complete missions and earn new Leyte Gulf containers and Leyte tokens, the latter of which you can exchange for containers guaranteed to drop Tier VI–IX Premium ships, the "I Shall Return" permanent camouflage for Tennessee, the Ghost of the Pacific permanent camouflage for Enterprise, as well as eight 10-skill-point historical Commanders, and more

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f120da214f05a83baf272e74bf6e89757bfab612.jpg[/img]

[h3]Take the Update 13.9 Survey![/h3]

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 13.9? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!
[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD13-9 style=button][b]Take Survey[/b][/url]

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.9 Round 2
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.9. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-139/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]Mode Shuffle Returns![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/334e888541e11741efff86f61e822be428fc9646.jpg[/img]

You may remember the Mode Shuffle temporary battle type that randomly placed you in either an Airship Escort, Convoy, or Arms Race battle back in Update 13.6. Well, it's returning in 13.9, but with one important change—[b]Arms Race will be removed[/b] from the rotation in favor of the [b]Epicenter[/b] mode, which we last saw on the Live Server back in Update 0.11.4!

Not only is Epicenter making a reappearance, but its team point-earning system has been updated to better reward risk takers who venture into the inner Key Areas, as well as make the endgame more interesting.

[h2]German Unification Day in the Event Pass[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/670e3a324c79e48b46cb86b656abf9a2f4fc20cc.jpg[/img]

Update 13.9's Event Pass is dedicated to an important German holiday that celebrates the reunification of East and West Germany after the end of the Cold War.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f6a76637cba4c759be6d8626c8612a179569f7e1.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b]The first progression line[/b] rewards "Black, Red, and Gold" and "Black, White, Red" permanent camouflages, along with the German Navy permanent camouflage for [b]P. Heinrich[/b] and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for [b]P. Rupprecht[/b].
[*]Unlocking the [b]second progression line[/b] will let you get your hands on Premium destroyer [b]Karl von Schönberg[/b], the German Navy permanent camouflage for [b]Zieten[/b], the German Eagle permanent camouflage for [b]Schlieffen[/b], German Commander [b]Willie Neumann[/b], and a German Squadron Premium container.
[/list]

[h2]"Red October" Bounty Hunt[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9068aef89fcb35239192e703856de6bfec46dab5.jpg[/img]

The dynamic Bounty Hunt experience is returning to the seas of World of Warships, this time with a Soviet-themed coat of paint.

The goal is to sink Bounty ships or earn the Bounty achievement in Random Battles. If you choose to take on the Bounty status for yourself, your goal will be to sink ships and earn achievements.

You can get the Bounty status in the Armory in exchange for 100,000 Credits, and each player can purchase up to 80 Bounty statuses during the event, with the first three being free. The Bounty status will be removed once your ship is destroyed or the event ends.

Rewards include Soviet Era containers, Victory Banner permanent camouflages for several Soviet ships, Victory permanent camouflages, and Coal. 

During the first week of the event, you'll be able to track the total number of Bounties destroyed and earn various goodies in the exciting and rewarding Leaderboard competition. The top 10 players in each region will receive Premium Tier VIII submarine [b]S-189[/b], or 5,000 Steel if they already have this ship in their fleet. The top 11–25 will get 3x Soviet Era Premium containers, and the top 26–50 players will get 1,000 Steel.

notes.title: Update 13.8: World of Warships Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/10ad804367ef903b961dc1150efa0c4b6983a8db.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of some of the content that is introduced in Update 13.8. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-138-9th-anniversary/  style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Anniversary Celebrations![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b8d3289d7c9af6ccf906556d23d76c76b6181a95.jpg[/img]

World of Warships will be turning 9 years old this month! In our usual fashion, we are throwing an all-out party full of Festive Rewards and events for our players!

[h3]Festive Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/95a5586c65cfefdbfad282a83dbddc5ab90ca052.jpg[/img]

As is tradition, throughout our Anniversary update you can unlock special rewards for achieving certain [b]Base XP thresholds[/b] aboard any and all Tier V+ ships in your Port. And this year, we've made it easier than ever!

Your rewards will consist of [b]Festive Tokens[/b], a currency that can be exchanged in the Armory for Tier VIII American cruiser [b]Rochester[/b], Battle of Paso de Patria containers, the Stellar Pioneer permanent camouflage for [b]Benson[/b], Supercontainers, and much, much more!

[h3]New Collection[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c9537e7375f9c136ee7d5f38ccea02ce5b9e004a.jpg[/img]

It's been a long time coming and now it's finally here! To celebrate our anniversary, we have a brand-new in-game puzzle collection for you to complete! 

There are 60 elements in total, which you can get from Battle of Paso de Patria standard and Premium containers. The final reward for completing the collection will be new unique [b]Pan-American Commander Joaquim Marques Lisboa[/b].

[h3]Aquatica Fair[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0979855bfaabab52d50be520ad8a86f4388fb6e1.jpg[/img]

A new event has entered the Armory! In the Aquatica Fair event, you'll spend Tries to earn items from a large reward pool that includes new Tier IX Spanish battleship [b]Victoria[/b], Tier IX European battleship [b]Karl XIV Johan[/b], Tier VIII German battleship [b]Anhalt[/b], the Galactic Wanderer permanent camouflage for Victoria, and other anniversary-themed permanent camouflages from past years. 

[h2]Pan-American Battleships in Early Access[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b481018abe679670823d977cc432ac3655be8cda.jpg[/img]

Be the first to try out the first Pan-American line of battleships in the game with our latest Early Access event! Battleships [b]Ipiranga[/b], [b]Los Andes[/b], and [b]Libertad[/b] are awaiting your command, each with a large number of guns they can bring to bear. 

To complement this setup, the ships have access to a [b]Combat Instructions[/b] mechanic that, when activated, improves the range, damage, and reload time of their secondary batteries. To charge the Combat Instructions meter, you must either score hits with your main battery guns or accumulate potential damage.

In addition, the Pan-American battleships have access to an [b]enhanced Repair Party[/b] consumable that restores a higher amount of HP.

As for downsides, gun-for-gun, their main batteries have lower range and firepower than the equivalent ships of other nations, and their citadels are vulnerable to enemy shells when the ships' broadsides are exposed.

[h2]Operations Battle Type Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2a1ada51a9193d27d8e7236ed6de6c7aa6d9dcf7.jpg[/img]

Update 13.8 will introduce changes to Operations. These changes will affect Naval Station Newport, Raptor Rescue, The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, Aegis, and Cherry Blossom. [b]We have expanded the range of tiers[/b] that can participate in these 6 Operations, allowing you to bring your Tier VI–X ships and superships into battle.

[h2]More Novelties and Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/db3ae586646e34d26b052961542d6c4606ce7cc6.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b]New Season of Ranked Battles[/b]: Season 19 begins this week with the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Leagues in a 6 vs. 6 format on Tiers VI and VII, VIII and IX, and X and superships, respectively.
[*][b]New Clan Battles Season[/b]: Codenamed "Asp," the new season of this competitive battle type will be played in a 7 vs. 7 format aboard Tier VIII battleships, destroyers, and cruisers.
[*][b]Expedition to the North Pole[/b]: The road to the New Year begins here! Leading up to December, complete special combat mission chains during each update, then collect rewards such as ships and Santa's Gift containers as you progress.
[*][b]Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles[/b]: Get ready to welcome new Commanders, totally rad permanent camouflages, Pizza Time Premium containers, and more themed content later in Update 13.8. Stay tuned for more information!
[*][b]System Requirements Update[/b]: We've updated the system requirements for World of Warships based on our latest performance tests to provide our players with the most optimal hardware configurations. Game client performance should not change for current users.
[/list]

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.8
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.8. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-138/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-138/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-138/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]Celebrate 9 Years of World of Warships![/h2]

Update 13.8 marks the 9th Anniversary of our game, so—as has become tradition—we're going all out with the celebration for our players!

[h3]Claim Anniversary Rewards[/h3]

Throughout the update, you'll be able to claim special Anniversary rewards by exchanging [b]Festive Tokens[/b] (more on those a little further down) in the Armory. Among the rewards, you'll find:

[list]
[*][b]Rochester[/b] (U.S. Tier VIII Premium cruiser)
[*]The [b]Stellar Pioneer[/b] permanent camouflage for [b]Benson[/b]
[*]Supercontainers
[*]Battle of Paso de Patria containers
[*]And more!
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3669a44a1342542a7d643c11ac7b913a81225ea7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bfc243d7af9f4d9f2617e4500423f15210e8e3b7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Earn Festive Tokens With Battle Performance Bonuses[/h3]

The beloved Battle Performance Bonuses have returned for the Anniversary update! With this mechanic, all you have to do is achieve specific combat results playing your Tier V+ ships to earn [b]Festive Tokens[/b].

You can receive several rewards simultaneously without having to play each individual ship, and you'll now obtain Battle Performance Bonuses for your selected ship by earning cumulative Base XP. 

You can also trigger additional Battle Performance Bonuses for different ships while playing the same ship multiple times. So you can play your favorite ship and activate Battle Performance Bonuses for as many other ships in your Port as you like. 

[h3]Festive Event Pass[/h3]

Event Pass 13.8 incorporates UI improvements highlighting important rewards, as well as general visual improvements.

Among the rewards of the first progression line, you'll be able to obtain Festive Tokens, Battle of Paso de Patria containers, and [b]Ipiranga[/b] (Pan-American Tier VIII battleship) as the final reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e2150b129c7bd449d37f9c50dc36af1687f4c3ec.jpg[/img]
The second progression line, unlockable for Doubloons, will provide you with a Battle of Paso de Patria Premium container as a bonus level reward; a bonus package for Tier VIII ships; and various permanent camouflages, including the [b]Ordem e Progresso permanent camouflage[/b] for Ipiranga as the final reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/660b17b79fa68776e28bcaffc85e1853b11db095.jpg[/img]
[h2]Battle of Paso de Patria Collection[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e17b3f5d766ebde9db7bbad72f1b96264d941dcd.jpg[/img]
Our all-new in-game collection is themed around new [b]Pan-American unique Commander Joaquim Marques Lisboa[/b], who is the final reward for its completion.

We're also adding the new "Collection Token" system to in-game collections as a whole, which will streamline the use of duplicate collection items to complete collections. 

[h2]Operations Update[/h2]

With the release of Update 13.8, Operations Defense of Naval Station Newport, Raptor Rescue, "The Ultimate Frontier," Hermes, Aegis, and Cherry Blossom will have their tier requirements expanded, allowing Tier VI–X ships and superships to participate.

Operations enthusiasts rejoice!

notes.title: Update 13.7: Almirante Oquendo at the Dockyard
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.7. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-137-almirante-oquendo-at-the-dockyard/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-137-almirante-oquendo-at-the-dockyard/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-137-almirante-oquendo-at-the-dockyard/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Almirante Oquendo at the Dockyard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ae0f870c51b17cf87c551c68b20a99e93212f6ab.jpg[/img]

Starting in Update 13.7, you can assemble new Spanish Tier IX cruiser [b]Almirante Oquendo[/b] at the Dockyard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7c0bde122c26c21ff7bd14f156c6fffcf479aa88.jpg[/img]

[b]Ship features:[/b]
[list]
[*]A powerful main battery with access to an alternate firing mode that, when activated, improves shell dispersion at the cost of a higher reload time.
[*]High speed but a relatively vulnerable citadel.
[/list]

The shipbuilding process consists of 20 phases, 18 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat missions. When you reach Phase 11, you'll be rewarded with German Tier VI cruiser [b]Leipzig[/b]. If she's already in your fleet, you'll receive two Dockyard phases instead; so with that and completing enough combat missions, you can earn [b]Almirante Oquendo completely free[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/52903a0ec062250c1352e163248ef12f8f072a8d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e133377df6bcd3fdefa66094dd60071cbe38149a.jpg[/img]

The Dockyard combat missions can be completed during Updates 13.7 and 13.8, while the Dockyard will remain available until the start of Update 13.10.

[h2]Colorful Regatta Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cdebc6111e59d8ff505d68fb7acdb1b5193e763f.jpg[/img]

The seas are awash with vivid colors in celebration of the Colorful Regatta Event Pass!

[list]
[*][b]The first progression line[/b] includes rewards such as the Colorful Regatta Premium container and flag, plus Coal, Steel, and more. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/09f3497f9547f02a25feed7b9525e12ff17c597f.jpg[/img]
[*]Unlock the [b]second progression line[/b] to gain access to some more colorful goodies: even more Colorful Tokens, the Fields of Tuscany permanent camouflage, more Coal, and more Steel!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ee5889d4111a0340fc1f62eb26edbe46a90dd7c7.jpg[/img]
[/list]


Colorful Tokens, which can also be obtained from Colorful Regatta containers, can be used to unlock colorful ships in the Armory, including new [b]Zaō CLR[/b], plus [b]Kléber CLR[/b], [b]Roon CLR[/b], and [b]North Carolina CLR[/b].


[h2]Labyrinths of History Web Adventure[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c20ffab073ff2391eaf0ed04102c417e70da8047.jpg[/img]

Become the protagonist of an exciting narrative adventure through an alternate history timeline of Great Britain, with new British aircraft carrier Theseus taking center stage!

In this "Choose your own adventure" style event available starting in the third week of Update 13.7, you'll be able to decide how the story unfolds by completing special combat missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/39f6296f86440499ee5661e9357228dd7de57a0d.jpg[/img]

Finish the adventure to earn Commander [b]William Taylor[/b] with 6 skill points, as well as Heart of Oak containers and Britannia Tokens. You can use those Tokens in the Armory to purchase Tier VIII carrier [b]Theseus[/b] and other desirable themed rewards!

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.7. Round 2.
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.7. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-137/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-137/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-137/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]Dockyard: Almirante Oquendo[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f66c1a8a15ad0d02391a841ba33340e8c05fc0b3.jpg[/img]

The construction of a new Tier IX Spanish cruiser—[b]Almirante Oquendo[/b]—begins in Update 13.7!

Armed with twelve 203 mm barrels, this ship comes equipped with an alternative fire mode—Modified Shells—that makes her guns 20% more accurate at the cost of longer reload times when activated.

Building Almirante Oquendo at the Dockyard involves 20 construction phases. Most of these phases can be advanced through by completing combat missions, but you'll need to finish any two phases by other means if you want to build the ship. If you already own Tier VI German cruiser [b]Leipzig[/b]—which we're giving away as an intermediate reward in the construction process—you'll be granted those additional two phases instead of the ship when you reach this reward on the progression line! Otherwise, as usual, you can also purchase phases for Doubloons to make progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/258c544f3d2a38541c0791f35a383a7f13d4638f.jpg[/img]

The current Dockyard event runs until the start of Update 13.10, and the combat missions will continue to be available until the end of Update 13.8. Once 13.9 rolls around, you'll only be able to progress further in the Dockyard by purchasing phases for Doubloons.

[h2]Colorful Regatta Event Pass[/h2]

For Update 13.7's Event Pass, we're basking in summer's vibrant colors. 

Our [b]first progression line[/b] will paint your summer with Colorful Tokens, the Colorful Regatta flag, a Colorful Regatta Premium container, 3 days of Warships Premium Account, and other valuable rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6183dbc45000a62993162daf3620977bfdaee12f.jpg[/img]

You can unlock the [b]second progression line[/b] for Doubloons, and enjoy the mosaic of Fields of Tuscany permanent camouflage, more Colorful Tokens, a healthy dose of Coal, Steel, and other valuable rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1f43785e439f619510752ff3d2ff8c570cafc6d1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Web Adventure With Theseus[/h2]

An exciting new narrative adventure awaits you on our website in Update 13.7! The story explores the "what if...?" of an alternate history from the perspective of the United Kingdom, centered around our latest addition to the game, British Tier VIII aircraft carrier Theseus.

During the adventure, you'll decide how the story unfolds. All of your choices, aside from the first one, will activate special missions that you must complete to progress the story further. Once you've made all of your choices and finished all the missions, the story will end and 6-skill-point Commander [b]William Taylor[/b] will join your roster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/09f923c5108d1cdbe148475f7573c19f8fc27064.jpg[/img]

The Armory is teeming with special bundles offering you Heart of Oak Premium containers, plus bundles that hold [b]Theseus[/b], a permanent camouflage for Tier X British battleship [b]Thunderer[/b], and more!

notes.title: Update 13.6: New French Destroyers
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the content in Update 13.6. For more information, visit the dedicated article on our website.

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-136-new-french-destroyers/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-136-new-french-destroyers/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-136-new-french-destroyers/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]French Destroyers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b732c726757a11e209c200999147cbdd5d978c70.jpg[/img]

An all-new branch is springing out of the French Navy Tech Tree! Newcomer French destroyers [b]L'Adroit[/b], [b]Duchaffault[/b], [b]Le Hardi[/b], [b]L'Aventurier[/b], [b]Orage[/b], and [b]Cassard[/b] take on the role of close-range torpedo boats.

Starting from Tier VII, the ships will have access to powerful [b]torpedoes that can travel fast and far, but inflict variable damage based on the distance they travel[/b]. In other words, they are most effective at close range and lose destructive power the longer they travel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2a1d9e860ba97ae94e35c9e686a88ae46ecf204a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d3f576349de941f618a51045ba2642dafee89b0e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Early Access: How to Unlock[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/37cf4bb7666df626303ef50fb9bc25f232f08862.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]The Tier V and VII ships can be unlocked in the first and second progression lines of the French Destroyers [b]Event Pass[/b], respectively.
[*]The Tier VI, VIII, IX, and X ships can be found in [b]consecutive bundles[/b] from a dedicated section of the Armory.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f040566a61069dd9f4423906cccd315a1b973632.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/28d8bc16c87b900f036532967aa64dddc6936656.jpg[/img]

For more information about the Early Access event, see the dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/early-access-to-french-destroyers/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/early-access-to-french-destroyers/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/general-news/early-access-to-french-destroyers/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Mode Shuffle[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/585a67c9bdaca35fc39df8821a8f2a92b16591b5.jpg[/img]

Update 13.6 brings a new temporary battle type—Mode Shuffle—that will randomly place you in one of three familiar game modes focused on close-quarters encounters: Airship Escort, Convoy, or Arms Race!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/340f7058a2479aa6eb935064538617e679d23221.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7e04a1b21bd9b7d6a1f83eed83c36a740df4f761.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d42423b4c480d6870e4b4fe7b588db72e793143.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5d9e0b7b83c3def85ae1d25d8a20a87c2814d32e.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9681b9114b936b382a8b95cea7d622e3a9941710.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6a9527ec41f7ed9b26599103b89410b5d3f768c8.jpg[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/925eb013517edb62cb9468a474d1676fed78559d.jpg[/img]

Three Brawls await you in Update 13.6. This time, you'll have access to different support consumables, similar to those from the Piñata Hunt event and Clan Battles Season 25.

[list]

[*]5v5
[*]Tier V destroyers

[h2]Ranked Battles Season 18[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/104b459fb37e05296c4acb64a0db8f95979920e1.jpg[/img]

A new season of Ranked Battles kicks off July 10!

[b]Bronze League[/b]:
[list]
[*]7v7; Tier VI and Tier VII ships
[*]No more than 1 aircraft carrier, 1 submarine, 4 battleships, 4 destroyers, and 6 cruisers
[/list]

[b]Silver League[/b]:
[list]
[*]7v7; Tier X ships and superships

[h2]Armory[/h2]

[*]STAR TREK

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.6. If you'd like to participate in the Public Test for the next update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-136/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-136/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-136/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h3]Changelog[/h3]

     [*]Fixed a bug which caused equipping a second flag to not work as intended for American aircraft carriers.
     [*]Fixed a visual bug with the ship preview option in the Armory.
     [*]Fixed a bug which sometimes prevented players from changing the volume of the in-game music when in battle.
     [*]Fixed several other small issues.

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] This update is still being tested. The information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h3]Mode Shuffle[/h3]

The highlight of the current test is the [b]Mode Shuffle[/b], a new temporary battle type that places you into one of three game modes:

[list]
    [*][b]Airship Escort:[/b] Help your team's airship reach the finish line first by escorting it and hindering the enemy airship's progress.

    [*][b]Convoy:[/b] Enter the battle as either a raider or defender as a flotilla of AI transport ships push forward to reach their destination across the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a74204cb8a9b05be2268f2c9549bfe9ef412668b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/44a12f2b9df512ddb9b29de80b3ece80c5131cea.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65dc0eee29d11ba9b60bbb3fb3027516d541cf2a.jpg[/img]

This line features powerful torpedoes with high damage, speed, and a long range. Starting with Le Hardi, these torpedoes will deal considerable damage at close range, but decrease in power the farther they travel.

[i][b]Note:[/b] These ships will not be available during the Public Test.[/i]


[h3]Support Consumables in Brawls[/h3]

In Update 13.6, you will be able to participate in three Brawls, featuring a twist to make battles even more engaging. 

[b]Support consumables[/b] will boost your team's effectiveness in battle. You may remember them from the Piñata Hunt event or 25th season of Clan Battles, but this time, the rules have changed: only specific support consumables will be available in each format.

notes.title: Update 13.5: Are you Ready for the Summer?
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the content in Update 13.5. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website.

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-135-new-d-day-operations/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-135-new-d-day-operations/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-135-new-d-day-operations/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]D-Day Operations Continue[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/590074f8dcab7dfd1428a042ab4884e161ad5e6f.jpg[/img]

Update 13.5 will see the bulk of our D-Day event play out, with [b]two separate themed PvE Operations[/b], each lasting two weeks.

[list]
[*][b]Atlantic Wall Defense[/b]: During the first two weeks of the Update, you can take command of German Tier V-VII destroyers to lead the defense of the Normandy beaches from the Allied invasion fleet. Protect the coast and lay minefields to buy precious time for the arrival of reinforcements.
[*][b]Omaha Beach Assault[/b]: Take the reins of an Allied warship on a mission to save stranded ships and clear a path to the legendary Omaha beach for your fleet.

[b]Classified Documents[/b] are available in all the D-Day Operations, and you can select which ones to bring into battle with you to gain additional combat bonuses against specific enemy types.

A new section of the dedicated reward track unlocks at the start of each Operation. Complete secondary tasks  to progress along the track and earn valuable rewards, including permanent camouflages for Baltimore and Jervis and British Commander William Tennant. If you continue earning Stars and unlocking extra levels, you'll earn 1x D-Day container for each level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3fdd4e7dcbc5cbfa84d7855fef015ccd78dca16b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/718d3058bc9b93c15ec458209fcd199e04463ee9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Summer Festival[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d9bb55a1636faa64a5c3f92d42fc4a7aa3bfeb0d.jpg[/img]

We're ready for the Summer in World of Warships, with a themed event pass and an Armory and Premium Shop fully stocked with flavorful content!

For the Event Pass, we've prepared two progression lines full of delicious summer treats. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/aa518ea05c887f6ef2036e62fbe69ec626c58727.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b]The first progression line[/b] includes rewards such as the Beach Party flag, the Summer permanent camouflage, Picnic by the Sea and Distant Voyages containers, plus our new Treasure of the Sea Premium container. 
[*]Unlock the [b]second progression line[/b] with 2,500 Doubloons to unlock even more summer mementos: Blue Lagoon and Brazilian permanent camouflages, the Gold Eagle permanent camouflage for Minnesota, even more containers, plus Juruá!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/39aee6e26de4760164643fe695b4ef73fd05d715.jpg[/img]

[h2]Clan Battles Season 26[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/88e1b4b4cdcf5631cf5f5f713afab1b0d4672363.jpg[/img]

After a short, experimental season, Clan Battles is ready to kick back into full gear with an all-new season starting this June 19.

[b]Format[/b]:
[list]
