notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.5 Round 3
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.5. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and would like to read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-135/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-135/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-135/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]D-Day Operations[/h2]

Update 13.5 will play host to [b]two new D-Day Operations[/b]—each available to play for 2 weeks. As with the first Operation taking place in the current Update (13.4), you will be able to unlock [b]Classified Documents[/b] by opening Intelligence Folders earned while playing the Operations. These Classified Documents come in three secrecy levels and grant different buffs against certain enemy types.

[h3]Atlantic Wall Defense[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a5acef3d6168c930f745f13831581351bf59deee.jpg[/img]

The first Operation of Update 13.5 will place you [b]in the boots of a German Captain[/b] leading a desperate defense of the beaches and coastal batteries from the onslaught of Allied forces.

You can play the Operation aboard Tier V–VII German destroyers; if you don't own one, a rental vessel will be provided to you. All destroyers in this Operation come equipped with the new [b]Drop Minefield consumable[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5960fd8e44cb5b76681eda080aa3a62cffc2e3f5.jpg[/img]

Your main goal is to place as many minefields as possible in the way of the attackers, with the bonus tasks being to save as many coastal guns as possible and destroy the Allied destroyers, battleships, and aircraft carrier while surviving until Axis reinforcements arrive. Lastly, if one of your teammates is destroyed, a buff will be activated for your team so you can continue the fight.

[h3]Omaha Beach Assault[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c83ce9f4d63421c42d0201e100261bed10d68e3e.jpg[/img]

The final D-day scenario will put you [b]back on the Allied side[/b] on the same map from the previous Operation.

Your team can consist of Tier V–VII battleships, cruisers, and destroyers from Great Britain; the U.S.A.; the Commonwealth; France; and the Netherlands, as well as select European ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/40be56daab0a4509e079ea78d90ae2c9acaaa278.jpg[/img]

This time, your mission is to rescue the crews of the damaged vessels and then destroy the very same coastal batteries you were defending in the prior Operation. Other tasks include destroying all the Schnellboots, escorting the attacking force, defeating the remaining destroyers, and having half of your team still standing at the end of it all.

notes.title: Update 13.4: D-day Anniversary
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the content in Update 13.4. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6470526d9b9d6abd45af0944211a015e5dc6353d.jpg[/img]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-134-d-day-anniversary/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-134-d-day-anniversary/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-134-d-day-anniversary/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]D-Day[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6daa905594e67740d7ed0f5275de34b0b8a76ac2.jpg[/img]

In honor of this incredible military operation, three new Operations are coming to World of Warships in a new event battle type!

Starts: May 30

The first Operation will be available in Update 13.4, while the second and third Operations will become available in Update 13.5. Each Operation will last for 2 weeks, feature Tier V–VII ships, and accommodate up to 6 players in a Division.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a6c0a719eaca3adc8dcab63af04660804f430941.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a64c38fe2da88ab0ae3494c165cca2fad465056a.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a1592dd0351a0f1e1ac265a51f2387e99fffaf4c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/250378a0ef563573d185a9501afdee5e91e3a69a.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1ba9dae1d1d04c76194efe58d19cfc5ff4ceb1df.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cffc49b1b7b3fd9f093dab7543b795a0945a0968.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3751337f992671617bca973ca2e26dd14ffc1ce6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2faf75c9f0dc3940ced3d9e8df0f1c9e86fb65b8.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4d693b5f74c17a707852bacc25db3735a6b3733f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/129d53977842b1246aebd501acc3304411137849.jpg[/img][/url]

In the first Operation, you'll take command of the Allied vanguard spearheading the landings on Utah Beach. You'll have to fight through enemy naval forces and suppress coastal defenses to ensure the safe arrival of your landing craft.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bcf814698a2a8d9de04ac938501fdf926e497ef7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fc2e23fad0be77e00d5be9992adcd77d0d9140cd.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b7969aaebff9f172c96d199f9bf174cac27d36da.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/26faf499dc66e9cbc17a449e34bd321d01ac4e17.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9b2d764e0302c7d757b659809d944820e467bbf6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c22722dda2afcd543b59f10828f840a13467c392.jpg[/img][/url]


[h3]Classified Documents[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b66887e5160e06fb0f5f882ef9041ed0edf61680.jpg[/img]

As part of the Operations commemorating D-Day, we're introducing a special event mechanic called "Classified Documents." These provide bonuses against specific enemy types, and they come in three different levels: Confidential, Secret, and Top Secret, with each level providing additional bonuses.

[h2]Azur Lane Wave 6[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/189263c160570c5fea7672cc23e87ea621a4d5ce.jpg[/img]

World of Warships and Azur Lane are joining forces once again! Update 13.4 will welcome the Sixth Wave of our collaboration! This time, the already impressive list of Azur Lane Commanders will be joined by five newcomers with individual voiceovers: Shimakaze, Ägir, Hornet, Queen Elizabeth, and Fusō; moreover, three new ships will be added to the game—AL Shimakaze, AL Ägir, and AL Hornet, as well as commemorative flags for the new ships.

[h3]Azur Lane Event Pass[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/dd4cc33abc2852d0fd422cf4d03cfa450ed1be51.jpg[/img]

But that's not all! Update 13.4 brings a new thematic Event Pass that features new content from the Azur Lane collaboration!

"Among the special rewards of the first progression line, you'll be able to obtain Azur Lane containers, an Azur Lane permanent camouflage for 
Queen Elizabeth, plus Commander Queen Elizabeth with an individual voiceover and 10 skill points."

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.4 Round 3
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.4. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-134/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]80th Anniversary of D-Day[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/26383e173507b71ebf5ccf13aec8cceb4e642d29.jpg[/img]

On the morning of June 6, 1944, the full force of the Western Allied powers was brought to bear against Germany's Atlantic Wall on the beaches of Normandy, in what amounted to the largest amphibious invasion in History.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7886355c06078a0941b7dd78308e0c3c20dee45c.jpg[/img]

80 years on, we're commemorating it in World of Warships with [b]three brand-new event Operations[/b] spread across Updates 13.4 and 13.5:

[olist]
[*]Clear the way for landing craft at Utah Beach by suppressing German defenses.
[*]Take command of German destroyers and delay the arrival of Allied forces at Omaha Beach.
[*]Mount a daring rescue operation at Omaha Beach as an Allied ship.
[/olist]

Each Operation will be available for 2 weeks, and you'll be able to participate in Divisions of up to 6 players helming Tier V–VII destroyers, cruisers, and battleships.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8189c0aa5ff3f7b302ffc49a12086896650ddd8a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/44a817e6edcbc4b6f9a94f3a5e5232cd35bb7c2f.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/aa5761dc0adc9d90f3716b15ef9586570c309a58.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d836127db6eb2ed6f5ac28348a73811e9f7bc58.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8959f33480abd9642b287587e0a80e5c57f15c09.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/365bb03e7e8f7bfc32bed9e215edc69d6ed9e337.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cb10c91840a62f59c11514e47d3d8a7af0f4b3e3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fd9423f4cc86d2a931971c71b8b23c67c838b776.jpg[/img][/url]

The D-Day Operations only have a single difficulty level, and completing the primary objective will not be the hardest part. There will, however, be a series of secondary objectives that will grant you [b]Stars[/b] and increase the overall difficulty of the Operation. The Stars will progress you through a special [b]reward track[/b], giving you the opportunity to earn [b]new Classified Document options[/b].

[h3]New Mechanic: Classified Documents[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/775feeb0bcde9046e63a593340da6834e463b026.jpg[/img]

A special mechanic, [b]Classified Documents[/b], will be available in these Operations and can be activated against certain enemy groups for additional bonuses. Each Document has three levels: "Confidential," "Secret," and "Top Secret." Each new level grants an additional bonus to the existing Classified Document option.

There are twelve options in total—six Allied and six Axis—and players receive one option per side at the start of the event. Only three can be brought into an Operation at a time. You can either choose them in the Port manually before battle or during a short window of time after the Operation begins.

[h2]Clan Battles 25: Support Consumables[/h2]

Clan Battles Season 25, codenamed "Polar Bear," will be shorter than usual due to its experimental nature—we're adding some of the [b]support consumables[/b] you may be familiar with from the recent Piñata Hunt event. These special consumables will provide advantages to you and your team.

To keep teams balanced with these support consumables active, there will be restrictions on the number of consumables that can be taken into battle per Division, as well as restrictions on which types can equip certain consumables.

notes.title: Update 13.3: Wisconsin at the Dockyard
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the content in Update 13.3. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website.

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-133-wisconsin-at-the-dockyard/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-133-wisconsin-at-the-dockyard/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-133-wisconsin-at-the-dockyard/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Dockyard: Wisconsin[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ef364293a6bc8d5ada89b48e7f04864d2b93e3a.jpg[/img]

Build the historic American battleship in Update 13.3! 

[b]Ship features:[/b]
[list]
[*]"Immediate Systems Reload" Combat Instructions that reduce your consumable preparation/cooldown time.
[*]Accurate guns that inflict relatively low damage.
[*]High speed and good concealment, but relatively weak armor.
[/list]

The shipbuilding process consists of 30 phases, 28 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat missions. When you reach shipbuilding phase 20, you'll also be rewarded with [b]West Virginia '44[/b]. If you already have her in your fleet, you'll receive three Dockyard phases instead; so, with that and completing enough combat missions, you can earn [b]Wisconsin completely free[/b]!

The Dockyard combat missions can be completed during Updates 13.3 and 13.4, while the Dockyard will remain available until the start of Update 13.6.

[h2]Golden Week Festivities[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e6753837edff1754bc47bf106e29b9e8e3feb0e4.jpg[/img]

The new update welcomes a new Event Pass dedicated to the special holiday celebrated in Japan and East Asian countries!

The Event Pass consists of two 20-level progression lines.

[list]
[*]Among the rewards of the [b]first progression line[/b], you'll find Romanian Commander [b]Andrei Teodorescu[/b], permanent camouflages, a permanent bonus package for Tier VII ships, and Golden Tokens.
[*]For the [b]second progression line[/b], you can expect the Japanese Lacquer permanent camouflage for [b]Kongō[/b], the Dawn Harmony permanent camouflage for [b]Shimanto[/b] and [b]Takahashi[/b], a permanent bonus package for a Tier VIII ship, new Japanese Commander [b]Ashikaga Teru[/b], and Doubloons.
[/list]

Golden Tokens can be spent at the Wishing Wharf event in the Armory.

[h3]Wishing Wharf[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/01df299422d76f424a4d95fd41141bf3fd838157.jpg[/img]

During the Wishing Wharf event, you can spend Golden Tokens to try to get random rewards. Each Try will cost you 100 Golden Tokens.

The event rewards are separated into three categories based on their rarity:

[list]
[*][b]Common rewards[/b]: Special and rare economic bonuses, Free and Elite Commander XP, Credits, and signals.
[*][b]Rare rewards[/b]: Hyūga, Maya, new hybrid cruiser Chikuma II, and Hayate, as well as themed permanent camouflages for Hyūga, Maya, Mogami, Hayate, and Yamato.
[*][b]Supreme reward[/b]: Chikuma II Golden with characteristics similar to Chikuma II but a unique appearance.
[/list]

[h2]Asymmetric Battles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c4c1780b25e915cf7b20737d40c77d42bd43fbec.jpg[/img]

Here's some good news for PvE fans—we've decided to bring Asymmetric Battles back for the entire duration of Update 13.3!

The rules haven't changed since the last iteration, and as for the bots, they'll continue to be a 12-ship team two tiers lower than each tier represented in the player team.

[h2]Leaderboard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/017a09980250a0ff1100fd1064f71e3721a50f6c.jpg[/img]

A new Armory activity starts in May! Join the competition and earn cumulative Base XP in all battle types. You'll be able to track your progress, as your position will be updated hourly.
The top 5 players in each realm will be rewarded with [b]Tsurugi[/b], while the top 6 to 50 players will get a discount coupon for the purchase of Tsurugi. [b]All participants[/b] who earn at least 3,000 Base XP during the event will get 500 Community Tokens as a reward.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.3
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.3. For more information about the upcoming features and rewards for participating in the Public Test, visit the dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-133/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-133/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-133/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]Wisconsin at the Dockyard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2150f445060a7fa3c5f0d26b8e961e5c125fc2fa.jpg[/img]

[b]Wisconsin[/b] is coming to the Dockyard! The construction process consists of 30 phases, 28 of which can be completed via combat mission groups. If you complete all the Dockyard missions, you'll only need to purchase two phases to get the new ship!

Completing phase 20 will award you with Tier VII Premium battleship [b]West Virginia '44[/b]! If you already own her, you'll instead get three construction phases, potentially allowing you to earn [b]Wisconsin[/b] for free!

[h2]Asymmetric Battles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fee7b9d0dee509e8a337d3ae11c4d65d940d47da.jpg[/img]

The fan-favorite [b]PvE battle type[/b] is returning! Battles will be fought in a 5 vs. 12 format and feature Tier VI–X ships, including superships. While human players will be able to select any ship type, submarines won't be an option for the bot-controlled team.

For the player team, the maximum tier difference between ships will be limited to one, while bots will control ships up to two tiers lower.

[h2]Golden Week Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7aa770542ca9e3b4d8d4b1f165795a8e34366c90.jpg[/img]

The Event Pass for Update 13.3 is themed around Japan's Golden Week holidays.

The first progression line holds Asian Lantern and Golden Week permanent camouflages, a permanent economic package for a Tier VII ship, Golden Tokens, and more!

The second progression line holds the Japanese Lacquer permanent camouflage for [b]Kongō[/b], the Dawn Harmony permanent camouflage for [b]Shimanto[/b] or [b]Takahashi[/b], a permanent economic package for a Tier VIII ship, new Japanese Commander [b]Ashikaga Teru[/b], and Doubloons.

[h2]Custom Destruction Animation[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/99210682e517299b061238cf7965e3ef9000514f.gif[/img]

We're testing a new concept in Update 13.3 – a permanent camouflage that adds a custom destruction animation to [b]ships you destroy[/b] instead of the standard explosion.

You can get one of these camouflages for free during Update 13.3 and can purchase three additional ones for Credits.

notes.title: Update 13.2: Piñata Hunt
notes.notes:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-132-pinata-hunt/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-132-pinata-hunt/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-132-pinata-hunt/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h3]Piñata Hunt[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/43e491a8e803ecd8aad5d54999e43edbf4fd0e1c.png[/img]

Update 13.2 brings the Piñata Hunt event! You'll be able to hunt a special Piñata ship during the event to gain an advantage over your opponents. Available as a separate battle type, this year’s event features the specially decorated Colorful Islands map.

[b]Details[/b]
[list]
[*]Battles with Tier VIII–IX ships of all types; 7 players per team.
[*]When the Piñata is taken down, a shrinking control point will spawn on the spot where it sinks.
[/list]

The Piñata Hunt also introduces a new mechanic—support consumables. There are eight unique support consumables in total, with each ship type having access to five of them. One consumable for each ship type will be unlocked at the start, while up to four others can be attained by completing missions or by purchasing them with Credits in the Armory. You'll be able to select only one support consumable per battle.

During the Piñata Hunt event, you can obtain Piñata Tokens by completing combat missions. You can exchange these Tokens for rewards in the Armory.

[h3]Early Access to Commonwealth Cruisers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/85b27abea5aef1475e167d647258bdcd5adc59d1.png[/img]

The long-awaited Commonwealth cruisers enter Early Access in Update 13.2!

To celebrate their arrival, the following themed permanent camouflages are being added to the game: Indian Tiger for Delhi, New Zealand Fern for Auckland, and Australian Ornament for Cerberus. Additionally, historical Commanders [b]Harold Farncomb[/b] and [b]Leonard Murray[/b], the Commonwealth Rockfish patch, the Commonwealth Team commemorative flag, and Commonwealth Team Premium containers are being added to the game.

Keep your eyes glued to our website for the special article covering these new cruisers!

[h3]Commonwealth Team Event Pass[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4fe64ed6fa67a8bc8551a936d9ea6ec58e06b10b.png[/img]

Update 13.2 brings a new thematic Event Pass! You can participate in it and journey through two progression lines that offer loads of rewards. Each line comprises a total of 20 levels—complete them to earn all the main rewards and gain access to additional rewards for completing extra levels.

You'll be able to obtain historical Commander Harold Farncomb with 6 skill points, the Commonwealth Team commemorative flag, the Indian Tiger permanent camouflage for Delhi, and Commonwealth Tokens in the first progression line, as well as other valuable rewards for free. After completing the initial 20 levels, you'll receive 2x More Signals containers as a reward for completing each extra level.

The second progression line, unlockable for Doubloons, holds Mysore as the most prized reward. Among the other rewards, you'll be able to obtain permanent camouflages like Gregale, Canada Day, Indian Tricolor, and Blue Lagoon, as well as Commonwealth Tokens and other valuable items. After completing the initial 20 levels, you'll earn Commonwealth Tokens as rewards for completing extra levels.

[h3]Submarine Updates[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f55c7f3d8a87fc41a3a5f24b0616e0f62fa43713.png[/img]

Multiple new features and improvements for submarines are going to be implemented with Update 13.2. This will affect not only their gameplay but also upgrades and balance.

Upon the release of Update 13.2, all players will be granted a 100% discount on demounting upgrades during the following week. The affected upgrades that are mounted on submarines at the moment of the update release will be demounted at no cost and removed from players' accounts. Compensation will be issued according to their full prices.

[b]More information about these changes, as well as the compensation rules, will be available in a separate article.[/b]

[h3]U.S. Aircraft Carriers Leave Early Access[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/12872366b0a8c069f577ff1a1a763e8cdf7e5f56.png[/img]

Early Access to Independence, Yorktown, and Essex ends with the release of Update 13.2.

The new aircraft carriers only have access to one standard torpedo bomber squadron, which is supplemented with two tactical squadrons consisting of attack and dive bomber aircraft.

Starting from Tier VIII, the tactical squadrons are equipped with the new Smoke Curtain Generator consumable.

[b]More information will be available in a separate article.[/b]

[h3]Ranked Battles[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d9dbc28534215eeb219ccec155f735734980e913.png[/img]

Update 13.2 brings Ranked Battles Season 16.

Bronze League battles will utilize a 6 vs. 6 format with Tier VIII ships; players will helm Tier X ships and superships in both the Silver and Gold Leagues.

For the Bronze and Silver Leagues, no more than one submarine, four battleships, and four destroyers are allowed per team; for the Gold League—no more than one submarine, three battleships, and four destroyers per team.

[b]More information will be available in the game client.[/b]

[h3]Brawls[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d534d40f1d970887b4cdd30d5acc4963d747330a.png[/img]

Update 13.2 will see four Brawls unleashed in different formats. The first Brawl will utilize a 5 vs. 5 format with Tier VIII battleships, aircraft carriers, and submarines. No more than one submarine, one aircraft carrier, and four battleships per team are allowed. Players can participate in Divisions of up to three players.

[b]More information will be available in the game client.[/b]

[h3]YouTube Memberships[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/721a0ff89dc8e9c3f3fdb5db2673bfe97043f5dc.png[/img]

We've updated the benefits of our YouTube memberships program. Complete special combat missions in Update 13.2 to earn Community Tokens, Special Bonuses containers, and German Squadron containers!

The special combat missions for our YouTube members can be claimed until the end of the current update, and you have until the end of the next update to complete them.

[h3]Interface Improvements[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6f3f673ec098415cbea5d64a39fed5460f9f62f8.png[/img]

We've improved the Clan interface by including two additional windows: the first one displays information about Clan bonuses, and the second window displays the Clan description and additional information. We've also added the ability to include a clickable Discord link in the Clan description.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.2
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.2. For more information about the upcoming features and rewards for participating in the Public Test, visit the dedicated article on our website.

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/style]

[h2]April Fools' Day Event[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b5274c9daa51da2519ab548a2e0bb924a53b97e5.jpg[/img]
We've created a brand-new battle type and special map for Update 13.2. Piñata Hunt pits two teams of seven Tier VIII–IX ships against one another while also tasking them to compete in sinking a special Piñata ship.

Sinking the Piñata will spawn a control point that shrinks over time for the two teams to compete over.

Upon entering battle, one of 14 event-themed camouflages will be randomly applied to your ship. A brand-new custom explosion animation will play for any ships that get sunk during the hunt.

We're also introducing a new feature—support consumables—for this game mode; they will aid you and your team in sinking the Piñata ship. Each ship can pick one consumable to take into battle, and it can be recharged for everyone on your team up to three times during each battle by entering three interactive zones that will spawn as the Piñata takes damage.

By participating in the event, you can obtain Piñata Tokens that are redeemable for candy-themed permanent camouflages.

[h2]Submarine Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c2ed3d4ee485b36df1f4f20b50d135895c822fbd.png[/img]

We're introducing more changes in Update 13.2 to further combat "shotgunning" by submarines while maintaining the same level of effectiveness for the class. Submarine torpedoes are also being adjusted to deal different amounts of damage based on the distance from the launch point to their target.

[h2]Early Access to Commonwealth Cruisers[/h2]

Update 13.2 welcomes a new line of Commonwealth cruisers and their entirely new Tech Tree to Early Access. These are the new ships: [b]Sutlej[/b], [b]Port Jackson[/b], [b]Caradoc[/b], [b]Dunedin[/b], [b]Delhi[/b], [b]Hobart[/b], [b]Uganda[/b], [b]Auckland[/b], [b]Encounter[/b], and [b]Cerberus[/b].

These ships deal decent damage per minute, but their drawbacks include relatively poor ballistics and slow-traversing turrets. At Tier VII, their torpedoes become long range to the extent that they can even be launched from stealth.

Ships of the line feature Hydroacoustic Search, available in its own slot at Tier IV and sharing a slot with Defensive AA Fire at later tiers. Starting from Tier V, they gain access to the signature Commonwealth Crawling Smoke Generator, and from Tier VIII, they have Repair Party.

Starting from Tier V, Commonwealth cruisers also have access to an enhanced variant of the Submarine Surveillance consumable with an improved range, and their Depth Charge Airstrike characteristics also improve.

[h2]Other Changes and Additions[/h2]

[list]
[*]Clan interface improvements: We've improved the Clan interface by including two additional windows: one displaying Clan bonuses and the other displaying the Clan description and info. We've also added the ability to include a clickable Discord link in the Clan description.
[*]Commonwealth Commanders: New portraits and voiceovers for standard Commonwealth Commanders are being added to reflect India, New Zealand, Australia, and Canada.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 13.1: Lunar New Year
notes.notes:
Changes to submarines and ASW, Lunar New Year celebrations, exterior system update, collaborations with popular YouTubers, the return of Airship Escort, and more!
This is a short overview of Update 13.1. You'll find more information in dedicated articles on our website.
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/update-131-lunar-new-year/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/game-updates/update-131-lunar-new-year/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/game-updates/update-131-lunar-new-year/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]
[h2]Submarine and ASW Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c2ed3d4ee485b36df1f4f20b50d135895c822fbd.png[/img]
As we [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/upcoming-changes-to-aircraft-carriers-and-submarines/]announced[/url] previously, we're working on solving major problems with submarine interactions, and we're now ready to present some changes to submarines and ASW. With these changes, we're aiming to create more consistent interactions between submarines and surface ships while still maintaining the current level of combat effectiveness of submarines.
[h2]Changes to the Exterior System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bccd557feb1628dc47cd446cda21166645dce5db.png[/img]
Starting with Update 13.1, most expendable camouflages available in the game will get their permanent versions. New permanent camouflages will operate similarly to already existing permanent camouflages, such as New Year, Epoch, or Made of Steel; however, you'll be able to mount them on ships of any tier. These camouflages can either be purchased or earned through various activities, events, and missions.
[h2]Lunar New Year[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ee9c2bbe8b786c64ab9c50170e851f3fbc2bc3a.png[/img]
Participate in our themed Event Pass for the occasion and journey through two progression lines that offer a plethora of rewards! Each line comprises a total of 20 levels – complete them to earn all the main rewards and gain access to additional rewards by completing extra levels.
As part of the Lunar New Year celebrations, the New Year Beast patch, Lunar Demon permanent camouflage for Hsienyang, and Commander Nian with an individual voiceover have been added to the game. The Dragon Port has also been updated for the occasion.
[h2]Airship Escort[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b42cbbe33da9a37eac25a6cabfc9d46de62c5720.png[/img]
Airship Escort returns as a separate temporary game type in the third week of Update 13.1!
As always, your goal is to help the allied airship to reach its destination while protecting it from opponents. Alternatively, you can achieve victory by destroying all enemy ships.
[b]Format[/b]
[list]
[*]12 vs. 12
[*]Tier VIII–X ships
[*]All ship types
[/list]
[h2]Early Access to U.S. Aircraft Carriers Continues[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ebdae273f8e8ae717a23c5d1e0fd6c502b0955f5.png[/img]
Early Access to the new U.S. aircraft carrier line is ongoing! You can still earn American Tokens from random bundles available for Doubloons and then exchange them for rewards in the Armory: Essex with a 10-skill-points Commander and Port slot, the Hero of Midway permanent camouflage for Yorktown, the Defender of the Pacific Ocean permanent camouflage for Essex, up to 10x Wings of Freedom Premium containers, and Credits.
With the release of Update 13.2, this branch will become available for all players in the Tech Tree.
[h2]Clan Battles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/110858f649cc2682d28c5d041f553f5efa5564a9.png[/img]
A week after Update 13.1 is out, Clan Battles Season 24—dubbed "Sea Dragon"—commences.
Clan Battles offer an excellent opportunity to show off your skills in World of Warships. It's not only the results of individual battles that are important here but also general progress. Fight alongside your allies and rise to the top!
Win Clan Battles to earn valuable rewards, such as Steel, Oil, days of Warships Premium Account, and combat signals, as well as rare and unique expendable economic bonuses. The more victories you achieve, the more rewards you'll earn!
[h2]Armory[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3f6b16c708adf398cda749ad24e88aab26ef1c3c.png[/img]
[h3]Sicilia in the Research Bureau[/h3]
Welcome a new addition to the Armory: with the release of Update 13.1, Sicilia will become available to purchase for 60,000 Research Points.
Battleship Sicilia takes her name from the famous island in southern Italy, as well as the swift and mighty ironclad of the same name which served in the Regia Marina at the turn of the 19th and 20th centuries.
[h3]Battle of the Java Sea[/h3]
An event dedicated to the Battle of the Java Sea, one of the famous naval battles of the Pacific campaign of World War II, starts in the second week of Update 13.1.
We've prepared a special mission chain that can bring you various rewards, including Java Sea Tokens; one of two new historical Commanders, Takeo Kurita or Karel Doorman; Battle of the Java Sea containers; and a Battle of the Java Sea Premium container. Java Sea Tokens will also be available in special bundles in the Armory for Doubloons.
[h2]The Creatorverse! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9ecc8a4ea15f030c058a4a8e1ec6ea73c288d773.png[/img]
We've partnered with five major content creators to bring their unique content to World of Warships! CouRageJD, MoistCr1TiKaL, Ludwig, Nadeshot, and Sapnap are preparing to sail out on our virtual seas. Their respective Commanders—CouRage, CHUCK BLAST, Stonebeard, Nadeshot, and Sapnap—are voiced by the famous YouTubers themselves!
But that's not all: we've also prepared thematic commemorative flags representing each of them, as well as permanent camouflages carefully crafted with their input—Pride of the CouRageous for Leander, BLAST MASTER for Bayern, Stonewash for Normandie, Thief's Future for Pensacola, and Fire Carrier for Fubuki.
[h2]YouTube Memberships[/h2]
We've updated the benefits of our YouTube membership program. Complete special combat missions in Update 13.1 to earn Community Tokens, along with Journey to the West containers and Lunar New Year containers!
We're expanding this program to the channels of our contributors so that more Captains can support the content they like. This means that, in addition to the three levels of membership on our official channel, you can now purchase the WoWS Commander membership level from our contributors. Check all the details [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/our-youtube-memberships-offer-is-expanding/]here[/url].

notes.title: Update 13.0: New U.S. Aircraft Carriers
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of Update 13.0. You can find more information in dedicated articles on our website.
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/update-130-new-american-aircraft-carriers/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/game-updates/update-130-new-american-aircraft-carriers/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/game-updates/update-130-new-american-aircraft-carriers/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]
[h3]Early Access to U.S. Aircraft Carriers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d4dae8bb57570d7d8781a0e7a13c4f60e6c2d9b.png[/img]
Early Access to the upcoming U.S. aircraft carrier line begins in Update 13.0. The three ships being added are Independence, Yorktown, and Essex. In addition to these three historical vessels, camouflages for Yorktown and Essex, as well as a commemorative flag, are being added to mark the event.
[h3]U.S. Aircraft Carriers Event Pass[/h3]
Update 13.0 delivers an event comprising 20 levels that you can progress through by completing a series of daily and weekly missions. Tier VI aircraft carrier Independence stands as the most prized reward in the first progression line.
During this event, you'll have the option to unlock the second progression line for Doubloons. Much like the first progression line, this line also comprises a total of 20 levels, but where it stands out is in the rewards if offers: Tier VIII aircraft carrier Yorktown, a bonus package for Yorktown, Commander Statue of Liberty with 6 skill points and an individual voiceover, the Freedom permanent camouflage for Tier X Des Moines, and more!
[h3]American Tokens[/h3]
You can exchange your American Tokens for Essex with a 10-skill-point Commander and Port slot, permanent camouflages for Yorktown and Essex, Wings of Freedom Premium containers, and Credits. Obtain them either via random bundles for Doubloons or by completing extra levels of the second progression line of the U.S. Aircraft Carriers Event Pass.
Besides American Tokens, the random bundles also hold special and rare economic bonuses of all types, Coal, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, Credits, and American battleship Rhode Island, which can only be obtained via this route. The option to purchase the new battleship will become available in a future updates.
[h3]Sestri-Ponente Dockyard Continues[/h3]
The construction of cruiser Michelangelo continues at the Sestri Ponente Dockyard in Update 13.0.
During the first 3 weeks of the new update, players will be able to complete combat missions and advance through Dockyard construction phases to obtain the main reward—Michelangelo herself.
[list]
[*]The construction process comprises 32 phases, 27 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat mission groups.
[*]You can also complete shipbuilding phases by spending 1,750 Doubloons per phase and purchasing Starter Packs: 10 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 10,000 Doubloons and 5 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 6,000 Doubloons.
[/list]
The Dockyard will remain in your Port until the release of Update 13.1.
[h3]Bounty Hunt Event[/h3]
Update 13.0 also includes a new iteration of the Bounty Hunt event together with changes that were previously announced in Update 12.8. The Bounty Hunt event will be available in Random Battles, and when taking on the Bounty role, players need to helm Tier VI–X battleships, cruisers, or destroyers in battle.
Both players with Bounty role and regular players will be able to earn Star Tokens, which they will be able to spend in the Star Emissaries Armory category. The main rewards are Bionic permanent camouflages for Des Moines, Buffalo, and Baltimore. Players will also be able to obtain Coal, common bonuses containers, and signals.
[h3]Star Emissaries[/h3]
Besides the previously mentioned Bounty event and rewards, more goods can be found in the Star Emissaries Armory category!
As part of the event, you can use Doubloons to buy random bundles that hold STAR Kitakaze, STAR Edinburgh, Commanders Andromeda and Triangulum with 10 skill points and individual voiceovers, expendable economic bonuses, and other valuable rewards. 
The main feature of these ships is their permanent camouflages, which dynamically change their appearance in the midst of battle depending on whether the ship is detected.

[h3]Ship Parameters Display in Battle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2f273d5a582cdd857fb39c439f5bd36e4cd7396b.png[/img]
We've added a feature that enables players to see various ship parameters while in battle! Essentially, players will be able to click on opposing and allied ships in the Team window before or during a battle (press/hold the Tab key to access this window). A tooltip will appear providing information on the selected ship, such as hit points, armament ranges, movement speed, and possible consumables, among other parameters.
This feature also allows players to hover their mouse over attributes such as shells, torpedoes, and consumables in-battle and check the data for those items, similar to the functionality in Port.

[h3]Armory[/h3]
With the release of Update 13.0, Halford will become available in the Armory for 228,000 Coal.
Halford is the first hybrid destroyer in our game, and the ship carries an attack aircraft tactical squadron equipped with the Engine Cooling consumable. The aircraft are armed with powerful Tiny Tim rockets with high damage and armor penetration characteristics. 
[h3]Unique Upgrades[/h3]
In Update 13.0, two ships will receive new unique upgrades: German Tier X destroyer Elbing and Dutch Tier X cruiser Gouden Leeuw are each getting a unique upgrade that can be mounted in Modification Slot 6.

[h3]Hololive Collaboration[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f734e2bb7971dea3a6f4ab9b179560bc094265f4.png[/img]
Update 13.0 brings back the heroes of hololive production. Popular Japanese VTubers are ready to fill the ranks of Commanders and plunge into the heat of naval battles back-to-back with players! Welcome back the hololive commanders with individual voiceovers! Players can also obtain hololive production expendable camouflages and a memorable flag during the event.

But that's not all! Players can also complete combat missions to choose between Commander Fubuki Shirakami, with six skill points trained for I Hashidate
, or Commander Moona Hoshinova, with six skill points trained for I Chengan
as the final reward.

Ⓒ 2016 COVER Corp.
[h3]Ranked battles and Brawls[/h3]
Update 13.0 delivers Ranked Battles Season 15 and unleashes three Brawls in different formats.
For a complete list of changes, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/][b]Player Support[/b][/url]

notes.title: Update 12.11: Holiday Season
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4b77f8daf6c3f769bfa848f1e550f34cb0b6512d.jpg[/img]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-1211-holiday-season/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-1211-holiday-season/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-1211-holiday-season/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h3]Daily Login Rewards[/h3]
As part of the festive events and celebrations, the daily login rewards have been updated with some extras such as an additional Superсontainer and multiple Santa’s Gift containers.


On top of this, you'll be able to find many more presents in the game and on our official platforms during this time!

[h3]Battle Performance Bonuses[/h3]
Battle performance bonuses during the festive season have become a well-loved tradition, so we're happy to bring them back. Please note: We have slightly changed the rewards from last year, and they now scale better with the ship tier.


[b]Festive Certificates[/b] are a temporary resource that can be exchanged for in-game items in Update 12.11.


[h3]Changes to Santa's Containers[/h3]
Santa’s containers have mostly stayed the same but with an improvement that we hope you'll enjoy. This year, we've updated and shortened the drop list of ships: 43 older ships have been removed and 19 new ones have been added to make it easier for you to obtain more desirable ships. With these changes, there are now exactly 150 available ships in Santa's containers. All removed ships are available in the Armory for direct purchase.

The visual appearance of the containers has been updated for the occasion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/12f1ab483f7ea105f4bfe70d179d812a132f8e10.png[/img]

[h3]Holidays in Santa City[/h3]
We're happy to unveil [b]our new event[/b] that will shower you with loads of festive rewards!

Holidays in Santa City includes 20 levels, with additional rewards available after finishing them. You can advance through the levels by completing daily and weekly missions, and since they are based on scoring Base XP in any battle type, you can play the game in the way you want and still claim the rewards!

The main reward of the base progression line is new [b]Scharnhorst '43[/b] at level 10. We wanted to make this ship easily obtainable for all types of players, be they hardcore or casual: just fight 1–3 battles per day and you'll be able to get this ship within 5 days.


You can also unlock an additional progression line using Doubloons to earn more rewards and new [b]Stord ’43[/b] as the final reward.


One Festive Certificate is the reward for completing each additional level for both the first and second progress lines.
For this occasion, the Fjords Port has been transformed into Santa City.

[h3]Salvage for Victory[/h3]
Salvage for Victory is back! The event comprises 100 stages, and you'll be able to unlock several new cruisers and legendary [b]Kitakami [/b]consecutively by combining various resources. You can mix and match Research Points, Steel, and Coal without any limitations, as well as use Warships Premium Account to complete up to 16 stages of this event at any point!


Truly avid collectors can complete an extra 20 stages, and at Stage 100, you'll receive the exclusive Bitter Wind permanent camouflage for Kitakami and commemorative flags for all four ships.

[b]Kitakami [/b]won't be distributed in any other way for the next 2 years in-game after the end of this event. The permanent camouflage for [b]Kitakami [/b]will remain exclusive and only be available through this event. The other ships won't be distributed in any other way for at least a year.

[h3]Sestri Ponente Dockyard[/h3]
Update 12.11 delivers a new Dockyard! Progress through the stages to earn various rewards and obtain the main reward—[b]cruiser Michelangelo[/b].
[list]
[*] The construction process comprises 32 Phases, and you can advance through 27 of them by completing Dockyard combat mission groups.
[*] You can also complete shipbuilding phases by spending 1,750 Doubloons per phase and purchasing Starter Packs: 10 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 10,000 Doubloons and five shipbuilding phases in exchange for 6,000 Doubloons.
[/list]
Additionally, this iteration of the Dockyard delivers a new feature that allows you to preview Dockyard ships much like how you can preview them in the Armory.

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Japanese battleships [b]Yumihari, Adatara[/b], and [b]Bungo[/b] leave Early Access and will become researchable ships in the Tech Tree.
[*] Asymmetric Battles are still available.
[*] Ruggiero di Lauria will be available in Armory for 31,000 Steel.
[*] Piemonte will be available in the Tech Tree as a continuation of the Venezia line.
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 12.10
notes.notes:
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3f10e762-56ca-11ee-96d3-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[quote][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics won’t necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/quote]

[quote][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/quote]

[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/bulletin-1210/][/url]Asymmetric Battles Return[/b][/h2]
The forthcoming Update 12.10 reintroduces Asymmetric Battles in a fresh format. Battles will now be staged in a 5 vs. 12 format, featuring Tier VI–X ships and superships. While players can helm any ship types they like, submarines will be absent from the bot-controlled team.

In player teams, the maximum tier difference between ships will be limited to one; bot ships may be up to two tiers lower than player ships.

[quote][i]Example: Players helming Tier VI and VII ships will be pitted against bots sailing Tier IV and V ships.[/i][/quote]

Players may assemble Divisions comprising up to five members to participate in Asymmetric Battles. A single Division may include:
[list][*]One aircraft carrier
[*]Up to two battleships
[*]Up to two cruisers
[*]Up to two destroyers
[*]One submarine[/list]
AI-controlled ships have been reprogrammed to prioritize attacking the player-controlled ship with the highest HP in close proximity. We’ve also slightly reduced the bots' ability to evade torpedoes. These bots will also exhibit increased engagement in battles for Key Areas.

We've implemented these changes based on our analysis and player feedback, with the aim being to enhance the gameplay experience for non-battleship classes. This also adds more dynamism and challenge to battles involving Key Areas.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/14b19a82-6bf3-11ee-b6b5-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/14aff9b6-6bf3-11ee-b56b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/bulletin-1210/][/url]Commander Skill Update[/b][/h2]
In Update 12.10, various Commander skills for battleships, cruisers, and destroyers are undergoing modification. These changes are founded on extensive statistical analysis and player feedback, with the aim being to update underused or underperforming skills. A comprehensive list of changes can be found in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/482]DevBlog[/url].

[quote][i]Players will be offered a 1-week window to reset their Commander skills at no cost following the launch of Update 12.10. Further details will be released in due course.[/i][/quote]

[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/bulletin-1210/][/url]Upcoming Events[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Voyage to the North Pole[/b][/h3]
The event will continue in Update 12.10 with new Captain's Holdall Premium containers available in the Armory. Additionally, players will soon be able to complete all combat mission sets and obtain

[h3][b]New Arrivals in the Armory[/b][/h3]
With  12.10, we're kicking off an event focusing on Soviet ships. Players will have the opportunity to purchase new Soviet battleship
and special Soviet containers that can drop ships like , , , and , as well as exclusive Soviet camouflages. [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5b5c7554-6bf5-11ee-9abd-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Two weeks after that, a French-themed event will follow, during which battleship
will be available for purchase. [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5b600ebc-6bf5-11ee-9845-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Exclusive combat missions will also be available for Coal, rewarding players for high skill and daring gameplay with valuable items, such as
’s Liberation permanent camouflage for achieving five consecutive Brawl victories or the Marianne patch for five consecutive wins in Co-op or Operations.
Players will get only one shot at each mission, but repurchase options will be available.

[h2][b][h1=round-2-schedule][/h1]Round 2 Schedule[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Sep 28, 06:30 PM CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Oct 3, 07:30 AM CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

During the 1st Round of the Public Test, we have noticed an increased amount of game crashes. We suspect that the root of the issue might be connected to the special camouflages that ships receive when selecting the Last Voyage of Transylvania, so we might have to disable these camouflages at some point during the 2nd round of the Public Test.

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of the Public Test for Update 12.9! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fixed several textures in the Kure Port.
[*]Made various improvements to Last Voyage of Transylvania, including changes to bot itineraries, ship type modifiers, spawns of some ships and their HP.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused sounds from Last Voyage of Transylvania to play in other game types.
[*]Fixed an issue when submarines exceeded their maximum speed while switching between periscope and submerged states in Last Voyage of Transylvania.
[*]Fixed textures of the camouflage that ships received in Last Voyage of Transylvania.
[*]Fixed several other minor issues.[/list]
[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/public-test/public-test-129/][/url]Events and Features[/b][/h2]
Update 12.9 delivers a new Halloween Operation and the Salvage for Victory event in the Armory, as well as a specially decorated Kure Port and new iteration of Personal Challenges as a part of Early Access to the new Japanese Battleship line.

Take a look at the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-129/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and welcome to the Test!

[h2][b][h1=combat-missions-and-rewards][/h1]Combat Missions and Rewards[/b][/h2]
Progress through combat missions on the Public Test Server to earn Community Tokens. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

[quote][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/quote]

[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/bulletin-129/][/url]Halloween[/b][/h2]
Update 12.9 brings forth a new Halloween Operation from the eerie dusk! You can take part in the Last Chapter Operation and finally bring to an end the conflict between the Forces of Light and the Twilight fleet. This time, you need to escort Transylvania and protect her from enemy forces as she travels on her way to deliver a special explosive to destroy the Portal once and for all!

You can participate in Last Chapter playing your own Tier VIII–IX ships of all types. Their appearance will be changed with a themed black-and-gold camouflage with special visual effects. All ships will receive special modifiers to even out their performance in the Operation.

Additionally, your team's ships will receive extra buffs each time one of your teammates' ships is destroyed, giving you a chance to complete the operation even if your team suffers multiple ship losses.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b15543d8-56cd-11ee-a4ae-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b1399fe8-56cd-11ee-89bd-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2c39cd96-56d1-11ee-89bd-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
As in previous Halloween events, the map is covered in Filth, and it gradually damages ships if they linger too long in it. Transylvania is surrounded by a safe zone that moves with the ship; however, her magic weakens over the course of the battle, causing the safe zone to become smaller until it reaches its minimum size.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdf5b65e-56cc-11ee-a522-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdf9822a-56cc-11ee-adfe-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdf6c062-56cc-11ee-a926-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdf8df00-56cc-11ee-96d3-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]

, , and —will enter Early Access. To celebrate the occasion, Port Kure has been decorated.  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f600796-56ce-11ee-a7b2-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Salvage for Victory[/h2]
During the event, you can use a combination of multiple in-game currencies to exchange them for points and fill a progress bar. Once you reach certain milestones, you can claim corresponding rewards. Some currencies may have limitations on the number of Points you can receive. Fill up the bar to 100% to receive the final reward!

[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/bulletin-129/][/url]Events[/b][/h2]
Let's take a brief look at some of the upcoming events of Update 12.9. Full details will be published later in dedicated articles on our website.

[h2]Road to New Year[/h2]
We're starting the New Year celebrations early! Complete special mission chains to earn Arctic Tokens that can be used to purchase containers in the Armory—the container selection refreshes with each new update. Additionally, you will receive mystery rewards for completing some of these chains—more information about them will be revealed in the future.

[quote]The final reward for the event will become available in Update 12.11: you will obtain [/quote] for completing the final mission chain.  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/295e85e8-56cd-11ee-96d7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]

It's "Black in Black" time! Black B and other five new ships—Smolensk B, Iwami B, Lazo B, Brandenburg B, and Repulse B—are ready to join your fleet, so you can roam the seas in style.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8a41654-56cb-11ee-96d3-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8c41594-56cb-11ee-a7b2-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8bb0c1a-56cb-11ee-850d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8bd2342-56cb-11ee-8320-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8bc3266-56cb-11ee-a4ae-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8c4509a-56cb-11ee-8cc4-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Heroes of Might and Magic III[/h2]
The astrologers proclaim the week of Heroes of Might and Magic III in World of Warships!
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/82a7fe64-56ef-11ee-96a2-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
Meet six epic new Commanders with individual voiceovers based on iconic heroes from the classic turn-based strategy game! Catherine Ironfist of the Castle, Mephala of the Rampart, Solmyr of the Tower, Sandro of the Necropolis, Nymus of the Inferno, and Gunnar of the Dungeon are ready to stand at the helms of your ships and lead their factions to victory! For this special crossover event, we've also added Heroes of Might & Magic’s iconic Kingdom of Erathia Griffin banner as a commemorative flag!

[url=#airship-escort-in-random-battles]Airship Escort in Random Battles[/url]

[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/bulletin-128/][/url]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
World of Warships is celebrating another glorious Anniversary—the new update marks the game’s 8th Birthday! We’ve prepared various activities and rewards in honor of the event, and the Designer's Table Port is getting freshly decorated for the occasion.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f39bc50-40b4-11ee-9f46-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f39f86e-40b4-11ee-abe0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f3b4b42-40b4-11ee-bf58-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f399ed2-40b4-11ee-a5a9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f3af502-40b4-11ee-8734-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Festive Rewards[/h2]
To celebrate the 8th Anniversary of World of Warships, we're bringing back bonuses for your performance in battles playing all ships of Tier V and above. However, the reward distribution method has been changed, and players will earn Festive Tokens. More information about Anniversary changes can be found [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/472]here[/url].

This year, we want to renew our approach to the event and update the rewards, as well as the ways in which you can earn them.

In the past, the event structure was completely tied to the number of Tier X ships players had in Port. However, as the game progressed, more opportunities to obtain Tier X ships appeared, therefore we decided to shift the focus toward a different reward distribution and different tiers. Now, players will be able to obtain the following rewards on the Live Server: Supercontainers,
(or another Tier VIII ship if a player already has Bayard), rare economic bonuses, a new container with bonus packages and festive camouflages, as well as a special coupon for the Armory.



[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/bulletin-128/][/url]Airship Escort in Random Battles[/b][/h2]
After having appeared twice on the Live Server as a separate battle type (most recently, 12.0), Airship Escort is by now a familiar game mode for many players.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5ae43542-40b4-11ee-a5a9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Airship Escort was well received by our community; however, there were some concerns over its implementation into Random Battles—we have heard the community feedback and will actively monitor its introduction. If necessary, we’ll be able to reduce the frequency of the Airship Escort game mode in Random Battles, as well as reduce the number of maps for which this mode can appear. Our goal is to add greater variety to Random Battles without adding long queue times for an additional game mode, and we’ll reevaluate this over time as we actively curate our Random Battle playlists.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a0085be0-40b3-11ee-a5a9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[quote][i]As a result, Airship Escort will be resurfacing for the Public Test of Update 12.8 as one of the possible game modes in Random Battles. During the Public Test, there will be a higher chance for the Airship Escort mode to appear in Random Battles.[/i][/quote]

[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/bulletin-128/][/url]Spanish Cruisers[/b][/h2]
Update 12.8 marks the end of Early Access to Spanish cruisers; they will soon become researchable ships in their respective Tech Tree.

These ships have main battery guns with average range and damage per minute, and they are also armed with short-range torpedoes.

Spanish cruisers of Tier VII and higher feature the "Burst Fire" alternative firing mode, their shells follow a flatter trajectory, and their AP shells penetrate armor more effectively. These ships are fast, but they have average maneuverability.

All players will be able to try the Spanish cruisers in the upcoming Public Test.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a0005d14-40b3-11ee-9087-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/bulletin-128/][/url]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[h2]Signals[/h2]
Starting with Update 12.8, players will be able to auto-buy signals individually in the equipment window of the Port. The auto-buy feature is turned off by default, but it’s simple to switch on. Once players run out of signals, they will be able to replenish them by using Credits.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3b69b3ea-40b4-11ee-a5a9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Notification Improvements[/h2]
The appearance of the following windows has been changed: personal offers, Division invitations, Clan invitations, Training Room invitations, and behavior warnings.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fac4ae12-40b3-11ee-a5a9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fac8c448-40b3-11ee-8734-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]

[h2][b][h1=lüshun-in-the-dockyard][/h1]Lüshun in the Dockyard[/b][/h2] 
The construction of [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_fae90b7297e33378dbd81d57f61baa5671f67f363435768f1c9f66b39168730b.png[/img] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Lüshun[/b][/b] is commencing at the Tan Yun Dockyard.
 
The process comprises 35 shipbuilding phases, 30 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat mission groups. You can also progress through shipbuilding phases by spending [b]1,950[/b] Doubloons per phase and purchasing Starter Packs: [b]10 shipbuilding phases[/b] in exchange for [b]11,000[/b] Doubloons and [b]5 shipbuilding phases[/b] in exchange for [b]7,000[/b] Doubloons.
 
The Dockyard combat missions can be completed during a period that spans Update 12.7; Update 12.8; and the first 3 weeks of Update 12.9. The Dockyard will remain in your Port until the release of Update 12.10.
  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7cbe09d0-2b84-11ee-9708-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fbc613e8-2bb2-11ee-ac1b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fbc31274-2bb2-11ee-b6d9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fc9ba5ee-2bb2-11ee-b16d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]  
[h2][b][h1=concealed-maneuvers-127][/h1]Concealed Maneuvers[/b][/h2] 
Update 12.7 features the second stage of the Concealed Maneuvers temporary battle type. We're continuing to test new mechanics for aircraft carriers—specifically, the Air-Dropped Minefield and Smoke Curtain Generator consumables. Battles will utilize a 9 vs. 9 format with Tier IX–X ships.
 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314e27aa-2b84-11ee-97d8-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314ba3ae-2b84-11ee-ad3b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314a1ac0-2b84-11ee-9708-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] 
[quote][i]For the new iteration, we're adding aircraft carriers [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_a608afcc194232095536ebc93508eb7b4b68cf46bc3600cd28b4afd0ad9a38b3.png[/img] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Essex[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_afff8f2e1e23cdf6b9314f80cca4fb85af40cfbe7812a9ccc707fd24ed207557.png[/img] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Taihō[/b][/b]. Essex's bombers will be able to call in a special airstrike to deploy an Air-Dropped Minefield, while Taihō's attack aircraft will be able to deploy smoke screens. We've discussed these mechanics in greater detail [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/concealed-maneuvers-temporary-battle-type/]here[/url].[/i][/quote]
 
Unlike the first iteration of Concealed Maneuvers, this iteration allows you to take submarines into battle. They can interact with minefields. Each mine will have a mooring cable attached to it. If a submarine contacts the cable, the mine will detonate and damage the submarine. The closer the mine is to the submarine, the more damage it will inflict and the higher the chances of dealing critical damage will be.
 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7cc01d38-2b84-11ee-b658-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7cc02094-2b84-11ee-ad3b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]  
[h2][b][h1=visual-and-audio-enhancements][/h1]Visual and Audio Enhancements[/b][/h2] 
We've made significant changes to the audio and visual components of the game.
 
[h2]Visuals[/h2] 
In Update 12.7, high-detail textures are being added to the New York Port, as well as the New Dawn, Polar, and Islands maps. The islands on these maps will receive updated collision models. The models fully match the contours of the islands in the game, and ships will be less likely to get stuck near the islands.
 
[h2]New York[/h2] 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c33fe9e2-2b83-11ee-ba15-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3403014-2b83-11ee-ad3b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c340922a-2b83-11ee-b486-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] 
[h2]New Dawn[/h2] 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7151c4ac-2b83-11ee-bf29-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/715426ac-2b83-11ee-9708-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/71549c68-2b83-11ee-9bd9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] 
[h2]Polar[/h2] 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/93f9766c-2b83-11ee-9bd9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/93f9766c-2b83-11ee-bf96-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/93fcf21a-2b83-11ee-bafc-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] 
[h2]Islands[/h2] 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e89bca62-2b83-11ee-9bd9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e89b01cc-2b83-11ee-ad3b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e89aac72-2b83-11ee-bf29-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] 
Maps with high-detail textures will feature more birds and fish; players can even come across sharks there. We've also introduced dolphins that will occasionally follow ships when there's no active combat.
  
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/11e6f9aa-2b84-11ee-aa30-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/11e407cc-2b84-11ee-9bd9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/11e421ee-2b84-11ee-bf29-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] 
We've updated the visual effects of water splashing on ship bows; we've added animations of sea foam sweeping across ships and drops falling from the hull and floating away in the wind; we've made sun rays look more realistic underwater and added animations for air bubbles.
  
We've improved the effects for shells, bombs, and rockets hitting ships and islands, as well as the effects of overpenetration, ricochets, and citadel hits.
   
We've animated the unfolding of antennas and funnels on a number of aircraft carriers, as well as the rotation of funnels on a few French battleships. These changes will apply only to ships that have these features incorporated into their designs. For the list of ships, please refer to our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/462]Development Blog[/url]. We've also animated the rotation of secondary gun mounts that players will be able to see during calm moments on the battlefield.
  
The game visuals will look better at low graphics quality settings. They will be practically the same as the visuals at high graphics quality settings as of 2021. We've also slightly improved the game performance at the lowest quality graphics settings.
 
[h2]Audio[/h2] 
We've updated sound effects of guns firing, shells hitting ships and water, overpenetration, ricochets, and waves dashing against ship bows. The sounds of battles occurring far from players will become clearly distinguishable and accurately simulate sounds traveling over long distances.
 
The quality of all sound effects and their interactions will be improved. The sound picture will adapt to the battle conditions, prioritizing sounds of greater significance and bringing them to the foreground.
  
[h2][b][h1=other-changes-and-improvements][/h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2] 
[h2]Distinctive Insignia Changes[/h2] 
A Distinctive Insignia tab will be added. This is where you can create your personal insignia by combining different available elements—the symbol, shape, border color, background color, and texture. You'll also be able to generate a random patch from the available elements; moreover, the rendering technology will be improved—patches, including existing ones, will look more realistic.
 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5fef881e-2ba8-11ee-bf35-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5fed3910-2ba8-11ee-8ecb-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5feedd56-2ba8-11ee-9eef-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] 
[h2]Trade-In[/h2] 
During the first 2 weeks of Update 12.7, a special tab will be added to the Armory. There, players can decommission certain Tier V–X Premium and special ships, including rare ones. By doing so, they will receive significant discounts on a number of other ships obtainable for Doubloons. Rare ships that are hard or impossible to obtain can be traded for greater discounts.
 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fb4542b4-2bb1-11ee-9969-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5c9ed788-2bb6-11ee-a82b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5f8b701e-2bb6-11ee-8201-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/62290020-2bb6-11ee-ae88-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] 
[quote][i]We'll share all details about this trade-in opportunity in the future. Right now, you can try out this feature on the Public Test server![/i][/quote]
 
[h2]Other Changes[/h2] 
We're implementing an upgrade recommendation system that will cover all ships. Just like Commander skills, the recommended upgrades will now be marked with a special icon. Players will be able to buy all the recommended upgrades and mount them in vacant slots at once with the help of a special button.
 
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1491c6a6-2ba9-11ee-b486-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1492b930-2ba9-11ee-8ecb-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] 
We've reworked the battle type selection screen. The upper section of the screen will display the permanently available battle types, and the lower section will display the temporary and seasonal types. We've updated the existing descriptions of battle types and added some new descriptions. You can open them by pressing the [b][b]"i"[/b][/b] button. We've added tooltips that pop up on hovering over the battle type icon. They contain information about ship restrictions and the time remaining until the end of particular battle types, Sprints, or Prime Times.
  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/148028b0-2ba9-11ee-9eef-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] 
We've implemented a new approach to how Premium and special ship features are displayed in the Equipment tab.
  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1495beaa-2ba9-11ee-a077-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] 
We've also fixed the animation of torpedoes exiting torpedo launchers; this change won't affect the gameplay.

notes.title: Update 12.6: Spanish Cruisers
notes.notes:
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/86e19f8c-2218-11ee-939c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Update 12.6 delivers the following:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][url=#early-access-to-spanish-cruisers]Early Access to Spanish Cruisers[/url]
[*][url=#battle-pass]Battle Pass[/url]
[*][url=#concealed-maneuvers]Concealed Maneuvers[/url]
[*][url=#european-destroyers]European Destroyers Are Available to Everyone[/url]
[*][url=#armory]Armory[/url]
[*][url=#battle-of-the-somme-collection]Battle of the Somme Collection[/url]
[*][url=#economic-changes]Economic Changes[/url]

[*][url=#technical-improvements]Technical Improvements[/url]
[*][url=#game-balance-changes]Game Balance Changes[/url]
