[*][url=#other-changes-and-improvements]Other Changes and Improvements[/url][/list]
[h2][b][h1=early-access-to-spanish-cruisers][/h1]Early Access to Spanish Cruisers[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/eaf73342-2218-11ee-88e7-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

Update 12.6 delivers Spanish cruisers to Early Access.
These ships have main battery guns with an average range and damage per minute. They are also armed with short-range torpedoes.

Cruisers of Tier VII and higher feature the "Burst Fire" alternative firing mode, their shells follow a flatter trajectory, and their AP shells penetrate armor more effectively.

The newcomers are fast, but they have only average concealment and maneuverability.

Spanish cruisers boast a wide range of consumables to choose from:
[list][*]The Hydroacoustic Search consumable is available from Tier IV; starting from Tier VI, players can choose to mount Defensive AA Fire in the same slot instead.
[*]Starting from Tier VII, Repair Party is introduced, and players have a choice between Fighter or Spotting Aircraft in another slot.[/list]
[quote][i]We've updated the Ocean Port and added national emblems for Spanish ships to mark the event.[/i][/quote]

Gold and Silver Spanish Tokens will come in handy while the cruisers are in Early Access, and one way of obtaining them is via the Personal Challenges event that’s making a return in Update 12.6. Once again, you'll have to demonstrate your skill by achieving specific accomplishments while commanding ships of different nations and types.

This time, the event features an updated interface.
[list][*]We've added a section with information about earned rewards to the Personal Challenges page.
[*]A number of other visual changes and improvements have been made.[/list]  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bdca4918-2178-11ee-bda7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b][h1=battle-pass][/h1]Battle Pass[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea233de4-2218-11ee-8396-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

As usual, the new update delivers a fresh Battle Pass. Earn BP Points by completing daily and weekly combat missions, advance through the BP progress bar, and earn awesome rewards!

The final reward of the [b]Free Battle Pass[/b] is 7x Rare Bonuses containers and [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/afc3876a-217f-11ee-9409-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img][b]100[/b] Silver Spanish Tokens. You can exchange the latter for sequential bundles that include bonus packages applicable to Tier V–VIII Early Access ships or for Gold Spanish Tokens.

The [b]Premium Pass[/b] delivers even more valuable items, and the final reward for completing it is [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/af8401f8-217f-11ee-a7f9-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img][b]500[/b] Gold Spanish Tokens. Use them to obtain sequential bundles that hold Tier IV–VIII Spanish cruisers, permanent camouflages for Tier VIII–X ships, and other items.


We've changed the post-progression rewards for the Premium Battle Pass: after completing all of its levels, players will receive [b]1x Rare Bonuses container[/b] and [b]1,000[/b] Coal for each additional level.

The seasonal bonuses remain the same as they were in the previous iteration—additional combat missions to earn BP points and progress through levels; a [b]+100%[/b] bonus for the first daily victory; and a [b]+5%[/b] bonus to Coal, Steel, and Research Point earnings.

[h2][b][h1=concealed-maneuvers][/h1]Concealed Maneuvers[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3884ab08-222d-11ee-ba6d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 21 Jul. 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 08 Aug. 02:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Update 12.6 introduces the Concealed Maneuvers temporary battle type, which has been designed to test new mechanics for aircraft carriers.

We've added two new aircraft carriers to the game—[b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Kikaku[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Concord Bridge[/b][/b]. They resemble [b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Shōkaku[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Lexington[/b][/b], except that they feature adjusted parameters and squadrons with unique consumables. These aircraft carriers can be rented for the duration of the event; however, you can't take them into battles of any other type.

What sets these new aircraft carriers apart are their squadrons' unique consumables—Smoke Curtain Generator and Air-Dropped Minefield.

[b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Kikaku[/b][/b]'s attack aircraft are equipped with Smoke Curtain Generator, which can set smoke screens just like ships with Smoke Generators.

[b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Concord Bridge[/b][/b]'s bombers are armed with the Air-Dropped Minefield consumable. When activated, it calls in another aircraft to deploy a minefield within a circular area below the position of the squadron at the point of activation. The mines don't arm immediately, but once they do, they deal damage to any enemy ships that collide with them, and they have high chances of causing flooding.

[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tier VII–VIII aircraft carriers, cruisers, battleships, and destroyers in a 9 vs. 9 format.
[*]Eligible aircraft carriers aren’t limited to [b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Kikaku[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Concord Bridge[/b][/b]; all classes are allowed.[/list]

[h2][b][h1=european-destroyers][/h1]European Destroyers Are Available to Everyone[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea88891a-2218-11ee-a9b1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

When Update 12.6 goes live, the European destroyers will become available for all players to research.

These newcomers are artillery destroyers that primarily rely on their main battery guns in battle.
[list][*]They are exclusively armed with HE shells; starting from Tier VIII, the shells have flat-trajectory ballistics.
[*]The high-speed torpedoes of the new European destroyers should be considered as secondary armament in most situations due to their low damage and rather short range.
[*]The highlight of this branch is the consumable combination of Smoke Generator and Surveillance Radar, the latter of which is available from Tier VIII and features a long range but a short action time. The destroyers are also equipped with Engine Boost.
[*]The new ships have mediocre speed and poor concealment, but higher-tier representatives boast large HP pools.[/list]
[h2][b][h1=armory][/h1]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e9c37aa8-2218-11ee-bbd0-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Warship Strike[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 11 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Fri. 01 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Warship Strike is back in the Armory! You’ll again be tasked with fighting against AI in a 1 vs. 1 format. To participate in the minigame, you'll need special Strike Passes. You can purchase them in limited quantities in exchange for in-game resources and in unlimited quantities for Doubloons. One Pass costs [b]250[/b] Doubloons.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c229bf1e-2184-11ee-b4bb-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c1be3046-2184-11ee-b9b2-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The rewards have also changed: this time, they are chosen at random and include ships and Doubloons, among other possibilities.
[h3][i]Rewards for sinking ships[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[list][*][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img]Destroyer: 2x common economic bonuses of each type
[*][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img]Cruiser: 3x common economic bonuses of each type
[*][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img]Battleship: 5x common economic bonuses of each type
[*][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.png[/img]Aircraft carrier: 6x common economic bonuses of each type[/list][/expand]
[h3][i]Rewards for gaining victory[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
You can receive one item from the following list (the percentage indicates the drop chances of each group of items):
[list][*][b]350[/b] Doubloons — 4.5%
[*]11x special economic bonuses of the same type — 15% for each type
[*][b]6,250[/b] Free XP — 12.5%
[*][b]18,750[/b] Elite Commander XP — 12.5%

[quote][i]Warship Strike can be played in the game client and on the Armory website.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Van Speijk[/h2]
With the release of Update 12.6, [b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Van Speijk[/b][/b] will become available in the Armory for [b]46,500[/b] Research Points.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/78c49462-2188-11ee-8871-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
In 1938, the Netherlands decided to strengthen their fleet, and new designs similar to Scharnhorst were introduced in 1939. The authorities were set on reducing the size of the ship for economic reasons. They favored a 16,000-ton cruiser with a projected speed of 33 knots and either 240 mm or 280 mm main battery guns; however, they eventually had to settle on a smaller caliber for the project.

The cruiser is armed with nine 203 mm main battery guns that don't have a particularly long range of fire. She also comes with HE Bomb Airstrike. This armament boasts an extensive action range but takes a lot of time to reload and is limited to only one flight. Other strengths of the ship include a well-armored citadel and decent concealment.

The cruiser has also access to Hydroacoustic Search, Defensive AA Fire, and Repair Party with a reduced reload time in separate slots.

[h2]Naval Community[/h2]
With the release of Update 12.6, the following items will be removed from the Naval Community tab of the Armory:
[list][*]The Symbols of Yukon bundle

[*]The Japanese Castle permanent camouflage for [b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Fusō[/b][/b]
[*]The Stars 'n' Stripes permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Texas[/b][/b]
[*]The More Camouflages container[/list]
The following items will be added to the Naval Community tab:
[list][*]A bundle with "The Beautiful Game" flag and patch, available for [b]4,000[/b] Community Tokens
[*]The Wings of Courage permanent camouflage, available for [b]2,000[/b] Community Tokens
[*]The Bionic permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Pensacola[/b][/b], available for [b]4,000[/b] Community Tokens
[*]The Orca permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Huron[/b][/b], available for [b]6,000[/b] Community Tokens
[*]The Blazing Tropics permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Atlanta[/b][/b], available for [b]8,000[/b] Community Tokens
[*]The Independence Day permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Colorado[/b][/b], available for [b]8,000[/b] Community Tokens[/list]

[h2][b][h1=battle-of-the-somme-collection][/h1]Battle of the Somme Collection[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e9974578-2218-11ee-a9b1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 27 Jul. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 24 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

A week after the release of Update 12.6, a new collection—Battle of the Somme—will become available. It commemorates one of the most immense battles of World War I, which took place from July 1, 1916 through November 18 of the same year on both banks of the River Somme. It was a confrontation between the armies of the British Empire and French Third Republic on one side and the forces of the German Empire on the other side.

To complete this collection, you'll need 60 different elements that the new Battle of the Somme containers can drop. These containers can be obtained in the Armory in exchange for Doubloons and in the Premium Shop. They are also rewarded for completing combat missions, and the number of containers you can earn this way will be sufficient to complete the entire collection. The exchange rate for duplicate elements is 2:1.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/392b56aa-2189-11ee-a7fb-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We'll reveal the contents of this container on [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/contents-and-drop-rates-of-containers/]our website[/url] with the release of Update 12.6.

The rewards for completing the collection are [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Somme[/b][/b], a ship that's kin to [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Jutland[/b][/b], with the unique "Lest We Forget" permanent camouflage and a Commander with 10 skill points.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/392f2744-2189-11ee-b382-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=economic-changes][/h1]Economic Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e9ab6e04-2218-11ee-9cc3-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

Starting with Update 12.6, we'll be adding Operations to the majority of combat missions. Due to the specifics of this battle type, it's easier to fulfil the requirements of some combat missions in Operations; so as not to change the difficulty of missions in other battle types, results achieved in Operations will be reduced by a certain factor.

For certain metrics, the progress in combat missions and Personal Challenges will be halved when playing in Operations. For example, if a mission requires you to earn two "Destroyed" ribbons, you’ll need to earn four such ribbons if you decide to go for it in Operations. Another way to complete this mission would be by earning one ribbon in a Random Battle and two ribbons in Operations.

When the reduction factor is applied to combat missions, the Operations icon will display a special indication.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/430f31fa-2215-11ee-85d7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=brawls][/h1]Brawls[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea413f24-2218-11ee-9275-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

Update 12.6 features four Brawls in different formats.

[h3][i]Brawl 1[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Fri. 21 Jul. 10:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Format: 5 vs. 5 playing Tier IX ships; no more than two battleships and three destroyers. You can participate in a Division of up to five players.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Brawl 2[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Format: 4 vs. 4 playing Tier VIII submarines, destroyers, cruisers, and battleships; no more than one submarine, two battleships, and two destroyers. You can participate in a Division of up to four players.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Brawl 3[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Format: 4 vs. 4 playing Tier X battleships. You can participate in a Division of up to two players.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Brawl 4[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Format: 3 vs. 3 playing Tier X ships; no more than one submarine, one aircraft carrier, two destroyers, two cruisers, and two battleships. You can participate in a Division of up to three players.
[/expand]

[h2][b][h1=division-star][/h1]Division Star[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/385e91e8-222d-11ee-aee2-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

The Division Star is a special event in which you can earn extra rewards by playing together with your Clanmates.
[list][*]You can earn a Division Star by playing in a Division with your Clanmates.
[*]Stars can be earned in all battle types, except for Training Battles.
[*]Certain numbers of earned Stars unlock access to various rewards.
[*]If you switch Clans, any Stars and rewards you previously received remain with you.[/list]

By playing together with your Clanmates, you can earn a total of up to three Stars—one for each fulfilled requirement:
[list][*]Winning a battle.
[*]Earning the "Shoulder to Shoulder" Division achievement.
[*]Earning the "Coordinated Attack" Division achievement.[/list]  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42e1eb3c-2215-11ee-bbd0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=technical-improvements][/h1]Technical Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/eabdf00a-2218-11ee-a48d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Settings Menu Improvements[/h2]
In Update 12.6, we've completely reworked the Settings menu interface.

All available parameters are now divided into [b]eight sections[/b]: Display, Graphics, Audio, HUD, Camera, Mouse, Keyboard/Controls, and Other. Certain settings have been removed, while others have been merged together.

The interface changes introduced in this update aim to enhance user experience by providing a simpler and more convenient way to personalize the game to your liking! Furthermore, "under the hood" enhancements have been implemented so that we can seamlessly add new settings in the future.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9132b392-2216-11ee-939c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Recruiting Station Combat Missions[/h2]
Update 12.6 delivers missions with requirements specifically designed for Recruiters and their Shipmates. Team up in Divisions to progress through them and earn rewards!

[quote][i]Only Division members who are in a "Recruiter-Shipmate" relationship with at least one other Division mate will have their progress towards the Recruiting Station combat missions counted.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Replay Improvements[/h2]
[list][*]We've added the post-battle statistics screen to the end of replays.
[*]We've also added a "Watch Again" button.[/list]
[h2]Twitch Drops[/h2]
Twitch Drops are back in Update 12.6. We took advantage of this break to make a technical improvement that will allow users to request and receive Twitch Drops without the need to re-log into their accounts.

[h2][b][h1=game-balance-changes][/h1]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/380ed8a6-222d-11ee-bec1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

We’re tuning the balance of certain ships based on our analysis of their combat effectiveness and your feedback. The changes will affect U.S. researchable hybrid battleships and British cruiser [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Hawkins[/b][/b].

[h3][b]Tier V British cruiser Hawkins[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The shell ballistics have been changed and are now characterized by a flatter trajectory.
[*]The armor penetration capabilities of AP shells have been improved.[/list]
[h2][b][h1=content-additions-and-changes][/h1]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea69cb06-2218-11ee-85d7-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

The game will feature:
[list][*]Commanders [b]José Prudencio Padilla[/b] and [b]Pavel Nakhimov[/b]
[*]Commanders [b]Fyodor Apraksin[/b], [b]Murat Serezli[/b], and [b]Hua Hu[/b] with individual voiceovers[/list]  [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/28f9bca2-2217-11ee-a48d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]200 Years of the Colombia Navy and Telnyashka flags[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/28c72562-2217-11ee-8115-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]200 Years of the Colombian Navy patch[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/284989ea-2217-11ee-9275-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Four emblems for Pan-American ships[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2966392c-2217-11ee-a9b1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Prince Dmitry Pozharsky permanent camouflage for [b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Dmitry Pozharsky[/b][/b][/list]  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a7f2aca2-224f-11ee-b31b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]An individual voiceover for Commander [b]Minakami Shiori[/b][/list]
[quote][i]In Update 12.7, Ranked and Clan Tokens will be removed from the game, and players will receive compensation in the form of Steel. As long as that Update is live, camouflages that are available in exchange for Ranked and Clan Tokens will also be available for Steel. More info on these changes will follow at a later date.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Container Changes[/h2]

[h2][b][h1=other-changes-and-improvements][/h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/384338da-222d-11ee-9518-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-126-spanish-cruisers/#concealed-maneuvers][/url]Lantern Lights[/h2]
We’ve prepared a chain of combat missions to celebrate the traditional Japanese Obon Festival.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list][*]The starting number of points in the updated Domination mode in Co-op Battles has been increased from 150 to 200.
[*]Fixed the behavior of AI-powered bots in the following Operations: Aegis, Raptor Rescue, Narai, and Defense of Naval Station Newport.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the sonar indicator to be displayed incorrectly on a target that was hit by a sonar ping.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the text input field in the game chat to stop working when switching between Armory tabs.
[*]Fixed an issue in Operation Killer Whale that could prevent a battle from finishing in defeat when all player ships were destroyed after completing the initial primary task but prior to receiving the second one.
[*]Removed visual artifacts on the following maps: The Faroe Islands, Fault Line, and Seychelles.
[*]Removed visual artifacts in the following Ports: Saint Petersburg, Zipangu, and Naval Base.
[*]Fixed an issue that affected the Epic Games Store overlay loading and the friend list display.
[*]Fixed an issue that made it impossible to switch to the Binocular View when opening the game menu or hovering over the Minimap while pressing [b]Shift[/b].
[*]Updated the historical descriptions of U.S. ships.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Commander [b]Michiel de Ruyter[/b] not to be marked as "Historical" in the Captain's Logbook.
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented players from getting a reward for completing a global mission chain.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it impossible to activate Combat Instructions with the Airstrike or torpedo armaments selected.
[*]We've added tooltips to the conditions of combat missions to be completed to earn certain achievements.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused excessive CPU load when loading the game.
[*]Fixed the incorrect display of deep-water torpedo tech specs when a Commander's skills were in effect or when equipment was active in combat.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused [b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Manfred von Richthofen[/b][/b]'s catapults to be misaligned.
[*]Fixed the incorrect sigma parameter for Hull B of [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] North Carolina[/b][/b]. Now, it's the same as for Hull A and amounts to 2.05 instead of 2.0.
[*]Reduced the cost of shells for [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Cheshire[/b][/b] from [b]275[/b] to [b]250[/b] Credits.[/list]

notes.notes:
[url=steam://run/1248250][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/8495af204654afb129f8a12c44c02d0c2e13176d.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Captains![/b]

Joining the Public Test is a great way to earn containers with Premium ships, permanent and expendable camouflages, and other valuable items. This time, we're providing you with an opportunity to obtain [b]European Tokens[/b]—you'll need these to unlock Early Access to European destroyers! notes.title: The Return of Convoy in Update 12.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/84b92a52d456ff416beb356cde109e5cc873a291.jpg[/img]
[b]The Convoy temporary battle type is back in the game in Update 12.4.[/b]

You're once again tasked with defending or attacking transport ships that are en route to their destination point with essential supplies.

The principles behind the Convoy battle type are based on real historical events. In the past, sea battles didn't only involve warships clashing and aerial assaults. A significant aspect of naval confrontations involved defending or attacking the shipping lanes that were being used to transport strategically important cargo.

[quote][i]Convoy will be available throughout Update 12.4.[/i][/quote]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#what-has-changed]What Has Changed[/url]
[url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#combat-missions]Combat Missions[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=what-has-changed][/h1]What Has Changed[/b][/h2]
Update 12.4 delivers the following changes:
[list][*]We've added one more map—you'll be fighting tooth and nail on Haven.
[*]We've updated the behavior of bot ships—transport ships will now change their speed to avoid torpedoes instead of changing course.
[*]We've improved the battle type interface.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d0b8b34-f962-11ed-a358-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d3fda74-f962-11ed-b1f0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d099d60-f962-11ed-ad3c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d3bf0b2-f962-11ed-b64e-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 25 May 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 22 Jun. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h3][i]Defending and attacking[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed between the two teams. You can enter each battle either alone or as part of a Division of up to three players.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Team missions[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
The defending team needs to escort convoys of cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one convoy ship reaches her destination point or the entire enemy team is sent back to Port. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Transport ships[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
All convoys are made up of Liberty-class transport ships. They have little HP and weak armor. On the other hand, they can deploy smoke screens and change speed to avoid enemy torpedoes. In addition, these ships are armed with two main battery guns and twelve secondary battery guns that are capable of firing at approaching opponents. They also have AA defenses to repel air attacks.
[/expand]
[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
[list][*]12 vs. 12 with Tier VIII—X ships.[/list]
[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3]
North, Hotspot, Trap, Two Brothers, Tears of the Desert, Haven, Crash Zone Alpha.

[quote][i]Depending on the map, the convoys can follow two or three routes at the same time, leading to one or several destinations.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
Your successes in Convoy will be rewarded with special themed achievements:
[table][tr][th][b][b]Achievement Name[/b][/b][/th][th][b][b]Condition[/b][/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86f7b8-ebd8-11ec-822f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] [b]Living Shield[/b][/td] [td]Receive two torpedo hits from the opponent while being within a 2-kilometer radius of an allied ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86c1c6-ebd8-11ec-8e96-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] [b]Neat Job[/b][/td] [td]Win by destroying all the transport ships and without losing any allied ships. [b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 11 Apr. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of the Public Test for Update 12.3! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fixed visual errors in the Kure Dockyard, the Seychelles map, and the Zipangu Port.
[*]Fixed an incorrect description in the tooltip about the usage of Burst Fire at the beginning of a battle.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the incorrect display of the parameters of skip-bombers in the tooltips in battle.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the Seychelles map to fail to display the islands on the tactical map due to fog.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the last attack flight of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_8f3e3f4bb152e80cc8fb2cc34d426c6d85d57b72014c768883384055a2c2f3f7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Graf Zeppelin[/b][/b]'s torpedo bombers to drop two torpedoes instead of three.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=combat-missions-and-rewards][/h1]Combat Missions and Rewards[/b][/h2]
Progress through combat missions on the Public Test Server to earn Community Tokens. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

[quote][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[b]Please note:[/b] The Battle Pass rewards on the Public Test Server differ from the rewards on the 12.3 Live Server.[/i][/quote]

When you first enter the 12.3 Public Test Server during Rounds 1 and 2, you will be credited with [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]750[/b] Coal and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]100[/b] Doubloons on the Live Server for each round.

[quote]Public Test 12.3 includes special missions that will bring you rewards on the Live Server.[/quote]
[h3][i][h3][b]Recurring Combat Missions[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Earn 12,000 Base XP in Random and Co-op Battles, as well as in Brawls, playing Tier VI–X ships and superships.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] [b]1,600[/b] Community Tokens.
[hr][/hr]
Earn 1,000 Base XP in Random and Co-op Battles.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]2,500[/b] Free XP; [b]200[/b] Community Tokens; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000[/b] Credits.

[quote][i]This combat mission will only be available on the [b]second[/b] and [b]third days[/b] of each round of the Public Test. The mission [b]refreshes[/b] at 02:00 UTC.[/i][/quote]

[h3][i][h3][b]First Combat Mission Chain[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Deal damage, earn Base XP, and obtain "Destroyed" ribbons. [b]The rewards on the Live Server[/b] are 1x Tactical Special container and 6x Golden Week containers.

[quote][i]You can complete the combat mission chain in Random and Co-op Battles, as well as in Brawls, playing Tier VI–X ships and superships. The chain is available for completion throughout the entire duration of Public Test 12.3.[/i][/quote]

[h3][i][h3][b]Second Combat Mission Chain[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Gain victories, earn Base XP, deal damage, and obtain "Destroyed" ribbons. [b]Rewards on the Live Server:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] Free XP; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]700[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]800,000[/b] Credits; and [b]10,000[/b] Elite Commander XP.

[quote][i]You can complete the combat mission chain in Random and Ranked Battles, as well as in Brawls, playing Tier VI–X ships and superships. The chain is [b]available for completion three times per day[/b] between the following times: 11:00–15:00 UTC; 17:00–21:00 UTC; and 22:00–02:00 UTC. You can complete all the missions three times and obtain the associated rewards three times each day.[/i][/quote]

[quote][i]You can find more details about the chains in the Public Test client.[/i][/quote]

Players who join the 12.3 Public Test Server will also receive the following rewards on the Live Server: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]250[/b] Doubloons, 2x More Coal containers, and 1x Tactical Special container.

[quote]In total during Public Test 12.3, you can obtain up to [b]7,500[/b] Community Tokens; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]25,100[/b] Coal; 4x Tactical Special containers; 2x More Coal containers; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]450[/b] Doubloons; 6x Golden Week containers; 14x Pioneer camouflages; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]150,000[/b] Free XP; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]24,400,000[/b] Credits; and [b]280,000[/b] Elite Commander XP.[/quote] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=starting-bonuses][/h1]Starting Bonuses[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]You'll be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]
If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 12.2, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*]All researchable Tier VI and VIII ships with 21-skill-point Commanders
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] Credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] Doubloons; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]250,000[/b] Coal; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Warships Premium Account[/b].
[*]Sets with expendable economic bonuses and 50 signals.[/list]
[quote]If you fought at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 12.2 Public Test, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.[/quote]
[quote][i]If you're joining the Public Test for the first time after an account transfer, you will only receive the standard starting bonuses.[/i][/quote]

[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 07 Feb. 06:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of the Public Test for Update 12.1! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes applied to Unique Upgrades. Details are available in a post on the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/414]Development Blog[/url].
[*]The settings of the updated Domination mode have been adjusted: the starting number of points for teams is 150; the reward for destroying an enemy ship is 40 points; and the penalty for losing an allied ship is 25 points.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which the client could crash during the start or end of a battle.
[*]Fixed a bug with the position of the ship in the port of Fjords.[/list]
[h2]Special Features of the Test[/h2]
Brawl test stages will be available on the Public Test Server.

[h3][b]Brawl 1[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tier VIII ships in a 1 vs. 1 format.
[*]All ship types are available.[/list]
[h3][b]Brawl 2[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tier X ships in a 3 vs. 3 format.
[*]All ship types are available.
[*]You can participate in a Division of up to three players.[/list]
[quote][i]Restrictions: No more than one aircraft carrier, one submarine, two cruisers, two destroyers, and two battleships.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

[quote][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[b]Please note:[/b] The Battle Pass rewards on the Public Test Server differ from the rewards on the 12.1 Live Server.[/i][/quote]

[h2][b][h1=shared-combat-missions][/h1]Global Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
Global combat missions are being introduced into the game in Update 12.1. Their goal will be common to all players on the server, and each participant will contribute to the mission progress. Global combat missions can be represented both by chains and individual missions.

After completing a global combat mission, all players who participated in it will receive the final reward. It's possible to complete global combat missions before their official deadlines. If this happens, only those players who actually contributed to the mission progress will receive the reward.

During Public Test 12.1, you will be able to try out the modified Domination mode with three Key Areas for Random Battles. The new settings are aimed at eliminating situations where battles are too long or too short.

[h3][b]New Settings[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Starting number of points at the beginning of battle: [b]200[/b]
[*]Points when destroying an enemy ship: [b]+40 [/b]for all ship types
[*]Points when losing a ship: [b]–32[/b] for all ship types[/list]
The modified Domination mode will be added to the following maps: New Dawn, Fault Line, Shards, Trident, Neighbors, Crash Zone Alpha, Northern Waters, and Faroe Islands. We will decide on the final fate of the modified Domination based on the results of testing the new settings.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3739ce78-98a7-11ed-9911-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/376c87aa-98a7-11ed-8900-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

Added interactive music for submarines. It will match the special stealthy gameplay of submarines. The music will change depending on several factors:

Updated the display of squadrons on the decks of aircraft carriers in the Port and in battle. Aircraft carrier decks now display all types of squadrons available on the ship. The number of aircraft of each squadron on deck is equal to the size of the attacking flight.

notes.title: Airship Escort in Update 12.0
notes.notes:
[url=https://youtu.be/ELoYdW4K-i0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3dbb9f83343c92115f6ac98116a4bfb951991543.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]The battle type that tasks you with escorting airships returns to the game with some improvements and a new name.[/b]

Airships historically carried intelligence agents bearing important messages and diplomats traveling to conduct secret negotiations in neutral territories.

Your objectives are to delay the hostile airship while also making sure that your allied airship is the first to reach the destination point.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#maps]Maps[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=ELoYdW4K-i0;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6ea297b6-9666-11ed-a5fb-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Restrictions[/b][/h3]
The battle type involves Tier VIII–X ships of all types fighting in teams of 12.

[h3][b]The Task[/b][/h3]
Lead your allied airship to its destination before the opposing team does or destroy all hostile ships.

Ships can affect the speed of the allied or opposing airships by staying within an interactive zone near each one:
[list][*]Airships move at a standard speed if there are no players within its interactive zone.
[*]Airships accelerate if only allied ships are within the borders of their interactive zones.
[*]Airships slow down if at least one opposing ship is within the borders of their interactive zones.[/list]
If your team simultaneously speeds up the allied airship and slows down the opposing airship, the allied airship now receives additional acceleration. This change will help prevent situations that previously occurred where battles continued for too long when one of the teams was able to gain a serious lead over the opposing team. At the same time, the base airship speed has been reduced to prevent battles between equal teams from ending too quickly.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53a1bb68-91bb-11ed-a5e9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5302aeec-91bb-11ed-9210-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5302706c-91bb-11ed-bf11-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53a7887c-91bb-11ed-b837-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/52fcb5aa-91bb-11ed-924c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/52f38958-91bb-11ed-95c1-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
While staying within the interactive zone of any airship, players earn acceleration and slowdown points, plus some extra Credits and XP per battle.

The interface of the battle type has been revamped:
[list][*]New hints that pop up in battle have been added, and the old ones have been updated.
[*]The airship icons and movement progress bar have been changed.
[*]The display of airship routes on the Minimap has been updated.
[*]We've added new quick commands that can be activated by clicking the icon on the airship movement bar.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/52fc5754-91bb-11ed-b6e7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Complete special daily and weekly combat missions to obtain Community Tokens.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0126e752-95b0-11ed-9766-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[h3][i]Daily mission[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Win an Airship Escort battle.
[list][*][b]Reward:[/b] [b][b]30[/b][/b] Community Tokens[/list][/expand]
[h3][i]Weekly missions[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Earn 5,000 base XP in Airship Escort.
[list][*][b]Reward:[/b] [b][b]350[/b][/b] Community Tokens[/list]
Earn 15,000 base XP in Airship Escort.
[list][*][b]Reward:[/b] [b][b]400[/b][/b] Community Tokens[/list]
Earn 50,000 base XP in Airship Escort.
[list][*][b]Reward:[/b] [b][b]550[/b][/b] Community Tokens[/list][/expand]
[h3][b]The most skilled players can unlock special achievements.[/b][/h3] [table][tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_VICTORYCLAIMED_69f3f26161a92dd6a92c2b17a89f4855d27bcd27edbb186526e63f6731e1a70a.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Snatched Glory[/h3][/td] [td]Win by destroying all opposing ships when the opposing airship is near the very end of its route.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_STOPPER_3aeaa3429f32b9e28bffaeeccb5a935f63d4cd64a21243aae2b7822dbd7317f9.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Held at Bay[/h3][/td] [td]Continuously slow down the opposing airship for 1 minute.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_5MINUTESWINNER_35b0206a2d60ffa59bba9efe2147cb9e03aa509450db536e8e8e2dcefbe4e54c.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Relentless[/h3][/td] [td]Win by constantly staying close to the allied airship over the last 5 minutes of a battle.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_PHOTOFINISH_7615de9bed90f541457240ea4f3a170edf51d628a1efab890076fe931cb1b772.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Photo Finish[/h3][/td] [td]Win by bringing your allied airship to the destination point with a slight lead over the opposing airship while also speeding up the allied airship or slowing down the opposing airship at the end of the battle.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_INCENTER_1bc8a7b88d570ac4fd77ce3eb1a1f5ec5835bc49d912a978cbf3ae1562666793.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Push Ahead, Hold Them Back[/h3][/td] [td]Simultaneously speed up your allied airship and slow down the opposing airship.[/td][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=maps][/h1]Maps[/b][/h2]
We've updated the routes for several old maps and added several new ones.
[list][*]Battles will be fought on the following maps: Shards, Sea of Fortune, Trident, Warrior's Path, Estuary, Hotspot, Islands of Ice, North, and Shatter.
[*]The routes for maps Trident, Warrior's Path, Estuary, Hotspot, and Islands of Ice have been updated.[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: The 5 USD Bounty Challenge Just Got Easier!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/19b78fa043402380837d56f9dbf379f49be0eb41.png[/img]

Happy December, Captains!

To celebrate the huge popularity of our[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/552990/view/6368678185299597546] 5th Anniversary event[/url]—and in the spirit of the holiday season—we’ve prepared a surprise update for all our new players hunting the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/552990/view/6368678185299597546]5 USD Steam Credit bounty[/url].

[h3] Now it's 5 times easier to get your free credit — you just need to get the “Amateur” achievement! This achievement is granted whenever you win your [b] first 10 Random Battles![/b] [/h3]

You’ll know you’ve qualified to win when you’ve earned the “Amateur” achievement in the game client, which in total should take you no more than 3 to 4 hours of playtime.

And one last thing: to honor our most active players, we will send [b]1 Santa's Gift container[/b] and [b]1 Steam Container[/b] to all players who have earned the Warrior achievement at the event end!


[b]Terms and conditions:[/b]

[expand type=showmore ]
[list]
[b][*]If you already had the “Amateur” achievement before November 17th, you can still get 5 USD earning the “Warrior” achievement for winning 50 Random Battles.
[*]If you didn't have the “Amateur” achievement before November 17th and earned both the “Amateur” and the “Warrior” achievements, you will get a Steam container and a Santa container as a bonus.[/b]
[*]The achievement must be unlocked in the game client in your World of Warships account in order to be validated. This is not to be confused with the Steam Achievements.
[*]While the achievement must be unlocked during the event’s duration, not all progress toward the achievement needs to occur in the same time frame.
[*]The Warrior achievement can only be earned once.
[*]The reward will be issued only once per user, no later than 1 week after the event ends.
[*]By participating in the event, you accept the applicable Rules of the World of Warships game and Clans. All winners will be subject to anti-bot checks before prizes are distributed. Duplicate accounts will not be rewarded.
[*]By participating in the event, you accept the "5 USD Bounty Challenge" promotion rules available below. Please note that if you win a reward, your Steam ID will be shared with Valve Corporation to enable crediting of the reward to your Steam Wallet account.
[/list]

Detailed rules of the event can be found [url=https://eu-wotp.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/document/promotion_rules_wows_english_edit.pdf]here[/url].[/expand]


[b]Happy anniversary, Captains![/b]

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.9
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#early-access-to-submarines]Early Access to U.S. and German Submarines[/url]
[url=#personal-challenges]Personal Challenges[/url]
[url=#operation-wolfpack]Operation Wolfpack[/url]
[url=#technical-updates]Technical Updates[/url]
[url=#halloween]Halloween[/url]
[url=#other-changes]Other Changes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=early-access-to-submarines][/h1]Early Access to U.S. and German Submarines[/b][/h2]
We are pleased to introduce a new ship type—submarines! We worked hard to prepare submarines for their eventual release during their time in testing. We've tweaked their mechanics and the ways they interact with other ship types based on the test results, statistics, and player feedback.

Following the latest round of changes to this ship type, we're confident that submarines in their current state fit well into the gameplay of World of Warships and are ready to be introduced into the game on a permanent basis. U.S. and German submarines will be the first full-fledged representatives to emerge (or submerge!) in the game.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cedb1ae8-329f-11ed-9f00-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cee6857c-329f-11ed-bd80-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cedec652-329f-11ed-a759-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cee40bf8-329f-11ed-9a9a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
German and U.S. Tier VI and VIII submarines will arrive in Early Access. They can be obtained from sequential bundles in the Armory in exchange for [b]Submarine Tokens[/b].

The Tokens can be obtained by completing Personal Challenges that await you in Update 0.11.9; in exchange for Community Tokens; and from random bundles for Doubloons.

Submarines can also be obtained from the new Submarines containers.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/86c1cd88-32a4-11ed-aed8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]You'll be able to reset all of your Commanders' skills if you so wish and remove upgrades free of charge during the first 2 weeks after Update 0.11.9 goes live. To automatically reset skills of all your Commanders for free, you'll need to click a button in a special article on our website.[/list]
For several updates after the release of Update 0.11.9, we don't plan to make significant changes to the gameplay of submarines, their settings, and the way they interact with other ship types, unless there is a critical need to do so. This will allow them to catch on in the game and give players an opportunity to acclimatize to the new ship type. In the meantime, we'll be able to collect the most up-to-date and accurate statistics. At the same time, small balance changes will still be made when necessary.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=personal-challenges][/h1]Personal Challenges[/b][/h2]
Personal Challenges will become available again during Update 0.11.9. For this iteration, we've updated the interface, as well as diversified the mission completion criteria.

As before, Personal Challenges are divided into two stages of 2 weeks each. During the first stage, you need to earn ribbons; during the second stage, you need to earn Base XP. In future iterations, new conditions will be added, such as damage dealt.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/97f27d52-32ac-11ed-ad45-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/96d4c038-32ac-11ed-874d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list]As a reward for completing missions, you'll earn Submarine Tokens, which are required to obtain submarines in Early Access, as well as Coal.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=operation-wolfpack][/h1]Operation Wolfpack[/b][/h2]
Special Operation Wolfpack is dedicated to the release of submarines. It will allow players to get to grips with the new ship type and its gameplay.

The Operation is inspired by real World War II events—submarines hunting for convoys.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
Players fight at the helms of Tier VI and VIII submarines in a team of seven.

An enemy convoy with strategic cargo breaks through neutral waters. A combat squadron rushes to help the convoy.

[b]Your objective[/b] is to break through the lines of escorting warship groups and destroy the transport ships before they reach their destination point and meet with reinforcements. During the Operation, the submarine squadron will be provided with air support from allied aircraft.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3a0749a-32ac-11ed-b68b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3cb9abc-32ac-11ed-90be-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3b432d2-32ac-11ed-8fe0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=technical-updates][/h1]Technical Updates[/b][/h2]
We've returned the movement effect of sonar pings emitted by submarines. It was good at drawing the attention of both the targeted player and their allies to the attacking submarine. Combined with the ping launch effect that appears on the surface of the water, it will allow you to locate a submarine more accurately and attack her more effectively.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6fca6dc8-32a5-11ed-aed8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Added new ribbons for depth charges. They will more clearly show the effectiveness of dropping bombs on submarines:
[table][tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/36e2dbfa-32a3-11ed-aed8-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]The "Hit" ribbon is awarded when a submarine receives full damage from a depth charge.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/37048c5a-32a3-11ed-a3f6-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]The "Splash Damage" ribbon is awarded when a submarine receives partial damage from a depth charge.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Adding Automatic ASW for Aircraft Carriers[/h2]
All aircraft carriers of Tier VI and above will receive a variant of Depth Charge Airstrike that functions automatically. It will not serve as a tool for hunting submarines; it will only give aircraft carriers a means of defense against submarines that deploys even when the ship's Captain is controlling squadrons.

Depth Charge Airstrike will activate if a submarine or signs of her presence, such as oil spots on the water or the effect of using sonar, are detected within the armament's range. An airstrike will be carried out taking any necessary lead into account. At the same time, the submarine will have the opportunity to evade if she effectively maneuvers in time.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c967a6fc-32a5-11ed-9729-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=halloween][/h1]Halloween[/b][/h2]
Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness await players this year as part of the Halloween celebrations.

Operation Saving Transylvania will be available as Operation of the Week in the first week of the update; Sunray in the Darkness—in the second week. Players will be able to complete them as part of a Division throughout Update 0.11.9. Both Operations will be available at the normal difficulty level. Standard Operations will be available for completion during Update 0.11.9 as part of a Division only. With the release of Update 0.11.10, Operations of the Week will be replaced by Random Operations again.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/554d8632-32a6-11ed-9729-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55526044-32a6-11ed-af91-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94b7c224-32a6-11ed-8d29-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The update also brings back the Twilight Battle temporary battle type, which is familiar to players from Halloween 2018, with minor visual improvements. Let's take a refresher on the key rules of this event!

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29d3e35c-32a6-11ed-87c3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29db1d02-32a6-11ed-bd80-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2a2b47dc-32a6-11ed-8c0b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Two teams of seven players each clash against each other playing special ships on the map from Operation Sunray in the Darkness. The [b]key objective[/b] is to destroy all enemy ships. At the same time, the water area is gradually taken over by the Filth, and the safe zone for ships continuously shrinks. Ships outside the safe zone receive damage depending on the ship type.

[list][i]Twilight Battle will become available 2 weeks after Update 0.11.9 goes live.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[h2]Changes to Commanders, skills, and upgrades[/h2]
A number of unique Commander talents, skills, and upgrades have been updated to bring them to a better balance and increase their versatility. More details are available on our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/367]Development Blog[/url].

We've also made improvements to the interface of the Commander Skills screen and Skills in Detail section. It's now possible in the Reserve to view the available Commanders of all nations, regardless of whether Captains have ships of those nations or not.
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6f17136-32a9-11ed-a6d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6c6551e-32a9-11ed-b06b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6dde62a-32a9-11ed-874d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]

[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 30 Aug. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.8! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes were applied to researchable Italian and German destroyers, as well as a number of other ships. Depth Charge Airstrike parameters have additionally been unified for all cruisers and battleships. Details are available on our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/364/]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Updated bot Tiers and fixed a number of bugs in Operations.
[*]The interface of the window displaying bonus gifts has been updated.
[*]Fixed a number of bugs in several different Ports.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which ships could get stuck near the islands on some maps.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the client to crash when playing in a submarine.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash when in spectator mode.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which characters were duplicated in the game chat text entry box when opening the tactical map.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

You can complete the mission all three times and obtain the rewards three times during the day.[/i][/list]

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]You will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]
If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.11.7, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*]At the start of the Public Test, every participant will have all researchable Tier VI and VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 19 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] Credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] Doubloons; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]250,000[/b] Coal; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Warships Premium Account[/b].
[*]Sets with expendable economic bonuses and 50 combat signals.[/list]
[list]If you played at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 0.11.7 Public Test, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.[/list]

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]

[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#wows-anniversary]World of Warships Anniversary[/url]
[url=#warship-strike]Warship Strike[/url]
[url=#reworked-operations]Reworked Operations[/url]
[url=#changes-to-the-reload-mechanics]Changes to the Reload Mechanics[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=wows-anniversary][/h1]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
This year, World of Warships is celebrating its seventh birthday! We've prepared various activities for our players in honor of the occasion.

[h2]Seven Seas Collection[/h2]
An important new feature that's also part of our birthday celebrations is the Seven Seas collection dedicated to historic ports that have been recreated in our game. The Seven Seas collection will let you take a fresh look at familiar locations from a new perspective and get to know some curious facts from the history of as many as 16 famous ports.

The collection elements can only be obtained from dedicated same-name containers. You can earn these containers by progressing through special chains of combat missions and also find them in free daily bundles in the Armory. Rest assured that those containers will be quite enough to complete the entire collection. The collection consists of four pages, with four elements on each.

[list][b]Reward for completing a page:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b].
[b][b]Reward for completing the collection:[/b][/b] bonus package for a Tier VII ship.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d29aed54-1c90-11ed-8872-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Note: The new collection will not be available on the Public Test Server.[/i][/list]

[h2]Festive Rewards[/h2]
To celebrate the Seventh Anniversary of World of Warships, we're bringing back gift bonuses for your performance in battles playing all ships of Tier V and above. This time, however, we've added an important enhancement—the ability to receive several gifts for a single battle!

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34c44aba-1c92-11ed-8944-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34cfef3c-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35f26caa-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3640f672-1c92-11ed-ad59-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35055c94-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
If a player has 100 or more ships, they will be able to receive a standard gift for a battle played with a ship, as well as extra bonus gifts that depend on the amount of Base XP earned. The old rule that you can't get gifts a second time playing the same ship applies as well.

Extra bonus gifts can be applied toward any other ship they have not been applied to, so you can "score" a gift for that ship without the need to actually hit the seas for battle at her helm.

The bonus gift rewards depend on your ship tier:
[list][*]For Tier V–VII ships, it's 1x Special Bonuses container
[*]For Tier VIII–IX ships, it's 1x Rare Bonuses container and 1x Special Bonuses container
[*]For Tier X ships and superships, it's 1x Supercontainer[/list]
The number of bonus gifts you receive after a battle depends on the number of ships you have in your Port and the amount of Base XP earned in that battle. For example, a player with a Port fleet exceeding 300 ships will be able to earn four gifts in one battle: one gift for entering battle with a ship and three gifts for effective action in battle.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/02f79758-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
The new [b][b]Special Bonuses container[/b][/b] drops Level 2 economic bonuses. 5x bonuses of one of the following types: "Credits [b]+40%[/b]," "Ship XP [b]+200%[/b]," "Commander XP [b]+200%[/b]," "Free XP [b]+600%[/b]."

The new [b][b]Rare Bonuses container[/b][/b] drops Level 3 economic bonuses. 3x bonuses of one of the following types: "Credits [b]+160%[/b]," "Ship XP [b]+800%[/b]," "Commander XP [b]+800%[/b]," "Free XP [b]+2,400%[/b]."
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=warship-strike][/h1]Warship Strike[/b][/h2]
One of the fresh activities that's getting released with Update 0.11.8 involves challenging AI in a new game codenamed "Warship Strike," inspired by a classic naval combat game. You can access the game via the Armory. You'll need a special resource—[b]a Strike Pass[/b]—to unlock access to it and play. Strike Passes can be earned by completing special combat missions.

You can pause any ongoing battle at any time and return to it later, and your progress will be saved. Battles can also be completed automatically. In that case, the AI completes the battle for you. The battle results will simply appear on the screen, and you'll receive all due rewards in the form of Festive Tokens. These are issued for sinking enemy ships and winning battles.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/64b9c772-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/649ba008-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
You can exchange these Tokens in the Armory for the option that suits your needs best:
[list][*]Permanent camouflages
[*]Bonus packages for ships
[*]Economic bonuses
[*]Containers with signals and resources
[*]Credits[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=reworked-operations][/h1]Reworked Operations[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.11.8, we've reworked all Operations in the game. The purpose of these changes is to give you the opportunity to participate in Operations playing more of your favorite ships and earn valuable rewards along the way.

Now, Tier VI to VIII ships can be matched in battle at the same time, and the final team lineup will have an effect on the strength of the bots and post-battle earnings. The "fee" for re-entering battle with the same ship will be removed.

The economy in effect in Operations will change as well. Previously, players earned Stars for completing an Operation, and the rewards could only be obtained once. We've removed Stars altogether, and the rewards can now be earned by progressing through dedicated daily and weekly combat missions specifically designed for Operations. The rewards are Community Tokens.

The Operation of the Week won't be available in Update 0.11.8. When playing on a team where your allies are selected automatically, an Operation will be picked at random. You will still be able to select an Operation of your liking when you are part of a Division.

[list][i]Update 0.11.8 brings back the following three Operations for the revamped game mode: The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, and Cherry Blossom.[/i][/list]

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85ea4502-1c92-11ed-9180-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8680b76c-1c92-11ed-a853-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/867fda04-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a2490a30-1c92-11ed-8944-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a248fce8-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a24937da-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3fcba64-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3fb9e72-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3719ef2-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=changes-to-the-reload-mechanics][/h1]Changes to the Reload Mechanics[/b][/h2]
We've changed the gun reload mechanics that are applied when switching shell type.

With the "Gun Feeder" Commander skill active, the shell type will now switch faster even if not all main battery guns are completely reloaded after a salvo (which was required prior to the change for the skill to take effect).

Shells now have a new parameter—"shell-type switching time."
[list][*]If the current gun reload time exceeds the shell-type switching time, shell switching will not affect the gun reload time.
[*]If the current gun reload time is shorter than the shell-type switching time, the gun reload time when switching shell types is equal to the shell-type switching time.[/list]
The Gun Feeder skill bonus applied to shell-type switching time has been changed from [b]–50%[/b] to [b]–40%[/b]. For example, if the standard gun reload time is 30 seconds, the shell-type switching time with the Gun Feeder skill activated will be 18 seconds, but the following should be kept in mind:
[list][*]If the remaining gun reload time is 20 seconds and you switch shell type, the reload time will still be 20 seconds.
[*]If only 5 seconds are left for the guns to reload, switching shell type will increase the gun reload time to 18 seconds.[/list]
[list][i]The new mechanics apply to each turret individually. Shell-type switching time will be shown in a ship's tech specs.[/i][/list]
Additionally, all researchable Italian battleships will have the "[b]–30%[/b] to shell-type switching time" bonus applied by default, which means that it will apply even when the Gun Feeder skill is inactive. Activating the skill will further increase this bonus.

Speaking of Italian battleships, switching between shell types frequently is an important gameplay component. The extra bonus will emphasize this feature and increase the effectiveness of using the Gun Feeder skill compared to battleships of other nations.
