notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#dockyard]Dockyard[/url]
[url=#camera-improvements]Camera Improvements[/url]
[url=#submarine-improvements]Submarine Improvements[/url]
[url=#british-battleships-part-2]British Battleships: Part 2[/url]
[url=#other-changes]Other Changes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=dockyard][/h1]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.7 kicks off the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] at the Dockyard. The ship is armed with twelve 305 mm guns placed in four main battery turrets. The cruiser's AP shells have good damage-dealing capabilities and enhanced ricochet angles. The ship also has a large HP pool and good armor protection.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 40 phases. These shipbuilding phases can be completed by progressing through Dockyard combat missions or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] Doubloons to pass through each phase. The combat missions span Update 0.11.7, 0.11.8, and the first three weeks of 0.11.9. The Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the start of Update 0.11.10.

[list]In total, you can progress through 34 out of 40 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions. Completing the 25th phase will reward you with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Huron[/b][/b] with a 6-skill-point Commander and a Port slot. The final reward is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] with the Ceremonial permanent camouflage, a Port slot, a Commander with 10 skill points, and a commemorative flag.[/list]
If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] and upon construction completion, you'll obtain a Puerto Rico Certificate, which can be exchanged in a special section of the Armory for one of the following rewards: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]35,000[/b] Doubloons, [b]33,000[/b] Steel, or [b]63,000[/b] Research Points. Thus, you'll be able to purchase any other available Tier X ship for completing shipbuilding phases at the Dockyard. If you do not exchange your Puerto Rico Certificate for one of the resources before the release of Update 0.11.10, you will automatically receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]35,000[/b] Doubloons when the update goes live.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e0aee92-0767-11ed-9ad0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e074c74-0767-11ed-88b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e0e3a52-0767-11ed-937a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=camera-improvements][/h1]Camera Improvements[/b][/h2]
The battle camera will be improved in Update 0.11.7 to make gameplay experience more comfortable.
[list][*]The base default view angle will be changed.
[*]The camera performance when using Spotting Aircraft will be improved: Now, a player has two camera positions to choose from to make aiming while using Spotting Aircraft more comfortable.

[list][*]Lower position, similar to the camera position without Spotting Aircraft.
[*]Upper position, similar to the current camera position when using Spotting Aircraft.[/list][/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6caa5666-0745-11ed-990b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ca0df28-0745-11ed-96e8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][*]New settings will be added.

[list][*]Field of view: The setting allows players to set the angle of view themselves. The setting does not affect the Binocular mode.
[*]Camera height: This allows you to raise and zoom out the camera from a ship.
[*]Airstrike alternative controls: Enables dynamic camera zoom based on distance when using Airstrike.[/list]
[*]When switching to Airstrike mode, the position of the main battery and torpedo launchers will be fixed.
[*]The camera view angle in the torpedo launcher view is similar to that in the main battery view.
[*]Improved camera performance when tracking flying shells and in replays.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=submarine-improvements][/h1]Submarine Improvements[/b][/h2]
Submarines will receive a number of improvements in Update 0.11.7.

[h3][b]The Hydrophone consumable will be split into two—Echo-Ranging Set and Low-Frequency Hydrophone.[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Echo-Ranging Set shows the position of surface ships and highlights the bottom topography.
[*]Low-Frequency Hydrophone allows you to detect submerged submarines.[/list]
Hydrophone combines two different tasks and is often used to perform only one, while the second is performed in vain. Splitting the consumable will make playing submarines more comfortable by enabling you to activate exactly the equipment you need at a given time.

Both consumables will be available on all submarines. The settings of the new consumable types will change from the current version of Hydrophone.

[h3][b]Disabled guaranteed detection for submarines in submerged position.[/b][/h3]
Due to interaction specifics, it is common for submarines to accidentally detect each other. Because of this, they come under an airstrike and are forced into a duel with no possibility of safely disengaging. Disabling guaranteed detection will make playing submarines more comfortable, and in case players want to attack an enemy submarine, they will be able to use Low-Frequency Hydrophone.

[h3][b]The visual effect above a submarine when using sonar will also be displayed for the submarine herself.[/b][/h3]
The change will make playing submarines clearer and help players better understand enemy submarine interaction.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=british-battleships-part-2][/h1]British Battleships: Part 2[/b][/h2]
The Port of London has been updated as part of the continuation of Early Access to British battleships.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b57bad4a-0745-11ed-8f93-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b57ef054-0745-11ed-9857-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b582065e-0745-11ed-b5c8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
Improved in-game shadow rendering for all presets. Added a new shadow quality preset—Very High. Increased detail level for High and Maximum presets.

Improved buoys. Increased model quality and added soft lamp flashing.

[list][b]The minimum system requirements have been increased to require full support for DX 11 SHADER MODEL 5_0. The minimum required graphics cards are now GeForce GTX 460/Radeon HD 5770/Intel HD Graphics 4000. It will not be possible to run the game client on older graphics cards.[/b][/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
The Port of Rio de Janeiro has been added to the game to celebrate the 200th anniversary of Brazil's independence.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82acc10a-0746-11ed-be95-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82a8e6ca-0746-11ed-9857-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82ac13a4-0746-11ed-8f93-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82acd6d6-0746-11ed-bf91-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Updated the drop rates of items from the "Two Titans—One King" Premium container. The containers that players have on their accounts will be changed accordingly with the release of the Update:
[list][*]Chances of dropping expendable camouflages reduced from 29% to 21%.
[*]Chances of dropping permanent camouflages increased from 7% to 12%.
[*]Chances of dropping Commanders increased from 14% to 15%.
[*]Chances of dropping expendable economic bonuses increased from 40% to 42%.
[*]Number of containers that must be opened to guarantee the acquisition of one of the permanent camouflages—unless dropped from one of the open containers—reduced from 35 to 20.[/list]

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added the ability to browse, sell and convert economic bonuses in the Inventory.
[*]While converting signal sets into economic bonuses, now only special signals are taken into account. Economic signals are converted separately. Thus, owners of special signals on the Live server will be able to get more economic bonuses of the third and fourth level.
[list][*]The Economic Bonus [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/economic-bonus-calculator/]Calculator[/url] will be updated along with this change.[/list]
[*]Made balance changes to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]★[/b] Clausewitz[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Collingwood[/b][/b], British battleships, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_America_e1c73e4294d3f8addc39872e23f6457e6f540a68db120d8bc5dec7e2034f83af.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Rio de Janeiro[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Hampshire[/b][/b], and submarines. Update 0.11.6 launches a whole new branch of Tier III to X British battleships into Early Access. Equipped with powerful torpedoes and main guns that don’t have a particularly long reach, the new sea giants will show their worth at medium- to knife-duel distances. The Repair Party consumable they have on board regenerates a decent chunk of any lost HP.

The battleships carry HE shells with standard penetration capabilities, their accuracy is fairly average, and the AP shells they fire have a typically British fuse time. Their main batteries are solid enough, with calibers reaching up to 457 mm at Tier X. Ships of Tiers V and above can take advantage of Engine Boost. Starting from Tier VI, these battleships will be a bitter bite for aircraft as they get Defensive AA Fire; starting from Tier IX, Repair Party is swapped for Specialized Repair Teams.

[list][i]The new British battleships won't be available on the Public Test server.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=separation][/h1]Separation of Exterior Visuals and Economic Bonuses[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.6 kicks off a major overhaul of the economic component of the game by separating the visual element from economic bonuses.



While working on the update, we aimed to achieve several goals:
[list][*]Offer an option to select economic bonuses and visual elements (camouflages) separately.
[*]Simplify management of economic bonuses.
[*]Make sure the transition from the old system to the new one is as comfortable as possible.
[*]Maintain the current state of the in-game economy in terms of costs and earnings.[/list]
[list]We’ve improved the interface, bonus management, Inventory display, and much more! The key principle behind this effort is that you as players [i]do not lose[/i] in your overall earnings. In certain scenarios, you actually [i]gain even more[/i] than before.[/list]
Below is a brief list of the key changes. For a deeper look into the separation process, please refer to our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/327]Development Blog[/url].

[h3][i][h3][b]List of Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[list][*]Economic bonuses will now act as individual in-game entities that are separate from camouflages and signals. Camouflage patterns will change a ship's exterior only and will be applied separately from these bonuses.
[*]Bonuses to XP will have no effect on Free XP and Commander XP. To compensate for this, we have changed all permanent and expendable economic bonuses.
[*]Basic Free XP earnings are now twice as large.
[*]Economic bonuses from permanent camouflages are purchased separately, and their effect will be applied towards a ship's economy on a permanent basis. Expendable bonuses can also be added on top of permanent ones.
[*]Only one economic bonus can be applied towards each of the resources (Credits, combat XP, Free XP, and Commander XP) at the same time. This limitation serves to simplify the way the system works. The values of these bonuses are designed in a way that they can cover even the most profitable combinations from the current system.
[*]Instead of reducing the post-battle service cost, permanent camouflages will provide a bonus to Credits so that your average earnings either remain unchanged or grow.
[*]The service cost for Tier IX and X researchable ships has been reduced from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]120,000[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]115,000[/b] and from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]180,000[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]150,000[/b] Credits, respectively.
[*]To account for the changes to bonuses applied towards service costs, the current service cost in Co-op Battles will be additionally reduced by [b]13.3%[/b] while Credits earnings will grow by [b]12.5%[/b].
[*]We want camouflages to affect ship exteriors only, so we’re removing all the combat bonuses they used to offer. The bonus that provided a [b]3%[/b] reduction in the detectability range by sea is now included in all ships' tech specs by default. We also removed the bonus that increased the dispersion of incoming enemy shells by [b]4%[/b].
[*]At present, the number of signals and camouflages displayed in the Exterior tab does not include those currently mounted on your ships. When this change goes live, you will always know the exact number of reserves you have in stock—the total number of signals and camouflage patterns you have on your account will be displayed.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6e613c8-f12f-11ec-ad63-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6ec0152-f12f-11ec-bbf4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6e5ce86-f12f-11ec-972c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6ebb0da-f12f-11ec-b67d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
This change, along with the addition of the new in-game entity, entails a revision of all rewards in the game. In combat missions, campaigns, Operations, and collections—economic and special signals will be replaced with bonuses. Camouflages will also be supplemented with bonuses.
[list][i]The contents of all containers that drop signals or camouflages will also change.[/i][/list]
Apart from that, the following two account access levels are going to be added to support the upcoming changes:
[list][*]Level 5, unlocking combat bonuses for a ship
[*]Level 7, unlocking economic bonuses for a ship[/list]
It means that we’re increasing the total number of access levels to 17. At the same time, the total number of battles that need to be played to unlock the access levels will not change. All of your current progress toward unlocking access levels will be retained, meaning that you won't lose any progress and will still get any due rewards.

[h2][b][h1=ai-updates][/h1]AI Updates[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.11.6, we've substantially upgraded the AI behind our bot ships in Training and Co-op Battles.
[list][*]We’ve enhanced the AI responsible for bots moving, firing, and using consumables in Training Battles.
[*]In Co-op Battles, AI-controlled aircraft carriers will now move to the nearest Key Area if only a few surviving allies are left in battle.
[*]Bots will now be less likely to ram one another or strike islands in Co-op Battles.[/list] [hr][/hr]

notes.title: Updated Convoy in Update 0.11.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/567c483954a7a6fbfcc1912ef3087154790fc6aa.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.11.5 brings back the Convoy temporary battle type, which tasks you with defending or attacking transport ships as they sail to their destination point.[/b]

We've updated the format and diversified the maps, as well as increased the number of transport ships that now move along different routes. We've also revamped the interface and tactical tips in battle, as well as changed the description of the Convoy rules in the battle-type selection window.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e51943fa-ebed-11ec-ae3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[i]In real life, naval battles involved more than squadron duels and air raids. A significant aspect of confrontations between navies involved defending or attacking cargo lanes used to transport strategically important cargo.[/i]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#achievements-and-combat-missions]Achievements and Combat Missions[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2]
To ensure high-quality matchmaking and contribute to battles being assembled more quickly, Convoy is only available during a certain Prime Time period each day.

[h2]Format[/h2]
12 vs. 12 with Tier VIII–X ships.

[list][i]Convoy will be available throughout Update 0.11.5.[/i][/list]

We've changed some conditions of Convoy to bring more variety to the tactics of both teams and diversify the gameplay in this battle type.

Aircraft carriers, destroyers, cruisers, battleships, and submarines are allowed to participate.

Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed among the two teams. You can enter each battle either alone or as part of a Division of 2—3 players.

The [i]defending team[/i] needs to escort convoys of cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The [i]defending team[/i] wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is sent back to Port. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoys or its defenders.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314653f2-ebe5-11ec-b84a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314aa86c-ebe5-11ec-b8aa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314d67e6-ebe5-11ec-bfc8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3147d0ce-ebe5-11ec-90a1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1fd37b04-ebdb-11ec-9ff5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f3eb7d0-ebdb-11ec-bd60-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/video/convoys_torp_evading_1200x600_wg_spb_wows.mp4]In total, there are six AI-controlled transport ships in each battle. Depending on the map, transport ships will be split into three convoys of two ships or two convoys of three ships.[/url]
[list][*]Each convoy moves along its own route.
[*]Each route has its own destination. The destination points may be the same or different.
[*]The convoy's route is visible to both teams on the Minimap.
[*]The numbering of routes is tied to their travel time—the higher the number, the longer the duration of the route.[/list]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/video/convoy_shooting_1200x675_wg_spb_wows.mp4]All convoys are made up of Liberty-class transport ships. They have little HP and weak armor, but they can deploy smoke screens, as well as change speed and maneuver to dodge enemy torpedoes. In addition, the transport ships are armed with two main battery guns and twelve secondary battery guns capable of firing at approaching enemies.[/url]
[h2]Maps[/h2]
North, Hotspot, Trap, Two Brothers, Tears of the Desert, Crash Zone Alpha. A cyclone can appear on the Trap map.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558addcc-ebe6-11ec-ae3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558b3362-ebe6-11ec-a4eb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5592ffca-ebe6-11ec-9ff5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558ed2f6-ebe6-11ec-a3b0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558cb700-ebe6-11ec-b8aa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55919a36-ebe6-11ec-bfc8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558d7f82-ebe6-11ec-a2ee-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=achievements-and-combat-missions][/h1]Achievements and Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
As before, your successes in Convoy will be rewarded with special themed achievements. We've updated their visual appearance for the new iteration.
[table equalcells=1][tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86f7b8-ebd8-11ec-822f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Living Shield[/b][/td] [td]Receive two torpedo hits from the enemy while being within a 2-kilometer radius of an allied transport ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86c1c6-ebd8-11ec-8e96-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Neat Job[/b][/td] [td]Win by destroying all the transports and without losing any allied ships. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9ddc5c12-ebd8-11ec-9882-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Safe Route[/b][/td] [td]Win a battle and save all transports. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d8a9972-ebd8-11ec-a75f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Nerves of Steel[/b][/td] [td]Win and survive in a battle when the enemy has twice the number of warships or more. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship. Can be completed while playing for any team.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d8f7dac-ebd8-11ec-ac73-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Raider[/b][/td] [td]Destroy two transports in a single battle.[/td][/tr][/table]
Due to the specifics of the battle type, you can only earn these achievements in Convoy.
[list]You will have access to special combat missions that can be completed only in Convoy. Win and earn Base XP to obtain Community Tokens.[/list]
[list][i]Detailed information about the special mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]

[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 07 Jun. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.5! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!
[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Made balance changes to the Kansas-Vermont branch of American battleships, Unites States, and submarines. See our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/329]Development Blog[/url] for details.
[*]Fixed the external code execution technical vulnerability in World of Warships' replay tool. We thank those who brought the problem to our attention.
[*]Fixed an issue because of which the FPS limit in battle was not removed in Update 0.11.4. This limit has now been removed for all players. If you want to set it manually, edit the [code]<maxFrameRate>[/code] value in the [i]preferences.xml[/i] file in the game folder.
[*]Corrected the display of an outdated tech tree. The tech tree now matches Update 0.11.4.
[*]Thanks to your feedback, it was discovered that after completing the relevant combat missions on the 0.11.5 Public Test, players received Commander Dasha only for the Tier I ship of her respective version's nation. The rewards have been changed, and now battles on each nation's Tier X ship will bring several Dasha Commanders with a specialization for that nation's Tier X ships. We thank you for your feedback and for bringing this issue to our attention.
[*]Updated the routes and fixed a number of bugs in the Convoy battle type's interface.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused submarines to be incorrectly positioned at the beginning of battles in the Standard Battle and Domination modes on some maps.
[*]Fixed a number of issues on the maps Northern Waters, Shards, and Faroe Islands, as well as on Operation Narai's map.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the Division invitation window to move arbitrarily on the screen.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the markers for submarines' homing torpedoes to not be displayed on the minimap.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

[list][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=the-return-of-convoy][/h1]The Return of Convoy[/b][/h2]
Military operations at sea didn't only involve duels between squadrons or air raids against enemy ships. In real life, a significant aspect of confrontations between navies involved defending or attacking cargo lanes used to transport strategically important cargo. During [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/convoy-defend-or-destroy/]Update 0.10.8[/url], you had an opportunity to participate in a separate battle type—Convoy—in which you had to either defend or destroy cargo ships. We've updated the rules and format, and Convoy is going to return in Update 0.11.5!

[h3][i]Format[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
The battles will be fought in teams of 12 with Tier VIII–X ships.

Players can participate in Convoy playing submarines as well. The limit on the number of submarines is identical to Random Battles.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Rules[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed among the two teams.

The defending team needs to escort a convoy of AI-controlled cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is destroyed. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Maps[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
North, Hotspot, Trap, Two Brothers, Tears of the Desert, Haven, Crash Zone Alpha, Northern Waters.

The defending team needs to escort a total of six transport ships. Depending on the map, they are divided into convoys of two or three ships, and each convoy follows its own route. This means that you can expect two or three convoy routes with either the same destination or different ones. This change allows for new tactics for both teams and makes the gameplay more diverse. At the same time, we've reduced the number of Convoy ships respectively for each route so as not to complicate the task for the attacking team and to avoid performance issues in battle.
[/expand]
[list][i]Apart from changing the rules and format, we've also updated the interface and tactical hints in battle, as well as the Convoy rules in the battle mode selection window.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=faroe-islands][/h1]Faroe Islands[/b][/h2]
In [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/community/choose-a-new-map/]autumn of 2021[/url], players helped us choose the visual style for the new map. It has now passed through the final stages of preparation, and we're ready to introduce the new Faroe Islands map in Update 0.11.5!

Battles will take place among flowing mountains covered with a thin layer of snow and islands with steep shores. The map has been designed for battles involving Tier VII–X ships, as well as superships. It can be found in the Domination mode with three or four Key Areas.

[h2][b][h1=submarines][/h1]Submarines[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.11.5, changes are going to be made to the matchmaker based on player feedback regarding submarines. The limit on the number of submarines and destroyers in a team will depend on the waiting time of the first player in the queue:
[list][*]0–39 seconds: Four ships total; no more than four destroyers and two submarines.
[*]40–89 seconds: Five ships total; no more than four destroyers and two submarines.
[*]In case of longer waiting times for the first player, these limits will be less strict.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
Changes to rental Commander management:
[list][*]Rental Commanders can no longer be reassigned to different ships. Rental Commanders with specializations for different ships won't be shown in the Commander Replacement tab.
[*]If a ship had several rental Commanders, only one of them with the highest number of skill points and most XP will remain. The rest of the rental Commanders will be removed from player accounts.[/list][hr][/hr]

notes.title: Arms Race Hits Random and Co-op Battles in Update 0.11.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9f50dfc0d6e5d944eb11941981a9a1e0b1fce434.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.11.4 brings Arms Race—a mode that allows you to improve the characteristics of your ship right in battle—into Random and Co-op Battles.[/b]

With the addition of Arms Race to Random and Co-op Battles, we're disabling Epicenter.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#features-of-arms-race]Features of Arms Race[/url]
[url=#how-buff-areas-work]How Buff Areas Work[/url]
[url=#buff-types]Buff Types[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2]
Arms Race will be available only in battles where the highest ship tier is IX or X, as well as in battles with superships. You can enter a battle in a Division of no more than three players. The number of players and matchmaking restrictions are the same as those applied in Random and Co-op Battles.

It will also be available only on these eight maps: Northern Waters, Sleeping Giant, Loop, Warrior’s Path, Mountain Range, Land of Fire, Islands of Ice, and Hotspot.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1abcd6aa-d29b-11ec-91d2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac437c4-d29b-11ec-b168-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b66a0ae-d29b-11ec-a66e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac27984-d29b-11ec-abbb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac4112c-d29b-11ec-b4bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b67d456-d29b-11ec-8a8c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac7ff30-d29b-11ec-890f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac67aa2-d29b-11ec-a14f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=features-of-arms-race][/h1]Features of Arms Race[/b][/h2]
Once a battle starts, areas with buffs spawn on the map. If you can make it to a special area and pick up the buffs before your opponents do, your entire team will get a bonus to their combat abilities till the end of that battle.

Eight minutes after a battle starts, a Key Area appears in the center of the map. The diameter of this area then shrinks over time. The team that captures it will be able to quickly gain an advantage in points and greatly increase their chances of winning. The capture time is 120 seconds. Holding an area brings 10 points every 2 seconds.

To win a battle, a team will need to meet one of the following conditions:
[list][*]Sink all enemy ships
[*]Be the first to score 1,000 superiority points
[*]Reduce the opposing team's points to zero
[*]Prevail over the opposing team by the number of points at the time the battle ends[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34acb83e-d285-11ec-a866-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/354b3cac-d285-11ec-a119-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35431036-d285-11ec-95b6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34a520ba-d285-11ec-b748-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]Battles in the Arms Race mode will bring players the standard sums of XP and Credits they would get in Random or Co-op Battles (depending on which type of battle they are in). Activating buff areas will also be rewarded.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=how-buff-areas-work][/h1]How Buff Areas Work[/b][/h2]
Each buff area becomes available to capture 2 minutes after spawning. The player whose ship first enters the area after its activation gets a buff for their ship and all allies.

If both allied and enemy ships are in a buff area at the moment of its activation, the team with the most ships in the area gets the buff. If the ship numbers are equal, the balance of power inside the area must shift one way or another for a team to receive the buff.

In addition to the buffs, each captured area grants 20 points to your team and deducts 20 points from the enemy team. Players who capture a buff area receive an economic reward of XP and Credits. New buff areas appear on the map every 2 minutes until the 14th minute of each battle. Buff areas spawn randomly on maps, so every battle is unique!
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/88c7e8a8-d299-11ec-a14f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=buff-types][/h1]Buff Types[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Permanent HP recovery for ships and carrier aircraft:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Restores [b]+0.04%[/b] HP per second for destroyers and submarines
[*]Restores [b]+0.03%[/b] HP per second for cruisers
[*]Restores [b]+0.02%[/b] HP per second for battleships
[*]Restores[b] +0.125%[/b] HP per second for carrier aircraft[/list]
[h3][b]Faster reload time for all ship armaments; faster squadron preparation time for aircraft carriers:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−10%[/b] to the reload time of all armaments and sonar
[*][b]−10%[/b] to squadron restoration time[/list]
[h3][b]Boosted armament damage for ships and carrier squadrons:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+10%[/b] to maximum ship armament damage
[*][b]+10%[/b] to maximum armament damage of carrier and hybrid ship squadrons[/list]
[h3][b]Increased current and maximum HP values for ships and carrier squadrons:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+10%[/b] to current and maximum HP of destroyers and submarines
[*][b]+7.5%[/b] to current and maximum HP of cruisers
[*][b]+5%[/b] to current and maximum HP of battleships
[*][b]+17%[/b] to current and maximum HP of carrier squadrons[/list]
[list][i]Each buff has three levels. The bonuses stack up if you capture the same buffs multiple times. All four buff types can be applied to a ship simultaneously.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0e948830-d4fa-11ec-8d47-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]Picking up a buff that you have already maxed out will have no effect. Capturing a buff area will bring 20 superiority points to your team and deduct 20 points from the enemy team. Buff areas disappear after being captured.[/list]

notes.title: Waterline: Roadmap Update – Spring 2022
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2803640665][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4385e192275530917dbe689be694da3607501bbf.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Captains![/b]

In early February, we announced our plans for 2022. Over the months since our [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/roadmap-for-2022/]previous publication[/url], many of our ideas have been implemented. More information about future changes to World of Warships is now available and some details have changed. It's high time we shared our development plans for the second half of 2022!
[list][i]Please note that all the information contained in this document is preliminary. Any changes and new features that we announce may be adjusted several times during tests. During each of those testing rounds, we'll carefully consider your feedback and opinions. Now, let's get down to the details! To reveal the information, click on the respective blocks.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#whats-already-done]What's Already Done[/url]
[url=#spring-2022]Spring 2022[/url]
[url=#summer-2022]Summer 2022[/url]
[url=#fall-2022]Fall 2022[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=C-LcU9W2TGI;full][/previewyoutube] 
[h2][b][h1=whats-already-done][/h1]What's Already Done[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/797e48b6-c7cb-11ec-a918-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]
[h2]Ships[/h2]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/pan-asian-cruisers-review/]Pan-Asian cruisers[/url] are now available to everyone, and Early Access to [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/italian-destroyers-review/]Italian destroyers[/url] will also end soon.

A new nation has been added to the game—Spain. The first representative is [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/history/armada-canarias/]Canarias[/url].

they were added to the branches of their respective nations.
[h2]Game Events[/h2]
We celebrated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/lunar-new-year/]Lunar New Year[/url].

Players had a chance to try out [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/dirigible-derby/]Dirigible Derby[/url] and fight in the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/savage-battle/]Savage Battle[/url] on the Flooded City map.

Construction of [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/history/armada-atlantico/]Atlântico[/url] has started on the already familiar Clydebank Dockyard.
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
Significant [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/graphics-improvements-in-0113/]visual improvements[/url] have been implemented. Snow, ice, and sand on maps have become more realistic and spectacular, the ice build-up effect has appeared on ships and is visible in battles on snow-covered maps, and shadows on maps and ships now look more realistic.

A number of visual effects have been updated, and we're continuing to rework maps and Ports to bring them up to HD quality. By the way, we've released a Hot Fix episode covering our work on the World of Warships graphics. You can watch it [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zdr_M3cXnn8]here[/url].

We've also disclosed the item drop chances for all containers. Check them out [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/contents-and-drop-rates-of-containers/]here[/url].
[h2][b][h1=spring-2022][/h1]Spring 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/794085da-c7cb-11ec-92c5-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]
[h2]French Cruisers[/h2]
Update 0.11.4 kicks off Early Access to new French ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Cherbourg[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Brest[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Marseille[/b][/b]. The cruisers are armed with large-caliber guns mounted on their bows. Their long reload time is partly compensated for by the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable. The ships are capable of achieving high speeds with the help of the improved Engine Boost consumable that is typical for French ships. The armor of the new cruisers ensures good protection of their citadels against medium-caliber AP shells, but they are quite vulnerable against HE and SAP shells.
[list][i]Read the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/311]Development Blog[/url] and [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-0114/]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.4[/url] to learn more details about Early Access to the French cruisers.[/i][/list]
[h2]Arms Race in Random and Co-op Battles[/h2]
Arms Race was first introduced into the game quite a long time ago—as a separate test mode initially, and then as a format for several Ranked Battles seasons later. [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/arms-race-in-update-01010/]In Update 0.10.10[/url], it returned as a separate battle type featuring various changes and improvements. It received positive feedback from players and demonstrated good statistics. The next stage of the Arms Race development will be its introduction to Random and Co-op Battles.

Arms Race will be available only in battles where the highest ship tier is IX or X, as well as in battles with superships. It will also be available only on these eight maps: Northern Waters, Sleeping Giant, Loop, Warrior's Path, Mountain Range, Land of Fire, Islands of Ice, and Hotspot. With the addition of the new mode to Random and Co-op Battles, Epicenter will be disabled.
[h2][b][h1=summer-2022][/h1]Summer 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/79671a7e-c7cb-11ec-a53d-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]
[h2]British Battleships[/h2]
Great Britain—one of the mightiest naval powers in the world—is expecting reinforcements. The branch of [b]British battleships[/b] will feature warships that are historically classified as battlecruisers.

The new Tier III–VI ships were actually built in real life. The new ships of higher tiers were created based on Royal Navy projects from the first half of the 20th century.
[list][i]More details about the concept and settings of the new British battleships are available in the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/310]Development Blog[/url].[/i][/list]
[h2]Game Events[/h2]
[h3][b]Sea Battle[/b][/h3]
We strive to delight you with new and interesting activities. Sea Battle is one of them. It's inspired by a classic game that you're probably familiar with.

You'll need a special resource—[b]Passes[/b]—to participate. Passes can be earned by completing combat missions.

When playing Sea Battle, you'll be competing against AI. Destroying ships and winning battles will bring you rewards. These rewards can include special themed resources, e.g. Tokens for Early Access to ships, or other in-game items. Before starting or during playing, you can press the "Finish battle automatically" button for the AI to finish the battle instead of you. Battle results will be displayed on the screen, and you'll receive any due rewards. You can pause the battle at any time and return to it later without losing your progress.
[h3][b]New Iteration of Convoy[/b][/h3]
Convoy was first introduced to the Live Server as a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/convoy-defend-or-destroy/]separate battle type[/url] in Update 0.10.8. It received positive feedback from players, and we're happy to announce that we'll soon launch the second iteration of this battle type.

Battles will utilize a 12 vs. 12 format with Tier VIII–X ships. The maps and routes have been updated—you can expect two or even three convoy routes on the map, with one or more destination points. This will increase gameplay variety for both the escorting and attacking teams, as well as offer new tactics. Along with this, we'll decrease the number of ships in Convoy respectively for each route so as not to complicate the task for the attacking team and to avoid performance issues in battle.

We've also prepared various interface improvements, updates to tips, and other changes to help players take their bearings in the new battle type.
[h3][b]Return of Puerto Rico[/b][/h3]
The Dockyard with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_America_e1c73e4294d3f8addc39872e23f6457e6f540a68db120d8bc5dec7e2034f83af.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Atlântico[/b][/b] won't be the last one this year. The next opportunity to build a ship will come at the end of summer. This time, we'll return the pioneer of the Dockyard—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b].

The first Dockyard with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] was very complicated and not the most successful from the perspective of its design and mechanics. We've taken all of our mistakes into account and reworked the event design. As all subsequent iterations—starting with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Odin[/b][/b]—demonstrated, the Dockyard in its current format has become a full-fledged part of our game and works well. On top of that, many players have been asking when we are going to bring Puerto Rico back to the game. That's why we've decided to put Puerto Rico back on the stocks—we see it as an excellent opportunity to rectify our early mistakes with this feature. It also means that you'll be building a Tier X ship, which hasn't happened since the very first Dockyard. Those who didn't manage to build the ship in the New Year Update 0.8.11 or started playing the game later will now have a chance to do so. Obtaining the ship will be much easier than the first time, but it won't be possible to finish the construction for free, same as with previous ships at the Dockyard.
[list]Players who already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] in their Ports but still build her at this Dockyard will be provided with compensation. We plan to give such players the opportunity to select a bundle with one of the following resources: Doubloons, Steel, Coal, or Research Points. The amount of whichever resource is in the bundle will be enough to obtain any Tier X ship currently available for purchase.[/list]
[h3][b]Return of Operations[/b][/h3]
As a result of the changes to aircraft carriers in Update 0.8.0, many AI-related internal tools became outdated. Adjusting aircraft carriers controlled by AI became hard or even impossible. For this reason, some Operations were temporarily removed from the game. We are currently actively working on aircraft carriers' AI to bring some Operations (e.g. Cherry Blossom, Hermes, and The Ultimate Frontier) back to the game.
[h3][b]Personal Challenges[/b][/h3]
Personal Challenges are a rather easy but interesting activity that allow you to achieve results playing your favorite ships and get rewards for this. They also encourage you to research new ship branches.

Future updates will bring new iterations of Personal Challenges with a number of improvements. More "type–nation" categories will be added for completing challenges, including Early Access ships. New mission conditions will be introduced: earning ribbons or XP; dealing damage. It will be possible to style Personal Challenges for themed events like New Year's Night, Clash of Courage, and their analogs. We'll also improve the interface to make it more informative.
[h3][b]Return of USS Black and Website Minigames[/b][/h3]
A special event is planned for June during which you'll be able to obtain USS [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Black[/b][/b] and earn various themed rewards. The event is going to be accompanied by a web campaign that will allow you to choose your own path through the Pacific theater of World War II in 1944 on a special map and build a career for your own Commander. As a reward for completing the campaign, you'll receive a U.S. Commander with 12 skill points. You can distribute some of the skill points by making choices right on the campaign map.
[list]With the introduction of the Pan-Asian cruiser branch, we've added a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/history/a-look-through-time-pan-asian-cruisers/#assemble-the-ten]special minigame[/url] to publications dedicated to ships coming to Early Access. Play, familiarize yourself with new ships, remember them, and get special achievements! We're going to add such minigames to articles about each new ship branch in our game.[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[h3][b]New Map: The Faroe Islands[/b][/h3]
The visual style of The Faroe Islands map was selected by players back in [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/community/choose-a-new-map/]fall 2021[/url], and the map is currently in the final stages of its preparation. We plan to release it to the Live Server with Update 0.11.5.
[h3][b]Changes to the Containers Tab[/b][/h3]
The cargo ship feature is currently very limited—players can only see the total number of containers they possess. This is particularly inconvenient for those who store lots of containers. To address this issue, we're going to improve the system for storing containers on the cargo ship and make it more informative.

Players will be able to view the numbers of each container type they have and open containers only of a specific type. We're adding information about container names and their descriptions, as well as an option to get information about the drop chances of container items.

We initially planned to finish this feature in spring, but tweaking it and testing the reworked cargo ship requires more time. That's why the changes to the Containers tab will be implemented in one of the summer updates.
[h3][b]Training Missions for New Players[/b][/h3]
Helping new players master the key principles and mechanics is a very important part of the game development. For this purpose, we're adding a set of simple missions to World of Warships. These missions will gradually focus on different game mechanics. This will help inexperienced players get their bearings in World of Warships, acquire basic skills through playing, and receive small rewards for this. Each mission will have its own set of tips that will enable players to better navigate in the game.

This is another feature that we've postponed to summer because we needed more time to finalize the design of these missions.
[h3][b]Separation of Exterior Elements and Economic Bonuses[/b][/h3]
We're working on the separation of exterior elements and economic bonuses, as well as on updating the latter. These changes will enable you to select economic bonuses and camouflages separately, and they will simplify the process of managing economic bonuses. We'll do our best to make the transition from the old system to the new one as comfortable as possible, as well as to conserve the current state of the game economics (prices and earnings). Cumulatively, players won't lose in profitability and will earn even more in some situations.
[list][i]This large-scale change will be implemented in one of the summer updates or in the early fall. All essential information is published in the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/318]Development Blog[/url].[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Changes to the Battle Camera[/b][/h3]
The quality of textures and effects is an essential part of the game, but the way players see World of Warships is no less important. Not long ago, we [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/287]announced[/url] a new stage of testing battle camera settings. Its results were positive. Some minor tweaks are still required, and after that, we'll implement these changes on the Live Server.
[h3][b]Independence Day: Update of U.S. Destroyer Models[/b][/h3]
In summer, we traditionally celebrate U.S. Independence Day. You can expect to see loads of themed content. Updating the models of U.S. destroyers will also be dedicated to this holiday. This work will span two updates. First, we'll update the models of researchable Tier VII–X destroyers. Second, we'll turn to the models of researchable Tier II–VI destroyers and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Sims[/b][/b], which we started working on concurrently with the researchable ships.
[h2][b][h1=fall-2022][/h1]Fall 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/79395422-c7cb-11ec-a05e-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

New features and improvements that we plan for fall are at the preliminary design stage, so we don't have many details to share with you. We'll cover the most important things.
[h2]Japanese Light Cruisers[/h2]
By fall, we'll have added Japanese Tier V–X light cruisers for testing. Their concept is in development, but we can already safely say that all ships of the branch will have 610 mm torpedoes at their disposal, and their torpedo launchers will have wide aiming angles. As for their main batteries, the Tier V and VI ships will have 152 mm guns, the Tier VII ship will have 155 mm guns, and high-tier cruisers will carry 150 mm dual-purpose guns.
[h2]Anniversary and Improvements of Battle Performance Bonuses[/h2]
We're going to celebrate World of Warships' Anniversary—our beloved game is turning seven! Players can expect loads of themed rewards and interesting activities.

Naturally, festive bonuses for battle performance will also be available. Many players have very extensive Ports, and getting rewards for battle performance on each ship can be very difficult and time-consuming. To deal with this, we plan to rework the battle performance bonus system. Players with many ships in their Ports will be able to receive rewards from several ships per battle.
[h2]Halloween[/h2]
For Halloween 2021, we [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/halloween-nightmare-operations/]brought back[/url] themed Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness. As the statistics showed, players were enthusiastic about their return—Nightmare Operations appeared to be much more popular than the standard ones. This year, we plan to add Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness as part of the Halloween activities again. Besides that, we are considering the possibility to additionally bring back another once very popular themed Operation—Terror of the Deep—featuring submarines!
[h2]New Map[/h2]
In addition to The Faroe Islands and continuation of reworking maps and Ports to bring them up to HD quality, we plan to start working on one more new map. It's currently at the preliminary design stage. We promise to disclose details later when we're ready.
[list]We'll keep releasing special videos of the Waterline series once per quarter! We'll share new information and our plans for the upcoming 6 months with you, as well as explain why we make any changes to the already announced plans. Stay tuned![/list]
[i]World of Warships Team[/i]

To participate, select "[b]Public Test[/b]" in the [b]Game Instance[/b] menu of the Wargaming Game Center. Join in for piles of rewards! Earn Community Tokens and exchange them for containers, permanent and expendable camouflages, and other valuable items.

With Update 0.11.4, we're adding lots of new features including Arms Race in Random and Co-op Battles, improvements to the Minimap, and further updates to submarines[i].[/i] Take a look at the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-0114/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and welcome to the Test! See you on the Public Test Server!

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.4! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Important: The second session will be live until:[/b] [b]Thu. 05 May 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
After analyzing their combat effectiveness, we’re reducing the survivability of submarines in Update 0.11.4 with the following changes:
[list][*]The damage radius of ship-dropped depth charges has been significantly increased: 450 to 800 m.
[*]Increased the damage dealt by airstrike depth charges in the outermost part of their damage radius.
[*]The minimum airstrike depth charge drop distance for battleships has been changed to 500 m, like cruisers.[/list]
[h3][b]New mechanics for displaying the source of enemy sonar pings[/b][/h3]
In the Public Test for Update 0.11.4, we tested a change to the sonar ping visual effect from enemy submarines: instead of displaying the ping itself in real time, an effect is played on the water surface near to where the ping was emitted.

The new effect was supposed to make it easier to find the source of the ping. If the submarine emitting the ping is undetected, the effect is displayed at a certain distance from the submarine in order to give the submarine a chance to avoid taking damage.

After the Public Test, we got a lot of feedback about this new effect. Mainly:
[list][*]The effect disappears too quickly and is difficult to notice.
[*]The effect is often displayed too far from the submarine to determine its actual location.[/list]
Therefore, we are introducing the following changes to this mechanic:
[list][*]Increased the time the effect remains visible to 5 seconds.
[*]The distance at which the ping from the emitting submarine is displayed has been halved.[/list]
[h3][b]Removal of the possibility to remain constantly between two depth states by quickly tapping the dive and surface buttons[/b][/h3]
In Update 0.11.4, we removed the possibility of walking the line between two different depths while enjoying the benefits of both. The characteristics of periscope depth are now maintained between the depths of 0 and 15 m. The 15 m depth mark will be the border between periscope and maximum depth states. We also changed the possible depth limits for maximum depth to 30 m and 60 m.

[h3][b]Other submarine changes[/b][/h3]
We made adjustments to the captain skills for submarines, you can find all information about this change in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/322]Development Blog[/url].

[h3][b]Other changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus for strengthening the current and maximum combat capability of aircraft carrier squadrons in the Arms Race has been increased from 10% to 17%.
[*]The setting "Transmit exact position in the square" is now enabled for all players by default.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which the selected prime time in Clan Battles was reset in some cases.
[*]Fixed incorrect descriptions of superships in the port.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which an empty field appeared in the team list when activating voice chat.
[*]Now, when the [b]Enter[/b] key is pressed quickly in the "Exit Battle" dialog box, the player exits the battle, and the client closes in the "Exit Game" dialog box.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which in some situations in battle it was impossible to use an airstrike.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash when opening dialog boxes.
[*]Fixed bugs in the armor of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Submarine/special_ac6b2659676bb2f9f46f099fd4ad26d30f2fa64d76f6487f382af721ac6bee4f.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] U-190[/b][/b].
[*]Fixed a bug due to which submarines displayed the wrong torpedo speed after picking up power-ups.
[*]Fixed a bug with the missing horn on the "Japanese Castle" camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Fusō[/b][/b].
[*]Fixed a bug due to which ship names on the minimap could overwrite ship icons when minimap rotation was enabled.
[*]Fixed a bug with the position of the fort icon after the destruction of the ship.
[*]Made balance changes to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Chkalov[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Petropavlovsk[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Yueyang[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Des Moines[/b][/b] and other ships. See our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/321]Development Blog[/url] for details.[/list]

[*]50 signals of all types (except for special signals) will also be added to your PT account.[/list]
[list]If you played at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 0.11.3 Public Test, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.[/list]

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#arms-race-testing]Arms Race in Random and Co-op Battles during the Public Test[/url]
[url=#french-cruisers]French Cruisers[/url]
[url=#italian-destroyers-in-the-tech-tree]Italian Destroyers in the Tech Tree[/url]
[url=#submarine-improvements]Submarine Improvements[/url]
[url=#minimap-improvements]Minimap Improvements[/url]
[url=#azur-lane]Azur Lane[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=arms-race-testing][/h1]Arms Race in Random and Co-op Battles during the Public Test[/b][/h2]
Arms Race is a game mode that players are very familiar with. Previously, it appeared in the game as a standalone battle type or as a format in seasons of the old Ranked Battles. We've spent a lot of time improving and expanding this mode based on your feedback and various statistics that we've gathered. It last appeared on the Live Server in Update 0.10.10. During the Public Test of Update 0.11.4, Arms Race will be introduced into Random and Co-op Battles.

Arms Race will be available only in battles where the highest ship tier is IX or X, as well as in battles with superships. It will also be available only on these eight maps: Northern Waters, Sleeping Giant, Loop, Warrior’s Path, Mountain Range, Land of Fire, Islands of Ice, and Hotspot.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0190727e-bfd9-11ec-a774-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0193abba-bfd9-11ec-b739-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/018fe62e-bfd9-11ec-b724-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/018cbb2a-bfd9-11ec-b8da-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]With the addition of Arms Race to Random and Co-op Battles, we're disabling Epicenter.[/i][/list]

[list]Take part in testing Arms Race in Random and Co-op Battles during the Public Test of Update 0.11.4, and let us know what you think! This will help us decide the fate of this mode on the Live Server, based on your feedback and statistics.[/list] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=french-cruisers][/h1]French Cruisers[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.4 kicks off an event that puts new French cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Cherbourg[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Brest[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Marseille[/b][/b] right in spotlight! These ships will become available in Early Access on the Live Server only when the update is released. Meanwhile, we invite you to take part in the testing of the event.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/706f82d6-bcb2-11ec-b00c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/70a16fee-bcb2-11ec-a626-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7171a826-bcb2-11ec-8f88-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
These new ships found their places next to the first branch of French cruisers. The main feature of the new ships is their large-caliber guns (in terms of their class) mounted on the bow. While they reload slowly, this is compensated for by the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable.

The new ships are capable of achieving high speeds with the help of the improved "French" Engine Boost consumable.

Their armor does a great job in protecting them against medium-caliber AP shells, but it's quite vulnerable against HE and SAP shells.

Medium and long ranges are optimal for engagements, but with the help of their 139 mm secondary battery guns with improved accuracy, the new ships can also show their worth in close-range encounters.

Port of Marseille has been updated.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c8875b1e-bf0b-11ec-ae71-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dcb4c998-bcb1-11ec-b00c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dc166e24-bcb1-11ec-a3d0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=italian-destroyers-in-the-tech-tree][/h1]Italian Destroyers in the Tech Tree[/b][/h2]
The entire branch of Italian destroyers will become available for players to research with the release of Update 0.11.4. You can learn the details about how to play the new Italian ships in a dedicated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/italian-destroyers-review/]article[/url] on our website.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc7b61d0-a692-11ec-8901-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bce6de42-a692-11ec-a9e6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc785dc8-a692-11ec-9f4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc743df6-a692-11ec-b297-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=submarine-improvements][/h1]Submarine Improvements[/b][/h2]
Submarine testing continues. What changed in Updated 0.11.4?
[list][*][b]Disabled the possibility to launch conventional torpedoes at maximum depth.[/b] From Update 0.11.2, conventional torpedoes no longer home in on targets vertically. It became inefficient to launch them from the maximum depth, which is why we've disabled this possibility.
[*][b]Disabled the increased dive capacity depletion rate when a submarine was detected by the enemy.[/b] This led to a change in the corresponding Commander skill and upgrades—a modifier for the dive capacity restoration rate has been introduced instead of the modifier for additional dive capacity depletion. Additional dive capacity depletion was very low and also had no impact on the gameplay of submarines. We decided to get rid of it because it was overcomplicated.
[*][b]The effect of the ping moving has been replaced with the effect of its launch, which also shows its direction.[/b] If a submarine isn't detected when it's used, the effect is displayed in the direction the sonar ping was emitted within a range of several kilometers. The effect that was previously used was visible and drew attention, but it was hard to understand where it started. The new effect better shows where the sonar ping was emitted from. Players' attention will still be drawn by the hit indication and the sound of any pings that came close. The new effect will help players better understand the locations of undetected submarines so they can attack them with main battery guns and depth charges with improved efficiency.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/274ca282-bfd2-11ec-b739-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/27558fdc-bfd2-11ec-b6b2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2751a232-bfd2-11ec-801a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=minimap-improvements][/h1]Minimap Improvements[/b][/h2]
To make communication in battle more convenient, comprehensive, and simple, we've updated the Minimap. Added new settings.
[list][*][b]Show the exact location in the square. [/b]When double-clicking the Minimap, the exact spot is shown instead of the overall square.
[*][b]Show object location.[/b] When double-clicking an object (ships, bases, forts, armament), the signal on the Minimap is transmitted, similar to hotkeys ([b]F3[/b] or [b]F5[/b]).[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3822d99e-bfd9-11ec-a774-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac41b324-bfd2-11ec-801a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac4ad292-bfd2-11ec-885e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac46ac94-bfd2-11ec-ad4c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Minimap settings consist of two sections: [b]Circle Settings[/b] and [b]Other Settings[/b].

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03a97494-bfd3-11ec-801a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03a1ecb0-bfd3-11ec-885e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=azur-lane][/h1]Azur Lane[/b][/h2]
As part of the next stage of our collaboration with Azur Lane, World of Warships will see the addition of:
[list][*]Ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] AL Aurora[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] AL Azuma[/b][/b].
