notes.title: Graphics Improvements in Update 0.11.3
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2794673336][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d454ddfe57f4f16b806857830cd2b3603aa04c8c.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]World of Warships is constantly evolving.[/b]

Our team works every day to make the game more interesting and attractive. This meticulous work has been transforming our favorite game for many years.
[previewyoutube=Jg3J4Bie8qY;full][/previewyoutube]
We've made major improvements to the following maps: Tears of the Desert, Trap, Warrior's Path, and Solomon Islands. We've added high-detailed textures and changed the weather, visual effects, and underwater world, as well as carefully worked on many other details.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d788aca8-b58d-11ec-9239-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d7725840-b58d-11ec-976f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d76d3d6a-b58d-11ec-9823-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d78c6b18-b58d-11ec-b074-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d77002e8-b58d-11ec-bfb5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d76baf54-b58d-11ec-95ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d8054af6-b58d-11ec-9445-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d801a77a-b58d-11ec-ad7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We've improved how snow and sand are displayed on islands, and we've also added the effect of snow covering ships, depending on the weather.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/af11276c-b58f-11ec-95ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae55cc1a-b58f-11ec-9239-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The camouflages of aircraft now match the ships they take off from. This effect applies to all aircraft types in the game, including aircraft carrier squadrons and fighters, spotting aircraft, and Airstrike flights.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/af0d6384-b58f-11ec-a356-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae5f2f4e-b58f-11ec-8b34-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We've reworked the visual component of the underwater world. The ships and underwater landscape now look more natural and picturesque. We've also improved how distant underwater objects are drawn in the Binocular View.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5c19fad8-b590-11ec-9239-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5c0e76a4-b590-11ec-9823-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:

[h3][b]Captains![/b][/h3]
Find out how to make the most of our latest Twitch Drops!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#channel-drops]Official Channel Drops[/url] ● [url=#challenges]Twitch Challenges[/url] ● [url=#drops]Twitch Drops[/url] ● [url=#community-tokens]How to Spend Community Tokens[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/worldofwarships style=button][i][/i] WoWS | Twitch[/url]

[h3][i][h3][b]How to Receive Twitch Drops[/b][/h3][/i][/h3] [table][tr][td]
Get Twitch Drops by watching livestreams on the official World of Warships channel or those of any other Twitch streamer playing World of Warships [b]with Drops enabled[/b]. Take care to ensure that your Twitch account is linked to your Wargaming Account, else it won’t work!
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/twitch-connect/ style=button]Instructions[/url]
[list][i]On the first Thursday of the game update, Drops become available and remain claimable for a full week until they are refreshed the following Thursday.[/i][/list]
[/td][/tr][/table][hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=channel-drops][/h1]Official Channel Drops[/b][/h2]
Official Channel Drops differ from other Drops in that they can only be obtained by watching the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/worldofwarships]official World of Warships Twitch channel[/url]. There are two types of Official Channel Drops:
[list][*][b][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c8660192-a735-11eb-ae9d-d89d6715223c.png[/img]Update Stream Drops[/b]: Watch 1 hour of our official Update 0.11.3 showcase streams (from April 13 through 19) to get a Wargaming container.
[*][b]Weekly Drop[/b]: Get 250 Community Tokens each week of the update by watching an hour of official streams per week. This update spans 5 weeks, so you can get a total of [b]1,250 Community Tokens[/b] from the weekly drop.[/list]
[list]Each Wargaming container holds [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1[/b] day of Warships Premium Account and some signals.[/list]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/worldofwarships/schedule style=button]Official Channel Stream Schedule[/url]
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=challenges][/h1]Twitch Challenges[/b][/h2]
This is the biggest source of Community Tokens! Twitch Challenges are combat missions that unlock directly in your Port each week after watching [b]90 minutes[/b] of eligible World of Warships broadcasts, whether on our official channel or other channels. Each of the five weekly missions will reward you with [b]400 Community Tokens[/b], for a grand total of 2,000 by the end of the update.

Commanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.11.0! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fixed bugs on the maps Solomon Islands, Tears of the Desert, and Trap.
[*]The snow cover effect on ships has been added for the maps Big Race, Ice Islands, Polar, Northern Waters, Shatter, and Northern Lights.
[*]Fixed a bug causing clan tags to not display in Contacts.
[*]Fixed the incorrect exchange rate for duplicate elements of the “Italian Destroyers” collection.
[*]Fixed incorrect bonuses provided by [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_America_e1c73e4294d3f8addc39872e23f6457e6f540a68db120d8bc5dec7e2034f83af.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Atlântico[/b][/b]’s permanent camouflage. The values were brought to standard for Tier VIII.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
By progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server, you can earn Community Tokens. Community Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items. All details about Community Tokens are available in [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/community-tokens/]a dedicated article[/url]
[list][b]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/b][/list]

[h2][b][h1=early-access-to-italian-destroyers][/h1]Continuation of Early Access to Italian destroyers[/b][/h2]
Early Access to Italian destroyers continues in Update 0.11.3. An additional component of the event dedicated to Early Access is a new collection that reveals details of the artillery armament of Regia Marina destroyers and awards of Italian sailors.

[b]The collection[/b] consists of three pages, with six elements on each. Elements of the collection can be obtained from the event containers.

[b]The reward for completing each of the sections is[/b] the ability to mount a second commemorative flag aboard Italian destroyers, cruisers, and battleships.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection are [/b][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Leone[/b][/b] and a commemorative flag.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f86588c4-a6c4-11ec-86dd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=dockyard][/h1]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
The building of Pan-American battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_America_e1c73e4294d3f8addc39872e23f6457e6f540a68db120d8bc5dec7e2034f83af.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Atlântico[/b][/b] commences in Update 0.11.3. She will leave the famous British Clydebank Dockyard that saw [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Marlborough[/b][/b] sail out in the past. Atlântico carries ten 381 mm guns in 5 twin turrets with only one shell type—AP shells.

[h2]Event Rules[/h2]
[list][*]The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 22 phases.
[*]These shipbuilding phases can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat mission groups or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] Doubloons to pass through each phase.
[*]The combat mission groups span two updates—0.11.3 and 0.11.4—and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the start of Update 0.11.5.
[*]In total, you can progress through 19 out of 22 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions.[/list]
[list][i]Please note: New battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_America_e1c73e4294d3f8addc39872e23f6457e6f540a68db120d8bc5dec7e2034f83af.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Atlântico[/b][/b] will not be available on the Public Test server.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=visual-improvements-and-changes][/h1]Visual Improvements and Changes[/b][/h2]
Our work on the visual component of the game is ongoing, and you can expect new graphical improvements and changes in Update 0.11.3.

[h2]New Effects[/h2]
We've improved how snow and sand are displayed on islands. We've also added the effect of snow covering ships, depending on the weather.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3999d2c2-a8f1-11ec-b64f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39ecf664-a8f1-11ec-9e99-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39911b14-a8f1-11ec-978e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]HD textures on maps[/h2]
We're continuing to update all the maps to accommodate enhanced HD textures. In Update 0.11.3, high-detail textures will be added on the Tears of the Desert, Trap, Warrior’s Path, and Solomon Islands maps.

In future updates, we'll keep working on texture details on other maps and Ports.
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95b51e50-a8f5-11ec-b034-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95be7054-a8f5-11ec-bef1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95cd1bb8-a8f5-11ec-90cb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/965b1f76-a8f5-11ec-b64f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95ce1db0-a8f5-11ec-9372-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9659c194-a8f5-11ec-b587-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95b53692-a8f5-11ec-b852-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95cda682-a8f5-11ec-a3e9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Aircraft camouflages[/h2]
The camouflage mounted on the ship will also be displayed on aircraft that belong to that ship. This effect applies to all aircraft types in the game, including aircraft carrier squadrons and fighters, spotting aircraft, and airstrike flights.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09c35be2-a6c9-11ec-a20a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09c374ba-a6c9-11ec-8ab0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Underwater world improvements[/h2]
The improved visuals have made the ships and underwater landscape look more natural and picturesque. We've also improved how distant underwater objects are drawn in the Binocular View.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ff81b70-a8f2-11ec-919a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6f3f5ffe-a8f2-11ec-b64f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ff9704c-a8f2-11ec-917a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

Captains, thank you for participating in the Public Test of Update 0.11.2! Since this Update is particularly complex and packed with content, we decided to go outside the boundary of our usual PT structure and host a third session to ensure maximum stability for all players. As always, your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix bugs. Check out the changelog and join the third session of the Public Test!
[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The game client has been stabilized and bugs that caused it to crash have been fixed.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed submarines to receive “Hits to citadel” ribbons.
[*]Fixed a bug causing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Tallinn[/b][/b]’s camouflage to not be fully displayed.
[*]Balance changes have been applied to the Savage Battle mode, as a result of which the Barracuda faction was strengthened.
[*]Balance changes were made to some test ships and to submarines. Details can be found at our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/293]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Fixed visual bugs in the port of Taranto.
[*]Fixed bugs relating to the display of the different submarine states and their associated parameters on the minimap, tooltips, and UI.
[*]Fixed a bug where when changing the type of torpedoes on a submarine, information about the ability to hit a target was incorrectly updated.
[*]Fixed other minor bugs.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
[list][*]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[*]Any due rewards will automatically be credited to your account within a few days of the release of the new update.
[*]Once the Public Test begins, the starting ships for the Savage Battle event will appear on your accounts.[/list]
[list][i]By progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server, you can earn Community Tokens.[/i][/list]

[list][*]In the first round, many testers experienced game crashes. For the second round, we’ve done some bugfixing to stabilize the client. Thank you for your feedback.
[*]Changed the colors of the different teams' icons in Savage Battle — now they are more easily distinguishable from each other.
[*]Balance changes applied to the Savage Battle mode: the Moray Eel faction has been reinforced, the Octopus faction was weakened, and changes were made to the post-battle economy of ships based on testing results.
[*]Fixed incorrect detectability settings for submarines.
[*]Fixed and issue that caused ships to get stuck near islands on the map Neighbors.
[*]Fixed a bug that made the researching of ships in bulk work incorrectly.
[*]Fixed visual bugs in the Flooded City port.
[*]Fixed the incorrect working of the Top Grade Gunner skill.
[*]Balance changes were made to Superships, Hornet, submarines, and depth charges. Further details can be found in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/289]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Fixed several other minor bugs.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
[list][*]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[*]Any due rewards will automatically be credited to your account within a few days of the release of the new update.
[*]Once the Public Test begins, the starting ships for the Savage Battle event will appear on your accounts.[/list]
[list][i]By progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server, you can earn Community Tokens.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=submarines][/h1]Submarines[/b][/h2]
After a short break, submarines are again lurking in the depths of our seas for testing purposes. Read on for a glimpse of how to play and counter the revamped subs.

In this new round of testing, we've gone above and beyond to address all the issues reported by you—from subs being hard to detect and interact with, to the unstable damage-dealing capabilities of submarines. We've made both playing and countering submarines more intuitive. We hope these changes will help us shape the final stages of the new ship type's evolution. To make it easier for you to go through the new round of testing, we've reworked the way information is displayed by placing a stronger focus on the key aspects of playing a sub and countering one.

[h3][b]Countering a Submarine[/b][/h3]
[list][*]In the new testing round, surface ships have a wider range of options to interact with submarines.
[list][*]Sonar pings emitted by a sub now hint at the sub's approximate location because surface ships now have the ability to spot those pings.
[*]We've added a new mechanic—oil spills. These will appear on the water's surface over the location of damaged submarines, giving you the ability to track their movements.[/list]
[*]The Airstrike armament with an accelerated cooldown will allow for more frequent attacks and complement the new mechanics.
[*]Airstrike depth charges now always cause flooding, making them the perfect weapon to take a major chunk of a sub's HP.
[*]A submarine, however, can only have one instance of flooding at a time. This means that putting her under a barrage of Airstrikes won't be an overly efficient way of using this armament.[/list]
[h3][b]Playing a Submarine[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A sub can glide between three key positions—the surface, periscope depth, and maximum depth. This will make it easier for players on both teams to operate submarines and determine their depth in battle.
[*]A submarine can inflict damage to her foes in two ways:
[list][*]The safer option is to use homing torpedoes.
[*]The harder and riskier but more rewarding option is to stick to conventional torpedoes.[/list]
[*]The number of Damage Control Party consumable charges is now limited, which means that it's more important now for submarines to be aware of the situation around them and stay alert at all times.
[list][*]Damage Control Party should be used wisely, and it will certainly help you escape some tricky situations. For example, a damaged sub risks being tracked down by the oil spill she leaves on the surface and then suffering more flooding damage from the inevitable depth charge attack that ensues.
[*]If you run out of charges early in a battle, you will reduce your chances of having an effect on the outcome of the battle during its closing stages.[/list]
[*]An unlimited number of charges for the Hydrophone consumable. In the new testing round, this equipment will provide updated data on the whereabouts of enemies more frequently.[/list]

[list][i]More details about these changes will be available on the Public Test Server and in the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/279]Development Blog[/url].[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=italian-destroyers-part-1][/h1]Italian destroyers: Part 1[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.2 ushers Italian destroyers into Early Access.

All ships of the new branch are notable for being able to deal high damage per minute, but their main battery guns spit SAP and HE shells only and have a very short range of fire. The Italian destroyers are also armed with long-range torpedoes. The ships have access to Exhaust Smoke Generator and Emergency Engine Power starting from Tier II.

The Taranto Port has been updated to celebrate the arrival of the Italian destroyers in Early Access.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8b9e33c-90b3-11ec-8b85-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][b]The Italian destroyers will not be available on the Public Test Server.[/b][/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=clash-of-courage][/h1]Clash of Courage[/b][/h2]
One of the key new features is a temporary event called Clash of Courage. The Italian Navy, known for its love of destroyers, is staging a competition between divisions composed of the same series of ships to determine the most successful team. Choose which team you want to join as an ally, and keep in mind that each team will provide you with a unique reward—an Italian Commander with 6 skill points and a team patch.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8c9824c-90b3-11ec-8b65-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The Clash of Courage event works in a similar way to the New Year's Night, Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry, and Battle of the Beasts events.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8d667b4-90b3-11ec-8af5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]Participate in the event to earn Italian Tokens, which can be exchanged for Early Access ships, permanent camouflages, and other items.[/list] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=savage-battle][/h1]Savage Battle: Sink 'Em All![/b][/h2]
The Savage Battle is back! The power of a once-great civilization is now history, and their glorious city is destroyed and flooded. It's your territory now—fight and become one of the best!

Battles will be fought between four teams, each with three ships. The small line-ups will let players enjoy the battle playing either solo or in a Division.

The Savage Battle will start on the outskirts of a flooded city. At the beginning of the battle, your ship has no consumable charges. This is because the world is on the brink of collapse, and the only limited resources that remain out there will go to those who fight the hardest to get them. Collect consumable charges from special zones and remember—each time you destroy an enemy ship, you will also obtain a charge for a random consumable. Watch out—the other teams are on high alert and can get at you where you would least expect them! On top of your enemies, you also want to watch out for the Wild Fire that encircles the water. Ships that remain engulfed in the Wild Fire gradually lose HP.

[h3][i]Octopus[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]

The ships are also equipped with secondary batteries, but these are not the specialty of the Octopuses. [/expand]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fbdebf32-90af-11ec-976b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The resources that you obtain at the end of each battle now depend on the place your team takes—the higher the place, the more resources you'll obtain! The team that loses all of their ships is out of the battle. The team with the last surviving ship (or ships) on the battlefield is the winner.

[h2][b][h1=visual-effects-improvements][/h1]Visual Effects Improvements[/b][/h2]
World of Warships is getting even more pleasing to the eye! The new update brings reworked effects for shooting main and secondary battery guns; depth charges hitting the water and islands; local weather effects on the Hotspot, North, Greece, and Islands of Ice maps; aircraft explosions on the deck when aircraft carriers are destroyed; obtaining a Supercontainer; and rain.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59b6dc66-90b0-11ec-9296-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59ad1b36-90b0-11ec-b09e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59e6afd6-90b0-11ec-aa54-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59ec1df4-90b0-11ec-976b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=changes-to-the-game-mechanics][/h1]Changes to the Game Mechanics[/b][/h2]
We have updated the mechanics of determining a ship's maximum spotting range. All ships now have a minimum spotting range that depends on their tier and type, as well as a dynamic spotting range. The first range is a constant value that's set regardless of the ship's parameters. The dynamic spotting range depends on the current firing range of all the ship's weapons (main battery guns, torpedoes, secondary battery guns, and Airstrike) and always exceeds this value by 25% or 3 km. At the same time, it's the higher value of the minimum and dynamic spotting ranges that's always applied.

[i]Example:[/i] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] North Carolina[/b][/b] has a standard firing range of 21.1 km. The minimum spotting range for a Tier VIII battleship is 30 km. The dynamic spotting range for North Carolina is 21.1 * 1.25 = 26.4 km. As the largest value is applied, the spotting range for North Carolina with a firing range of 21.1 km is set at 30 km.

If we equip the ship with Gun Fire Control System and Artillery Plotting Room Modification 1, our firing range will be 27 km and the dynamic spotting range value will reach 33.75 km, which will be the prevailing value for the ship's spotting range in this case. If we also launch Spotting Aircraft in battle and increase our firing range to 32.4 km, our spotting range in battle will increase to a value that exceeds 40 km.

This, of course, is but a simple example that's intended to show how the new mechanics work. It's by no means a recommendation for selecting upgrades and equipment for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] North Carolina[/b][/b].

As we standardize these values, the standard spotting range values of certain ships may either decrease or increase.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Minor changes have been made to the Port interface—we've updated the tooltips for currencies and resources, corrected descriptions of ships, and added other minor details.
[*]We've also made it possible to research several consecutive ships from any branch in the Tech Tree.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c0f0a4bc-90b4-11ec-b0cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b][h1=pan-asian-cruisers][/h1]Pan-Asian Cruisers[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dce0835a-89b0-11ec-98fa-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.11.1, Pan-Asian cruisers continue to be available in Early Access. Ships of the new branch are equipped with main guns that have a rather small caliber but high rate of fire. They carry powerful deepwater torpedoes that pose a deadly threat to all ship types except destroyers. This, however, comes at a price—the new ships cannot boast of having high survivability.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5751746-8a44-11ec-9e8d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5606634-8a44-11ec-93e3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5d3d4ac-8a44-11ec-9527-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c56faff4-8a44-11ec-ba47-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Consumables[/h2]
[list][*]Smoke Generator with a reduced cooldown time for all ships of the branch.
[*]Defensive AA Fire for the new cruisers of Tier VI and above.
[*]Torpedo Reload Booster for the ships of Tier VII and above.

[h2][b][h1=dirigible-derby][/h1]Dirigible Derby[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/af6af810-8a64-11ec-a67e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.11.1 kicks off a temporary battle type named "Dirigible Derby."

Historically, airships carried intelligence agents with important messages and diplomats traveling to conduct secret negotiations in neutral territories. The new battle type tasks you with a mission to delay the hostile airship while also making sure that your allied airship is the first to reach the destination point.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
Each team will have an invulnerable airship that moves along a fixed route. Your team's mission is to outrun the opposing team in escorting their airship to the end of the route or destroy all enemy ships.

The teams can affect the speed of both allied and hostile airships. Each airship has an interactive zone with a 3 km radius displayed around it. The airship will move faster if only allied ships are within that zone and will slow down if at least one enemy ship manages to sneak inside it.

[b]Format:[/b] 12 vs. 12 playing Tier X ships.

[h2][b][h1=personal-challenges][/h1]Personal Challenges[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dd2abcf4-89b0-11ec-a65b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.11.1 brings back Personal Challenges. Your goal during the event is to earn as much base XP as possible while showing off your skills in battle playing ships of different types and nations. More details will follow in a dedicated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/personal-challenges-and-the-naval-battle/#personal-challenges]article[/url].

We've updated the rewards, and the table of records will be reset 2 weeks after the update goes live. This means that the rewards will again become available to any players who manage to reach the top level prior to the reset.

You can take up Personal Challenges in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Dirigible Derby.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
Each completed Personal Challenge mission will bring you [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_cf148075fbd52573c744fbc889a1a765b55ca304693f6c2b5fecf36d3cc8ef76.png[/img] 1x Mediterranean Token and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]50[/b] Coal.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6c08d47a-8a6e-11ec-baae-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The event is split into two rounds, each 2 weeks long.
[*]In the span of 2 weeks, you can get a maximum of [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_cf148075fbd52573c744fbc889a1a765b55ca304693f6c2b5fecf36d3cc8ef76.png[/img] 50 Tokens.
[*]After reaching the maximum weekly limit, each completed task will bring only [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]50[/b] Coal.
[*]Once the table is reset, you'll be able to earn Tokens again.
[*]The entire event can bring you as many as [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_cf148075fbd52573c744fbc889a1a765b55ca304693f6c2b5fecf36d3cc8ef76.png[/img] 100 Mediterranean Tokens.[/list]
Navigate to "Gibraltar Pillars"—a special tab in the Armory—to exchange Mediterranean Tokens for sequential bundles and other rewards. You will have access to two types of sequential bundles. They include one of two new ships—[b] [b][b]VI[/b] Dido[/b][/b] or [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Canarias[/b][/b]—clad in the Atlantic permanent camouflage, as well as Firepower Premium containers, which can drop Tier X ships. Mediterranean Tokens can be exchanged until the end of Update 0.11.2.

The number of Tokens you can grab for free by progressing through Personal Challenges will be enough to get [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Dido[/b][/b] or [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Canarias[/b][/b] and one Firepower container.

[b] [b][b]VI[/b] Dido[/b][/b], named in honor of Queen Dido—the legendary founder of Carthage—served extensively in the Mediterranean during World War II. The ship is armed with ten 133 mm main guns and torpedoes that have a decent reload time and speed. She can also choose between firing all of her torpedoes in a single salvo or one at a time. Despite somewhat mediocre survivability, the ship boasts good concealment and agility characteristics. She is propelled by an engine with enhanced parameters that allow her to gain or drop speed fast. However, the cruiser lacks the Propulsion Modification 1 upgrade in Slot 4. Dido is equipped with Defensive AA Fire and Short-Burst Smoke Generator, which has lots of charges and a short reset timer but also a short smoke setting time and individual smoke clouds that don't last very long.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/324efb46-8a51-11ec-abcb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b] [b][b]VI[/b] Canarias[/b][/b] was built in Spain in the 1930s using a British design (Armstrong). During World War II, Spain remained neutral, and the means of identification the cruiser carried on both of her sides was the country's national flag. The ship is armed with eight 203 mm main guns that can fire only AP shells with enhanced ricochet angles. The guns have a long firing range and good reload time for their caliber. Canarias' survivability is quite solid, but this feature comes at the cost of rather mediocre maneuverability. The range of consumables the ship has access to includes Hydroacoustic Search and Engine Boost—a consumable that isn't typically found on cruisers and provides the ship a 15% boost to her maximum speed.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/324fe52e-8a51-11ec-bc2f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Firepower containers have chances of dropping a new ship named [b] [b][b]X[/b] Forrest Sherman[/b][/b]—the lead ship of a series of destroyers that were built after World War II and designed with the experience gained from the conflict in mind. The ship relies on three rapid-firing 127 mm main guns that spit HE and SAP shells, as well as four 533 mm single torpedo mounts—two on either side of the ship. They have a long reach and good reload time but a narrow aiming sector. The destroyer is equipped with Hydroacoustic Search, Defensive AA Fire, and Smoke Generator with a small number of charges, but she has no access to Engine Boost.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9a4489d2-8a51-11ec-8748-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The destroyer will also be available in the Armory in exchange for Coal later.

[h2][b][h1=changes-to-the-in-game-economy][/h1]Changes to the In-Game Economy[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dcdb171c-89b0-11ec-a885-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Damage to Aircraft[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe0f9fca-7ac4-11ec-b3e5-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]The economic reward for destroying aircraft will now be distributed in the same way as the reward for damaging and destroying ships. Some Credits and XP will be issued not only for shooting aircraft down but also for dealing damage to them.

On average, the amount of resources earned won't change, but the reward will be easier to obtain.

[h2]Ammunition Resupply[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe1514a0-7ac4-11ec-bff8-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]The costs of resupplying aircraft carrier ammunition and the Airstrike armament will now be calculated by reference to the amount of ammunition used rather than the number of aircraft lost. Credits will also be spent on resupplying depth charges used by destroyers and cruisers.

These steps will bring the costs of resupplying aircraft carrier ammunition, the Airstrike armament, and depth charges in line with the other types of ammunition.

[h2]Aircraft Carrier XP[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe15a744-7ac4-11ec-a704-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]We've reworked the way XP is earned by Tier VIII and X carriers. They will now earn more for sinking enemies and less for damaging them.

Previously, good battle performance playing Tier VIII and X carriers yielded a smaller reward compared to the other ship types. Even sinking numerous enemy ships hardly ever placed carriers among the top XP earners on the team. Now, effective performance in battle will result in a bigger reward.

[h2]Changes to Bots[/h2]
We've completely reworked the AI system behind the in-game bots. The new system makes setting up bots for various battle types and in-game scenarios simpler and faster.

We've simplified the behavior algorithm of bots for all difficulty levels in the Training Rooms. We don't expect any considerable changes to bot behavior in Operations, Co-op Battles, or the various temporary battle types. However, since the sheer scale of this update of the entire AI system is so massive, it's difficult to provide an assessment of the effects of these changes at this point. We'll be keeping a close eye on bot behavior and making further tweaks if necessary.

Currently, we're actively working on improving the AI within this new system. We already have some improvements planned for bots in Operations and the Training Room. In addition to that, changes are also expected in other battle types. We'll share the details a bit later.

Commanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.11.0! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes were applied to Superships, German battleships, and others. We will also be unifying the way acceleration works across all ships. Further details are available in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/270]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Improvements were made to "Dirigible Derby": we implemented bug fixes to solve problems with ship spawn positions on the map, earning achievements, and airships colliding with each other, as well as other minor fixes and improvements. We also added an icon indicating that the airship has slowed down if there are no allies within its circular interactive zone.
[*]Fixed an issue that made it impossible to choose a ship in the carousel after applying filters.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the client to crash after leaving the in-game browser.
[*]Fixed several other issues.[/list]

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.1[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#dirigible-derby]Dirigible Derby[/url]
[url=#super-aircraft-carriers]Super Aircraft Carriers[/url]
[url=#personal-challenges]Personal Challenges[/url]
[url=#changes-to-the-in-game-economy]Changes to the In-Game Economy[/url]
[url=#other-improvements]Other Improvements[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=dirigible-derby][/h1]Dirigible Derby[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.1 kicks off a new temporary battle type codenamed "Dirigible Derby."

Historically, these airships carried intelligence agents with important messages and diplomats traveling to conduct secret negotiations in neutral territories. The new battle type tasks you with a mission to delay the hostile airship while also making sure that your allied airship is the first to reach the destination point.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
[list][i]Battles will be held in a 12 vs. 12 format playing Tier X ships.[/i][/list]

Each team will have an invulnerable airship that moves along a fixed route. Your team's mission is to outrun the opposing team in escorting their airship to the end of the route or destroy all enemy ships.

The teams can affect the speed of both allied and hostile airships. Each airship has an interactive zone with a 3 km radius displayed around it. The airship will move faster if only allied ships are within that zone and will slow down if at least one enemy ship sneaks inside it.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5df8a930-7ac6-11ec-8769-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e11b1a0-7ac6-11ec-b66c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5eb81018-7ac6-11ec-a2c2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c333c48c-7ce8-11ec-8197-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c32029b8-7ce8-11ec-a8ce-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=super-aircraft-carriers][/h1]Super Aircraft Carriers[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.1 sees the launch of two new superships in the game:
[list][*]British aircraft carrier [b]Eagle[/b] was initially laid down as one of the Audacious-class warships. The carrier was completed to a substantially altered project, and she was later given an extensive modernization that allowed her to carry and operate the most advanced deck-based aircraft of the 1950s, including jet aircraft.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/504bfa74-7ac3-11ec-a4d4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]American aircraft carrier [b]United States[/b] was intended to be the lead ship of a new design of super carriers that was laid down in 1949 but was never completed. Our developers have recreated her in the game as a fleet strike carrier with necessary alterations to the ship's layout design and equipment.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/50ba3854-7ac3-11ec-8d97-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The ships carry two types of squadrons: standard and tactical. While standard squadrons are a carrier's striking power that players are already familiar with, tactical squadrons constitute a new weapon.

Tactical squadrons on board the new carriers are composed of very fast jet-propelled aircraft. This feature allows them to quickly cover substantial distances and carry out lightning-fast attacks against enemy ships. The jet aircraft of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b] Eagle[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b] United States[/b][/b] cannot slow down below their cruising speed, and their engine boost won't cool down when the aircraft are airborne.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/76d9466e-7ac4-11ec-8769-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29e5c24c-7ac4-11ec-8284-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We would like to note that the tactical squadrons carried by [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b] Eagle[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b] United States[/b][/b] are best used as auxiliary weapons, which is why they consist of one attacking flight only. This means their efficiency will be substantially impaired with each aircraft they lose, and for this reason, they can't expose themselves to enemy AA fire for long.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/76ccce20-7ac4-11ec-b3e5-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29ec27e0-7ac4-11ec-a6e6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=personal-challenges][/h1]Personal Challenges[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.1 brings back Personal Challenges. Your goal during the event is to earn as much Base XP as possible while demonstrating your skills in battle playing ships of different types and nations. More details will follow in a dedicated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/personal-challenges-and-the-naval-battle/#personal-challenges]article[/url].

We have updated rewards, and the table of records will be reset 2 weeks after the update goes live. This way, rewards will again be available to players who have already reached the limit.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a6346f90-7dbe-11ec-8e2d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]Rewards:[/b][/b] A new temporary resource called [b]Mediterranean Tokens[/b], plus Coal. Navigate to a special tab in the Armory to exchange your Mediterranean Tokens for bundles with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Dido[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Spain_5e711825138501e1ece2e80248e5b5efd6e544b05d2887dd1bd8ec577e33d820.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Canarias[/b][/b] in their Atlantic camouflage, as well as other rewards.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/20eeadaa-7ac6-11ec-bff8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/20e4d564-7ac6-11ec-a2c2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=changes-to-the-in-game-economy][/h1]Changes to the In-Game Economy[/b][/h2]
[h2]Damage to Aircraft[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe0f9fca-7ac4-11ec-b3e5-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]The economic reward for destroying aircraft will now be distributed in the same way as the reward for damaging and destroying ships. Part of Credits and XP will be issued not only for shooting aircraft down but also for dealing damage to them.

On average, the amount of resources earned won't change, but the reward will be easier to obtain.

[h2]Ammunition Resupply[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe1514a0-7ac4-11ec-bff8-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]The costs of resupplying carrier ammunition and the Airstrike armament will now be calculated by reference to the amount of ammunition used rather than the number of aircraft lost.

Credits will also be spent on resupplying depth charges used by destroyers and cruisers.

With these steps, we're bringing the costs of resupplying aircraft carriers' ammunition, the Airstrike armament, and depth charges in line with the other types of ammunition.

[h2]Aircraft Carrier XP[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe15a744-7ac4-11ec-a704-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]We've reworked the way XP is earned by Tier VIII and X carriers. They will now earn more for sinking enemies and less for damaging them.

Previously, good battle performance playing Tier VIII and X carriers yielded a smaller reward compared with the other ship types. Even sinking numerous enemy ships hardly ever placed carriers among the top XP earners on the team. Now, effective performance in battle will result in a bigger reward.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=other-improvements][/h1]Other Improvements[/b][/h2]
[h2]Changes to Bots[/h2]
We've entirely reworked the AI system behind in-game bots. The new system makes setting up bots for various battle types and in-game scenarios simpler and faster.

We've simplified the behavior algorithm of bots for all difficulty levels in the Training Rooms. We don't expect any considerable changes to bot behavior in Operations, Co-op Battles, and various temporary battle types. However, since the sheer scale of this update of the entire AI system is so massive, it's difficult to provide an assessment of the effect of these changes at this point. We'll be keeping a close eye on bot behavior and make further tweaks if necessary.

[h2]Tech Tree Changes[/h2]
With the release of Update 0.11.1, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] will be replaced in their Tech Tree branches by [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Preussen[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Delny[/b][/b], respectively.

More details about the Tech Tree changes are available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/upcoming-changes-to-the-tech-tree/]special article[/url].

[h2]Technical Updates[/h2]
[list][*]We've updated the way in which the conditions of missions and rewards, as well as other UI elements, are displayed in the Combat Missions tab.
[*]The behavior of the ships carousel has been fixed and updated for cases where various actions are made in the Port.[/list]

[h2][b][h1=pan-asian-cruisers][/h1]Pan-Asian Cruisers[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4b2a3a10-72c6-11ec-898b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The ships of the new branch have small-caliber guns with high rates of fire and powerful deepwater torpedoes, but they cannot boast of having high survivability.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e80da3fe-72ca-11ec-951d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03ec661e-7221-11ec-84df-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03d45aa6-7221-11ec-92e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04683b0e-7221-11ec-8eb5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/043fe320-7221-11ec-8d9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03d8898c-7221-11ec-a157-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Consumables[/h2]
[list][*]All ships in the branch are equipped with a variant of the Smoke Generator consumable with a reduced cooldown time.
[*]The new Tier VI and higher cruisers have Defensive AA Fire.
[*]The Tier VII and higher ships have the Torpedo Reload Booster consumable.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Sejong[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Jinan[/b][/b] are equipped with Repair Party.[/list]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
[b]Rewards:[/b] Completing combat missions will earn you a new temporary resource—Pan-Asian Tokens—as well as ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Chungking[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Chumphon[/b][/b] for completing the second and fourth combat mission groups, respectively.

Pan-Asian Tokens can also be obtained from random bundles available for Doubloons, free daily bundles, and in exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory.

[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_3_7c644d2bd3e7a71a90f1aed7ac9713ee597a33cd89aadb235cdd9e9e0647e798.png[/img] [b]Pan-Asian Tokens[/b] are a new temporary resource that can be earned for completing combat mission groups. Moreover, Pan-Asian Tokens can be obtained from random bundles available for Doubloons, free daily bundles, and in exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory.

[b]Rewards for Pan-Asian Tokens:[/b] Sequential bundles with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Rahmat[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Harbin[/b][/b], Silk Sunrise permanent camouflages for researchable Pan-Asian Tier VII–X cruisers, plus other rewards.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/caa34958-7221-11ec-9ee1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Jinan[/b][/b] will become available for purchase in exchange for Doubloons after you obtain all the sequential bundles available for the Tokens.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Sejong[/b][/b] is available in random bundles for Doubloons.[/list]
The Dragon Port has been updated to celebrate the arrival of the Pan-Asian cruisers in Early Access.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8ee46f0c-721f-11ec-a157-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8df4e09a-721f-11ec-88c9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8dfeca88-721f-11ec-bb9d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list]When Update 0.11.2 goes live, the Pan-Asian cruisers will become available for all players to research.[/list] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=asymmetric-battles][/h1]Asymmetric Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a608d1e-72c6-11ec-973a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2][b][h1=rental-superships][/h1]Rental Superships[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a96eef4-72c6-11ec-b5ac-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Superships and their mechanics have been of great interest to players so far, and these ships may one day become a full-fledged part of World of Warships. In the future, we want to continue the existing branches by adding superships. We consider this to be a logical step, and we are confident that superships do not fit into Tier X because of their superiority over their "predecessors" in terms of their performance characteristics.

This is a big and important decision for World of Warships. For this reason, we've planned thorough testing of the superships based on our previous experience.

We're carefully monitoring both the data we receive and your feedback. The current Ranked season has shown that superships fit into the current game concept and have been warmly received by players.

Therefore, starting from Update 0.11.0, the testing of superships will continue not only in Ranked and Co-op Battles but also in Random Battles.

Random Battles have a different format compared to Ranked Battles—12 vs. 12. It's important to test superships in these conditions because they significantly change the battle tempo and density, which means that the effectiveness of superships may change. The high popularity of Random Battles will allow us to collect the necessary statistics and get feedback for the further development of superships.

Only Tier IX and X ships will be able to participate in battles with superships, and the standard restrictions on the number of ships of certain types and tiers apply in battle.

[h3][i][h3][b]Battle of Jutland Container Mechanics[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
The chances of obtaining a particular reward from a group are the same for all items in the group. If a container drops an item from the Ships and Permanent Camouflages group, you will receive an item that you do not already have. The drop chances of a specific group don't change, regardless of how many items you already have from that group.

If you already have all the ships or permanent camouflages from the list and a Battle of Jutland container drops an item from the Ships and Permanent Camouflages group, you will receive the Battle of Jutland camouflage.

Battle of Jutland containers have the guaranteed drop mechanic applied: If an item from the Ships and Permanent Camouflages group does not drop after you open 249 Battle of Jutland containers, you are guaranteed to find an item from this group in the 250th container of this type.

[h2][b][h1=pan-asian-cruisers-part-1][/h1]Pan-Asian Cruisers: Part 1[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.0 brings Pan-Asian Tier V–X cruisers to Early Access. The ships of the new branch are notable for their small-caliber guns, high rates of fire, and powerful deepwater torpedoes, but they also have rather low survivability.

All researchable Pan-Asian cruisers are equipped with a variant of the Smoke Generator consumable with a reduced cooldown time, and starting from Tier VI, they have Defensive AA Fire. The new Tier VII–X ships are equipped with the Torpedo Reload Booster consumable; and starting from Tier IX—with the Repair Party consumable.

[list][b]The Pan-Asian cruisers can't be obtained on the Public Test Server.[/b][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rental-superships-0110][/h1]Rental Superships in Random Battles in 0.11.0[/b][/h2]
As we've already mentioned, superships with special mechanics have the potential to become a full-fledged part of World of Warships, given the interest shown in them. In the future, we want to continue the existing branches with superships. In addition to the logic of this continuation of the branches, we also believe that due to the superiority of superships in terms of their performance characteristics over their "predecessors," they do not fit into Tier X.

This is a big and important step for our game. Based on our previous experience, we planned to test them thoroughly. We're carefully monitoring both the data we receive and your feedback. The current Ranked Season has shown that superships fit into the current game concept and have been warmly received by players.

Therefore, starting from Update 0.11.0, the testing of superships will continue not only in Ranked and Co-op Battles but also in Random Battles—the most popular battle type in the game. This will allow us to better assess the current state of superships and continue to refine the content that is important for the game development.

In addition, Random Battles have a different format from that of Ranked Battles—12 vs. 12. It's important to test superships in this battle type because this significantly changes the battle tempo and density, which means that the effectiveness of superships may change.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf4459e4-5cb8-11ec-87cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf575576-5cb8-11ec-b48b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf5d1826-5cb8-11ec-a574-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf54c6f8-5cb8-11ec-8d2c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf5f57e4-5cb8-11ec-b663-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf31ee12-5cb8-11ec-91b7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]In Update 0.11.0, rental superships will be available from random bundles in the Armory. Only Tier IX and X ships will be able to participate in battles with superships, and the standard restrictions on the number of ships of certain types and tiers apply in battle.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=asymmetric-battles][/h1]Asymmetric Battles[/b][/h2]
The update sees the return of Asymmetric Battles—a temporary battle type with a different distribution of ships and tiers between teams.

We've changed the tiers of ships you can helm into battle.

[h3][b]First team[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tiers: IX and X
[*]Number of ships: 6–8[/list]
[h3][b]Second team[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tiers: VII and VIII
[*]Number of ships: 9–12[/list]
If there aren't enough players in the matchmaking queue, bots may be added to teams.

[list][i]To participate playing a Tier IX–X ship, a new temporary resource—[b]Battle Tokens[/b]—is required. You can earn these Tokens for completing combat missions by participating in Asymmetric Battles playing Tier VII–VIII ships.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=submarine-tweaks][/h1]Submarine Tweaks[/b][/h2]
We've updated the sonar ping and torpedo mechanics. A submarine can now simultaneously maintain sonar pings on several enemy ships.
[list][*]Sonar pings that hit a ship are now either active or inactive.
[*]After you launch torpedoes, they home in on an active ping hit sector and continue to home in on the sector if it becomes inactive. At the same time, torpedoes you release cannot be redirected to another target.
[*]Only the last sonar ping that hits an enemy ship is considered to be active.
[*]If a ship has an active ping hit sector and torpedoes are homing in on the sector, it will become inactive when the ping hits another ship.
[*]If a ship has an active ping hit sector and torpedoes are not homing in on the sector, it will disappear when the ping hits another ship.[/list]
These changes will prevent submarines from changing the target their torpedoes are homing in on, but they will also give them the ability to efficiently counter multiple opponents at once.

[h3][b]Detectability Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Submarines at the operating depth can now detect ships in smoke from the assured acquisition range.
[*]Ships in smoke can now detect submarines at the operating depth from the assured acquisition range.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused submarines to be affected by a 20-second detectability penalty after using a sonar ping.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused ships' detectability to increase for submarines after firing main battery guns while in smoke.[/list]We have also made a number of balance changes to submarines and anti-submarine weapons. The full details are available on our Development Blog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/23336b02daeab6994111d793a449dbf407af5402.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Recently, two bugs have been found on the main server:
[list][*]some ship modules have become indestructible;
[*]HP is incorrectly distributed to different parts of the ship when the Survivability Expert skill is active.[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The fix for the issue will be deployed[/b] [b]Fri. 17 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[list][b]Expected downtime: ~1 hour.
Please be aware that because of this, cross-server Clan Battles will not be available on the days the patch is being applied.[/b][/list]

Instead of reverting the mechanics, the fix will adjust how getting additional HP works in general (this covers such cases as Survivability Expert or, for example, HP buffs in Arms Race). Additional HP will be distributed among different parts of the ship proportionally instead of being put into the hull. As an example of what effect it might have, a destroyer with about 2,000–2,500 HP in the bow section and roughly 20,000 total HP, the increase of HP in the bow would be about 400 HP, which will not lead to a significant gameplay change. We understand that it won't be a full revert to how it was before, but we were planning to change this mechanic as it will help to improve the technical state of the game and keep the mechanics consistent.

As for the bug with indestructible modules — regrettably, the fix will only be deployed with the release of 0.11.0 due to the noticeable technical risk caused by applying it without sufficient testing, since it concerns the game's crucial damage dealing logic. We will also adjust the combat missions in the Dockyard which require destroying modules.

We apologize for this situation and would like to offer you a token of gratitude in the form of 3 WG containers — each dropping a day of Premium account — in each one which you will be able to claim by pressing the button below until the end of the year.

[h2][b][h1=new-year-celebrations][/h1]New Year Celebrations[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a62a04d6-527d-11ec-bb54-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gifts[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Fri. 10 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]End:[/b] [b]Thu. 20 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

A free Santa's Gift container will be available for you on the main page in the Armory. You can also claim another Santa's Gift container in the in-game Premium Shop.

The Armory and Premium Shop are also offering bundles with three types of Santa's Gift containers. In these festive containers, you'll find Doubloons, Coal, days of Warships Premium Account, camouflages, signals, or even one of 134 ships. You have specific chances to obtain rare ships, as well as Tier X ships.

[h2]Battle performance bonuses[/h2]
Receive traditional New Year battle performance bonuses—[b]"Snowflakes"[/b]—playing all of your Tier V ships and higher.

The bonus for combat results can be obtained by either scoring the first victory or earning 300 base XP playing a ship. Depending on the ship tier, you'll receive:
[list][*]Tier V–VII ships: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]750[/b] Coal
[*]Tier VIII–IX ships: [b]75[/b] Steel
[*]Tier X ships: 1 New Year Certificate[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3ef4ee64-52ac-11ec-a91f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3eef8096-52ac-11ec-b6d7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3eee0928-52ac-11ec-a5e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[b]New Year Certificates[/b] are a special temporary resource that you can exchange for festive Santa's Gift, Santa's Big Gift, and Santa's Mega Gift containers during Update 0.10.11.
[list][*]You can get one Santa's Gift container in exchange for [b]1[/b] New Year Certificate.
[*]You can get one Santa's Big Gift container in exchange for [b]3[/b] New Year Certificates.
[*]You can get one Santa's Mega Gift container in exchange for [b]5[/b] New Year Certificates.[/list]
[list][i]You'll be able to take advantage of festive battle performance bonuses until the end of Update 0.10.11. You can blow a Snowflake off each ship once in battles of any type, except for Training Battles.[/i][/list]

[list]With the release of Update 0.11.0, each remaining New Year certificate will be exchanged for one Santa's Gift container.[/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Exchange limit[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
If the exchange limit of 100 unopened containers is exceeded, the Santa's Gift containers you receive will not be opened automatically. This means that you can store more than 100 containers. However, due to the technical specifics of containers received after the exchange limit, the subsequent opening of a Santa's Gift container or any other container that you receive will lead to all Santa's Gift containers that exceed the unopened container limit being opened.

Let's say you have 100 unopened containers and 4 New Year Certificates at the end of the update cycle, for example. With the release of Update 0.11.0, your remaining 4 New Year certificates will be exchanged for four Santa's Gift containers, and these will not be opened automatically. Thus, you'll have 104 unopened containers. If you then open one Santa's Gift container or receive a More Resources container, any other Santa's Gift containers in your possession that exceed the limit will be opened automatically.

[h2]New Year's Night[/h2]
One of the primary features of our New Year celebrations is a temporary event called [b]New Year's Night[/b]. Magic stars brought three snow giants to life, and those snow giants now have the responsibility to prepare the festive celebrations. Each star entrusted its snow giant an errand in preparation for the celebrations. Help them contribute to the celebration!

The New Year's Night event is similar to the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry and Battle of the Beasts events but with some small interface tweaks—we've updated the tooltips on the team selection screen and above the mission cards.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95f9dfe6-52aa-11ec-9b4c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/961e3788-52aa-11ec-bf12-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/961a9e5c-52aa-11ec-a908-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/958a8a7e-52aa-11ec-a41a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95874864-52aa-11ec-b66d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h3][b]Event rules[/b][/h3]
The event starts 2 weeks after the release of the update and runs until the end of Update 0.10.11. It is divided into four stages, with each stage running for 1 week.

Once each week, you can choose one of three teams named after the magic stars: [b]Modus[/b], [b]Sertum[/b], or [b]Munera[/b]. During the event, you need to complete personal missions that are issued daily to all participants. The missions can be completed throughout the day in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles. Completing the missions will advance you through personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards.

Each team offers different unique rewards such as themed Commanders—the snow giants with 6 skill points—and [b] [b][b]V[/b] Omaha[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]V[/b] Jaguar[/b][/b], or [b] [b][b]V[/b] Conte di Cavour[/b][/b] in the Snow and Stars permanent camouflage. The first time you earn a unique reward from any team, you will also receive the New Year's Night achievement.

Other rewards include a new temporary resource—[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_6_2949a8a229f2246eaf7a90ca8e43e15593606e41c27ca88657864966a6b07d19.png[/img] [b]Star Tokens[/b], Christmas and New Year in the Navy collection containers, and New Year Sky expendable camouflages.

You can receive up to 600 Star Tokens for taking part in the event. Apart from that, you can obtain up to 300 Star Tokens in exchange for Credits in the Armory, or alternatively, you can also purchase them with Doubloons.

[h2][b][h1=dockyard][/h1]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a5764f2c-527d-11ec-b328-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.11 offers you the opportunity to start building a new ship. [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Marlborough[/b][/b] is based on a 1947 project with some of the design solutions borrowed from the Vanguard-class and King George V-class ships. Her primary feature is extensive but not particularly accurate artillery consisting of sixteen 356 mm guns housed in four turrets. While the battleship's armor is rather mediocre, this is compensated for by low detectability and numerous main battery guns that fire quite rapidly for her type and have a decent firing range.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ceecb216-52a9-11ec-b66d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ce7abf9e-52a9-11ec-a41a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ceecfed8-52a9-11ec-b28a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
While constructing [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Marlborough[/b][/b], you can also obtain the famous [b] [b][b]III[/b] Dreadnought[/b][/b] and a new ship, [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Repulse[/b][/b]—one of the Renown-class battleships that fought during the First and Second World Wars. The ship is armed with six 381 mm guns housed in three turrets. The guns have a good reach and decent accuracy, and they reload quickly for a battleship. Repulse enjoys high speed and a large HP pool, but she is relatively poorly armored.

[h2][b][h1=submarine-tweaks][/h1]Submarine Tweaks[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a60ba900-527d-11ec-b136-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The torpedo homing mechanics have been updated:
[list][*]At the maximum launch distance, they will home in strictly on the impact point of a sonar ping without considering the target lead.
[*]As the distance to the target decreases, torpedoes will home in with a gradually increasing lead—up to 50%. After reaching half the launch distance, torpedoes will home in strictly on the lead point.
[*]At the same time, just like before, torpedoes stop homing when they are within a certain distance of their target.[/list]
This change will allow torpedoes to home in on their targets in a more natural way and reduce the frequency of situations where homing torpedoes launched in the proximity of islands at ships highlighted with a sonar ping would hit the land. Moreover, it will be somewhat easier for the target itself to dodge homing torpedoes because removing the sonar ping effect no longer affects the accuracy of torpedoes.

The Hydrophone now becomes available some time after each battle begins. Unlike main battery guns or torpedo launchers, the time that the Hydrophone takes to prepare for battle is longer than its reload time.

This change will reduce the impact of submarines on the gameplay on enemy submarines at the beginning of each battle and allow them to occupy a more advantageous tactical position without being detected by the Hydrophone at the very start of the battle.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list][*]Added an underwater torpedo reticle.
[*]You can enter Training Battles playing submarines on maps that feature the underwater world.
[*]Added the indication of additional dive capacity depletion for a detected enemy submarine.
[*]Added information about the additional dive capacity depletion of detected submarines to the post-battle statistics screen.
[*]Added new tips for submarines when they launch sonar pings at a target:
[list][*]"The ping will be dispersed"—if the target has the Damage Control Party or Fast Damage Control Team consumable active.
[*]"Insufficient time for torpedoes to acquire the target"—if the target is too close for torpedoes to home in.[/list]
[*]The ship status screen that is brought up by pressing [b]H[/b] now displays the ship's detectability from a submarine that is at the operational or periscope depths, as well as when the ship is inside a smoke screen.
[*]Added the ability to switch to torpedo launchers from Sonar by pressing [b]3[/b] for all submarines.[/list]

[h2]Other content[/h2]
We have added a Dutch Commander—[b]Klaas Janssen[/b]—available in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]35,000[/b] Coal. The Commander has two improved skills:
[list][*]For destroyers, cruisers, and battleships—Demolition Expert: [b]+1.5%[/b] to the chances of setting a target on fire when hitting it with HE shells (by default: +1%).
[*]For cruisers and battleships—Focus Fire Training: [b]+35%[/b] to AA damage in the priority sector (by default: +25%).[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/86e44792-52ac-11ec-8f04-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Added a German Destroyers container, available in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]2,000[/b] Coal. We have also changed the contents of the container.

Each German Destroyers container now includes:

[*]3x signals of the same type (Zulu, Equal Speed Charlie London, Papa Papa, or Zulu Hotel) or [b]1,500[/b] Elite Commander XP[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3f347c54-52bc-11ec-8cb8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
