[h2][b][h1=arms-race][/h1]Arms Race[/b][/h2]
Arms Race is back as a temporary battle type in Update 0.10.10. This represents an important testing round before we add Arms Race to Random Battles at some point in the future.

Arms Race brings various buffs scattered around the map that spice up the usual flow of battle. Once picked up, they benefit your entire team by improving their combat characteristics right until the end of each battle.

The new iteration features new buffs that boost armament damage and increase the current and maximum HP values. You can also expect the following changes:
[list][*]The HP-regenerating buff turned out to be overly effective compared with others and reduced the appeal of the Repair Party consumable for players. We've reduced the efficiency of the buff while also refocusing it to first restore the parts of ships that cannot be repaired by the Repair Party consumable.
[*]The following buffs have been removed: consumable reload acceleration for ships and squadrons; ship speed increase and rudder-shift time reduction, and aircraft Engine Boost consumable reload time reduction.
[list][*]Reducing the reload time was not as effective as we had intended. It provided a significant bonus only after several levels of this buff had been picked up. Players were only able to achieve this in the middle or closer to the end of a battle when most ships are typically left with just a few consumable charges or none at all.
[*]Boosting ship speed and maneuverability was excessively effective for a limited number of ships. For most ships, this boost was of little benefit.[/list]
[*]We have added an economic reward of XP and Credits for players who pick up buffs, but we have also brought the number of buff levels down from six to three. This will enhance the overall effect provided by each particular level.
[*]More buffs will now spawn in "neutral waters," and ships will start each battle in wide formations like they do in Random Battles.[/list]

[h2][b][h1=visual-improvements-and-changes][/h1]Visual Improvements and Changes[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.10 brings quite a few large-scale improvements and changes to the graphics as we continue working on the game's visuals.

[h2]New water[/h2]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a536a5ba-2b5f-11ec-b51f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Water simulation and visuals have been completely reworked for all maps. The new simulation system can create waves of any shape and height while also adding realism to wave dynamics. This means that waves will now gently rock a ship, and the ship will produce a response that varies according to the wave height. This change will not affect gameplay.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49b32876-2a97-11ec-87a4-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a7a771e-2a97-11ec-8165-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

We have improved the display of the sun glitter path over water and other optical effects on the water's surface. Added dynamic seafoam and updated the ship wake effect.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3e244472-2a83-11ec-bbf4-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[list][i]With low graphics settings, water simulation will remain unchanged.[/i][/list]

[h2]HD textures on maps[/h2]
We are launching a massive update for all maps and Ports to accommodate enhanced HD textures. In Update 0.10.10, high-detail textures will be added to the Two Brothers and Hotspot maps, as well as the Philippines, Saint-Petersburg, and Twitch Prime Ports.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4f4850d4-2a71-11ec-8cf1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4f601174-2a71-11ec-8e38-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/50090dce-2a71-11ec-9bc2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/500be918-2a71-11ec-885f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Future updates will bring high-detail textures for other maps and Ports. However, like with HDR lighting, such an update requires a huge amount of content to be reworked and an individual approach to each map and Port. For that reason, adopting the new technology for all maps and Ports in the game will take time and be implemented incrementally with the release of future updates.

[h2]Underwater world, vegetation, and animations[/h2]
We are continuing to improve the underwater world in our game. In Update 0.10.10, we have added underwater vegetation on the Two Brothers and Hotspot maps. The underwater world will also appear on the Haven, Sleeping Giant, and Crash Zone Alpha maps. In the next updates, we will focus on adding improvements to the underwater world on other maps as well.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/108011cc-2a74-11ec-8161-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/10be30d8-2a74-11ec-8cf1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/104b52b6-2a74-11ec-8fa2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/10bc76d0-2a74-11ec-b01e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/104dcca8-2a74-11ec-92a4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/108210ee-2a74-11ec-907d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Vegetation has been enhanced on all maps and in all Ports. Trees look more realistic with enhanced shading and rays of sunlight shining through the green foliage. We have also reworked the wind–tree interactions. We have added more trees and other green foliage on maps.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a529f806-2b5f-11ec-8b9e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a5359af8-2b5f-11ec-8afb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Ports and maps with HD textures now feature birds, fish, flying flags, and other moving objects. We'll continue adding more animations to maps and Ports over time.

[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
We have added the following five achievements that can only be earned by playing as part of a Division in Random Battles:
[list][*]Coordinated Attack: Your Division must destroy at least seven enemy ships.
[*]Hand to Hand: Your Division must damage at least 10 enemy ships. The damage caused to each ship must amount to at least 20% of her normal HP.
[*]Brothers-in-Arms: Each Division mate must destroy at least two enemy ships in a single battle.
[*]Strike Team: Damage caused by a Division must be equal to 50% or more of the consolidated total normal HP of all enemy ships.
[*]General Offensive: A Division must destroy ships of three different types.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/43076c64-2a9a-11ec-b0fc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The conditions for earning Division Stars (victory bonuses issued to Clanmates) have changed. You can now get a Division Star playing with each of your Clanmates as many as three times by:
[list][*]Winning a battle
[*]Earning the Coordinated Attack achievement
[*]Earning the Strike Team achievement[/list]
Throughout the entire duration of Update 0.10.10, the Engagement stage of the Naval Battle will be held in a group format. Clans will be randomly divided between several groups of 25 or 50 Clans each. The amount of Oil earned depends on the number of Stars obtained and the Clan's place in its own group. Once Update 0.10.11 goes live, the standard format of the Engagement will be replaced with the group format every four weeks.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c9a73b8-2a73-11ec-8fa2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c9aa612-2a73-11ec-9bc2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c9c2b4a-2a73-11ec-8cf1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
We have reworked the portraits of all Commanders in the game and brought them to a uniform size. Added new Commander portraits for the U.S.; Great Britain; the U.S.S.R.; Italy; Pan-Asia; and France.

[h2][b][h1=german-battleships-early-access][/h1]German Battleships: Early Access[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9f53ca0c-21db-11ec-9a67-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.9 brings Early Access to a new branch of German battleships.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae8e58c8-21d8-11ec-a2d7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/adac764c-21d8-11ec-9ab9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ad168b96-21d8-11ec-ade5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ad2b76fa-21d8-11ec-9322-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ad151aae-21d8-11ec-9ab7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/adaf2a36-21d8-11ec-bf48-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae8d4294-21d8-11ec-a00d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae907ea0-21d8-11ec-a5e7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Features of the Branch[/h2]
[list][*]While they don't have so many main battery guns, and those guns have a rather short range for this ship type, these battleships come out on top against their peers when it comes to accuracy. The shots you do fire will fly true and hit hard.
[*]Long-range torpedoes on Tier VII ships and higher.
[*]Numerous accurate secondary battery guns.
[*]Low detectability.
[*]A variant of the Hydroacoustic Search consumable that's similar to the type that German cruisers are equipped with.
[*]The Fast Damage Control Team consumable.[/list]
The Hamburg Port has been updated to celebrate the arrival of the German battleships in Early Access.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2d33f074-21fd-11ec-abd3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2d1d3442-21fd-11ec-b933-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2dd46770-21fd-11ec-87f5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2dd2387e-21fd-11ec-8174-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]When Update 0.10.11 goes live, the German battleships will become available for all players to research.[/i][/list]

[h2]German Tokens[/h2]
[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_ed097dd16572a276eebe738ca1babcb606d77a47cbaf5479b8ad244a7e3e0859.png[/img] [b]German Tokens[/b] are a new temporary resource that can be obtained:
[list][*]By participating in the Personal Challenges event.
[*]From free daily bundles.
[*]From bundles available for Doubloons.
[*]In exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory.[/list]
[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3]
Sequentially available bundles with new German Tier III–IX battleships; the German Eagle permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Prinz Rupprecht[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Schlieffen[/b][/b]; the German Navy permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Prinz Heinrich[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Zieten[/b][/b]; the "German Battleships: Part 1" commemorative flag; and other items.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/27952b32-21db-11ec-bfa6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The number of Tokens you can earn by participating in Personal Challenges combined with those you can get from free daily bundles will be enough to obtain German Tier III–VII battleships and the German Navy permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Prinz Heinrich[/b][/b].
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/27814356-21db-11ec-bf48-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Schlieffen[/h2]
Early Access to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Schlieffen[/b][/b] with a Port slot and 10-skill point Commander is one of the lots you can look forward to at the upcoming Lighthouse auction. The starting bid is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Doubloons; in total, [b]1,000[/b] lots will be auctioned.

The Lighthouse auction will be held from October 7 through 11. Look for details about the auction rules, lots, their quantity, and starting bids in a dedicated article that will be published on our website later this week.

[h2][b][h1=personal-challenges][/h1]Personal Challenges[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9fe05ddc-21db-11ec-bf48-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

A new temporary event called "Personal Challenges" will be available to you for the entire duration of Update 0.10.9. The goal of the event is to earn as much Base XP as possible while demonstrating your skills in battle playing ships of different types and nations.

The rules are similar to Naval Battles: a personal table of records will become available to you. This table displays all the available ship types and nations. After fulfilling one of the mission's requirements, you can move on to the next part of the table, which will offer a more difficult mission.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99b304b0-21fd-11ec-b933-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99e9d792-21fd-11ec-abd3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99e4545c-21fd-11ec-9234-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Key rules[/h2]
[list][*]You can take part in the event playing researchable ships of Tier V and higher, and you can also play Premium and special ships of Tier V–X if the nation has a researchable branch of that type.
[*]Personal Challenges can be completed in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles.
[*]You have an unlimited number of attempts.
[*]The table of records is reset once a week.[/list]
[list]Each mission you complete will reward you with [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_ed097dd16572a276eebe738ca1babcb606d77a47cbaf5479b8ad244a7e3e0859.png[/img] 15 German Tokens and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]50[/b] Coal. It's possible to earn up to [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_ed097dd16572a276eebe738ca1babcb606d77a47cbaf5479b8ad244a7e3e0859.png[/img] 510 Tokens each week. After reaching the weekly limit, each completed task will bring only [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]50[/b] Coal.[/list]
We come bearing gifts! Stay on the lookout for Community Tokens in this article and others on our website! You can exchange them for various items under the "Naval Community" tab of the Armory. Make sure to keep up to date with the news, and be sure to share the articles with your friends so they can also enjoy claiming gifts!

[h2][b][h1=halloween][/h1]Halloween[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9fe1906c-21db-11ec-ade5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In the dark night that bridges October 31 and November 1, hordes of dismal evil creatures squeeze out of their shelters and creep all around the earth, set on conquering new lands!

[h2]Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness[/h2]
We invite you to take part in Operations from previous years—save [b]Transylvania[/b] and defend the waters of the Silver Spear Archipelago from invasion by the Forces of Darkness!

Both Operations can be completed while Update 0.10.9 is live. A Super Hard difficulty level is available in addition to the Normal and Hard difficulty levels.

The first completion of a Super Hard Operation with 3 Stars or more will bring you Jack-o'-Lantern Premium containers that have specific chances of dropping one of the permanent Halloween camouflages from previous years, as well as other rewards. These can include expendable camos, Doubloons, and Free XP. There is also the possibility that Halloween permanent camouflages might drop.
[list][i]To complete the Operations, you will receive the following special ships on your account: [b] [b][b]III[/b] Blade[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]III[/b] Jackal[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]III[/b] Igor[/b][/b], as well as [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Urashima[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Svyatozar[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Magnu-S[/b][/b].[/i][/list]

[h2]Twilight Hunt[/h2]
On the third week of the update, a new temporary battle type called "Twilight Hunt" will become available to you. Show your true courage in battles against the Twilight Fleet at the helms of these fantastic future ships.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Thu. 21 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 11 Nov. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h3][b]Key rules[/b][/h3]
The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and the AI-controlled Twilight Fleet, led by the terrible [b]Rasputin[/b], on the gigantic Polygon map.
[list][*]Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map. Be cautious—the Portal opens up only some time after the start of each battle.
[*]You start out alone, but you can form teams directly in battle.
[*]It is now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player still starts the battle on their own. In order to coordinate their efforts, Division mates will need to locate each other on the map and create a team.
[*]The Twilight Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal or when the battle time expires.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8c17f86-21ea-11ec-84a7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8c81fd0-21ea-11ec-8bcc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e905ebda-21ea-11ec-9912-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e90c872e-21ea-11ec-9f5b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
A temporary resource—[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_2_65bc5d6f2e5b745981b237addbe95a8b0eab5f1e4be650cbe25135f0b2246955.png[/img][b]Battle Points[/b]—will be issued to players for destroying monsters and other players.
[list][*]Having accrued a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle.
[*]The Battle Points you receive aren't lost or spent in battle.
[*]Successfully exiting the Polygon will double the amount of Battle Points you earn.[/list]
The Twilight Hunt mode is divided into three stages. Each stage has a different difficulty level: Normal, Hard, and Super Hard.

Players can take part in the Twilight Hunt on one of nine ships, and each ship has her own style of gameplay. Apart from [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Valkyrie[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Gale[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Heracles[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Hector[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Avenger[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Whirlwind[/b][/b]—ships that you're probably already familiar with—you'll also be able to join the battle on monster ships [b] [b][b]X[/b] Fangblade[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Thornridge[/b],[/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Lobster-Eyed[/b][/b]. You must complete a special combat mission to obtain these ships.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2be75e20-21ff-11ec-aef8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2bf343d4-21ff-11ec-9948-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2bf063d0-21ff-11ec-87f5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3]
Earn Battle Points and complete daily and weekly combat missions. As a reward for completing them you'll receive Jack-o'-Lantern containers, Community Tokens, a new temporary resource called [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_3_09977141afe61c0ca2d00715ea4037b8306d808b4973171281587c5286c558a8.png[/img][b] "Twilight Tokens"[/b], and other rewards.

Twilight Tokens can be exchanged in the Armory for themed Commanders with 10 skill points; Intanian Fleet permanent camouflages for [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Admiral Hipper[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Hsienyang[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Implacable[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Kitakaze[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Dmitri Donskoi[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Iowa[/b][/b]; Jack-o'-Lantern containers; and other items.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ec348da-21eb-11ec-9948-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]More details about the Twilight Hunt's rules, as well as the available rewards in the Armory, will come in a dedicated article on our website.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=submarines-in-random-battles][/h1]Submarines in Random Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9f09bdea-21db-11ec-9546-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Submarines have been present in Ranked and Co-op battles for almost 2 months now, and we're extremely grateful for the battles you've played, as well as your feedback. By participating and telling us your opinions, you helped us determine what the next steps in submarine development are going to be.

We've planned a number of future changes for the new ship type, based on the data we collected and player feedback. First, we're going to add anti-submarine weapons on all Tier V–X cruisers and battleships in Update 0.10.9, except for Dutch cruisers and hybrids.

We're aware that adding anti-submarine weapons on a large number of ships can have a significant impact on the effectiveness of submarines, so we've made a number of balance changes to the new ship type:
[list][*]We've changed the characteristics of torpedoes—submarines now have tube-by-tube torpedo-launching capabilities. Tube-by-tube torpedo launching will allow for more dynamic gameplay and also allow better control over the number of torpedoes launched during an attack. To encourage submarine Captains to use sonar pings for better accuracy, the width of the torpedo launch sector has been increased
[*]German submarines were weaker compared to American submarines in terms of damage they were able to deal. To make them even in terms of this parameter, we've increased the maximum damage and the chances of causing flooding of torpedoes launched by German submarines.
[*]The torpedo tubes of German submarines are mostly located in their fore ends, which is great for attacking from longer distances. To shift German submarine gameplay toward long-range combat, we increased the range of their torpedoes.
[*]American submarines, in their turn, can be quite effective in short- and medium-range battles, because their torpedo tubes are located in both their bows and sterns. To encourage American submarine Captains to embrace this style of combat, the range of American submarines' torpedoes has been reduced.
[*]Reduced dive capacity depletion if the submarine is detected. The increase of dive capacity depletion in Update 0.10.8 significantly affected how comfortable it was to play submarines, and it also impacted their effectiveness. To make the detection of submarines impact their gameplay less, we've reduced the dive capacity depletion rates when submarines are detected.[/list]
Check out a detailed list of changes in a dedicated article on our website.

We’ve also changed the submarine settings in Co-op and Training battles. Now, submarines controlled by AI will take part in battles more actively. This change will prevent situations where the battle went on for far too long due to the process of searching for and destroying the last enemy submarine.

The next step in testing submarines is to add them to Random Battles. This will allow us to properly evaluate their state and gather feedback from a larger number of players.

[list][i]For this reason, rental submarines will become temporarily available in Random Battles during Update 0.10.9.[/i][/list]

Offering submarines in this way will help us keep an eye on how many of them are out on our seas and prevent extended queue times. We are going to keep a close eye on submarines in Random Battles, and we are able to take measures if their presence in Random Battles has an adverse impact on gameplay.

[h2][b][h1=interface-changes][/h1]Interface Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9ec3cf56-21db-11ec-bfa6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.10.9, we've updated the way in which ship characteristics are displayed in battle: Changed the ship parameters screen that opens by pressing [b]H[/b]. Any modifiers currently applied to the ship are now displayed in the pop-up window.

Apart from that, the battle interface has additional indicators for various temporary effects:
[list][*]Added the display of active skills and temporary modifiers of talents above the armament panel.
[*]Added a notification about changed parameters when Commander talents are activated.
[*]Updated the display of destroyed and incapacitated modules, fires, and flooding.
[*]Added a setting in the "Controls" section that allows timers on fires, flooding, and other modifiers to be permanently displayed when the adaptive full combat interface mode is enabled.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/98da8498-2200-11ec-ade5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94616184-21ec-11ec-bd7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/98b7de48-2200-11ec-8fe4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/989973f4-2200-11ec-87f5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/989c9516-2200-11ec-b0d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=content-additions-and-changes][/h1]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9fa454e0-21db-11ec-9044-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

World of Warships will see the addition of:
[list][*]Two variants of German Battleships containers that have specific chances of dropping German ships [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Brandenburg[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Max Immelmann[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Weimar[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Gustav-Julius Maerker[/b][/b], and other rewards. Brandenburg will be also available in the Armory in exchange for Doubloons.
[*]German Commander [b]Johannes Meck-Leyne[/b] with a unique voiceover.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d26d32e-21ee-11ec-8bd2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Loyang, Giuseppe Verdi, Marlborough, Novorossiysk, and Flag of the Tsar of Muscovy commemorative flags.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e635e82e-21ef-11ec-a5d0-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Regular Supplies container.[/list]
Especially for the King of the Sea tournament, we've added:
[list][*]King of the Sea XIII Red and King of the Sea XIII Green expendable camouflages.
[*]Commanders Edward Turner, Stepan Yermakov, Kenji Shiraishi, and Klaus Sternberger.
[*]King of the Sea XIII commemorative flag.
[*]Bane of the Seas permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] North Carolina[/b][/b].[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7abd4d54-1d0c-11ec-91f6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7b176c8a-1d0c-11ec-aa74-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1908f09c-21f1-11ec-b000-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/18cc1c58-21f1-11ec-a5d0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Tech Tree Changes[/h2]
In early 2022, [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] are going to receive the status of "special" ships and leave the branch. They'll be replaced with [b]Delny [/b]and [b]Preussen[/b], which better match other ships from the branch in terms of progression and gameplay.

Any players who own a permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] at the time when the ships are removed from the Tech Tree will receive the Type 20 permanent camouflage for Delny or Preussen, respectively.

Any players who had a permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Moskva[/b][/b] on their accounts at the time when Update 0.9.5 was released will receive the Type 20 permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Alexander Nevsky[/b][/b] within a week of Update 0.10.9 going live. Those who already have the Type 20 permanent camouflage will receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] Doubloons as compensation.
[list][i]Details about the new ships, as well as details about the upcoming changes, can be found in a dedicated article on our website.[/i][/list]

[h2]Armory[/h2]
The "Naval Community" section will have several changes. Premium Ship V and Premium Ship VII containers, as well as the Restless Fire commemorative flag, will no longer be available for purchase.

The following ships will be available to purchase with Community Tokens:
[list][*][b] [b][b]IV[/b] Ishizuchi[/b][/b] for  10,000 Community Tokens.
[*][b] [b][b]V[/b] Exeter[/b][/b] for  15,000 Community Tokens.
[*][b] [b][b]VII[/b] Leningrad[/b][/b] for  20,000 Community Tokens.[/list]
[list]The ships are credited with a Port slot and Commander with 3 skill points.[/list]
Apart from that, a bundle with a Supercontainer will become permanently available for [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png[/img] 6,000 Community Tokens and without any purchase restrictions in the "Naval Community" section.

[h2][b][h1=other-changes-and-improvements][/h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a0b735f0-21db-11ec-a00d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Upgrade Changes[/h2]
[h3][b]Anti-Submarine Aircraft Modification 1 upgrade (4th slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Renamed Airstrike Modification 1.
[*]Added for all Tier V–X battleships, researchable Tier V–X Dutch cruisers, and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_dd3112a12284f158a1e9d283ac7fa46d3beaa3d8698e70d99f28f6ade0286941.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b].[/list]
[h2]Technical changes of ship armor[/h2]
Changed the code that processed ship armor.

The update will allow for better interactions between shells and armor due to a more accurate calculation of the position of the shell in the ship's hull. For example, these changes allow us to avoid situations where a ship receives damage from penetration and overpenetration of the same shell at the same time. They also make it impossible to penetrate a ship's armor through various decorative elements on the deck.

The way in which the parts of a ship's armor are displayed will also change—it will be more detailed and uniform.
[list][i]The transfer of ships to the new armor system will take effect gradually, starting from Update 0.10.10.[/i][/list]
[h2]Other Changes and Improvements[/h2]
[list][*]Added the option to rent a Commander, similar to ship rental.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the shell ballistics of [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] to be calculated incorrectly in some cases.
[*]Fixed an error that caused torpedo range not to be shown in the characteristics of torpedo bombers in the Port.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the Airstrike bomb penetration value to be incorrectly displayed for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b][/b].
Fixed an error that caused the Survivability Expert skill to increase aircraft HP by an incorrect value.
[*]Other Improvements and Changes. For a complete list, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

Сommanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.10.9! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and to fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added the Depth Charge Airstrike armament for most Tier V-X cruisers and battleships that had no ASW armament. Balance changes were also made to submarines. More details are available in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/214]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Balance changes to german battleships, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Béarn[/b][/b], and other test ships were made. More details you can find [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/215]here[/url].

[*]Added an option in the game settings to always display timers of fires, floodings and other modificators when choosing an alternate or full battle interface mode.

[*]Fixed several issues with ships and bots in Twilight Hunt and festive Operations.
[*]Fixed several interface issues with Asymmetric battles.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the penetration of the Airstrike bombs of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_dd3112a12284f158a1e9d283ac7fa46d3beaa3d8698e70d99f28f6ade0286941.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b][/b] to be displayed incorrectly.

World of Warships: 6th Anniversary! We've prepared lots of new things for you in Update 0.10.8 to celebrate the event:
[list][*]The World of Warships Anniversary celebration, special battle performance bonuses, a themed collection, and much more!
[*]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event
[*]Dutch cruisers leaving Early Access
[*]Early Access to Soviet aircraft carriers
[*]Convoy—a new temporary battle type![/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#wows-anniversary]World of Warships Anniversary[/url] ● [url=#dutch-cruisers]Dutch Cruisers[/url] ● [url=#soviet-aircraft-carriers]Soviet Aircraft Carriers[/url] ● [url=#aircraft-bureaus-rivalry]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry[/url] ● [url=#convoy]Convoy[/url] ● [url=#armory]Armory[/url] ● [url=#conten-additions-and-changes]Content Additions and Changes[/url] ● [url=#other-changes-and-improvements]Other Changes and Improvements[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[list]Read through this article carefully and keep your eyes peeled for a gift! Share the article with your friends and Clanmates so they can arm themselves with all the essential info for this update![/list]
[h2][b][h1=wows-anniversary][/h1]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1962da5e-0c7e-11ec-809a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Festive Rewards[/h2]
In Update 0.10.8, you can earn festive battle performance bonuses on all of your Tier V and higher ships. Win a battle or earn 300 Base XP to receive Supercontainers, a new temporary resource called [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_6_16266bfe10c9894a55b2a77a7945ff1688ccdd935f462d4788f4ae693c233078.png[/img] [b]Festive Tokens[/b], and Gift containers:
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5acab0a4-0bf5-11ec-8001-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]Battle Performance Bonuses will be available
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]from:[/b] [b]Fri. 17 Sep. 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]to:[/b] [b]Thu. 04 Nov. 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d867076c-0c98-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d8720e96-0c98-11ec-9c86-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d8651088-0c98-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The bonus for each ship can be earned only once in battles of any type, except for Training Battles.[/i][/list]

In a special section of the Armory, Festive Tokens can be exchanged for containers of the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection; "6 Years of World of Warships" permanent camouflages for [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Lyon[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Yorck[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Shchors[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Gadjah Mada[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Akatsuki[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Zara[/b][/b]; Gift and Distant Voyages containers; and World of Warships Anniversary expendable camouflages. The rewards section will be available from September 17, before Update 0.10.10 is released.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6d8fb63c-0c89-11ec-b59e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Each Gift container holds 5x special signals of the same type (Dragon, Red Dragon, Wyvern, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan).

[list][i]You can only earn Festive Tokens from battle performance bonuses. With the release of Update 0.10.10, Festive Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2]The "6 Years of World of Warships" Collection[/h2]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04e3d61c-0c99-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04eacee0-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04f2e684-0c99-11ec-9c86-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
We're also celebrating our Anniversary with the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection, which is dedicated to the most notable events that happened in the game over the past year. The collection looks like a big jigsaw puzzle with 60 elements in it. The collection elements only drop from "6 years of World of Warships" special containers. You can obtain these:
[list][*]By completing a special combat mission chain that will become available on September 17.
[*]By participating in the new temporary Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event.
[*]In exchange for Festive Tokens.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/978ae61a-0c88-11ec-9041-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b]The reward for completing the collection[/b] is a Supercontainer, 6x Gift containers, and the "6 Years of World of Warships" commemorative flag.
[table][tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b98676d4-f07d-11eb-92e5-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2fe7841a-e3b0-11eb-96b4-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c803a1c6-0c8b-11ec-b3e3-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[list][i]The exchange rate for duplicates is 1:1.[/i][/list]

The "6 Years of World of Warships" containers will be added to the Armory in one of the future updates. When that happens, you'll be able to obtain them in exchange for Coal.

To celebrate the Anniversary, the Designer's Table Port has also been updated—the ship model is now located in a bright and spacious room.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39e0eb20-0c99-11ec-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39d9e186-0c99-11ec-bb49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39cd97b4-0c99-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39d64148-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list]We've also added some hidden festive achievements. Their requirements won't be announced or shown in the game client. If you achieve good results and have luck on your side, you'll earn them. Good luck![/list]
[h2]Resetting Stars in Operations[/h2]
With the release of update 0.10.8, any Stars earned in Operations will be reset. This means that the players who already received reward in Operation for a certain number of stars, can collect these stars again and receive corresponding rewards.

[h2][b][h1=dutch-cruisers][/h1]Dutch Cruisers[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5b274d50-0bf5-11ec-b7f5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

When Update 0.10.8 goes live, Dutch Tier I–X cruisers will become available for all players to research.
[h2][b][h1=soviet-aircraft-carriers][/h1]Soviet Aircraft Carriers[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5b17e8a6-0bf5-11ec-a375-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.8 brings Soviet aircraft carriers [b] [b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Pobeda[/b][/b] to Early Access.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac4587ac-0c99-11ec-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac3d7a30-0c99-11ec-9041-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac371a64-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Features of the Branch[/h2]
[list][*]Small number of aircraft in squadrons. Squadrons consist of a single flight that carries out one powerful attack with all aircraft at once.
[*]Starting from Tier VIII, aircraft are equipped with jet boosters. As with [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Ise[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Tone[/b][/b], the boosters kick in automatically during take-off and provide a short-term increase in speed.
[*]Small HP pools and low cruising speeds.
[*]Instead of standard bombers, Soviet aircraft carriers carry skip bombers armed with HE bombs.
[*]The torpedo bombers are armed with torpedoes that have a long range and take longer to arm.
[*]Starting from Tier VI, attack aircraft squadrons are armed with HE rockets similar to the American "Tiny Tim" rockets.[/list]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_7_33722423c774d6b0ffcc70c576e7538971637aefc907ec76bc1fabfef7d674bf.png[/img] Soviet Tokens[/b] are a new temporary resource that can be obtained:
[list][*]By participating in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event.
[*]From free daily bundles.
[*]From random bundles available for Doubloons.
[*]In exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory.[/list]
[b]Rewards for Soviet Tokens:[/b] sequentially available bundles with ships [b] [b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Pobeda[/b][/b] along with Forward Bound permanent camouflages for them, as well as other rewards. Komsomolets, Serov, and permanent camouflages for the Tier IV, VI, and VIII carriers can be obtained for free. The sum of Tokens you can earn in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event and receive from free daily bundles will be sufficient for that.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/888f8286-0c9e-11ec-acfb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b]Rewards from random bundles available for Doubloons:[/b] Forward Bound permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Admiral Nakhimov[/b][/b], Soviet Tokens, Victory expendable camouflages, and other items.

[list][i]When Update 0.10.10 goes live, [b] [b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Pobeda[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Admiral Nakhimov[/b][/b] will be available for all players to research. Soviet Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]6,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=aircraft-bureaus-rivalry][/h1]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5af027a8-0bf5-11ec-ad83-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.10.8, a new temporary event awaits you—Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry. It's based on the history of the development of Soviet naval aviation and the various research and development bureaus that worked on machines for the Soviet Navy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 09 Sep. 09:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 07 Oct. 03:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

The Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event is similar to the Battle of the Beasts event from Update 0.10.4, but it has a few differences.

[h2]The main differences in comparison to the Battle of the Beasts are as follows[/h2]
[list][*]Three teams instead of four.
[*]Unique rewards—team patches—will be awarded for personal progress, not for team progress. This means that you'll still be able to earn unique rewards if your team doesn't progress enough.
[*]Updated team selection window interface, as well as personal and team progress window.
[*]In the Port, personal progress till the next reward in now displayed instead of the team progress.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3e585ff0-0c92-11ec-8dc7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Rules of the Event[/h2]
[list][*]The event runs until the release of Update 0.10.9 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts 1 week.
[*]Once per week, you can select one of the three teams: Polikarpov Bureau Team, Chyetverikov Bureau Team, or Kocherygin Bureau Team.
[*]During the event, you need to complete personal missions that are issued daily to all event participants. They can be completed during the day in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles, as well as in the new temporary battle type—Convoy.
[*]Completing missions will advance you through personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards.
[*]Rewards: "6 Years of World of Warships" containers, themed patches, Victory camouflages, Coal, and Soviet Tokens.[/list]
You can read more about the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event in a dedicated article.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf892e30-0c99-11ec-8b8b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf7c7dca-0c99-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf6ec482-0c99-11ec-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf6cedba-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=convoy][/h1]Convoy[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5affd64e-0bf5-11ec-81fc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.8 brings players an opportunity to participate in a new temporary battle type—Convoy—which focuses on escorting (or sinking) transport ships. Historically, defending or disrupting cargo routes has been one of the key tasks of fleets: a timely supply of military equipment, ammunition, and provisions has always played a tremendous role in the success of combat actions.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
[list][*]The defending team is tasked with escorting a convoy of four bot ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire attacking team is destroyed.
[*]The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[*]Players are randomly distributed among the two teams. You can either play solo or as a member of the Division. 
[*]On average, it takes the convoy between 10 and 12 minutes to complete the route.
[*]Format: 7 vs. 7, playing Tier VIII ships Restrictions: No more than one aircraft carrier and three battleships per team
[*]Battles will take place on the following maps: The Atlantic, Islands of Ice, Warrior's Path, Loop, and Labyrinth.[/list]

[b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Chkalov[/b][/b] will become available when the update is released. [h2][b][h1=other-changes-and-improvements][/h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5c094386-0bf5-11ec-a751-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Game balance changes[/h2]
We've made some changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and player feedback. This applies to submarines and anti-submarine weapons in particular. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

[h3][b]Changes to characteristics of all submarines[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Dive capacity depletion when the submarine is detected increased from 2 to 4 points per second;
[*]Dive capacity restoration rate increased from 0.3 to 0.5 points per second;
[*]Detectability range by sea after using the Sonar Ping reduced from 4 to 2 km;
[*]The time it takes the torpedoes to arm increased from 0.5 to 2 s;
[*]Reduced the detectability after using the Sonar Ping in smoke:
[list][*][b] [b]VI[/b] Cachalot[/b]: from 2.4 to 2 km;
[*][b] [b]VIII[/b] Salmon[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] Balao[/b]: from 2.2 to 2 km;
[*][b] [b]VI[/b] U-69[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] U-2501[/b]: from 2.1 to 2 km.[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Changes of the Hydrophone consumable[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Consumable action time reduced:
[list][*][b] [b]VI[/b] Cachalot[/b], [b] [b]VIII[/b] Salmon[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] Balao[/b]: from 45 to 40 s.
[*][b] [b]VI[/b] U-69[/b], [b] [b]VIII[/b] U-190[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] U-2501[/b]: from 60 to 40 s.[/list]
[*]Consumable cooldown time reduced:
[list][*][b] [b]VI[/b] Cachalot[/b], [b] [b]VIII[/b] Salmon[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] Balao[/b]: from 90 to 80 s.
[*][b] [b]VI[/b] U-69[/b], [b] [b]VIII[/b] U-190[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] U-2501[/b]: from 90 to 60 s.[/list]
[*]Reduced ship bearing distance and spotting range of submerged submarines:
[list][*][b] [b]VI[/b] Cachalot[/b]: from 5.5 to 5 km;
[*][b] [b]VIII[/b] Salmon[/b], [b] [b]VI[/b] U-69[/b]: from 6 to 5.5 km;
[*][b] [b]X[/b] Balao[/b], [b] [b]VIII[/b] U-190[/b]: from 6.5 to 6 km;
[*][b] [b]X[/b] U-2501[/b]: from 7 to 6.5 km.[/list][/list]
[h3][b]VI Farragut, VI Monaghan, VI Icarus, VI Gallant, VI Guépard, VI Aigle, VI Ernst Gaede, VI T-61, IX Paolo Emilio, VI Fubuki, VI Hatsuharu. VI Shinonome, VI Gnevny, VI Juruá, VI Västerås, VII Skåne, VIII Öland, IX Östergötland, VI Huanghe, VI Fushun, VIII Siliwangi, VI Anshan, and VIII Fenyang[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Number of depth bomb charges increased from 1 to 2.[/list]
[h3][b]Cruisers VIII De Zeven Provinciën, VIII Belfast '43, and VI Huanghe[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added the possibility to mount the Depth Charges Modification 1 upgrade (fourth slot).[/list]
[h3][b]German aircraft carriers VIII A. Parseval, X M. Richthofen, VIII Graf Zeppelin, and VIII Graf Zeppelin B[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted the settings of bombers:
[list][*]Increased the chance of two bombs hitting the ellipse at once.[/list][/list]
[h3][b]American Tier X aircraft carrier X Franklin D. Roosevelt[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Torpedo bomber parameters were changed:
[list][*]Torpedo arming distance increased from 517 to 545 m.
[*]Torpedo launch spread increased by 5%.[/list]
[*]Bomber parameters were changed:
[list][*]Maximum damage caused by a bomb has been reduced from 11,200 to 10,600.
[*]HE bomb penetration reduced from 67 to 64 mm.
[*]Chances of fire being caused by HE bombs reduced from 64 to 60%.[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Soviet Tier X cruiser Alexander Nevsky[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The Repair Party consumable now restores 33% of the damage dealt to the citadel instead of 10%.[/list]
[h2]Other Changes and Improvements[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed an error that caused torpedoes to deviate from the selected trajectory if the ship was circulating during their launch.
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented the post-battle stats screen from being displayed for players after battles.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the animations of torpedoes being launched, as well as the periscope going up and down, to be displayed incorrectly on certain submarines.
[*]Fixed an error that prevented players from entering their login and password with the help of an on-screen keyboard at the login screen.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the integral characteristics of AA guns to be calculated incorrectly when mounting upgrades and mastering skills that improve AA defenses.
[*]Fixed an error that prevented rockets from dealing damage to parts of ships that were entirely destroyed.
[*]Fixed an error that sometimes made it impossible to set a course for autopilot after colliding with an island.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the ships to get stuck near one of the islands after appearing on the "Neighbors" map.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the Depth Charge Airstrike armament to disappear from [b] [b]IX[/b] Wujing[/b] and [b] [b]VIII[/b] Pyotr Bagration[/b].
[*]Fixed an error that cased the number of depth charges on [b] [b]VII[/b] Atlanta B[/b] not to match that on [b] [b]VII[/b] Atlanta[/b].
[*]Fixed an error that caused [b] [b]VIII[/b] Cleveland[/b] in her standard hull not to receive critical damage to her steering gears.
[*]Fixed the maximum range of Airstrike on [b] [b]VII[/b] Eendracht[/b] being 10 km instead of 11 km.
[*]Fixed the incorrect rocket travel time of [b] [b]VIII[/b] Kaga[/b] and [b] [b]VIII[/b] Kaga B[/b] attack aircraft.
[*]Maximum frame rate can now be set in [i]preferences.xml[/i]. Setting it in [i]engine_config.xml[/i] after each update is no longer necessary.
[*]Due a technical error, we've temporarily disabled the possibility to switch the camera to torpedo tubes on all submarines when clicking the preview icon in the parameters.
[*]Fixed an error that caused [b] [b]IX[/b] Z-44[/b] to have a slightly higher chance of fire on the ship.
[*]Other Improvements and Changes. For a complete list, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

Сommanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.10.8! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and to fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes made to German and Soviet aircraft carriers, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Franklin D. Roosevelt[/b][/b] and several other ships. Further details can be found in our Development Blog of [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/194]24 August[/url] and [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/197]26 August[/url];
[*]Fixed several issues and changed the background on the queue screen in the Convoys battle type;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the Grand battle icon to be displayed instead of the Convoys icon in combat mission descriptions;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the "impossible to hit the target" icon to be displayed above ships which can be hit by deepwater torpedoes;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the sound of ASW armament reloading to be played in Random battles on ships with ASW armament;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused ships on the "Neighbors" map to be stuck near one of the islands;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused bonuses to ship detectability to be displayed incorrectly on some of the upgrades;
[*]Fixed several other issues.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
[list][*]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

[h2][b][h1=wows-anniversary][/h1]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.10.8, World of Warships is celebrating its sixth anniversary! In honor of this event, we've prepared various activities for our players.

[h2]The "6 Years of World of Warships" Collection[/h2]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53ad0d7a-fe90-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53bd6120-fe90-11eb-b3c4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53be8032-fe90-11eb-b353-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The main treat for the anniversary is the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection dedicated to the most notable events that happened in the game over the past year. The collection looks like a big puzzle with 60 elements in it. You can obtain them only from "6 years of World of Warships" special containers. The containers are available:
[list][*]In the Armory, in exchange for a new temporary resource—Festive Tokens.
[*]For completing a special combat mission chain.
[*]In the new temporary Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe688d9e-fe76-11eb-9d6f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The reward for completing the collection will be a Supercontainer, 6x Gift containers, and the "6 Years of World of Warships" festive flag. The exchange rate for duplicates is 1:1.

Apart from the "6 Years of World of Warships" containers, Festive Tokens can be exchanged in the Armory for themed "6 Years of World of Warships" permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] In one of the future updates, the "6 Years of World of Warships" containers will be added to the Armory and be available in exchange for Coal.

[h2]Festive Rewards[/h2]
In Update 0.10.8, you can earn the familiar Snowflakes—festive bonuses for combat results of all your Tier V ships and higher. Depending on ship tier and type, you can obtain Supercontainers, Gift containers, and Festive Tokens.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9592808a-fe90-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/958a9992-fe90-11eb-a364-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/953a2c28-fe90-11eb-ba49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The bonus for combat results is the only way to earn Festive Tokens.

[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.10, Festive Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b].[/i][/list]

The Designer's Table Port was considerably updated in honor of the celebration.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c4415c76-fe90-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c4444d8c-fe90-11eb-b353-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3bc0300-fe90-11eb-a364-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3c92aee-fe90-11eb-9e0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=dutch-cruisers][/h1]Dutch Cruisers[/b][/h2]
When Update 0.10.8 goes live, Dutch Tier I–X cruisers will become available for all players to research.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/491f414c-fe78-11eb-83a3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4b4ea2f0-fe78-11eb-8ffd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/497e847c-fe78-11eb-8ffd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/498b6c00-fe78-11eb-bc89-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/48fe578e-fe78-11eb-bbb6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4b288e62-fe78-11eb-bbb6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/499b0f52-fe78-11eb-ba14-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/498afcfc-fe78-11eb-bdca-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4998b3a6-fe78-11eb-ab5a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4911cd0a-fe78-11eb-972c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=aircraft-bureaus-rivalry][/h1]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry[/b][/h2]
The update brings a new temporary event called Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry. It is based on the history of the naval aviation development and various experimental design bureaus that worked on new machines for the Navy.

Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry is similar to the Battle of the Beasts event that took place in Update 0.10.4 with the following changes:

[h3][b]The main changes compared to the Battle of the Beasts[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Three teams instead of four.
[*]Unique rewards—team patches—will be awarded for personal progress and not for team progress. This way, players will be able to obtain unique rewards even if their team doesn't reach the necessary progress point.
[*]Updated interface of team selection window, as well as the personal and team progress window.
[*]Your personal progress until the next reward is now displayed in the Port instead of your team's progress.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03c194aa-fe7e-11eb-91d5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Rules of the Event[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The event will run until the release of Update 0.10.9 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts one week.
[*]Once per week, you can select one of the three teams: Polikarpov Bureau, Chetverikov Bureau, or Kocherigin Bureau.
[*]During the event, you need to complete your personal missions issued daily to all participants. They can be completed during the day in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles, as well as in the new temporary battle type—Convoy.
[*]Completing missions will advance you through personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards.
[*]Rewards: 6 Years of World of Warships containers, themed patches, Victory camouflages, Coal, and Soviet Tokens.[/list]

[list][*]Squadrons consist of one flight, which carries out one powerful attack with all aircraft at once.

[*]Starting from Tier VIII, aircraft are equipped rocket boosters. As with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Ise[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Tone[/b][/b], the boosters kick in automatically during take-off and provide a short-time increase in speed.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/26474af2-fe91-11eb-a364-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The Tokens that you earn by participating in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry and opening free daily bundles will be enough to obtain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], and permanent camouflages for Tier IV, VI, and VIII aircraft carriers.

The random bundles available for Doubloons can drop the Forward Bound permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Admiral Nakhimov[/b][/b], Soviet Tokens, Victory expendable camouflages, and other rewards.

[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.10, Soviet Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]6,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=convoy][/h1]Convoy[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Thu. 23 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]End:[/b] [b]Thu. 07 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

In Update 0.10.8, players will have an opportunity to play in a new temporary battle type—Convoy—based on escorting transport ships. In real life, a large part of confrontation between navies consisted of defending or destroying cargo lanes because they played a crucial role during wars.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5027ef2a-fe91-11eb-a364-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Rules[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The defending team needs to escort a convoy of four bot ships that sail along a defined route. The team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is destroyed.
[*]The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[*]Players are distributed among teams randomly.
[*]On average, the Convoy needs between 10 and 12 minutes to complete their route.
[*]Format: 7 vs. 7 playing Tier VIII ships. Restrictions: No more than one aircraft carrier and three battleships per team.
[*]Battles will be held on maps such as The Atlantic, Islands of Ice, Land of Fire, Warrior's Path, Loop, Haven, Northern Waters, and Labyrinth.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/507c8d96-fe91-11eb-9e0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/503775ee-fe91-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/50803126-fe91-11eb-a193-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/50a00028-fe91-11eb-8bbd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]While the Convoy is available, you can complete special combat missions only for this battle type, which will bring you Community Tokens. Detailed requirements of these combat missions can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=submarines-in-ranked-battles][/h1]Submarines in Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b3597798-f6c7-11eb-ba29-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Ranked Battles Season 4 kicks off 1 week after the update hits the Live Servers.

In addition to the traditional four ship types, a new type—submarines—is joining the fight for Ranked glory in the new season.

Submarines have made quite a journey, having gone through six open and a gazillion closed tests since they were first announced back in 2019. Adding a totally new type of ship to World of Warships requires extended testing by a wide and stable audience in Random Battles. Testing them on a standalone server or in a special game mode would simply not give us a broad enough picture.

However, we don't want to allow submarines to "surface" in the main type of battle directly—it's essential that we ensure they are properly tested first. To perform the test, we've settled on Ranked Battles as the most suitable and closest equivalent of Random Battles. The new Ranked season starts a week after the update goes live, but submarines will be accessible immediately after the release of Update 0.10.7. Co-op Battles will give you an opportunity to try the subs out in a more relaxed environment and get prepared for the new Ranked season.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/202b78e8-f480-11eb-99a3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/202be77e-f480-11eb-9322-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f8d9a2e-f480-11eb-a89d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f97e330-f480-11eb-a1fe-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f7e0898-f480-11eb-a9a6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f7e80a2-f480-11eb-a62e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Season features[/h2]
[list][*]A maximum of two submarines is allowed per team.
[*]To prevent long queues from forming in the matchmaker, submarines will be rented out free of charge through random bundles from the Armory.
[*]Commanders will receive a fifth skill tree for submarines, and some of the skills of other ship types will receive additional effects that are designed to counter submarines.[/list]
You'll also find a revamped interface in the Port, and there are updated rules for the season:
[list][*]Ranked Battles statistics will be displayed in the profile summary. Distribution by league starts from Season 4. Statistics for previous seasons, broken down by leagues, will not be available.
[*]After qualifying, you can continue playing in the next league without having to wait for the start of a new Sprint. If you make it to Rank 1 in the Bronze League and successfully qualify, you can continue playing in the Silver League within the same Sprint.[/list]
[h2]Format[/h2]
[list][*]7 vs. 7
[*]Tier VI in the Bronze League
[*]Tier VIII in the Silver League
[*]Tier X in the Gold League[/list]
Like in the previous season, battles will be split into six Sprints. The first Sprint runs for 1 week, and each subsequent one runs for 2 weeks. Each new Sprint starts immediately after the end of the previous one.

[h2]Rewards[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba078878-f45b-11eb-bd1f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]More details about the new season of Ranked Battles and submarines are available in a dedicated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/submarines-in-ranked-and-co-op-battles/]article[/url].[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=dockyard][/h1]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b3234056-f6c7-11eb-b9f6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

We invite you to build [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] at the Rotterdam Dockyard! The ship is armed with eight dual-purpose 152 mm guns housed in four turrets. De Zeven Provinciën has access to the Repair Party and Engine Boost consumables, and she is equipped with the Airstrike armament. The ship's guns have a medium firing range and high rate of fire.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/80ae8bee-f6c7-11eb-909c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/80be4f5c-f6c7-11eb-a937-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/80c2eb0c-f6c7-11eb-b4e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/80dc53f8-f6c7-11eb-a648-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The rules of the new Dockyard are similar to those of the previous ones:
[list][*]The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 24 phases.
[*]You can advance through these by completing Dockyard combat missions or spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,500[/b] Doubloons on each phase.
[*]If you want to progress through shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs: nine shipbuilding phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]8,950[/b] Doubloons, or three phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]3,950[/b] Doubloons.
[*]The Dockyard combat missions span two updates—0.10.7 and 0.10.8. You can complete shipbuilding phases in exchange for Doubloons until the end of Update 0.10.9.
[*]In total, you can progress through 21 out of 24 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions.
[*]Completing shipbuilding phases will reward you with a container that drops a Tier V Premium ship, as well as Coal, Steel, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, days of Premium Account, Distant Voyages containers, and other rewards.
[*]Upon completing the 24th shipbuilding phase, you'll receive [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] in the War Paint camouflage, a Commander with 10 skill points, a Port slot, and a commemorative flag.[/list]
If you complete the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] by spending Doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions—completing each phase will bring you [b]250[/b] Steel.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f2659eac-f6cd-11eb-9ebe-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=dutch-cruisers-in-early-access][/h1]Dutch Cruisers in Early Access[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b31b2ff6-f6c7-11eb-b4e2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Early Access to our new ship branch is ongoing! To mark the occasion, we've added a whole chain of combat missions.

The first chain will become available 1 week after the update goes live, while those that follow will be unlocked each subsequent week.

Completing the combat missions will bring you the following rewards:
[list][*]Unique Dutch Commander [b]Klaas Janssen[/b] with the following enhanced skills:
[list][*]For destroyers, cruisers, and battleships—Demolition Expert: +1.5% to the chances of setting a target on fire when hitting it with HE shells (by default: +1%).
[*]For cruisers and battleships—Focus Fire Training: +35% to AA damage in the priority sector (by default: +25%).[/list]
[*]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 2" commemorative flag.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b97b7cea-f6cf-11eb-8ea0-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
