[h2][b][h1=changes-to-commander-skills][/h1]Changes to Commander Skills[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b3f779c0-f6c7-11eb-9a81-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Since the latest Commander skills update, we've taken a close look at the extensive feedback we received from you and compiled statistics related to those changes. We've made some balance tweaks, as well as improved or replaced unpopular skills. Some skills have received additional effects that are intended to counter submarines.

[h2]Battleship skills[/h2]
[h3][i][h3][b]One skill point[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Pyrotechnician[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Demolition Expert."
[*]Bonus added: +15% to the fragmentation damage area of the main battery and secondary battery shells, as well as HE rockets and bombs, when firing at submarines.[/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Two skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Consumables Enhancements[/b][/h3]
[list][*]This skill has been replaced with the "Brisk" skill, which provides the ship a 10% speed increase while she remains undetected.[/list]
[h3][b]Vigilance[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus added: +7% to the ship's torpedo protection.[/list]
[h3][b]AA Gunner[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "AA Defense and ASW Expert."
[*]Bonus added: +10% to damage inflicted by depth charges.[/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Three skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Added a new skill called "Improved Repair Party Readiness" that replaces the "Enhanced Anti-Torpedo Protection" skill:
[list][*]Activated effect: –0.8% to the reload time of the Repair Party consumable each time your ship receives potential damage equal to 100% of the ship's base HP.[/list]
[h3][b]AA Gun Aiming Expert[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Focus Fire Training."
[*]Bonus added: –10% to the reload time of the Airstrike armament (including the Airstrike with anti-submarine defense aircraft).[/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Four skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Added a new skill called "Furious" that replaces the "Brisk" skill:
[list][*]Activated effect: –5% to the reload time of main battery guns and +5% to the dispersion of shells fired by enemies attacking your ship for each active fire on board.[/list]
[h3][b]Improved Secondary Battery Aiming[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Manual Secondary Battery Aiming."
[*]Added the following permanent bonuses:
[list][*]−10% to the reload time of the secondary battery.
[*]−10% to the dispersion of secondary battery shells.[/list]
[*]We've reworked the mechanics for the bonus that gets applied to the maximum dispersion of secondary battery shells fired at a priority target:
[list][*]Activated effect: a gradual increase in secondary gun accuracy at a priority target when secondary battery guns are firing continuously. The maximum bonus to fire accuracy provided by the activated effect equals +50%. This can be achieved if the secondary battery has been continuously firing for 45 seconds.[/list]
[*]The accuracy bonus gradually decreases if the secondary guns haven't fired for 15 seconds.
[*]When the priority target is changed, the accuracy bonus provided by the activated effect instantly drops down to 75% of the accumulated accuracy.[/list]
[h3][b]Close Quarters Expert[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus removed: –10% to the secondary battery reload time.[/list]
[h2]Cruiser skills[/h2]
[h3][i][h3][b]Two skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Pyrotechnician[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Demolition Expert."
[*]Bonus added: +15% to the fragmentation damage area of the main battery and secondary battery shells, as well as HE rockets and bombs, when firing at submarines.[/list]
[h3][b]AA Gun Aiming Expert[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Focus Fire Training."
[*]Bonus added: –10% to the reload time of the Airstrike armament (including an airstrike using anti-submarine defense aircraft).[/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Four skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Outnumbered[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus to the main battery accuracy and ship speed is now activated if the number of visible enemy ships is equal or greater than the number of allies within the firing range of your ship's main guns. The bonus will also apply when there are no enemies or allies within your ship's main battery firing range.[/list]
[h3][b]AA Gunner[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "AA Defense and ASW Expert."
[*]Bonus added: +15% to damage inflicted by depth charges.[/list]
[h2]Destroyer skills[/h2]
[h3][i][h3][b]Two skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Pyrotechnician[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus added: +15% to the damage-inflicting area of main and secondary battery shells when firing at submarines.[/list]
[h3][b]Extra-Heavy AP Shells[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Extra-Heavy Ammunition."
[*]Bonus added: +10% to damage inflicted by depth charges.[/list]
[h2]Aircraft carrier skills[/h2]
[h3][i][h3][b]Four skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Hidden Menace[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus added: –50% to the height at which aircraft return to a carrier after an attack or upon pressing the [b]F[/b] key. Squadrons will now soar up to a height where they are invulnerable to AA fire faster.[/list]
[h3][b]Demolition Expert[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Pyrotechnician."[/list]
[list][i]Due to the arrival of submarines in Ranked Battles and the changes to Commander skills, you will be able to reset Commander skills and demount upgrades free of charge during Update 0.10.7.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Got a large collection of Commanders and want to reset all their skills at once?[/b][/h3]
Starting from August 12, after Update 0.10.7 is released for all regions, you'll find a link to a special page where you can enable the option to automatically reset all your Commanders' skills for free.

[h2][b][h1=armory][/h1]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b30d99f4-f6c7-11eb-909c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

When the update goes live, a large post-war destroyer—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Ragnar[/b][/b]—will join the fleet of available ships in the Armory. The destroyer is equipped with far-reaching artillery comprising four 152 mm guns housed in two turrets. Ragnar can boast of having a large HP pool and strong AA defenses but lacks torpedo armament. The ship has access to the Repair Party and Surveillance Radar consumables. She also has the Emergency Engine Power consumable at her disposal, which boosts her speed by 30%. Ragnar will be available for [b]27,000[/b] Steel.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7c73aafc-f6cf-11eb-a648-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The Flying Fish permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Franklin D. Roosevelt[/b][/b] is now available in exchange for [b]3[/b] Clan Tokens.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b427c9e8-f6ce-11eb-a648-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.8, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] Katori[/b][/b] will no longer be available for Community Tokens. However, you will still be able to get the ship for Doubloons.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=return-of-missouri][/h1]Return of Missouri[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b321eca6-f6c7-11eb-9ebe-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Our special event that commemorates the end of World War II launches on August 27. During the event, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] will appear in random bundles that can be obtained in exchange for Doubloons.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] was our first experience of creating a Tier IX Premium ship, and during her adjustment, the ship received excessively high Credit profitability compared to other Premium Tier IX ships. The existence of a large number of ships with such high profitability negatively affects the game economy. Furthermore, it was often excessive profitability rather than the ship’s specifications and gameplay that became the determining factor for players deciding to helm Missouri into battle more often than they would perhaps otherwise prefer.

At the same time, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] is a renowned historical ship, and we would like more players to have the opportunity to add the ship to their collections. In the forthcoming update, Missouri's base economic capabilities will be brought into line with other Tier IX Premium ships.

Players who already own the ship at the moment Update 0.10.7 goes live will, on average, earn the same number of Credits as before—a permanent combat mission will apply an economic bonus to all battles played at the helm of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b].

To mark the event, we're launching the Pacific War campaign on our website. You'll advance through it from the perspectives of those who sailed through flooding and flame in the grandest naval encounters of World War II. More details will follow in a dedicated article.

To celebrate the event, we've also added:
[list][*]A "Festive" permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b].
[*]"The Show-Me State," "Mighty Mo," "The Rebirth of American Sea Power," "17 Years of Active Service," and "Strength for Freedom" patches.
[*]USS Missouri commemorative flag.
[*]Commanders Neil Chesters, Brian Northcape, Fernand Lacroix, Frederik van Hendriks, Tomokazu Satomi, Aleksey Statsenko, John Duncan Morefield, and Yuen Xuanzhou.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/50eb043e-f6cf-11eb-b309-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Details of the event and info about how to grab the new content will be announced later. [/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=content][/h1]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/33ba6a36-f6ce-11eb-a36f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

We've added destroyer [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Groningen[/b][/b] to the Dutch Tech Tree. She belongs to the same series as [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Friesland[/b][/b] and both ships have identical characteristics. The new ship will be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]1,000,000[/b] Free XP in the Tech Tree. Alternatively, you can grab her for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]19,300[/b] Doubloons in the Armory.

Until the end of Update 0.10.7, all owners of [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Friesland[/b][/b] will be able to replace the ship with [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Groningen[/b][/b] free of charge in the "Inventory" section. More info on how to exchange the ships will be available in the game client.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ea5c5b3c-f6ce-11eb-8697-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We've added the following commemorative flags: Her Majesty's Naval Toaster, Brazilian Imperial Flag, and Submarine Warfare Insignia.

Premium Ship II-IV containers have been added.

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: [b] [b]III[/b] Von der Tann[/b], [b] [b]IV[/b] Moltke[/b], [b] [b]V[/b] Derfflinger[/b], [b] [b]VI[/b] Mackensen[/b], [b] [b]VII[/b] Prinz Heinrich[/b], [b] [b]VIII[/b] Zieten[/b], [b] [b]IX[/b] Prinz Rupprecht[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] Schlieffen[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] Incomparable[/b], and [b] [b]VI[/b] Karl von Schönberg[/b].

[h2]Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These[/h2]
The following content has been added to the game to mark our collaboration with Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These
[list][*]Free Planets Alliance and Galactic Empire expendable camouflages.
[*]Hyperion permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Baltimore[/b][/b], Triglav permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Kansas[/b][/b], Brünhild permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] August von Parseval[/b][/b], and Barbarossa permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Z-23[/b][/b].
[*]Star Fleet, Reinhard Fleet, and Kircheis Fleet patches.
[*]Legend of the Galactic Heroes container.
[*]Commanders Reinhard von Lohengramm, Siegfried Kircheis, Dusty Attemborough, Frederica Greenhill, and Yang Wen-li, each with a unique voiceover.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/39502d3c-f6d8-11eb-9e20-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Details on how to get this new content will be announced later.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b3180998-f6c7-11eb-8f3d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Several ships in a single bundle can now be previewed in the Armory.
[*]The amount of RAM consumed by the game client has been reduced.
[*]We've updated the videos in the Access Levels section.
[*]The shape of the coastline and seabed on the Shards, Trap, New Dawn, and Tears of the Desert maps has been reworked. Ships will now be less likely to get stuck near the coast.
[*]Remaining Premium Account time is now shown in real time.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused instances of fire on the bow of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b][/b]'s researchable hull to last for 30 seconds instead of the standard 60 seconds.
[*]The "Battle!" button will no longer remain blocked at the start of a new Ranked Sprint.
[*]Fixed an issue that removed the alternative color schemes for the permanent camouflages of [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Yukon[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Tashkent[/b][/b].
[*]Fixed the incorrect positioning of the camera in the Binocular view when all guns of a ship have been incapacitated.[*]Fixed an issue that made it impossible for the guns mounted in the stern of [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Constellation[/b][/b] to fire in certain positions.
[*]Other Improvements and Changes. For a complete list, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

Сommanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.10.7, and — in particular — for testing submarines in Ranked Battles! Your sincere and detailed feedback has helped us to tune the new class, as well as its mechanics and interactions with other ships, before the addition of submarines to Ranked and Co-Op battles on the main server in Update 0.10.7! Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!
[list][i]Please Note: The “Inventory” tab will be unavailable on the Public Test server for technical reasons.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes to submarines, anti-submarine upgrades, and the Depth Charge Airstrike were made, as well as some other adjustments. Further details can be found in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/181]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Fixed several issues with the interface of submarines in battle, as well as the display of their parameters in Port;
[*]Updated the tactical hints for submarines and surface ships that play against them;
[*]Updated the videos and fixed several issues in the Dockyard;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused some buildings to disappear in the Rotterdam port when playing with a lower graphics setting;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the limit on the number of submarines to be displayed in the division window when Random Battles were picked;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the indicator of a ship's detectability range to be not displayed when the Airstrike armament is active;
[*]Fixed several other issues.[/list]
[h2]Special Features of the Test[/h2]
[list][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]

During Public Test 0.10.7, all players will have access to Tier VI submarines, which they can play in Co-op and Ranked Battles in a 7 vs. 7 format. Tier VIII and X submarines can be obtained by completing combat missions.

The reward for completing the 24th shipbuilding phase on the Public Test server is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Coal instead of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b].

[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
Starting with the Public Test of Update 0.10.7, you'll be able to earn Community Tokens by completing tasks. Community Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, Premium ships, containers with Premium ships, and other in-game items. All details about Community Tokens are available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/community-tokens/]dedicated article[/url].

[h2][b][h1=submarines][/h1]Submarines[/b][/h2]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc93788c-e87f-11eb-977c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc90cd44-e87f-11eb-bd9f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd3ba520-e87f-11eb-87eb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc9f4aae-e87f-11eb-954f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc8ee1e6-e87f-11eb-9004-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd3e6058-e87f-11eb-915c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Update 0.10.7 is going to introduce a special season of Ranked Battles that you'll be able to participate in playing submarines! To prevent long waiting times in battle queues caused by many people trying to play submarines at the same time, submarines will only be available for limited rental periods in free random daily bundles.

The new ship type will also be available in Co-op Battles. This will allow you to check out the new mechanics in a more relaxed environment.

Commanders will receive a fifth skill tree specifically for submarines, and some of the skills of other ship types will receive additional effects that are designed to counter submarines.

[h2]Playing Submarines[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d3b10066-e870-11eb-8410-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
They are fragile and stealthy hunters that are capable of traveling not only horizontally, but also into the depths. The diving depth of a submarine affects her detectability, viewing range, and interactions with other ship types and submarines. Submarines have four submergence levels: surface, periscope depth, operating depth, and maximum depth. Each submergence level needs to be used in a specific situation, and the penalties and bonuses of each level must be taken into consideration. The time that submarines can spend underwater is limited by their dive capacity. However, dive capacity can be gradually restored when a submarine is on the surface.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0e5ef22-e86d-11eb-8f49-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

The main armament carried by submarines is acoustic homing torpedoes. The sonar ping mechanic will help you increase the potential effectiveness of your torpedo salvos. Hitting an enemy ship with a sonar ping temporarily activates acoustic homing on that ship. Torpedoes can ascend from the depths and home in on an enemy only with the help of an active sonar ping effect.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d3db9380-e870-11eb-99b5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Emitting a sonar ping makes your submarine more visible, so be sure to consider this factor if the enemy is nearby.

[h2]Playing Against Submarines[/h2]
Many destroyers and some light cruisers carry depth charges that can hit submarines that are lurking in the depth. Approach the approximate location of the submarine and release your depth charges using the [b]G[/b] key.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b121bdf4-e86d-11eb-b3b0-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

Some battleships can call anti-submarine defense aircraft. You can choose that armament type by pressing [b]4[/b]. The camera rises and the reticle allows you to select an area within a 10 km radius from the ship. Aircraft will arrive and drop depth charges in this area shortly after selecting it.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b106e808-e86d-11eb-b573-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

A submarine on the surface or at the periscope depth can be hit with shells, ship-launched and airborne torpedoes, bombs, and rockets, as well as by ramming. If you detect a submerged submarine, its dive capacity will be depleted more rapidly.

[h2][b][h1=ranked-battles][/h1]Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.7 kicks off the Fourth Season of Ranked Battles.

[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
[list][*]7 vs. 7
[*]Tier VI in the Bronze League
[*]Tier VIII in the Silver League
[*]Tier X in the Gold League[/list]
[h3][b]Changes to Ranked Battles[/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can participate playing rental submarines, which are available from free random daily bundles.
[*]Ranked Battles statistics are now available in the profile summary. Distribution by league starts from the Fourth Season. Statistics for previous seasons are not available.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d3efe132-e870-11eb-a72f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]After qualifying, you can continue to play in the next league without waiting for the start of the next Sprint. If you reach Rank 1 in the Bronze League and successfully qualify, you can continue playing in the Silver League within the same Sprint.[/list]
[list][i]Details of the Fourth Season of Ranked Battles will be announced later.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=changes-to-commander-skills][/h1]Changes to Commander Skills[/b][/h2]
Since the latest Commander skills update, we've taken a close look at your feedback and compiled a huge amount of data that relates to the changes. We've made some balance tweaks and improved or replaced unpopular skills.

For example, for battleship Commanders, we've updated the mechanics of the Improved Secondary Battery Aiming skill and replaced Consumables Enhancements with Brisk, which now costs 2 skill points. Some skills have received additional effects that are intended to counter submarines.
[list][i]When Update 0.10.7 goes live, all players will have a 100% discount on resetting Commander skills.[/i][/list]
You can learn more details about the updated skills during the Public Test and on our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/175]development blog[/url].

[h2][b][h1=dockyard][/h1]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
With the release of Update 0.10.7,  [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] will become available for construction at the Dockyard.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ec0e8de-e883-11eb-accc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Key features of the new Dockyard[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Ship construction at the Dockyard comprises 24 shipbuilding phases. You can advance through these by completing Dockyard combat missions or spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,500[/b] Doubloons on each phase.
[*]In total, you can progress through 21 out of 24 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions. To finish building the ship, you'll need to purchase three shipbuilding phases.
[*]If you complete the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] by spending Doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions—completing each phase will bring you [b]250[/b] Steel.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4aef49a2-e881-11eb-8d78-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ad3cd4e-e881-11eb-8410-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ad1dac0-e881-11eb-a5ac-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ae55d20-e881-11eb-872a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The rest of the rules remain the same as those for the previous Dockyard.

[list]The reward for completing 24 shipbuilding phases on the Public Test server is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Coal instead of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b].[/list]
[h2][b][h1=the-dutch-cruisers-part 2][/h1]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 2" event[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.7 continues to offer Early Access to Dutch cruisers. We've added a chain of combat missions that will bring you the following rewards when completed:
[list][*]Unique Dutch Commander [b]Klaas Janssen[/b] with the following enhanced skills:
[list][*]For destroyers, cruisers, and battleships—Pyrotechnician: [b]+1.5%[/b] to the chances of setting a target on fire when hitting it with HE shells (by default: +1%).
[*]For cruisers and battleships—Expert AA Marksman: [b]+35%[/b] to AA damage in the priority sector (by default: +25%).[/list][/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc442fc0-e87f-11eb-b83b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 2" commemorative flag.[/list]
[b]Early Access:[/b] Dutch Tier IV, VI, VIII, and IX cruisers that hit the seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.6 continue to be available in random and sequentially available bundles in the Armory.

When Update 0.10.8 goes live, Dutch Tier I–X cruisers will become available for all players to research.
[list][i]Please note: the new Dutch cruisers and Commander [b]Klaas Janssen[/b] cannot be obtained on the Public Test server.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=return-of-missouri][/h1]Return of Missouri[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.7 features an event that's dedicated to the end of World War II. During the event, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] will become available for purchase in exchange for Doubloons.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] was our first experience in creating a Tier IX Premium ship, and during her adjustment, the ship received excessively high Credit profitability compared to other Premium Tier IX ships. The existence of a large number of ships with such high profitability negatively affects the game economy.

Furthermore, it was often not the ship’s specifications and gameplay, but her excessive profitability that became the determining factor for players deciding which ship to take into battle. This resulted in some Captains playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] more often than they planned.

At the same time, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] is one of the most famous historical ships, and we would like more players to have the opportunity to add the ship to their collections.

In the forthcoming update, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b]'s base economic capabilities will be brought into line with other Tier IX Premium ships. Players who already own the ship at the moment Update 0.10.7 goes live will, on average, earn the same number of Credits as before—a permanent combat mission that applies an economic bonus to all battles will maintain the ship’s economic value for everyone who owned Missouri prior to this change.

[h2][b][h1=the-dutch-cruisers-part-1][/h1]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1"[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ff41fa58-dfcb-11eb-9706-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Dutch Tier IV–IX cruisers have arrived in Early Access.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6343afc2-dfe2-11eb-abd4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/640e2c34-dfe2-11eb-9809-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/640fcecc-dfe2-11eb-a739-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/640fc800-dfe2-11eb-ae00-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63b6e712-dfe2-11eb-ac45-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6353bc78-dfe2-11eb-9390-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Features of the branch[/h2]
[list][*]These ships have good maneuverability and concealment, but don’t have great firing range.
[*]The Tier VIII–X cruisers are armed with main battery guns that have impressive calibers for cruisers:
[list][*][b] [b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b]—203 mm
[*][b] [b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b]—240 mm
[*][b] [b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b]—283 mm[/list]
[*]At higher tiers, the new cruisers have solid armor that provides decent protection against HE shells.
[*]The Hydroacoustic Search, Fighter, and Spotting Aircraft consumables are available from Tier IV.
[list][*]Fighter and Spotting Aircraft are not available for [b] [b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b], [b] [b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b] or [b] [b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b].[/list]
[*]Defensive AA Fire and the Repair Party consumable with improved reload time are available from Tier VIII.
[*]The new Airstrike armament is available from Tier VI.[/list]
[h2]Airstrike[/h2]
Airstrike is a new type of armament that's set to make its first appearance on Dutch cruisers. It allows you to call in aircraft that bombard the specified area with HE bombs. Airstrike was created based on the low altitude bombing principle that was actually used in battle. Bombs dropped from aircraft in this manner had drogue parachutes which slowed their descent.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e2f8e14-dfe3-11eb-9809-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e4675c0-dfe3-11eb-b65a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e402b70-dfe3-11eb-ae00-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e4e4f2a-dfe3-11eb-9390-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Operating principle:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]When you activate Airstrike by pressing 4, an aiming reticle appears. This represents the location the bombers will strike. The strike area is comparablepa in size to two battleships.
[*]Clicking the left mouse button calls in a squadron that bombards the specified area after a certain period of time. The aircraft cannot spot enemies and cannot be directly controlled.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/728f8720-dfe3-11eb-9809-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/72974974-dfe3-11eb-8258-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[list][*]The bombs have drogue parachutes which slow their descent.
[*]The indicator near the drop area shows how long it will take for the bombs to reach the target after the aircraft are called in. Airstrike is most efficient against targets with low maneuverability and ships sheltering behind islands.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/729b1270-dfe3-11eb-b6df-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

Preparation of Airstrike begins at the start of each battle, similar to the loading of main battery guns and torpedo launchers. Tier VI–VII cruisers can call in only one attacking squadron, while Tier VIII–X cruisers can call in two squadrons. The armament is reloaded in successive order. Airstrike has a maximum operating distance of 10–13 km, depending on the ship tier.

When using Airstrike, you should take the long descent time of the bombs into account. It's best to deploy this armament against low-mobility targets such as battleships and large cruisers. You can also use it to strike any enemy ships that might think they are safely hiding behind the cover of islands.

[h2][b][h1=other-changes-and-improvements][/h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fee2d672-dfcb-11eb-9eba-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Visual and other enhancements[/h2]
[h3][b]The combat mission interface has been updated[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added a new type of combat mission that allows players to choose one of two rewards after completing it. This means that you can choose a reward that you like or need rather than obtain a predetermined reward. If no reward is chosen, the first reward will be credited after the mission expires.
[*]Priority missions are now highlighted. This will help you notice important missions or mission chains, such as those dedicated to certain activities, that offer valuable rewards, or that have a short duration.
[*]The tooltip now shows the exact expiration time of the mission.
[*]Fixed a number of errors that caused problems with how combat missions were displayed in the corresponding Port tab and on the post-battle statistics screen.[/list]
Missions that allow players to choose the reward, as well as highlighted priority tasks, will appear in the activities of future updates.

[h3][b]Updated the AI of bots[/b][/h3]
[list][*]They can now adjust their speed to avoid torpedoes.
[*]Reduced the likelihood of bots colliding with islands in Training and Co-op battles, as well as in Operations.
[*]In Co-op battles, bots will try to change their course if there's a risk of colliding with other ships, rather than lower their speed or move astern.[/list]
This change will result in more realistic behavior for bots.
[h2]Game balance changes[/h2]
We've made some changes to the parameters of certain ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and player feedback. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.
[h3][i][h3][b]Summary of Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Gustav-Julius Maerker[/b]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea reduced from 8.1 to 8 km. Other detectability values were reduced accordingly.[/list]
[b] [b]IX[/b] Felix Schultz[/b]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea reduced from 8.2 to 8.1 km. Other detectability values were reduced accordingly.[/list]
[b] [b]VII[/b] Leberecht Maass[/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 4 to 4.2 seconds.[/list]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Fenyang[/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 4.9 to 4.7 seconds.[/list]
[b] [b]VI[/b] Queen Elizabeth[/b]
[list][*]Main battery gun 180-degree traverse time reduced from 72 to 54.5 s.[/list]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Monarch[/b]
[list][*]Standard main battery firing range increased from 16.5 to 17 km.[/list]
[b] [b]VI[/b] Leander[/b], [b] [b]VII[/b] Fiji[/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 7.7 to 8 seconds.[/list]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Edinburgh[/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 7.5 to 7.7s.[/list]
[b] [b]VII[/b] Jervis[/b]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea increased from 7.2 to 7.3 km Other detectability values were increased accordingly.[/list]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Baltimore[/b]
[list][*]Surveillance Radar consumable action time reduced from 30 to 27 s.[/list]
[b] [b]VII[/b] Shchors[/b]
[list][*]Standard main battery firing range increased from 15.2 to 15.7 km.[/list]
[b] [b]VI[/b] Andrea Doria[/b]
[list][*]Maximum SAP shell damage increased from 9,900 to 10,250.[/list]
[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list][*]In Update 0.10.5, the mechanic that determines the contents of containers was changed—this is now determined at the point in time when the container is opened. This will prevent situations where players could receive a unique item for the second time if the container hadn’t been opened immediately after it was received and the player had already obtained the item from the container.
[*]In Clan Battles, when a cyclone appears, various weather effects will be displayed on maps.
[*]Updated the button and animation for receiving rewards in the "Daily Rewards" section.
[*]Optimized the performance of the game client with a large list of contacts or large blacklist.
[*]For displays with a resolution of 1920х1080 or higher, the size of the mouse cursor now becomes larger proportional to the screen resolution.
[*]Fixed an error that caused Co-op battles to take place with no more than two players on each team.

[h2][b][h1=dutch-cruisers-part-1][/h1]Dutch Cruisers: Part 1[/b][/h2]
Dutch Cruisers: Part 1 is an event for Update 0.10.6. Dutch Tier IV–IX cruisers—the main feature of the event—will become available in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.6! While you'll have to wait until the new update is released before you can actually take them into battle, you can take part in testing the event itself beforehand. Read our special [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/public-test-0106/]article[/url] to learn more details about the Public Test.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c1ccf91a-d25c-11eb-ae93-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3dda704-d25c-11eb-9fbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c31e765e-d25c-11eb-9c3c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c1243b5e-d25c-11eb-b721-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c129d6ea-d25c-11eb-b9b2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c39c917e-d25c-11eb-a8b4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3e60ca0-d25c-11eb-b9b2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c322fa1c-d25c-11eb-9d37-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c1cdb120-d25c-11eb-87bd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c126859e-d25c-11eb-8e24-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][b]The new Dutch cruisers can't be obtained on the Public Test server.[/b][/list]

[h2]Features of the branch[/h2]
[list][*]Good concealment and maneuverability but a short firing range.
[*]The Hydroacoustic Search, Fighter, and Spotting Aircraft consumables are available from Tier IV.
[*]Fighter and Spotting Aircraft are not available for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b][/b].
[*]An enhanced version of the Repair Party consumable and Defensive AA Fire are available from Tier VIII.
[*]At higher tiers, the new cruisers have good armor that provides decent protection against HE shells.
[*]Tier VIII–X cruisers carry main battery guns with the following calibers:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b][/b]—203 mm
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b][/b]—240 mm
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b][/b]—283 mm[/list]
[*]The new Airstrike consumable is available from Tier VI.[/list]
[h3][b]Airstrike[/b][/h3]
Airstrike is a new type of armament that's set to make its first appearance on Dutch cruisers in World of Warships. It was created based on the low altitude bombing principle that was actually used in battle. Bombs dropped from aircraft in this manner had drogue parachutes.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5aca4e9e-d260-11eb-bb7a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The squadron, which has an operating distance of 10 to 13 km, bombards the specified target with HE bombs that fall for an extended period of time. At the same time, the aircraft cannot spot enemies and cannot be directly controlled.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2599e7a8-d25f-11eb-bb7a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/254db32e-d25f-11eb-9efe-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2551fbb4-d25f-11eb-85ca-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/24c872ae-d25f-11eb-a582-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
[b]Rewards for Combat Mission Groups:[/b] a new temporary resource—[i]Dutch Tokens[/i]—as well as the "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" commemorative flag and the Kinderdijk Windmill patch. The reward for completing the second combat mission group is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Celebes[/b][/b]. The final reward for completing the last combat mission group is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Eendracht[/b][/b].

[b]Rewards for Dutch Tokens:[/b] sequentially available bundles with Tier IV, VI, and VIII Dutch cruisers; permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Eendracht[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b][/b]; and more desirable items.

By completing combat mission groups, you can earn enough Tokens to obtain Dutch Tier IV and VI cruisers, as well as the Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflage for the Tier VII cruiser.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3830100-d25c-11eb-9620-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b][/b] will be available in random bundles available for Doubloons.

Added a new Port—Rotterdam.

[h2][b][h1=updates-to-combat-missions][/h1]Updates to Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
A new type of combat mission is going to be introduced in Update 0.10.6. After completing these missions, you can choose one of two rewards. If you don't choose a reward and the mission expires, you'll automatically receive the first reward.

The most important and high-priority missions are now highlighted in the combat mission interface. Combat mission chains are displayed first.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5abbff38-d260-11eb-a8b4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Updated the AI of bots:
[list][*]They can now adjust their speed to avoid torpedoes.
[*]Reduced the chances of bots colliding with islands in Training and Co-op battles, as well as in Operations.[/list]
The Saint Petersburg Port has been decorated to celebrate Navy Day.

[h2][b][h1=german-destroyers][/h1]German Destroyers[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2e6a3376-ca92-11eb-948b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[list][i]When Update 0.10.5 goes live, German destroyers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VII Z-31[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Gustav-Julius Maerker[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]IX Felix Schultz[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]X Elbing[/b][/b] will join our ranks as researchable ships.[/i][/list]

[h2]Features of the branch[/h2]
[list][*]Accurate 150 mm main battery guns—a large caliber for destroyers.
[*]Powerful AP shells with good penetration and damage-dealing characteristics, as well as enhanced ricochet angles. Deploy them in battle to bring the pain to cruisers!
[*]Their solid HP pools and decent armor protection can shield them from the HE shells of most destroyers (unless an enemy Commander has mastered the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells skill). Combined with their effective artillery, this results in special gameplay for the new German destroyers. They are essentially agile ships that primarily focus on lone targets—light cruisers especially.
[*]Due to the low damage-per-minute stats of their HE shells and the destroyers' high detectability, these new ships aren't cut out for fighting for control of Key Areas.
[*]The Smoke Generator consumable boosts their already good survivability even further. Starting from Tier IX, German destroyers come equipped with the Defensive AA Fire consumable—a valuable asset that will allow you to counter hostile aircraft with greater confidence.
[*]Torpedoes with a standard reload time for most destroyers, good damage, and an excellent reach, but also a rather low speed.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0234f138-cab5-11eb-a317-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0238eb30-cab5-11eb-a87f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/01a438fa-cab5-11eb-a14e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/01a26a7a-cab5-11eb-acd1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=grand-battle][/h1]Grand Battle[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2dddb680-ca92-11eb-a276-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.5 brings a new temporary battle type—the Grand Battle. Its main feature comes in the form of super battleships. The destruction of legendary battleship Yamato by aircraft carriers presaged the domination of deck aviation in naval warfare. Super battleships are the ships that might have existed if shipbuilding had moved toward the development of main batteries as the primary decisive factor of battle.

Two super battleships will be available to you in the Grand Battle:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b] Satsuma[/b][/b] is a project based on [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Yamato[/b][/b] with reinforced primary armament—510 mm guns in four twin-gun turrets.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae2384f0-cab5-11eb-ae49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b] Hannover[/b][/b] is a Project "H-42" design with 483 mm guns placed in four twin-gun turrets and her secondary battery replaced with 128 mm dual-purpose artillery.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/adb8af7c-cab5-11eb-acd1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]More details about the Grand Battle's rules and rewards will come in a dedicated article on our website. Stay tuned![/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=us-independence-day][/h1]U.S. Independence Day[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/300bf9d0-ca92-11eb-9292-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In celebration of the American Independence Day, the game will feature a set of dedicated combat mission groups and a new auction.

[h2]Summer Battles[/h2]
Update 0.10.5 unlocks access to four themed combat mission groups called "Summer Battles." Completing them will bring you Dazzling and "Stars 'n' Stripes" expendable camouflages, as well as signal flags. Once you're done with the third group, you'll get [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VII Colorado[/b][/b], a Port slot, and a 6-skill-point Commander. The fourth group will bring you the Independence Day permanent camouflage for Colorado.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbe46db6-cabf-11eb-8c50-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]If [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VII Colorado[/b][/b] is already berthed in your Port, you'll receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]9,000,000[/b] Credits as compensation. Detailed information on the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]

[h2]Independence Day auction[/h2]
[h3][i][h3][b]Auction: key rules[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[list][*]Each auction consists of the following stages:
[list][*]An auction lot is announced with details of its starting price and the number of possible bid winners.
[*]The auction begins and bids can be placed.
[*]The results of the auction are summed up; bids are no longer accepted.
[*]The auction winners receive their rewards, while the other Auction participants receive their bids back.[/list]
[*]You can change your bid amount at any time, as long as bidding for that lot is still available.
[*]The number of lots is limited. The highest bids win.
[*]Players will only be notified about the starting bid for a lot and the number of possible winners.
[*]Depending on the lot, you can use various in-game resources for your bid.
[*]Once the results are calculated, the highest bids win. If there are several bids of the same amount, the earliest-placed bid wins. In this situation, the time when the bid was last changed is taken into account.
[*]It's a risk-free adventure! Any bids that don't win will be returned to the bidders when the auction closes.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 02 Jul. 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 05 Jul. 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h3][b]Lots[/b][/h3]
[list][*]U.S. Commander [b]Theodor "Trouble" Murphy[/b] with 14 skill points, plus 20 Rising camouflages
[*]Sharks permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]X Worcester[/b][/b]
[*]Eagles permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]X Worcester[/b][/b]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Coal
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Somers[/b][/b] commemorative flag[/list]
Auctions are cross-server—players on all World of Warships regions (CIS, EU, NA, and ASIA) compete with each other for the same lots, so the final number of winners is shared between the four servers.

[list][i]We'll share more details on the starting bids and numbers of winners closer to the starting date of the auction. Stay tuned for more news on our website![/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=game-mechanics][/h1]Changes to the Game Mechanics[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2dc57df4-ca92-11eb-bb55-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Friendly fire is now disabled[/h2]
In Update 0.10.5, we're disabling the ability to cause damage to allies (friendly fire) in all battle types. This change will have a positive effect on gameplay—your teammates will no longer be able to damage or destroy your ship.

[h3][b]Main changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can no longer damage or destroy allied ships, disable their modules, or cause detonation Ramming won't cause any damage to allied ships either.
[*]At the same time, all armament types can still hit allied ships. This means that you still won't be able to launch torpedoes at an enemy through an allied ship.
[*]Camera effects that indicate incoming damage won't be active for a ship that gets hit by allied shells or torpedoes.
[*]The warning about incoming allied torpedoes has also been removed, as they can no longer inflict damage.[/list]
[h3][b]Friendly fire penalty[/b][/h3]
While it's now impossible to damage allied ships, friendly fire is still tracked by the unsporting conduct penalty system. Any players who fire at teammates deliberately can expect to be penalized. This kind of behavior interferes with other Captains' experience of the game and doesn't contribute toward the success of the team.
[list][*]A warning for unsporting conduct will now be issued for a certain number of hits on allied ships in one battle:
[list][*]40 hits or more on one ally.
[*]50 hits or more on several allies.
[*]Hits on allied ships with any armament type, except for secondary battery hits, are counted.[/list]
[*]If you receive a warning in a battle, any Credits or XP earned in that battle will be forfeit as a penalty. However, provided that you don't break the rules in your next battles, any resources you earn in those battles will be credited to you as usual.
[*]An issued warning also triggers a friendly fire penalty. Damage will be inflicted to the perpetrator's ship each time they open fire at allies. The exact amount of inflicted damage depends on the perpetrator's current HP and grows with each new hit on an allied ship.[/list]
[list][i]More details about the unsporting conduct penalty system will be available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/combat-discipline/]dedicated article[/url].[/i][/list]

[h2]Attack aircraft: evolved mechanics[/h2]
We've reworked the rocket-launching mechanics for attack aircraft in Update 0.10.5.
[list][*]These planes will now fire small-caliber machine guns prior to firing rockets, and the duration of an attack run is now longer.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/edc1008c-cac0-11eb-8c50-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The machine guns don't inflict damage to ships—their function is to show the exact spot where the rockets are going to hit.
[*]Once the machine guns open fire, you won't be able to adjust the flight path of your attack aircraft. However, your attack aircraft also become immune to AA fire at that point.
[*]Apart from the rocket-launching mechanics, we've also changed the aiming settings, the time it takes to prepare for an attack run, and other attack aircraft characteristics. The attack aircraft of [b]VIII Saipan[/b], [b]VIII Sanzang[/b], [b]VIII Lexington[/b] (F4U-1D Corsair Tiny Tim), [b]X Midway[/b] (F8F Bearcat Tiny Tim), [b]VIII Graf Zeppelin[/b], and [b]VIII Graf Zeppelin B[/b] will now climb high at the start of an attack run.[/list]
Information about rocket hit zones, together with the prolonged attack time and fixed aiming reticle position, will allow Captains of agile ships—destroyers, primarily—to reduce the chances of taking rocket damage by making evasive maneuvers.
[list]The evolved rocket-launching mechanics are being applied to the attack aircraft of all carriers.[/list]
[h2][b][h1=recruitment-points][/h1]Community Tokens[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2e68fb3c-ca92-11eb-9604-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Recruitment Points are getting updated with the release of Update 0.10.5. They will become a more versatile resource that can be earned by participating in various activities and exchanged for various rewards.
[list][*]Recruitment Points have been renamed [b]Community Tokens[/b].
[*]These Tokens can also be earned outside of the Recruiting Station program. Watch official World of Warships streams and participate in Public Tests, as well as regional and global activities, to earn more Community Tokens, then spend them on some awesome rewards!
[*]The following rewards will be added to the special category of the Armory: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]III Katori[/b][/b], Premium Ship V and Premium Ship VII containers, permanent and expendable camouflages, commemorative flags, and much more![/list]
[h2][b][h1=interface-changes][/h1]Interface Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2de07f46-ca92-11eb-9d6b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The display of upgrades in the Equipment tab has been updated.
[list][*]A full list of available upgrades, including special and legendary ones, is now shown in each slot.
[*]While browsing the Equipment tab of the Port, you can now click through to purchase special or unique upgrades from the Armory.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b31ad00-cacb-11eb-abd4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]A button that will take you back to the Equipment tab has been added to the purchase status pop-up window.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b08c4a8-cacb-11eb-9e7f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Upgrade sorting has been updated: regular upgrades are displayed first, then special and legendary upgrades.[/list]
Changed the animation and display of how ribbons and achievements are received in battle. Changed the size of icons of earned achievements. They are now displayed separately from ribbons in the top-right corner.

[h2][b][h1=daily-shipments][/h1]Daily Shipments[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2e08c7ee-ca92-11eb-8f13-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

New daily rewards will become available to you from July 1.

This section is available in the player menu of the Port and includes 24 rewards that are refreshed on a monthly basis. If you succeed in collecting all 24 rewards before the end of the month, you can receive an additional reward of 750 Free XP for each subsequent day that you enter the game until the end of the month. If you don't click the "Collect Reward" button, the reward is collected automatically at the start of a new 24-hour period.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/eb10bba4-9922-11eb-90cd-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=armory][/h1]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2dadfe72-ca92-11eb-85a5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The following new ships will become available with the release of the update:
[list][*][b]X Druid[/b] is a destroyer armed with four dual-purpose 127 mm guns placed in two turrets on the ship's bow. They fire only AP shells with improved ricochet angles and a reduced arming threshold, so you can expect fewer overpenetrations and ricochets. While she lacks torpedoes, Druid has a wide choice of consumables at her disposal: Hydroacoustic Search, Short-Burst Smoke Generator, and Repair Party. The ship will be available in the Research Bureau for [b]56,000[/b] Research Points.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/beed5f34-cabc-11eb-9be6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]VIII Tone[/b] is a heavy cruiser armed with eight accurate 203 mm guns that are housed in four turrets situated on the ship's bow. She participated in key battles of World War II—the Battle of Midway and the Battle of Leyte Gulf. This fast ship has decent armor and good concealment. Tone also carries a squadron of four torpedo bombers with low detectability. Each bomber is armed with two torpedoes. The ship will be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]11,300[/b] Doubloons.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/61ff2a8c-cac1-11eb-89b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Unique historical Commander [b]Jerzy Świrski[/b] is now available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]175,000[/b] Coal.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5035c57a-caa5-11eb-9e9a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[b]VI Gallant[/b] is now available in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]48,000[/b] Coal.

We've added the Red Fox permanent camouflage for [b]X Plymouth[/b]—it's available for [b]10[/b] Ranked Tokens.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe023c7e-cabe-11eb-94b4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.5, German Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,100[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=content][/h1]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2ddf317c-ca92-11eb-9d80-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Added the Independence Day permanent camouflage for [b]VIII Constellation[/b] and Maple Leaf permanent camouflage for [b]VII Yukon[/b].
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3de786b4-cabf-11eb-8c50-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3de714fe-cabf-11eb-bfeb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][b]When Update 0.10.5 goes live, [b]VI Erich Loewenhardt[/b], [b]VII Nelson[/b], [b]VI T-61[/b], [b]VII Haida[/b], [b]VII Z-39[/b], [b]VIII Asashio[/b], [b]VI Admiral Graf Spee[/b], and [b]VIII Lenin[/b] will cease to be available. The ships will be taken out of the game due to a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. To maintain the proper level of ship diversity within teams, these ships will cease to be available to obtain for an indefinite period of time, but they may return in future.[/b][/list]

The following changes were made to the Tech Tree tab.
[list][*]The following ships were removed from the Tech Trees of their nations: [b]VII Duca degli Abruzzi[/b] and [b]VIII Mainz[/b].
[*]The following ships were added to the Tech Trees of their nations: [b]VIII Pyotr Bagration[/b], [b]VIII Tirpitz[/b] and [b]VII München[/b].[/list]
[b]VIII Mainz[/b] and [b]VII Duca degli Abruzzi[/b] are still available for purchase in the Armory.

A new nation—the Netherlands—has been added. Following the addition of the new nation, [b]IX Friesland[/b], which was historically a ship that belonged to the Royal Netherlands Navy, will still be a ship of the European nation. However, she'll be removed from the Tech Tree and won't be available to research when Update 0.10.6 is released. In Update 0.10.7 she'll be replaced with Groningen, which is identical to Friesland. She'll be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]1,000,000[/b] Free XP.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2debdc6a-ca92-11eb-8be0-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Added the possibility to earn an additional attempt during the Engagement stage, depending on when the stage began and the number of attempts used.
[list][*]24 hours after the start of the Naval Battle: one additional attempt for each five used.
[*]48 hours after the start of the Naval Battle: one additional attempt for each four used.[/list]
Information on how to earn additional attempts will be shown in the tooltip next to the current number of attempts.

[h2]Game balance changes[/h2]
We've made some changes to the parameters of certain ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and player feedback. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

[h3][b]Italian Tier X battleship Cristoforo Colombo:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 38 to 37 s.

[*]The Junior Shipbuilder, Senior Shipbuilder, Shipbuilding Inspector, and Chief Shipbuilding Inspector achievements are now displayed in the "Achievements" section when the player earns Research Points for the first time.
