[h2][b][h1=italian-battleships-part-2][/h1]Italian Battleships: Part 2[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/499dbccc-823e-11eb-ab6f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

With Update 0.10.2, Italian battleships continue to shine bright in the dedicated event that takes center stage!

[h2]Features of the Ship Branch[/h2]
[list][*]Semi-armor-piercing shells instead of HE shells. These shells can deal significant damage to weakly and moderately protected targets and vulnerable ship parts, but do not cause fires.
[*]A large number of guns with relatively short firing ranges and not the greatest accuracy.
[*]Decent maneuverability and armor protection.
[*]Tier VIII–X ships have access to the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which allows them to sneak away from enemies without having to reduce speed. However, shooting from within a smoke screen while retreating isn't recommended—battleships have high detectability when firing their main battery guns from within smoke.[/list]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
Italian battleships of Tiers IV–VI, as well as the Tier VIII and IX Italian battleships that hit the seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.1, continue to be available in sequential and random bundles in the Armory.

In Update 0.10.2, Italian Tokens will only be obtainable from random bundles available for Doubloons in the Armory. Players can spend Italian Tokens until the end of Update 0.10.2. After Update 0.10.3 goes live, all Italian Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,250[/b].
[list][i]When Update 0.10.3 goes live, Italian Tier IV–X battleships will be available for all players to research.[/i][/list]
[h2]Combat Mission Group Rewards[/h2]
Italian Battleships containers, signals, Credits, and the Legion permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b].
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0aa8ec46-830e-11eb-8e36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
If you already own the Legion permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b], you will receive compensation in the form of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]6,000[/b] Doubloons.

An Italian Battleships container may drop one of the following Premium ships: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VI Leone[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Duca degli Abruzzi[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Roma[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b], as well as special signals, Free XP, Regia Marina expendable camouflages, days of Warships Premium Account, and Doubloons.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ed9acfbe-8314-11eb-a953-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Free Bundles[/h2]
The Armory is offering free random bundles. Inside, you can find Italian Battleships containers, [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b], Doubloons, and other rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles are available until: [/b] [b]Mon. 05 Apr. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ed999806-8314-11eb-a69b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The bundles will be available for 18 days. You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=big-hunt][/h1]Big Hunt[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81d2e1bc-830b-11eb-85bd-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.2 brings a new temporary battle type called "Big Hunt"—a revamped version of the Key Battle that went live in Update 0.9.10. Demonstrate your skills as you stand against foes in an engaging competition of the future by assuming command over a ship that represents one of three corporations!

The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on the gigantic Polygon map.
[list][*]Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map. Be cautious—the Portal opens up only some time after the battle starts.
[*]You start out alone, but you can gather a team directly in battle.
[*]It’s now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player still starts the battle on their own. To coordinate their efforts, Division mates will need to locate each other on the map and build up their team.
[*]The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal, or when the battle time expires.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2457e88a-830f-11eb-8e36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/24523e58-830f-11eb-b1a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/245fd8d8-830f-11eb-9b0c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
A temporary resource—Battle Points—will be issued to players for destroying monsters and other players.
[list][*]Specifically for the Big Hunt, we've added a new boss ship called Aurora. Defeating her won't be smooth sailing, but doing so will bring a huge amount of Battle Points to the team that sinks her.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2445a206-830f-11eb-9d35-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Having accrued a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle.
[*]Any Battle Points you earn won’t be lost or spent in battle. You can exchange them for rewards in the Armory.
[*]Successfully exiting the Polygon will double the amount of Battle Points you get.[/list]
Grab the helm of one of a total of six ships, and try your luck in the Big Hunt! Each ship has a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay.

The first three ships, which you are likely to already be familiar with from the Key Battle, are available immediately with all of their modules. The three new ships—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Hector[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Avenger[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Whirlwind[/b][/b]—and all of their modules will become available after completing chains of combat missions.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/634348a8-8316-11eb-89ea-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63467abe-8316-11eb-b2ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63521298-8316-11eb-94b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Each ship is equipped with distinct types of weapons and consumables that can have a drastic impact on gameplay. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Hector[/b][/b], for example, can dive underwater, where she has greater speed and maneuverability, and can also ignore enemy shells and torpedoes for a short period of time. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Avenger[/b][/b] can be equipped with large-caliber mortars that have a big impact zone. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Whirlwind[/b][/b] offers a wide selection of torpedo armament and is capable of regenerating HP by damaging her enemies.
[list][i]More details on the Big Hunt rules, as well as the available rewards in the Armory, will come in a dedicated article on our website.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=visual-improvements][/h1]Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81d69820-830b-11eb-ba61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.2 ushers in a large-scale makeover of the in-game visual effects. All effects in the game—from shell tracers and fires on board ships, to gunfire, water splashes, and AA fire explosions—have been enhanced. New visual effects have been added for ricochets; fires on ships; citadel hits; incapacitated weapons; and active operation effects for the Damage Control Party, Repair Party, Main Battery Reload Booster, Defensive AA Fire, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca6cfbec-8310-11eb-a243-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca3ddb46-8310-11eb-9f40-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca186636-8310-11eb-b1a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
More details about the visual effects enhancements are available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/updated-visual-effects-review/]separate article[/url].

[h2][b][h1=division-star][/h1]Division Star[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/82398886-830b-11eb-93f1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Throughout Update 0.10.2, Clan members will have access to special victory bonuses in the form of a Division Star.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ed3599f0-8314-11eb-94b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]You can get a Division Star by playing as part of a Division with your Clanmates.
[*]A Star is issued to each member of a Division for the first victory gained by that Division during Update 0.10.2.
[*]A Star can be obtained in Random, Co-op, and Clan Battles, as well as in Operations.
[*]Earning a certain number of Stars unlocks access to various rewards.
[*]If you switch Clans, any Stars and rewards you previously earned remain with you.
[*]To see the roster of Clanmates who you can combine your efforts with in a Division, as well as the list of rewards you can get, navigate to the Division Star tab in the Clans section.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ed41b500-8314-11eb-a4bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=armory][/h1]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/820276b6-830b-11eb-968e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New ships[/b][/h3]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Austin[/b][/b], available for [b]29,000[/b] Steel, is a U.S. cruiser that was designed at the end of World War II. The ship is armed with twelve dual-purpose 127 mm guns in six turrets, and carries two quintuple-tube torpedo launcher mounts. The cruiser has an unlimited number of charges for the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable, which reduces the reload time of her guns by 75% instead of the standard 50%. She also has the Hydroacoustic Search and Defensive AA Fire consumables in separate slots. Her AA defenses are efficient, and she’s armed with SAP shells instead of AP shells.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/27dba80e-8312-11eb-9b58-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b], available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]228,000[/b] Coal, is an Italian battleship that was designed in the 1930s. As a further development of the Vittorio Veneto-class battleships, Marco Polo is equipped with nine 406 mm guns in three turrets. Like her researchable Italian counterparts, Marco Polo relies on AP and SAP shells, but her guns are more accurate. Instead of being equipped with the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, she has a choice between Spotting Aircraft or Fighter in a single slot. The ship boasts good concealment and decent armor protection. This ship may also drop from Italian Battleships containers.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/277cd144-8312-11eb-a383-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

When Update 0.10.5 goes live, Nelson[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VI We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance. Any interested players still have time to steer these ships into their Ports before Update 0.10.5 goes live in about 3 months' time.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81ddfd90-830b-11eb-96c0-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h3][i][h3][b]Content additions and changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81e20174-830b-11eb-9d35-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Weimar[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Tiger '59[/b][/b] have been added for testing by developers, volunteers, and community contributors.

[h3][i][h3][b]Other changes and improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81d0df20-830b-11eb-84c1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The aiming sights of aircraft carrier squadrons will now display a land-hit indicator similar to that displayed for the main battery guns of ships.
[*]The post-battle service costs for Tier II–VII Premium and special ships have been reduced.
[*]We've improved the operation of the ship's autopilot when moving backwards and when changing course.
[*]Performance of the game chat is now more stable.
[*]We've made changes to the set of recommended Commander skills for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Småland[/b][/b] and researchable Italian battleships.
[*]Fixed an issue that could sometimes make [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Lepanto[/b][/b]'s firing range longer than her viewing range: for Lepanto, the viewing range has been increased from 25.3 to 28.3 km.
[*]Fixed an issue that could freeze the dropping container animation on the barge when minimizing the game client window.
[*]Fixed lighting effects for the Port of Marseille.
[*]Fixed the ship's position in the Designer's Table Port.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the cost of Commander retraining to be displayed incorrectly.
[*]Fixed an issue that made it impossible to display a selected ship's stats for a particular Ranked Battles season in the Port.
[*]The player profile preview window now offers a player search option.
[*]We’ve added an option to view stats for a hidden player profile if the viewing and viewed players are members of the same Clan. Profile settings can be configured on the game website.
[*]Fixed an FPS drop that occurred in the Port when the camera moved to a certain position.
[*]Other improvements and changes. For a complete list, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

[*]Players will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]

If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.10.2, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] doubloons; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Premium Account[/b].
[*]50 signal flags of all types (except special signals) will also be added to your PT account.[/list]
If you fought at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 0.10.0–0.10.1 Public Tests, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.

[h2]How to Enter[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b91b8bba-7e6b-11ea-85b6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.2[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the Live Server. The new Italian battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#big-hunt]Big Hunt[/url] ● [url=#italian-battleships-part-2]Italian Battleships: Part 2[/url] ● [url=#visual-and-other-enhancements]Visual and Other Enhancements[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=big-hunt][/h1]Big Hunt[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.2 brings a new temporary battle type called "Big Hunt"—a revamped version of the Key Battle presented in Update 0.9.10. Demonstrate your skills as you stand against foes in an engaging competition of the future by assuming command over a ship that represents one of three corporations!

[h2]Key Rules[/h2]
The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on a huge map codenamed Polygon. Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/840e7ef8-72be-11eb-807b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/840b7000-72be-11eb-975e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/841e88e8-72be-11eb-992c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
You no longer need a key to achieve that, but be cautious, as the Portal opens up only some time after a battle starts, and access to it is heavily defended.

All players enter each battle solo, but can build up a team of their own or join other players to form teams as the battle unfolds.

It is now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player still starts the battle on their own. To play together, the Division mates will, therefore, need to locate each other on the map once they are spawned, and build up a team to coordinate their efforts. We've also added an option to place markers on the Minimap that are visible to all teammates to enable better cooperation in battle.

The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal, or when the battle time expires. The new mode will not feature a final battle in the Octagon.

[h2]Battle Points[/h2]
By destroying monsters and other players, you can earn a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle. You don't spend any Battle Points in the process of doing that, and because improving your ship won't cost any Battle Points, reinforce your ship as soon as you are able!

Specifically for the Big Hunt, we've added a new boss ship called Aurora. Defeating her will not be an easy ride, but doing so will bring a huge amount of Battle Points to the team that sinks her.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b50b626-72bf-11eb-992c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Successfully exiting the Polygon will bring you additional Battle Points.

Any Battle Points earned are transferred to the Port so that you can exchange them in the Armory on the Live Server for any of the three types of random bundles that offer different rewards. Among other items, players will be able to get a new temporary resource from those bundles—a Corporation Token—which can be exchanged for themed permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Amagi[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Akizuki[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Öland[/b][/b].

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8bb650e4-72bf-11eb-975e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b71f782-72bf-11eb-a820-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b5cc308-72bf-11eb-8560-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Ships[/h2]
A total of six ships will be available to players.

The first three ships, which you are likely to already be familiar with from the Key Battle, are available immediately with all modules. The three new ships—Hector, Avenger, and Whirlwind—and all of their modules will become available after completing a chain of combat missions.

Each of the ships carries new types of weapons and consumables that can have a drastic impact on gameplay. Hector, for example, can go underwater and hence ignore enemy shells and torpedoes for a short spell of time. Avenger can be equipped with large-caliber mortars that have a big impact zone. Whirlwind offers a wide selection of torpedo armament, and is capable of regenerating HP by damaging her enemies.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/912aa174-72bf-11eb-a820-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b7126b8-72bf-11eb-a12a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8bbbeac2-72bf-11eb-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=italian-battleships-part-2][/h1]Italian Battleships: Part 2[/b][/h2]
With Update 0.10.2, we're continuing the event that revolves around Italian battleships.

[h2]Early Access[/h2]
Italian battleships of Tiers IV to VI, as well as Tier VIII and IX Italian battleships which hit the seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.1, continue to be available in consecutive and random bundles at the Armory.
[list][i]When Update 0.10.3 goes live, Italian Tier IV–X battleships will be available for all players to research.[/i][/list]
[h2]Combat Mission Group Rewards[/h2]
Italian Battleships containers, signals, Credits, and the Legion permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b].
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b3601be-72bf-11eb-8f39-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
On the Live Server, an Italian Battleships container may drop one of the following Premium ships: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VI Leone[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Duca degli Abruzzi[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Roma[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b], as well as special signals, Free XP, Regia Marina expendable camouflages, days of Warships Premium Account, and Doubloons.

[h2][b][h1=visual-and-other-enhancements][/h1]Visual and Other Enhancements[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.2 ushers in a large-scale makeover of the in-game visual effects. All effects in the game—from shell tracers and fires on board ships, to gunfire, water splashes, and AA fire explosions—have been enhanced and reworked to accommodate the new lighting system. New visual effects have been added for ricochets; fires on ships with the Fire Prevention Expert skill active; citadel hits; incapacitated weapons; and active operation effects for the Damage Control Party, Repair Party, Main Battery Reload Booster, Defensive AA Fire, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables. These changes, depending on individual computer configurations and game settings, will not affect performance, but at peak loads will improve it significantly.

notes.title: Twitch Drops Changes in 0.10.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/29bf3ad7c8781ea2ed1f6abb094345f8d70c04ed.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Commanders![/b][/h3]
The way in which Twitch Drops work has changed, so in Update 0.10.1 you can expect things to look a little bit different than what you've been used to. The most important thing is that you'll still be able to collect free loot—including the valuable [b]Italian Tokens[/b] that are used to unlock Early Access Regia Marina battleships—just for watching World of Warships on livestreams!
[list][b]Don't forget[/b]: you need to link your Twitch account to World of Warships in order to receive Twitch Drops. It's easy! Just follow the instructions [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/twitch-connect/]here[/url].[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#what-changed]What changed?[/url] ● [url=#twitch-rewards]Twitch rewards[/url] ● [url=#where-and-how]Where and How[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/worldofwarships style=button]
Twitch | Follow
[/url]
[h2][b][h1=what-changed][/h1]What changed?[/b][/h2]
Three new features will affect you as a viewer on [b]Twitch[/b]:
[list][*][b][b]User Interface update[/b][/b] — the main feature of the changes implemented by Twitch to the Drops system is the implementation of a new sleek, comfortable, and informative UI. Now, you'll be able to track just how long you need to watch a stream for in order to get the next drop, thanks to a handy progress bar that will dynamically fill up as time passes. Once the bar is filled, you will get a notification right in your browser with a button to claim the reward[b]*[/b].[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/59e50f54-7078-11eb-95d9-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img]
[list][*][b][b]Sequential Drops[/b][/b] — it will now be possible to have rewards drop in a specific order, e.g. in order to start progressing towards receiving reward Y, you must first have watched for long enough to receive reward X.
[*][b][b]Removal of random-chance drops[/b][/b] — with the new update, it is no longer possible to facilitate rewards that have random chances of dropping for viewers. Since this mechanic was the basis for our Twitch Epic Drops, these types of rewards will no longer be available in their past form for the time being.[/list]
As far as [b]in-game[/b] changes go, there are another two points to keep in mind:
[list][*][b][b]Log in to claim rewards[/b][/b] — unlike in the previous system, where your Drops were credited instantly to your account if you had the game running in the background, it will now be necessary to log in to the game for the loot to hit your Port. If you receive a drop while you're logged in to World of Warships, you'll need to log out and log back in, or to restart the game.
[*][b][b]In-game confirmation of rewards[/b][/b] — if you want to make sure that you've received your Twitch Drop after logging in to World of Warships, you can click the “Info” button on the bottom-right of your Port screen, where the goodies will be displayed.[/list]
As this is only the first update with the new system, you can look forward to further changes and improvements in the months to come. Join us on-stream and let us know what you think!
[list][b]* Due to the Twitch overhaul, all Drops—not just for World of Warships—must now actively be claimed on your Twitch account either by clicking the button on the pop-up notification in the stream interface or in your personal Twitch inventory. If you take no action, the reward will disappear 24 hours after the end of each campaign. Each Update will have 2 campaigns, each lasting 2 weeks. For more information, consult the All Campaigns tab in the Twitch interface.[/b][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/59fb5d68-7078-11eb-ade7-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img]

[h2][b][h1=twitch-rewards][/h1]Twitch rewards[/b][/h2]
There are three types of Twitch Drops for World of Warships. All, except for the Official Channel Drops, can be obtained by watching any streamer on Twitch who is playing World of Warships and has [b][b]Drops Enabled[/b][/b].

On the [b]first Thursday of the update[/b], all three types of rewards become available and remain claimable for a full week, until they are refreshed the following Thursday.
[list][i]Be sure to join our official weekly English stream on Thursdays at 17:00 UTC so as not to miss out on any rewards![/i][/list]
[h3][b][b]Official Channel Drops[/b][/b][/h3]
A total of four simple missions—one for each week of the update—that will only drop when watching streams on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/worldofwarships]official World of Warships channel[/url]. Completing the missions will reward you with some extra [b]Early Access Italian Tokens[/b] to help you progress towards unlocking the new Italian battleships!

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/twitch/official-stream-schedule/ style=button]Official Stream Schedule[/url]

[h3][b][b]Twitch Drops[/b][/b][/h3]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2b5f8144-34ac-11eb-a15b-38eaa735f4cc_330x.png[/img]A special Twitch container delivered straight to your Port when watching streams⁠—no strings attached! You can receive up to five of these during Update 0.10.1, with a new container becoming available each Thursday.

Exceptionally, [b]two containers will be claimable during the fourth week[/b] of the update!

When opened, a Twitch Container drops:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]100,000 credits[/b]

Completing them will earn you up to 9,500 Italian Tokens, the Roman permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VI Andrea Doria[/b][/b], and battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VII Francesco Caracciolo[/b][/b] with a Port slot and Commander with 6 skill points.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c44251ee-6f9d-11eb-ab18-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[b]Italian Tokens[/b] are a temporary resource for the Italian Battleships event. Until the end of Update 0.10.2, Italian Tokens can be exchanged for various in-game items, including Early Access ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IV Dante Alighieri[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]V Conte di Cavour[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VI Andrea Doria[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Vittorio Veneto[/b][/b], as well as the Legion and Roman permanent camouflages.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f9c9e64-6c64-11eb-a298-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=italian-tokens-for-recruitment-points][/h1]Italian Tokens in Exchange for Recruitment Points[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles are available until:[/b] [b]Thu. 15 Apr. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

Invite your friends to join our naval battles in order to obtain even more Italian Tokens. You can spend your Recruitment Points in the Armory to purchase up to 10 bundles, with 100 Tokens inside each of them.

[url=https://armory.worldofwarships.eu/category/event_2 style=button]Go to Armory[/url]

[h2][b][h1=even-more-tokens][/h1]Even More Tokens[/b][/h2]
You may also gain access to an additional chain of combat missions for obtaining Italian Tokens. The difficulty of the chain, as well as the number of Tokens that you can earn, depends on your activity during the previous updates. You can find the full details in the game client.

[list][i]To unlock this chain, you need to have played at least one battle in Updates 0.9.12–0.10.0.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=daily-gifts][/h1]Daily Gifts[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles are available until:[/b] [b]Mon. 08 Mar. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

The Armory is offering free daily bundles. Within them, you'll find Italian Tokens, Doubloons, [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b], Regia Marina camouflages, and signals!
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c7faf998-6c65-11eb-b4eb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]A total of 12 bundles will be available for a period of 18 days.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=defender-of-the-fatherland-day][/h1]Defender of the Fatherland Day[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 19 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Fri. 26 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC033_commander_day_7a421a10a840b7e32c11996262de884b7c698b0583b98cb66bb6dc5cf2062cfd.png[/img]To complete the mission, you'll need to deal damage and earn ribbons, including "Main battery hits," "Hits to citadel," and "Destroyed" ribbons. Each of the five stages of the combat mission will bring you two “This is your day, Commander!” camouflages. You'll receive two more camouflages as the final reward.
[list][i]You can complete this chain of combat missions in Random and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations, playing Tier V–X ships.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=ranked-battles][/h1]Ranked Battles[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 18 Feb. 09:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 13 May 02:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fd251d7a-7100-11eb-a393-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]To complete a special combat mission, earn 1,500 base XP in Ranked Battles. As a reward, you'll receive two Gift containers. Each of them will drop five special signals of the same type (Hydra, Leviathan, Red Dragon, Scylla, Wyvern, Dragon, Basilisk, or Ouroboros).

[h2][b][h1=daily-missions][/h1]Daily Trials[/b][/h2]
One chain will become available to you each day. Progressing through each chain will reward you with XP, signals, Credits, Coal, and even [b]Steel[/b]!

[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1c392038-ab24-11ea-b1c1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Complete daily trials in March, and the following rewards will be yours:
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c2cde492-c1f4-11ea-b6a2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Research Bureau[/b][/h3]
Players with access to the Research Bureau will be able to earn even more Research Points by completing daily trials—[b]400[/b] Research Points for completing 25, 50, and 75 combat missions.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e93bd2bc-bc66-11ea-a764-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h1][i][h3][b]The conditions for completing the chains are as follows[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*]Each day, you can complete a chain of six missions.
[*]You must earn a certain amount of base XP in order to complete a mission of the chain.
[*]You must earn 250 base XP in a single battle in order to accomplish the first mission.
[*]The second mission requires you to earn 500 base XP across several battles.
[*]For missions 3, 4, 5, and 6: you need to earn 1,000; 1,100; 1,200; and 1,300 base XP in victorious battles, respectively.
[*]All missions within a chain must be completed in successive order, playing Tier V–X ships in Random, Co-op, or Ranked Battles, or in Operations.
[*]You'll receive any due rewards in your Port once you've completed the conditions of the missions.
[*]After completing the entire chain, you'll obtain the final reward.[/list]

[h2][b][h1=italian-battleships-part-1][/h1]Italian Battleships: Part 1[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/88303178-6c62-11eb-9be1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.1 kicks off an event that places the new Italian Tier IV–IX battleships right in the spotlight!
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7fcfa5fc-6c64-11eb-9be1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f3f43f4-6c64-11eb-aedc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7fd3c9ac-6c64-11eb-9160-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f38526a-6c64-11eb-b872-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7fcf15a6-6c64-11eb-a383-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f5f64fe-6c64-11eb-8a61-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Features of the Ship Branch[/h2]
[list][*]Semi-armor-piercing shells instead of HE shells. These shells deal significant damage to weakly and moderately protected targets and ship parts, but do not cause fires.
[*]A large number of guns but with relatively short firing ranges and not the greatest accuracy.
[*]Decent maneuverability and armor protection.
[*]Tier VIII–X ships have the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which allows them to hide from the enemy without having to reduce their speed. Shooting from within the smoke screen isn't recommended while retreating, because battleships still have high detectability when using their main battery guns in this situation.[/list]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
[b]Combat mission group rewards[/b]: a new temporary resource—Italian Tokens, Roman permanent camouflage for [b][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VI Andrea Doria[/b][/b], and special signals. Final reward for completing the last combat mission group: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VII Francesco Caracciolo[/b][/b], a Commander with six skill points, and a Port slot.[/b]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f9c9e64-6c64-11eb-a298-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Italian Tokens can also be obtained by completing special chains of combat missions[b];[/b] from random bundles available for Doubloons, free random bundles, and bundles that are available in exchange for Recruitment Points in the Armory; and by completing combat missions that can be activated by watching official World of Warships streams.

[b]Rewards for Italian Tokens:[/b] sequentially opened bundles with  [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IV Dante Alighieri[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]V Conte di Cavour[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VI Andrea Doria[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Vittorio Veneto[/b][/b]; the Roman permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VII Francesco Caracciolo[/b][/b]; Legion permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Vittorio Veneto[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Lepanto[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Cristoforo Colombo[/b][/b]; and other rewards.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f865faa-6c64-11eb-a168-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The number of Tokens that can be earned by completing combat mission groups will be enough to obtain Italian Tier IV–VI battleships and the Roman permanent camouflage for the Tier VII battleship.

[b]Rewards from random bundles available for Do[/b][b]ubloons:[/b] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Lepanto[/b][/b] plus a Commander with 10 skill points and a Port slot, Italian Tokens, Regia Marina expendable camouflages, and other rewards.

[h2]Free Bundles[/h2]
The Armory is offering free random bundles—Daily Gifts. Inside, you can find Italian Tokens, Warships Premium Account, Doubloons, and other rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles are available until: [/b] [b]Mon. 08 Mar. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c7faf998-6c65-11eb-b4eb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/i][/list]
The Taranto Port has been updated.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6e1d26b8-6d22-11eb-b789-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6e227b36-6d22-11eb-bfe5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6f1c3b12-6d22-11eb-86fd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=clan-battles-greece][/h1]Clan Battles: Greece[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f38eeed6-6d49-11eb-987d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Wed. 24 Feb. 12:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:  [/b] [b]Mon. 12 Apr. 04:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
Tier IX ships in a 7 vs. 7 format.

[h3][b]Restrictions[/b][/h3]
Up to two battleships per team.

[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3]
Up to [b]11,000[/b] Steel and other rewards.

No more than two mercenaries per Division.

The new season has a small, but very important change—we've added a system that allows ship limits to be set. We're working on making sure that each battle and game mode offers diverse and interesting gameplay. This change allows us to make the team compositions more varied and the battles more diverse.

The restrictions can be set for the entire duration of a season or for specific periods of time. For example, they could be set after the first 2 weeks of a season, then replaced with different restrictions a few weeks later. This allows us to promptly react to the current state of the season.

[h3][b]Possible restrictions[/b][/h3]

[h2][b][h1=ranked-battles-the-second-season][/h1]Ranked Battles: The Second Season[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f910d144-6d49-11eb-a3d8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The Second Season of Ranked Battles kicks off together with Update 0.10.1. Its structure is different from that of the First (test) season. In terms of the available rewards, you can expect Steel, Doubloons, camouflages, and much more!

[h2]Main Changes[/h2]
[list][*]The duration of the season has been doubled. The duration of each Sprint is 2 weeks.
[*]The Sprint rewards have also doubled on average.
[*]The number of ranks in the Bronze and Silver Leagues has increased from seven to 10.
[*]The number of Stars needed to reach the first rank and qualify has increased by 50% on average.[/list]
The Ranked Battles interface has also been updated.
[list][*]In addition to the rank, the league is now displayed in the tooltip above the player's name.
[*]After the qualification, the timer that shows the time remaining until the start of the next Sprint is shown in the tooltip above the next league.
[*]The scrolling speed of the rank carousel has been increased.
[*]Updated the descriptions of Jolly Roger achievements and tooltips, as well as some other descriptions.
[*]Fixed some errors in the Ranked Battles interface.[/list]
[h2]Rewards[/h2]
The rewards for each league will be refreshed and available again at the start of each new Sprint.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4422c302-6c48-11eb-b2d5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Reaching Rank 1 will reward you with Bronze, Silver, and Gold League containers.

[list]A commemorative flag is awarded for achieving Rank 1 in the Bronze League.[/list]
[h2]Rules of the Second Season[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/87faf644-6c48-11eb-ad80-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
More details about Ranked Battles Season 2 can be found in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/ranked-battles-2/]dedicated article[/url].

[h2][b][h1=updated-brawls][/h1]Updated Brawls[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d497a554-6d49-11eb-987d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

For Update 0.10.1, we've updated Brawls and made them a separate battle type, the seasons of which are short and have a smaller team format. One can take part either in a Division or solo. It is possible to participate in Brawls without being in a Clan.

In Update 0.10.1, the first season of updated Brawls will take place in the following format:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Mon. 08 Mar. 09:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 15 Mar. 02:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
Tier VIII ships in a 1 vs. 1 format.

[h3][b]Time[/b][/h3]
[list][*]ASIA: 01:00 — 18:00 UTC
[*]CIS: 06:00 — 23:00 UTC
[*]EU: 08:00 — 01:00 UTC
[*]NA: 16:00 — 09:00 UTC[/list]
[list][i]You can take part in Brawls only during the time specified for your server.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Game maps and modes[/b][/h3]
Big Race, Shatter, Crash Zone Alpha, and Sleeping Giant in Domination mode; Two Brothers in the Epicenter mode.

[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3]
Up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,250,000[/b] Credits; [b]80,000[/b] Elite Commander XP; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal; and 4x signals of each type, except for special ones.

[h3][b]Other features of Brawls[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Each Brawl lasts only for a few days. They are available throughout each day, except for low activity periods.
[*]If you're not playing in a Division, your allies are picked randomly. Matchmaking takes the type and tier of your ship into account.
[*]The ship-type compositions of each team won't necessarily mirror each other.
[*]Battles take place on maps with a reduced combat area. All ships will be of the same tier.
[*]You can't take part in a battle with opponents who you fought against in several previous battles.[/list]

[h2]Special Features of the Test[/h2]
[list][b]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server. The new Italian battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.[/b][/list]
In Update 0.10.1, we updated Brawls and made them a separate battle type, the seasons of which will be short and have a smaller team format. One can take part either in a Division or solo. It is possible to participate in Brawls without being in a Clan.

During the Public Test, two seasons of Brawls will be fought in the following format:

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.1[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][b]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/b][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#italian-battleships-part-1]Italian Battleships: Part 1[/url] ● [url=#updated-brawls]Updated Brawls[/url] ● [url=#clan-battles]Clan Battles[/url] ● [url=#visual-and-other-enhancements]Visual and Other Enhancements[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=italian-battleships-part-1][/h1]Italian Battleships: Part 1[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.1 kicks off an event that places the new Italian Tier IV–IX battleships right in spotlight! These ships will become available in Early Access on the Live Server only when the update is released. Meanwhile, we invite you to take part in the testing of the event.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c65d7a4-5f1c-11eb-8c28-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c4a84d6-5f1c-11eb-b8ae-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c4c3164-5f1c-11eb-911b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9cc349e8-5f1c-11eb-b508-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c56e078-5f1c-11eb-92db-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9cc346be-5f1c-11eb-81da-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The new Italian battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.[/i][/list]
[h2]Features of the Ship Branch[/h2]
[list][*]Semi-armor-piercing shells instead of HE shells. These shells deal significant damage to weakly and moderately protected targets and parts of the ship, but do not cause fires.
[*]A large number of guns with relatively short firing ranges and not the greatest accuracy.
[*]Decent maneuverability and armor protection.
[*]Tier VIII–X ships have the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which allows them to hide from the enemy without having to reduce their speed. Shooting from within the smoke screen isn't recommended while retreating, because battleships have high detectability when using their main battery guns in this situation.[/list]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
[h3][b]Rewards for Combat Mission Groups[/b][/h3]
A new temporary resource—Italian Tokens, permanent camouflage Roman for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VI Andrea Doria[/b][/b], and special signals. The final reward for completing the last combat mission group—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VII Francesco Caracciolo[/b][/b].

Italian Tokens can also be obtained by completing special chains of combat missions; from random bundles available for Doubloons, free random bundles, and bundles that are available in exchange for Recruitment Points in the Armory; and by completing combat missions from the official World of Warships streams.

[h3][b]Rewards for Italian Tokens[/b][/h3]
Sequentially opened bundles with Tier IV, V, VI, and VIII Italian battleships; permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VII Francesco Caracciolo[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Vittorio Veneto[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Lepanto[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Cristoforo Colombo[/b][/b]; and other rewards.

The number of Tokens that can be gained by completing combat mission groups will be enough to obtain Italian Tier IV–VI battleships and permanent camouflage Roman for the Tier VII battleship.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3c8d96a4-5f22-11eb-a768-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Rewards from the random bundles available for doubloons[/b][/h3]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Lepanto[/b][/b], Italian Tokens, Regia Marina expendable camouflages, and other rewards.

The Taranto Port has been updated.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e658fda-5fa3-11eb-bf88-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e67abbc-5fa3-11eb-94cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5f547eec-5fa3-11eb-bef9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The new Italian battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.

[h2][b][h1=updated-brawls][/h1]Updated Brawls[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.10.1, we updated Brawls and made them a separate battle type, the seasons of which will be short and have a smaller team format. One can take part either in a Division or solo. It is possible to participate in Brawls without being in a Clan.

[h3][b]Other Features[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Each Brawl lasts only for a few days. They are available throughout each day, except for low activity periods.
[*]If you're not playing in a Division, your allies are picked randomly. The matchmaking takes the type and tier of your ship into account.
[*]The ship-type compositions of each team won't necessarily mirror each other.
[*]Battles take place on maps with a reduced combat area. All ships will be of the same tier.[/list]
To access Brawls, you must have fought at least 130 battles in all available battle types.

You can try out this new battle type on the 0.10.1 Public Test server.

[h2][b][h1=clan-battles][/h1]Clan Battles[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.1 brings with it Clan Battles Season 12. It will be held in a 7 vs. 7 format, playing Tier IX ships.

The new season has a small, but very important change—we've added a system that allows ship limits to be set. We're working on making sure that each battle and game mode offers diverse and interesting gameplay. This change allows us to make the team compositions in Clan Battles more varied and the battles more diverse.

The restrictions can be set for the entire duration of the season or for specific periods of time. For example, they can be set after the first 2 weeks of a season, then replaced with different restrictions a few weeks later. This allows us to quickly react to the current state of a season without the need to create a large number of similar setups.

Either one or several restrictions can be set during a season.

The restrictions are displayed in the Division window and in the tooltip in the window above the ship carousel when the "Clan Battle" battle type is selected.

[h3][b]Possible restrictions[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Limit on the number of the same ships. For instance, the Division will not be able to join a battle if two or more of the same ships are selected.
[*]Limit on the number of specific ships. For example, the Division can have only one [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Yamato[/b][/b] and one [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]X Des Moines[/b][/b].
[*]Restriction that makes certain ships ineligible for battle. For example, one cannot join the battle playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Montana[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]X Shimakaze[/b][/b].[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a0ba9358-5fa3-11eb-9a4d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a0c1cb28-5fa3-11eb-bf88-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a098077a-5fa3-11eb-b60d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The details of Clan Battles Season 12 will be announced later.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=visual-and-other-enhancements][/h1]Visual and Other Enhancements[/b][/h2]
Updated the interface of Clan Battles.
[list][*]Updated some tooltips.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d2ecd926-5fa3-11eb-94cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d2ccf430-5fa3-11eb-bef9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Updated the way in which sun reflects off water. Improved the quality of reflections, waves, and areas with calm wind. Increased the amplitude and speed of waves on some maps. A range of errors related to how water is displayed have also been fixed.

notes.title: Brawls in Update 0.10.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/db4d575aaa4d92ab89691b5498b15791868e43d9.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.10.0 brings Brawls in a 7 vs. 7 format, playing Tier VIII and X ships. Don't miss this opportunity to fight for Credits, Coal, and Elite Commander XP![/b]

[table][tr][th][b]Rules ● Rewards[/b][/th][/tr][/table] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/23be8602-599a-11eb-91c9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Rules[/b][/h2]
Brawls are open to all players, even if a player isn't currently in a Clan. To participate, apply via the "Create Division" menu near the "Battle!" button, then wait for an invitation to join a Division. Only the player who creates a Division for a Brawl is required to be part of a Clan; the other invitees do not have to belong to any Clan at all. The inviting player should have the rank of Clan Recruiter or higher.

[h2][b]Lunar New Year[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6956c000-5713-11eb-9540-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.10.0, we're going to celebrate the Lunar New Year! The event includes combat missions, Daily Shipments, new themed ships, Commanders, and "Journey to the West" and Lunar New Year containers. On the occasion of this holiday, we've updated the Dragon Port and added new patches and flags.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/64b6a926-573a-11eb-9284-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/65740642-573a-11eb-84e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]


[h2]Combat Mission Groups[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start: [/b] [b]Thu. 21 Jan. 06:15 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]End: [/b] [b]Thu. 18 Feb. 05:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

Completing combat missions and groups will bring you "Journey to the West" and Lunar New Year containers, as well as signals, and themed camouflages. The final reward for completing the combat mission groups is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VI Anshan[/b][/b] with a 6-skill-point Commander and Port slot.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ccdc80c8-5737-11eb-9a2d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Journey to the West containers can drop one of the new ships—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Wujing[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VIII Sanzang[/b][/b]—in permanent Sha Wujing and Tang Sanzang camouflages with themed Commanders; or either [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Bajie[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Wukong[/b][/b]; or other rewards.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9b00b052-571d-11eb-8fdd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The ships, Commanders, and camouflages are named after heroes of the "Journey to the West" novel—a former celestial General, Sha Wujin; a Buddhist monk, Tang Sanzang; the Monkey King, Sun Wukong; and a sorcerer, Zhu Bajie.

Lunar New Year containers can drop the new Pan-Asian destroyer, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VIII Fen Yang[/b][/b]; or either [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VI Anshan[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Irian[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VIII Loyang[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Huanghe[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VIII Siliwangi[/b][/b]; [h2]Daily Shipments[/h2]
During Update 0.10.0, enter the game in the period between January 20 and February 3, inclusive, to start getting valuable rewards via the Daily Shipments section.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7d549f4e-5738-11eb-8b0c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
You can get a total of 10 rewards throughout the 14 days that the shipments are available. That means you can skip 4 days out of 2 weeks and still claim all the valuable rewards.

[h2][b]Commander Skills Update[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/688e3c3e-5713-11eb-9766-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The Commander skills system will be changed in Update 0.10.0.

[h2]Main Changes[/h2]
[list][*]We've added new skills and changed some of the old ones.
[*]Each Commander now has a separate skill section for each ship type. The skill section corresponding to the played ship type is active in battle.
[*]As skills have become more specialized and their total number has increased, the maximum possible number of skill points available to one Commander has been increased from 19 to 21.
[*]We've added a skill recommendation system, depending on the selected ship.
[*]Commanders with less than 21 skill points will additionally bring you Elite Commander XP in the amount of 5% of the Commander XP gained per battle.
[*]We've added a new method of obtaining Elite Commander XP—by dismissing unused Commanders.
[*]We've revamped the interface of the Commander skill, recruitment, re-assignment, and dismissal system.[/list]
With the release of Update 0.10.0, all your commanders’ skills will automatically be redistributed using a recommendation system—this way, you'll get a skill build that's effective for each specific ship in the new system. You can take advantage of the opportunity to reset Commander skills free of charge in Update 0.10.0. Make sure to try out different combinations and find the ones that suit your playstyle!
[list][i]After the release of the Update, additional balance corrections might be required. In case of significant changes going forward, we will provide additional opportunities to retrain your Commanders for free.[/i][/list]
[h2]Discounts and Bonuses in Update 0.10.0[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Thu. 21 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Thu. 18 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

To help you get familiar with the new Commander skills system in Update 0.10.0:
[list][*]Commander skills can be reset free of charge.
[*]Upgrades can be demounted free of charge.
[*]The cost in Doubloons to retrain commanders for different ships has been reduced by 90%—from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]500[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]50[/b] Doubloons.[/list]
In addition, to help you experiment with retraining Commanders:
[list][*]Players with Access Level 8 and above will receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]500[/b] Doubloons when they first log in to the game during Update 0.10.0.
[*]Update 0.10.0 features six special combat missions, one for each nation with more than one ship branch: the U.S.A; Japan; U.K.; the U.S.S.R.; Germany; and France. To complete each mission, you'll need to earn 1,100 base XP in any number of battles, playing a Tier VII–X ship in any battle type, except Training Battles. The reward for each one is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]100[/b] Doubloons.[/list]
[list][i]In total, you can obtain up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,100[/b] Doubloons. These will be enough to perform Commander retraining 22 times in Update 0.10.0.[/i][/list]
More details about the updated skill system are available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/commander-skills-update/]dedicated article[/url].
