If a ship's standard secondary battery firing range was originally higher, it will not be decreased. A ship's detectability is another limiter—the maximum possible range of its secondary battery should not exceed its minimum possible detectability. Because of this:
[list][*]The secondary battery firing range of the following ships has been reduced:
[list][*][b][b]VIII August von Parseval[/b][/b]—from 7 to 6.6 km
[*][b][b]X Manfred von Richthofen[/b][/b]—from 7.2 to 6.9 km[/list]
[*][b][b]X Plymouth[/b][/b]'s secondary battery firing range has been increased from 6 to 7.25 km.[/list]
[h3][b]German Tier VII–X battleships[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Secondary battery accuracy has been increased.[/list]
Thanks to this change, the secondary battery accuracy of German battleships with the “Improved Secondary Battery Aiming” skill will increase by 50%.

[h3][b]Engine damage[/b][/h3]
When a ship's engine is critically damaged, it now continues to function at 20% efficiency instead of stopping entirely.

[b][b]VII Atlanta[/b][/b], [b][b]VII Atlanta B[/b][/b]
[list][*]Standard main battery firing range has been increased from 11.1 to 13.3 km.[/list]
[b][b]X Colbert[/b][/b]
[list][*]Acceleration and deceleration dynamics have been improved.[/list]
[b][b]II Nino Bixio[/b][/b]
[list][*]Acceleration and deceleration dynamics have been decreased to standard values.[/list]
[b][b]III Taranto[/b][/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time has been reduced from 12 to 11.2 seconds.
[*]Acceleration and deceleration dynamics have been decreased to standard values.[/list]
[b][b]V Oklahoma[/b][/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time has been reduced from 40 to 38 seconds.[/list]
[b][b]VII Fiji[/b][/b]
[list][*]Deck armor thickness has been increased from 38 to 51 mm.[/list]
The different speeds of patrol fighters on researchable aircraft carriers, [b][b]VI Ark Royal[/b][/b], [b][b]VI Erich Loewenhardt[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Graf Zeppelin[/b][/b], and [b][b]VIII Graf Zeppelin B[/b][/b] have been increased to:
[list][*]Tier IV—187 knots
[*]Tier VI—221 knots
[*]Tier VIII—235 knots
[*]Tier X—266 knots[/list]
This change will improve the efficiency of fighters and prevent enemy planes from escaping. Later, we plan to accordingly increase the different speeds of all deck fighters.

The detectability of patrol fighters on all Tier VI, VIII, and X carriers has been increased to 7.5 km. This change will allow us to prevent a situation that might have been possible with the new skill system where patrol fighters could have appeared directly in front of a squadron, leaving no time for evasion.

The effects that increase a squadron's Engine Boost time no longer increase its recovery time.

[h1][i][h3][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]

The reason for the removal of these ships is a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain team diversity at an appropriate level, these ships will cease to be available for an indefinite period of time, but may return later.

Starting with the release of Update 0.10.2, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Somers[/b][/b] will no longer be available to obtain from the Armory for an indefinite period of time. We understand that accumulating resources to purchase a ship takes a long time, which is why we’re letting you know about the changes in advance. This will give players who are interested in these ships time to obtain them before Updates 0.10.1 and 0.10.2 go live in approximately one and two months, respectively.

[h1][i][h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]

notes.title: Commander Skills Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/af32ec95e69c37c37ca78f24e1d8e0977dfa1a45.jpg[/img]
[b]World of Warships is constantly evolving. New mechanics and ships with unique gameplay appear in the game on a regular basis. To ensure that Commander skills correspond to the current state of the game, we're carrying out a large-scale update by adding new skills and changing the old ones.[/b]

Changing the Commander skill system will make it more flexible and convenient, and give you a choice between several effective loadout options instead of one ultimate go-to option. This will enable you to customize your ship to more precisely suit your playstyle. In addition to updating the Commander skills, we've revamped the interface and made it more comfortable to use the Commander system, as well as retrain and level up Commanders.
[previewyoutube=QIE84Q4Nm90;full][/previewyoutube]
[table][tr][th][b]Summary ● Reasons for the Changes ● Discounts and Bonuses in Update 0.10.0 ● Skills ● Elite XP, Retraining, and Recruitment[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Summary[/b][/h2]
[list][*]We've added new skills and changed some of the old ones.
[*]Each Commander now has a separate skill section for each ship type. The skill section corresponding to the played ship type is active in battle.
[*]As skills have become more specialized and their total number has increased, the maximum possible number of Commander skill points has been increased from 19 to 21.
[*]We've added a skill recommendation system depending on the selected ship.
[*]Commanders with less than 21 skill points will additionally bring you Elite Commander XP in the amount of 5% of the Commander XP gained per battle.
[*]We've added a new method of obtaining Elite Commander XP—by demobilizing unused Commanders.
[*]We've revamped the interface of the Commander skill, recruitment, re-assignment, and dismissal system.[/list]
With the release of Update 0.10.0, all skills will automatically be redistributed using a recommendation system. This will give you a standard ship-specific skill build in the new system. You can take advantage of the opportunity to reset Commander skills free of charge in Update 0.10.0. Make sure to try out different combinations and find the ones that suit your playstyle!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Free skill reset is available until:[/b] [b]Thu. 18 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[list][i]If a Commander is in the process of retraining, their retraining will automatically be completed with the release of Update 0.10.0. If a Commander is not tied to a ship of their specialization, they will be assigned to a ship of their specialization with the release of Update 0.10.0. This only applies to researchable ships.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Reasons for the Changes[/b][/h2]
[list][*]For many ships, there was often only one skill build that worked effectively. By adding new skills and changing the old ones, we want players to have a choice between several different effective builds to accommodate different playstyles.
[*]Skills for all ship types were previously presented in the same skill tree. Because of this, some of them were ineffective for particular ships, or had different effects on different ship types. The new format allows us to create more specialized skills for each ship type and provides space for future development.
[*]The old skill system interface was not very user-friendly. We're updating it by adding the following features:
[list][*]A recommendation system that simplifies the selection of skills.
[*]The ability to dismiss Commanders you no longer need in exchange for Elite XP.
[*]The ability to select skills and evaluate their effect first, and only then approve your selection.[/list]
[/list]
[h2][b]Discounts and Bonuses in Update 0.10.0[/b][/h2]
To help you get familiar with the new Commander skill system in Update 0.10.0:
[list][*]Commander skills can be reset free of charge.
[*]Upgrades can be demounted free of charge.
[*]The cost in Doubloons of Commander retraining has been reduced by 90%—from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]500[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]50[/b] Doubloons.[/list]
In addition, to help you experiment with retraining Commanders for different ships:
[list][*]Players with Access Level 8 and above will receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]500[/b] Doubloons when they first log in to the game during Update 0.10.0.
[*]Update 0.10.0 features six special combat missions, one for each nation with more than one ship branch: U.S.A; Japan; U.K.; U.S.S.R.; Germany; and France. To complete each mission, you'll need to earn 1,100 base XP in any number of battles, playing a Tier VII–X ship in any battle type, except Training Battles. The reward is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]100[/b] Doubloons.[/list]
In total, you can obtain up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,100[/b] Doubloons. This amount will be enough to retrain your Commanders 22 times in Update 0.10.0.
[list]Discounts and combat missions are available [/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]From: [/b] [b]Thu. 21 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Until: [/b] [b]Thu. 18 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h2][b]Skills[/b][/h2]
Almost all skills in the new skill system have been updated, and many new ones have been added. Among those are:

Special skills that are activated by fulfilling certain conditions. Among the activated effects are:
[list][*]Close Quarters Expert: reduces the reload time of the battleship's main battery after an enemy has been spotted within the firing range of your ship's secondary battery. This skill is especially useful for specialized secondary battery battleships, but due to the increase in the secondary battery firing range in Update 0.10.0, the skill will also be suitable for other battleships.
[*]Dead Eye: reduces the dispersion of the battleship's main battery shells if there are no visible hostile ships within your ship's standard detectability range. Complement this skill with Concealment Expert and Concealment System Modification 1 to make it even more effective.
[*]Top Grade Gunner: reduces the reload time of the cruiser's main battery after an enemy has been spotted within your ship's standard detectability range.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/141199d0-5637-11eb-8bde-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Outnumbered: reduces the dispersion of the cruiser's main battery shells, and increases the ship's maximum speed if there are more visible hostile ships than allies within the standard firing range of your ship's main battery. The skill is useful both when pushing through the flanks and capturing Key Areas.
[*]Swift in Silence: increases the destroyer's speed while she remains undetected. The skill is especially suitable for stealthy torpedo destroyers.
[*]Fearless Brawler: reduces the reload time of the destroyer's main battery after the ship has been detected by the enemy. The skill is especially useful for artillery destroyers—French and Soviet—as well as when fighting for Key Areas.[/list]
If you know all the strengths and weaknesses of your ship and have fought dozens of battles playing her, consider applying skills that give you a large bonus along with a noticeable penalty, for example:
[list][*]Superheavy AP Shells: increases the maximum damage of the battleship's armor-piercing shells by 5%, but also increases the fire extinguishing and flooding recovery time by 30%.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7233afb2-5637-11eb-b3a6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Heavy HE and SAP Shells: increases the damage of the cruiser's HE and SAP shells by 10%, but also increases the detectability of ships with a main battery caliber of 149 mm and above by 15%.[/list]
Special skills for aircraft carriers that enhance fighters:
[list][*]Interceptor: the Patrol Fighters consumable is replaced by Interceptors. The aircraft called in are invulnerable to hostile fighters, do not attack hostile fighters, and do not spot hostile ships. Their patrol zone is increased by 10%. Thus, your fighters will only hunt enemy strike squadrons.
[*]Enhanced Reactions: the fighters you call in attack hostile aircraft not after 5 seconds, but after 1 second spent in the patrol zone. However, it takes them longer to arrive at the patrol zone, and they stop their patrolling faster.
[*]Use these two skills together: Interceptor will protect your fighters against enemy fighters and increase your patrol zone area, while Enhanced Reactions will speed up your fighters' reactions to enemy squadrons. When combined, these skills will enhance your ability to counter enemy aircraft and defend your allies.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/de8f1aa2-5637-11eb-b3a6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

We've also revamped the interface:
[list][*]Click on a Commander, then click on the "Change Commander" button to view all available Commanders of a single nation. For this purpose, you can also select a ship without a Commander and click on the "Assign Commander" button. Commanders are divided into two lists— those assigned to ships and those in the Reserve.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/61af802a-5638-11eb-b52d-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[list][*]You can now first select skills and evaluate their effects in the parameters section, and only then approve your selection.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2a5ed1c0-5638-11eb-a0ce-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[list][*]Recommended skills—standard skill options for a particular ship—are marked with a special sign. These skills are selected based on the ship's strengths.
[*]Click on the "All Skills" button to view skills for all ship types. You can distribute skills only for the ship type to which the Commander is assigned, but they are saved for each type separately.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbb7b22c-5638-11eb-b52d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Game Balance Changes[/h2]
We're making changes to some ships and parameters to better fit the new skills system. With the release of Update 0.10.0:
[list][*]Standard firing range of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Atlanta[/b][/b]'s main battery has been increased from 11.1 to 13.3 km
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Colbert[/b][/b]'s acceleration and deceleration dynamics have been improved[/list]
When a ship's engine is critically damaged, it now continues to function at 20% efficiency instead of stopping entirely.

[h3][b]The secondary battery firing ranges of battleships and cruisers have been increased.[/b][/h3]
New range (km):
[table][tr][th][b]Tier[/b][/th][th][b]Standard Firing Range[/b][/th][th][/th][th][b]Range With All Specific Upgrades and Skills[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][th][/th][th][b]German/French[/b][/th][th][b]Other[/b][/th][th][b]German/French[/b][/th][th][b]Other[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]III[/td] [td]4[/td] [td]3.2[/td] [td]5[/td] [td]4[/td][/tr] [tr][td]IV[/td] [td]4.8[/td] [td]4[/td] [td]6[/td] [td]5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]V[/td] [td]4.95[/td] [td]4.3[/td] [td]7.5[/td] [td]6.5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]VI[/td] [td]5.6[/td] [td]4.95[/td] [td]8.5[/td] [td]7.5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]VII[/td] [td]6.3[/td] [td]5.6[/td] [td]9.5[/td] [td]8.5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]VIII[/td] [td]7.6[/td] [td]6.6[/td] [td]11.5[/td] [td]10[/td][/tr] [tr][td]IX[/td] [td]7.95[/td] [td]6.95[/td] [td]12[/td] [td]10.5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]X[/td] [td]8.3[/td] [td]7.3[/td] [td]12.5[/td] [td]11[/td][/tr][/table]
If a ship's standard secondary battery firing range was originally higher, it will not be decreased. A ship's detectability is another limiter—the maximum possible range of its secondary battery should not exceed its minimum possible detectability.
[list][i]We'll keep a close eye on all ships and on how the updated skill system affects them. We will pay special attention to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Flint[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Smolensk[/b][/b], and secondary battery battleships.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Elite XP, Retraining, and Recruitment[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Elite Commander XP[/b][/h3]
Elite XP can be used to level up Commanders, accelerate Commander retraining for other ships, and redistribute skill points, and can also be converted into Free XP by using Doubloons.

When dismissing a Commander, you can convert some of their Commander XP into Elite XP:
[list][*]Up to 25% of the Commander XP, at the cost of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]10[/b] Credits for [b]1[/b] XP.
[*]Up to 100% of the Commander XP, at the cost of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1[/b] Doubloon for [b]110[/b] XP.[/list]
For example, if a Commander has [b]10,000[/b] XP, then upon dismissing this Commander, you can receive [b]2,500[/b] XP for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]25,000[/b] Credits, or [b]10,000[/b] XP for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]90[/b] Doubloons.

Commanders with less than 21 skill points will additionally bring you Elite XP in the amount of 5% of the Commander XP gained per battle. For Commanders with 21 skill points, any XP earned is converted into Elite XP; the additional 5% is not credited.

[h3][b]Retraining and specialization[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The ability to accelerate Commander retraining in exchange for Credits has been removed from the interface, but now it is "built" into the game and has been made free of charge. The amount of XP required for retraining has been halved.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2c7adbb0-5639-11eb-a29c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Skills will not work until a Commander's retraining is complete.
[*]A Commander without a specialization for a ship can't be assigned to that ship without retraining. This rule doesn't apply to Premium and special ships.
[*]The skill section for each ship type is redistributed separately from the others. The cost of redistributing skills remains the same.
[*]You can enter battle playing a ship without an assigned Commander. In this case, Commander XP will not be credited to your account. This will allow you to receive combat performance bonuses without reassigning Commanders, or to try out a new ship without having to retrain a Commander for her.[/list]
[h3][b]Recruiting Commanders[/b][/h3]
The cost and number of skills for recruited Commanders will change so that, if necessary, a player will be able to recruit a Commander with more skill points.
[list][*]Commander without skills: recruited free of charge.
[*]Commander with 6 skill points: available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]900,000[/b] Credits.
[*]Commander with 10 skill points: available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,500[/b] Doubloons.[/list]
[h3][b]Do you have a large number of Commanders and want to reset all their skills at once?[/b][/h3]
Starting from January 21, after Update 0.10.0 is released for all regions, you'll find a link to a special page here where you can automatically reset all of your Commanders' skills free of charge.

The New Year preparations are in full swing! We've prepared a lot of gifts and New Year activities for you: two New Year's campaigns, the Dockyard, battle performance bonuses, New Year's gifts, New Year's horns, and much more!
[table][tr][th][b]New Year in World of Warships ● Kure Dockyard ● Snowflakes: Battle Performance Bonuses ● New Year Campaigns ● Updates to the Ranked Battles System ● Armory ● Content Changes ● Game Balance Changes ● Technical Changes ● Support of Mac OS[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]New Year in World of Warships[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40d2acac-3fad-11eb-8a5f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Year's gifts[/h2]
[list][*]Head to the Armory to receive a free Santa's Gift container on the main page.
[*]Collect a second Santa's Gift container by opening the in-game Premium Shop.
[*]Another Santa's Gift container awaits you on a special New Year's [url=https://2021.worldofwarships.eu/?utm_source=wows-portal&utm_medium=link&utm_campaign=update-0912-new-year]website[/url].[/list]
The Armory and Premium Shop are also offering bundles with three types of Santa's Gift containers. Within them, you'll find doubloons, days of Premium Account, Coal, Free XP, expendable camouflages, signals, or even one of 107 Premium ships.

[h2]Free bundles[/h2]
The Armory is offering free random bundles—New Year Supplies. Within them, you'll find Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, as well as other valuable rewards.
[list]The bundles will be available [/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]From: [/b] [b]Tue. 22 Dec. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Until: [/b] [b]Mon. 11 Jan. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip 8 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0f7f67aa-404b-11eb-bdfa-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Kure Dockyard[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/409d0d40-3fad-11eb-b610-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.12, players will be able to start building a new Japanese battleship, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Hizen[/b][/b]. The ship is a variant of a super battleship project that preceded the development of the Yamato-class ships. She's armed with twelve 410 mm guns placed in four turrets. Having such an atypical number of guns for a high-tier Japanese battleship allows her to deal impressive damage per salvo.

[h3][b]Rules of the Dockyard[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 26 phases.
[*]These shipbuilding phases can be completed by progressing through the Dockyard combat missions, or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,950[/b] doubloons to pass through each phase.
[*]If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs: 10 shipbuilding phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]9,950[/b] doubloons, or 4 shipbuilding phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] doubloons.
[*]The combat missions of the Dockyard will span two updates—0.9.12 and 0.10.0. Players will be able to complete shipbuilding phases in exchange for doubloons until the end of Update 0.10.1.
[*]In total, you can pass through 22 out of 26 shipbuilding phases by progressing through Dockyard combat missions.
[*]Completing the 5th and 15th shipbuilding phases will reward you with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]II Tachibana[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]V Yahagi[/b][/b] in the Winter permanent camouflages, Commanders with 6 skill points, and Port slots.
[*]Completing the last four phases will reward you with [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal; one Santa's Mega Gift container; [b]2,000[/b] Steel; and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Hizen[/b][/b] in the War Paint camouflage with a Port slot, a Commander with 10 skill points, and a commemorative flag.
[*]Completing the other phases will bring you Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships, new Winter Strands expendable camouflages, and other valuable items.[/list]
[list][i]If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]II Tachibana[/b][/b] in your Port, then upon obtaining her again, you'll receive compensation in the form of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,425,000[/b] credits; a Port slot; the Winter permanent camouflage for Tachibana; and a Commander with 6 skill points.[/i][/list]
[list][i]If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]V Yahagi[/b][/b] in your Port, then upon obtaining her again, you'll receive compensation in the form of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]4,000[/b] doubloons; a Port slot; the Winter permanent camouflage for Yahagi; and a Commander with 6 skill points.[/i][/list]
If you complete the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Hizen[/b][/b] by spending doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions—completing each phase will bring you [b]400[/b] Research Points and [b]200[/b] Steel.

The Port of Kure will be added to the game. The designs for the Port and Dockyard were inspired by Kure harbor in Japan.

[h2][b]Snowflakes: Battle Performance Bonuses[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40a8586c-3fad-11eb-8fb4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.12, ships of Tier V and above will feature New Year bonuses for battle performance—Snowflakes. Depending on the ship's tier, you'll receive Coal, Steel, or Santa's Gift containers.

The mechanics of receiving the rewards for bonuses have been updated. You can now obtain a reward by gaining a victory or earning 300 base XP. Claim bonuses by playing your favorite battle type!

[h3][b]List of rewards[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tiers V–VII: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]400[/b]/[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]500[/b]/[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]750[/b] Coal
[*]Tiers VIII–IX: [b]75[/b] Steel
[*]Tier X: Santa's Gift container[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0dc1d00a-3fb6-11eb-91bc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Please note: you can get the battle performance bonus for each ship only once during Updates 0.9.12 and 0.10.0 in battles of any type, except Training Battles.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]New Year Campaigns[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40b726d0-3fad-11eb-b374-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.9.12 features two temporary campaigns—"In Pursuit of Strasbourg" and "Ships and Fates."

[h2]In Pursuit of Strasbourg[/h2]
The first New Year temporary campaign comprises 32 tasks in four missions. Each mission tells part of the story of the French Navy, using the example of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Strasbourg[/b][/b] and her famous sister ship—battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VI Dunkerque[/b][/b].

Completing the missions will bring you unique New Year Commanders of Pan-Asian, Italian, and French ships. Completing the Campaign will reward you with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Strasbourg[/b][/b], adorned in the Winter Holiday permanent camouflage.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0f71654c-404b-11eb-b63f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Strasbourg[/b][/b] in your Port, completing the Campaign will reward you with a Port slot; the Winter Holiday permanent camouflage; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]9,500[/b] doubloons.[/i][/list]
The first mission will become available with the release of Update 0.9.12, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.

[h2]Ships and Fates[/h2]
[list][i]Please note: to complete this Campaign, you'll need [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Strasbourg[/b][/b], which can be obtained as a reward for completing the "In Pursuit of Strasbourg" campaign, though if you’re short on time, you can also get her in the Armory in exchange for doubloons, or in the Premium Shop.[/i][/list]
The second New Year temporary campaign comprises 36 tasks in six missions. Each mission tells the story of a specific ship: cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]V Furutaka[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]V Hawkins[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]V Kotovsky[/b][/b]; destroyers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]V T-22[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]V Visby[/b][/b]; as well as battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]V New York[/b][/b].

Completing the missions will reward you with these ships, as well as unique New Year Commanders, Winter permanent camouflages, and Santa's Gift containers.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0fd3a0a4-404b-11eb-b2ee-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
All six missions of the Ships and Fates campaign will become available with the release of Update 0.9.12.

Both campaigns will remain available until the release of Update 0.10.0. As with all campaigns, you can complete the tasks of each mission multiple times. This will allow you to earn Stars, but you'll receive the reward for completing each task for the first time only.

[h2][b]Updates to the Ranked Battles System[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4098fa2a-3fad-11eb-89c1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.9.12 sees a large-scale update of the Ranked Battles system and gives start to a test Season of the new Ranked Battles.

[h3][b]Key features of the new system[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Ranked Battles seasons are now going to be held on a regular basis with short breaks between each one. This will mean that you can choose between Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles, as the latter battle type will be more regularly available.
[*]Each season is divided into several sprints. The duration of a single sprint is approximately 1–3 weeks, and this may differ from season to season.
[*]During a single sprint, players can only progress through their current league and qualify for the next one.
[*]Demonstrate your skills in the qualification, during which you'll fight against players from the next league to determine whether you'll progress to the next league or stay in your current one.
[*]The leagues are more tailored to your preferences:
[list][*]You can progress through the Bronze League at a smooth and leisurely pace.
[*]The Silver League offers bigger rewards, but will require more effort.
[*]The Gold League is the best option for the most experienced players who want to collect the most impressive haul of rewards.[/list]
[*]Ranked Battles aren't available to play during the hours of least activity. This is necessary to ensure high-quality matchmaking.[/list]
[h3][b]Rewards in brief[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The rewards are refreshed and updated for each new sprint and can be collected again—fight in your preferred league over and over again, and you'll collect rewards every time.
[*]Rewards are granted for achieving victories, reaching Rank 1, and qualifying.
[*]Steel hasn't gone anywhere: achieve victories, reach Rank 1, and accrue it to spend on items you desire in the Armory.
[*]Doubloons are granted as a reward in each league—the higher the league, the more doubloons you can get.
[*]New themed camouflages and achievements in each of the leagues.
[*]Ranked Tokens are awarded each time you reach Rank 1 in the Gold League. In Update 0.9.11, the cost of permanent camouflages available in exchange for Ranked Tokens has changed, and the number of Tokens on player accounts has increased by a factor of four.[/list]
[h2]Test Season[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/060b5fb0-4052-11eb-8cc3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[b]Time:[/b]
[list][*][b]CIS:[/b] 06:00 — 23:00 UTC
[*][b]NA:[/b] 16:00 — 09:00 UTC
[*][b]ASIA:[/b] 01:00 — 18:00 UTC
[*][b]EU:[/b] 08:00 — 01:00 UTC[/list]
[b]Format:[/b]
[list][*]7 vs. 7
[*]Tier VIII in the Bronze League
[*]Tiers IX–X in the Silver League
[*]Tier X in the Gold League[/list]
[h3][b]Season structure[/b][/h3]
Six sprints, each lasting 1 week. Each next sprint starts immediately after the end of the previous one.

During the Season, you can participate in no more than six sprints in the Bronze League, or five in the Silver League, or four in the Gold League.

[h3][b]Sprint rewards[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bronze League: up to [b]400[/b] Steel; up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]200[/b] doubloons; up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Coal; up to 5x Bronze camouflages; and up to 5x "Type 3 — Ranked" camouflages.
[*]Silver League: up to [b]500[/b] Steel; up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]300[/b] doubloons; up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]3,000[/b] Coal; up to 3x Bronze camouflages; up to 3x Silver camouflages; and up to 10x "Type 3 — Ranked" camouflages.
[*]Gold League: up to [b]600[/b] Steel; up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]400[/b] doubloons; up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] Coal; up to 3x Bronze camouflages; up to 3x Silver camouflages; up to 8x Gold camouflages; and one Ranked Token.[/list]
[list][i]This Season is the test Season for the new Ranked Battles system. We'll keep an eye on how it goes and monitor your feedback. Following the test Season, additional changes may be made to the new Ranked Battles system in order to improve it. In future seasons, the format, rewards, combat missions associated with Ranked Battles, and other details may differ from the current ones.[/i][/list]
You can learn more details about the updated Ranked Battles system and the first Ranked Season in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/updates-to-ranked-battles/]dedicated article[/url].

[h2][b]Content Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40e80732-3fad-11eb-8c0b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Starting from Update 0.10.1, the following ships will no longer be available to obtain: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Georgia[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]IX Alaska[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Massachusetts[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Thunderer[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Småland[/b][/b]. Georgia, Alaska, and Massachusetts will also no longer be available to purchase in the Premium Shop.

The ships have been taken out of the game due to a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of the ships they are made up of, these ships will no longer be available to obtain for an indefinite period of time, but may return in future.

From Update 0.10.2, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Somers[/b][/b] will cease to be available in the Armory for an indefinite period of time. We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance, so that any interested players can still steer these ships into their Ports before Updates 0.10.1 and 0.10.2 go live in about 2 and 3 months' time.

[h2][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0de6ed8-32d7-11eb-81b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.12, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

[h3][b]Kansas[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Sigma parameter increased from 1.6 to 1.7
[*]Armor penetration of shells increased by approximately 3.5%[/list]
[h3][b]Minnesota[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Armor penetration of shells increased by approximately 4%[/list]
[h3][b]Tallinn[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Armor penetration of shells increased by approximately 12.5%[/list]
[h3][b]Admiral Hipper[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 11.5 to 11 s[/list]
[h3][b]Hōshō[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Number of torpedo bombers in a squadron reduced from 6 to 5
[*]Size of an attacking flight of torpedo bombers decreased from 2 to 1
[*]Number of torpedo bombers on the deck reduced from 9 to 8
[*]Torpedo bomber restoration time increased from 59 to 71 s
[*]Torpedo damage increased from 5,400 to 5,800[/list]
[h3][b]Langley[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Torpedo damage reduced from 4,233 to 3,500
[*]Chances of causing flooding with torpedoes reduced from 33% to 30%[/list]
[h3][b]Manfred von Richthofen[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The area of the reticle ellipse of bombers has been increased[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0f9be858-404b-11eb-a1c0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Fixed an issue that resulted in excessive deceleration when Engine Boost was used. The value has been adjusted to match the standard one.[/list]
[h3][b]Implacable[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Maximum bomb damage increased from 5,300 to 5,600
[*]Chances of bombs causing fire on a target increased from 30% to 32%[/list]
[h3][b]Audacious[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Number of rockets carried by standard attack aircraft reduced from 12 to 10
[*]Number of rockets carried by researchable attack aircraft reduced from 14 to 12
[*]Maximum bomb damage increased from 6,000 to 6,400
[*]Chances of bombs causing fire on a target increased from 35% to 36%[/list]
[h2][b]Technical Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0d992ae-3fb2-11eb-8a73-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

As part of the game server component optimization, we’re reducing the maximum number of unopened containers on player accounts to 100. If you have more than 100 unopened containers at the time of the release of Update 0.9.12, the containers that you obtained earliest will be opened automatically.

[h2][b]Support of Mac OS[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/409361c8-3fad-11eb-9d23-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

We plan to cease support for Mac OS in January 2021. We made this decision due to the low popularity of this operating system among our audience. Supporting Mac OS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance. You can find more details in this Player Support [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/15628/]article[/url].

[h2]Special Features of the Test[/h2]
[list][*]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[*]Please note: Lunar New Year ships, camouflages, and Commanders will not be available on the Public Test Server.[/list]
The Public Test Server will host Brawls in a 3 vs. 3 format in the Arms Race mode, playing Tier X ships. To participate in these Brawls, it's enough for only the Commander to be a member of a Clan—up to two mercenaries can be invited to each team.

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]At the start of the Public Test, every participant will have all researchable Tier VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 19 skill points, as well as one Commander of each nation with 21 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*]Research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]Players will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]

If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.9.11, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000 [/b]credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] doubloons; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Premium Account[/b].
[*]50 signal flags of all types (except special signals) will also be added to your PT account.[/list]

If you played at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 0.9.6–0.9.11 Public Tests, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.

[h2]How to Enter[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.0[/b][/h1]
[i]Updates to the Commander skill system, Clan Brawls, Lunar New Year, and other new features.[/i]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][b]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/b][/list]
[table][tr][th][b]Commander Skills Update ● Brawls ● Other Changes[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Commander Skills Update[/b][/h2]
World of Warships is constantly evolving. New mechanics and ships with unique gameplay appear in the game on a regular basis. To ensure that Commander skills correspond to the current state of the game, we're carrying out a large-scale update by adding new skills and changing the old ones. Changing the Commander skill system will make it more flexible and convenient, and give you a choice between several effective loadout options instead of one ultimate go-to option. This will enable you to customize your ship to more precisely suit your playstyle. In addition to updating the Commander skills, we've revamped the interface and made it more comfortable to use the Commander system, as well as retrain and level up Commanders.

[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Each Commander now has separate skill sections for each ship type. Skill points in each section are distributed independently of each other.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d2979120-3936-11eb-b817-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d283af48-3936-11eb-9b52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d28684c0-3936-11eb-96cf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d286395c-3936-11eb-b6d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The skill section corresponding to the chosen ship type is active in battle.
[*]As skills have become more specialized and their total number has increased, the maximum possible number of Commander skill points has increased from 19 to 21.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13540882-3938-11eb-9b52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Elite Commander XP[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Commanders who don't have the maximum number of skill points will additionally bring you Elite Commander XP in the amount of 5% of the Commander XP gained.
[*]For Commanders with 21 skill points, any XP earned is converted into Elite XP; the additional 5% is not credited.
[*]When dismissing a Commander, you can convert some of their Commander XP into Elite XP:
[list][*]Up to 25% of the Commander XP, at the cost of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]10[/b] credits for [b]1[/b] XP.
[*]Up to 50% of the Commander XP, at the cost of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1[/b] doubloon for [b]150[/b] XP.[/list]
[/list]
For example, if a Commander has [b]10,000[/b] XP, then upon dismissing this Commander, you can receive up to [b]2,500[/b] XP for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]25,000[/b] credits; or up to [b]4,950[/b] XP for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]33[/b] doubloons.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/133c67d6-3938-11eb-b14b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Retraining and Specialization[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The ability to accelerate Commander retraining in exchange for credits has been removed, but the amount of XP required for retraining has been halved.
[*]Skills will not work until the Commander's retraining is complete.
[*]Each skill section is reset separately from the others.
[*]A Commander without a specialization for a ship can't be assigned to that ship without retraining. This rule doesn't apply to Premium and special ships.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13435fd2-3938-11eb-b6d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3]
The cost and number of skills for recruited Commanders will change so that, if necessary, a player will be able to recruit a Commander with more skill points.
[list][*]Commander without skills: recruited free of charge.
[*]Commander with 6 skill points: available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]900,000[/b] credits.
[*]Commander with 10 skill points: available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] doubloons.[/list]
You can enter battle playing a ship without an assigned Commander. In this case, you will not earn Commander XP.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/135c4b00-3938-11eb-b817-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can learn more details about the changes to the Commander skill system on the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/]Development Blog[/url].[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Brawls[/b][/h2]
The upcoming Update ushers in two Brawls with a 7 vs. 7 format:
[list][*]From January 26 to February 1 for Tier VIII ships.
[*]From February 9–15 for Tier X ships.[/list]
Battles will be fought in the Arms Race mode without aircraft carriers and with a limit of two battleships per team. To participate in these Brawls, it's enough for only the Commander to be a member of a Clan: up to six mercenaries can be invited to the team.

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[list][b]Please note: new ships, camouflages, and Commanders will not be available on the Public Test Server.[/b][/list]
[list][*]We've added special content dedicated to the Lunar New Year: Wujing and Sanzang in the Sha Wujing and Tang Sanzang permanent camouflages, together with themed Commanders; Fen Yang with the Lunar New Year permanent camouflage; and two types of the "Journey to the West" containers. To mark the celebrations, we've updated the Dragon Port.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13862434-3938-11eb-83d8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]To make it more explicit, we've updated the display of Early Access ships in the Tech Tree, as well as the description of their features.
[*]The segment split of torpedo bombers' reticles now depends on the number of aircraft in the attacking flight. This fixes an issue that prevented the display of some of lines in the reticle.
[*]Pressing the [b]F[/b] key after attacking with the last flight in a squadron will skip the attack animation and transition you to controlling the ship.
[*]When a squadron takes off, the aircraft models no longer disappear from the deck of an aircraft carrier all at once, but rather disappear in turn.
[*]We've updated the interface for carrier armaments in the Port.
[*]The message about the return of a squadron to their carrier has been removed.
[*]The game now loads while a video is played on the loading screen.[/list]

[h3][b]Features of the Branch[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and firing range, which come at the expense of longer gun reloading times.
[*]Great maneuverability for battleships and effective anti-torpedo protection, but rather a low speed.
[*]Decent AA defenses that can be reinforced with the Defensive AA Fire consumable.[/list]
[h2][b]Winter Trophies[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b12b4744-32d7-11eb-8b11-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.9.11 brings you the first batch of gifts and festive New Year activities.

[h3][b]Free random bundles in the Armory[/b][/h3]
[list]The bundles are available between December 4–22, 05:00 UTC[/list]
You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip up to 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b23de712-32d8-11eb-98b7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]We'll give you some indicators to jog your memory about claiming your rewards by highlighting the Armory banner with a color, as well as attaching a special icon and text notification to it.[/i][/list]
[h2]New Year Gifts[/h2]
Gear up for the time of gifts in World of Warships! From December 4, bundles that include three types of Santa's containers are scheduled to become available. Exchanging doubloons for them in the Armory is one of several ways in which they can be obtained.

Each festive container holds a reward: doubloons, days of Premium Account, Coal, Free XP, expendable camouflages, signals—or one of the 107 Premium ships!

[h2]Combat Mission Groups: Winter Trophies[/h2]
The new game event tasks you with completing 21 missions spread across three combat mission groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.9.11, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis. The final reward for completing the last group is the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier VIII ships.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/347d257c-32e7-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The Advent Calendar festivities kick off on December 1 and run until December 31. Open cards, get rewards, and complete missions to get even more rewards! More details about the Advent Calendar will follow in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/advent-calendar/]dedicated article[/url].

[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Z-44[/b][/b], a Type 1936B destroyer, armed with two quintuple-tube torpedo launchers that reload their long-range torpedoes quickly. The ship excels at conducting torpedo attacks from a distance. Unlike the researchable German destroyers, Z-44 doesn't have access to the Hydroacoustic Search consumable. The ship is available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]228,000[/b] Coal, as well as in bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Plymouth[/b][/b], based on one of the draft designs that preceded the creation of the Edinburgh-class cruisers. The ship's distinctive features include sixteen 152 mm guns placed in four turrets. Like the researchable British light cruisers, she carries AP shells only. The ship is equipped with the Surveillance Radar, Smoke Generator, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables, but has a short firing range and weak armor. You can get her in exchange for [b]27,000[/b] Steel.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Neustrashimy[/b][/b], the first Soviet destroyer that was designed and built after World War II. She boasts one of the best concealment values at her tier, coupled with effective torpedo armament and a large HP pool. The destroyer has access to a wide range of consumables, including Specialized Repair Teams and Defensive AA Fire. You can get her in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]296,000[/b] Coal.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Flint[/b][/b], an American cruiser with powerful artillery, good AA defenses, and high maneuverability. Twelve dual-purpose 127 mm guns with a high rate of fire that fire shells along arcing trajectories. Take shelter behind an island, then rain a barrage of shells down upon your enemies. Flint boasts decent torpedo armament and a favorable set of consumables: Smoke Generator with a long smoke dispersion time, Hydroacoustic Search, or Defensive AA Fire in one slot. You can get the ship for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]168,000[/b] Coal.[/list]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Flint[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Neustrashimy[/b][/b] were previously available for Steel—a valuable resource that's primarily earned in competitive game modes. We wouldn't like to diminish the value of those ships for their owners, which is why their prices are higher than the prices of other same-tier ships in Coal.
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Duke of York[/b][/b] is a renowned British battleship that played a crucial role in the sinking of the no-less-famous German warship, Scharnhorst. Duke of York carries HE shells that are notable for delivering increased damage and having higher armor-penetration capabilities. They can deal consistent damage to enemy battleships and cruisers, even at long ranges where AP rounds are less efficient. To successfully counter destroyers, Duke of York has access to Hydroacoustic Search—a rare consumable for this ship type. You can get the ship in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]101,000[/b] Coal.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Lazo[/b][/b], a Soviet Project 68 light cruiser, has large dimensions and carries a formidable main battery of twelve 152 mm guns. She's well suited to long-range engagements. She excels at exchanging fire over a distance of 20 km due to the trademark features of the Soviet artillery and the specific parameters of her Spotting Aircraft consumable. You can get her in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]83,000[/b] Coal.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]V Hill[/b][/b] is an American destroyer flotilla leader that was designed at the end of World War I. Her guns can be aimed quickly and she has comfortable torpedo launching angles, as well as decent AA defenses for her ship type and tier. You can get her for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]38,000[/b] Coal.[/list]

We've added containers from the "German Navy" and "Shipbuilding" collections, with each container available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Coal. This presents a good opportunity to complete the two collections if you haven't done so already.

The reward for completing the sections and the entire "German Navy" collection is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships. The reward for completing the "Shipbuilding" collection is a Santa’s Big Gift container.

In connection with the forthcoming update to Ranked Battles, we've made the following changes:
[list][*]The cost of permanent camouflage patterns for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Flint[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Black[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Stalingrad[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Bourgogne[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Shikishima[/b][/b] has been increased from three to [b]10[/b] Ranked Tokens.
[*]The number of Ranked Tokens that each player has accrued has been increased fourfold.[/list]
We've added the Predator permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Somers[/b][/b], available for [b]10[/b] Ranked Tokens.
[list][b]Starting from Update 0.10.1, the following ships will no longer be available: [b][b]IX Georgia[/b][/b], [b][b]IX Alaska[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Massachusetts[/b][/b], [b][b]X Thunderer[/b][/b], and [b][b]X Småland[/b][/b]. Georgia, Alaska, and Massachusetts will no longer be available to purchase in the Premium Shop.[/b][/list]

The ships have been taken out of the game due to a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of the ships they are made up of, these ships will no longer be available to obtain for an indefinite period of time, but may return in future.

We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance, so that any interested players can still steer these ships into their Ports before Update 0.10.1 goes live in about 3 months' time.

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[h1][i][h3][b]Changes to banners in the Port[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/857e5130-32ec-11eb-9dd2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The banners of the Armory and Premium Shop will now announce the arrival of new items, coupons, and temporary specials.

We've added pop-up windows to the Dockyard banner to give players status reports on the current shipbuilding phase.

[h1][i][h3][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0de6ed8-32d7-11eb-81b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.11, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

[h3][b]Soviet Tier X destroyer Khabarovsk, and Japanese Tier X destroyer Harugumo[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Loss of HP after being hit by an AP or SAP shell with a caliber of 280 mm and above will now not exceed 10% of the maximum damage that such a shell can cause.[/list]
[h3][b]British Tier VIII aircraft carrier Implacable[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Maximum bomb damage increased from 5,100 to 5,300
[*]Chances of a bomb causing fire on target increased from 29% to 30%[/list]
[h3][b]American Tier VIII battleship Kansas[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Sigma parameter increased from 1.5 to 1.6[/list]
[h3][b]Japanese Tier IX destroyer Kitakaze[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea increased from 7.56 to 7.76 km. Other detectability values have been increased accordingly.[/list]
[h1][i][h3][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0f8c90e-32d7-11eb-992d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: [b][b]IV Dante Alighieri[/b][/b], [b][b]V Conte di Cavour[/b][/b], [b][b]IX Lepanto[/b][/b], [b][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b], [b][b]X Vampire II[/b][/b], and [b][b]VIII Fen Yang[/b][/b].

The Gothic permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Bismarck[/b][/b] is now available in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] doubloons via the Exterior tab.

The exterior setting of the Naval Base Port has been reverted back to its initial design.

[h1][i][h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0e520ac-32d7-11eb-85e9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In January 2021, we're going to cease support for macOS. We've made this decision due to the low popularity of the operating system among our audience. Supporting macOS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance. More details are available from [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/15628/]Player Support[/url].
[list][*]We've added sound effects for some animations in the Port for the following themed permanent camouflages from the Transformers universe: Freedom Fighter for [b][b]X Montana[/b][/b], Gold Bug for [b][b]X Gearing[/b][/b], Messenger of Oblivion for [b][b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b][/b], and Crush ’n’ Destroy for [b][b]X Khabarovsk[/b][/b].
[*]Added an option to disable screen shaking from incoming damage and when using Engine Boost for squadrons with a new "Camera feedback when damage is taken" setting in the Controls tab.
[*]The Key Battle ships have been removed from player accounts. Any XP earned playing those ships has been transferred to [b][b]I Erie[/b][/b].
[*]We've removed the option to set an Autopilot course by clicking a square on the Minimap.
[*]Removed Naval Legends audio files from the [b]res/userMusiс[/b] folder. You can listen to all of our podcasts [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/wows-podcast/]here[/url].
[*]When previewing camouflage patterns in the Armory, a block will be displayed with the ship's tech specs adjusted for the effects and bonuses of the camouflage being previewed.
[*]Added an option to launch replays without pop-up notifications about opening files of such a format in Windows.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable to work incorrectly.
[*]Fixed an issue that, when locking onto a target with main battery guns, set an incorrect angle for the torpedo launchers. As a result, torpedoes could be sent in the wrong direction or the launchers could malfunction entirely.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the game client to crash after navigating to the Dockyard but before the ship being built had appeared in it.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused aerial torpedoes to arm at incorrect distances from the target.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the game client to freeze on the login screen.
[*]Fixed an issue that disabled the display of certain indicators (distance to aiming point, detectability, and shell flight time) for aircraft in battle with the alternative battle interface mode enabled.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused [b]Andrew Cunningham's[/b] "Lightning Fast" talent to provide an incorrect bonus to the speed of aircraft.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused a screenshot from the previous battle to pop up before displaying the battle results.
[*]Other improvements and changes. The full list is available from [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

[h2][b]American Battleships: Part 2[/b][/h2]
