The game event in Update 0.9.10 is presented by combat missions, Daily Shipments, and a new collection dedicated to the U.S. Navy.

For the purposes of standardization, Directives have been renamed "combat mission groups."

[list][i]Please note: American Tokens can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory until the event ends. After the end of the event, they will be exchanged for credits at the rate of 1:1,000.[/i][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The possibility to make this exchange will be available until: [/b] [b]Thu. 03 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h3][b]Combat mission groups[/b][/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start: [/b] [b]Thu. 29 Oct. 06:15 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]End: [/b] [b]Tue. 01 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

Rewards for completing the missions and groups: signal flags, camouflages, Coal, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, and Always Courageous containers.

[h3][b]Always Courageous containers[/b][/h3]
How to get the containers
[list][*]Up to 27 containers—by completing combat mission groups.
[*]Up to 4 containers—from Daily Shipments.
[*]Up to 10 containers—by completing special combat missions from the official World of Warships streams.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ad70767a-153f-11eb-90b0-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Each Always Courageous container includes:
[list][*]An element of the Always Courageous collection.
[*]1x special signal (Dragon, Wyvern, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan), or 1x Stars 'n' Stripes camouflage.
[*]One of the following: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]600[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]500[/b] Free XP; [b]1,500[/b] Elite Commander XP; 3x signals of the same type (Zulu, Papa Papa, Equal Speed Charlie London, India Bravo Terrathree, Zulu Hotel); or [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]50,000[/b] credits.[/list]
You can purchase Always Courageous Premium containers, which offer more rewards, in the Premium Shop, or obtain them in exchange for doubloons in the Armory. The rewards are as follows:
[list][*]An element of the Always Courageous collection.
[*]15x special signals of the same type (Dragon, Wyvern, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan), or 12x Stars 'n' Stripes camouflages.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]3,400[/b] Coal; or [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]8,500[/b] Free XP; or 3x Type 59 camouflages.[/list]
[h3][b]The "Always Courageous" collection[/b][/h3]
The newly added "Always Courageous" collection comprises four sections, with four elements in each. It will educate you about the main batteries of battleships, admirals, and medals for service in both World Wars, as well as the main uniform types of enlisted men of the U.S. Navy during World War II.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2d86a974-1540-11eb-8e52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b]Reward for completing the sections:[/b] 5x Stars 'n' Stripes expendable camouflages; Wings, Stars, and Stars 'n' Stripes patches.
[list][b]Reward for completing the collection:[/b] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]V Oklahoma[/b][/b] in the Military permanent camouflage, and a Commander with 6 skill points.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82791656-1540-11eb-9384-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]V Oklahoma[/b][/b] is a Nevada-class battleship, the unique feature of which is her ten 356 mm main caliber guns placed in two twin turrets and two triple turrets. The guns are accurate, have a decent firing range, and cause significant damage per salvo, but take rather a long time to reload. In close quarters, the battleship can make use of her accurate secondary battery guns.

The exchange rate for duplicates is 4:1. To exchange duplicates, you need to select a vacant slot in a collection section, then confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for the missing item in the window that appears.
[list][i]Elements of the collection can only be obtained from event-related containers. In Update 0.10.5, we're planning to add Always Courageous containers to the Armory. They will be available in exchange for Coal. Thus, you'll still be able to complete the collection and obtain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]V Oklahoma[/b][/b] if you haven't managed to do so in Update 0.9.10. The exact cost of the containers will be announced later.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Daily Shipments[/b][/h3]
During Update 0.9.10, enter the game in the period between October 29 and November 12, inclusive, to start getting valuable rewards via the Daily Shipments section.

You can get a total of 10 rewards, while the shipments are available for 14 days. Thus, you can skip 4 days out of 2 weeks and still claim all the valuable rewards.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40edcc9a-153b-11eb-b828-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]When Update 0.9.11 goes live, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b] will leave Early Access and become available for all players to research.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Key Battle[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e6c0a78-153d-11eb-8481-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
A new temporary battle type—Key Battle—has been added in Update 0.9.10. Demonstrate your skills in a futuristic competition by assuming command over a ship representing one of three corporations!
[list][*]The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on the gigantic Polygon map.
[*]You start out alone, but you can gather a team of up to three ships directly in battle.
[*]For destroying monsters and other players, you'll get a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points, you can also reinforce your ship directly in battle.
[*]The Battle Points you receive aren't lost or spent in battle. You can exchange them for rewards in the Armory.
[*]You'll find a monster with a key closer to the center of the map. If you destroy it, the monster will drop a key that will allow you to escape via the Portal.
[*]Once all the keys have been used or the Portal is closed, the remaining ships will be transported to a special area—the Octagon. The final battle takes place in a gradually shrinking combat zone. The last surviving ship will leave the Polygon successfully.
[*]Successfully escaping the Polygon will bring you additional Battle Points.
[*]Each of the three available ships offers a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on the gameplay.[/list]
The new themed Port inspired by the Polygon will ensure that you soak in the event's atmosphere before you enter battle.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42c0f118-1438-11eb-98de-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42842eea-1438-11eb-add3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42a3db5a-1438-11eb-b9cb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42c37532-1438-11eb-a54c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]More details on the Key Battle rules, as well as the available rewards in the Armory, will come in a dedicated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/big-hunt-the-key-to-victory/]article[/url].[/list]
[h2][b]Clan Missions[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e282934-153d-11eb-93a5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Some missions related to Clan development have been added to the Clans section of the menu. Oil is the main reward given for completing these missions, but two of them will deliver Coal to the Clan Treasury. In total, you can earn up to [b]32,100[/b] Oil and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]11,000[/b] Coal. You can also earn the "Formidable Fleet" achievement.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/66fbb18e-1754-11eb-aa7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The missions reward Clans for growing in size, participating in the Naval Battle, active playing of the Clan members, and fighting in Clan Battles. More details about the missions are available in the game client.

[h2][b]Aircraft Carrier Interface[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e6555ac-153d-11eb-bb7f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

We've made some changes that will ensure you receive useful information about the status of your ship while controlling a squadron in the air.
[list][*]A new marker pointing at your aircraft carrier has been added. It changes to indicate your ship's status: risk of collision, ship detected by the enemy, approaching torpedoes, etc.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/14d5aae4-175a-11eb-aa7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Sound notifications have been updated. The least informative ones have been removed in order to make space for new notifications that relate to the aircraft carrier's status.
[*]We've added the possibility to skip the attack animation and proceed directly to operating a squadron. The aircraft invulnerability period will be reduced by the duration of the skipped part of the animation.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a841f726-1541-11eb-bfeb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e10a750-153d-11eb-964f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The new Samurai permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Shikishima[/b][/b] has been added and made available in exchange for three Ranked Tokens.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca8d9e18-1756-11eb-a21a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][b]The opportunity to exchange [b]12,500[/b] Research Points for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]250,000[/b] Free XP in the Research Bureau didn't prove to be popular, so it will be removed.[/b][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The possibility to make this exchange will be available until: [/b] [b]Sat. 14 Nov. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin 0.9.10[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT! [/b]Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.[/b][/list]
[table][tr][th][b]U.S. Battleships: Part 2 ● Big Hunt: The Key to Victory![/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]U.S. Battleships: Part 2[/b][/h2]
[list][b]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the live server. The new U.S. battleships will not be available to research on the Public Test server.[/b][/list]
The event in Update 0.9.10 comprises combat missions, Daily Shipments, and a new collection dedicated to the U.S. Navy. It will inform you about the main batteries of battleships, admirals, medals for service in World Wars, and the main uniform types of enlisted men of the U.S. Navy during World War II.
For the purpose of standardization, the Directives have been renamed into combat mission groups.
[b]"Always Courageous!" containers[/b] can be obtained by completing combat mission groups in the "U.S. Battleships 2" section and opening Daily Shipments. Each container holds one element of the new collection, as well as other rewards.
[b]The "Always Courageous!" collection[/b] consists of four sections, with four elements in each.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5726504-07b5-11eb-b859-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The rewards for completing each section are five expendable Stars'n'Stripes camouflages and such patches as Wings, Stars, and Stars'n'Stripes.
[list][b]Completing the entire collection[/b] will bring you [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]V Oklahoma[/b][/b] in the Military camouflage and a Commander with 6 skill points.[/list]
[list][b][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]V Oklahoma[/b][/b] won't be available on the Public Test server.[/b][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dca68378-07be-11eb-9ce8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Elements of the collection can only be obtained from event-related containers.

We've also updated the Naval Base Port.

[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f96b6406-07be-11eb-9ce8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f96b6406-07be-11eb-9ce8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f963bd6e-07be-11eb-aa4e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f963bd6e-07be-11eb-aa4e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
[list][i]When Update 0.9.11 goes live, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b] will leave Early Access and become available for all players to research.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Big Hunt: The Key to Victory![/b][/h2]
A new temporary battle type—Key Battles—has been added to celebrate Halloween. A new themed Port emphasizes the event's atmosphere. Demonstrate your skills in an exhibition competition of the future by assuming command over a ship representing one of three corporations!
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d4f924d0-07b6-11eb-ac3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d4f0a468-07b6-11eb-bc8c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d521023e-07b6-11eb-af87-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on a gigantic Polygon map. The main objective is to exit the Polygon through a portal located at the center of the map. In order to do so, you need to destroy one of the special monsters and obtain a key. The monsters will initially be quite weak, but they will become more dangerous as you get closer to the portal.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a414e170-07bf-11eb-9ce8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Instead of the usual rectangular Minimap, the new battle type features a round one with the player's ship at its center. It shows everything within the spotting range of your ship.

You start out alone, but you can gather a team of up to three ships directly in battle. Only one player can use the key, which is why you'll face a choice—go all the way with your allies, or turn your guns against them and escape as a lone wolf via the portal. To invite a player to your team, aim at them and press [b]F[/b].

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f9052ed8-07bf-11eb-9ed6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8fdf726-07bf-11eb-9ce8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f9117846-07bf-11eb-8c94-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The number of keys is limited. After the last key has been used, the remaining ships will be transported to a special area—the Octagon. The final battle takes place in a gradually shrinking combat zone. The last surviving ship will also leave the Polygon successfully.

For destroying monsters and other players, you'll get a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle. For example, you can reduce incoming damage or increase the damage dealt by your guns. Once you earn a certain number of Points, a window will appear. This will allow you to select one of the two improvements. Use [b]Ctrl+1[/b] and [b]Ctrl+2[/b] to select. You don't need to spend any Points to make your selection.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b8a1405c-07bf-11eb-8c94-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Any Points you earn can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory. Successfully escaping the Polygon will bring you additional Battle Points. Please note: exiting through the portal will get you more Points than winning in the Octagon.
[list][b]The rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the live server.[/b][/list]
A total of three ships are available for this battle type in Update 0.9.10. Each of them offers a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay. For example, you could replace standard torpedoes with a type that temporarily disables all the main armaments of an enemy, but deal less damage. The choice of weapons is not limited to simple guns—lasers, plasma torpedoes, wavecasters, and mortars are all at your disposal. For example, wavecasters can destroy torpedoes in the water, while plasma ammunition heats up the target's armor and temporarily increases the damage dealt by subsequent hits of plasma shells and torpedoes to the same area. New modules are unlocked by completing special combat missions.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cc8b61ba-07bf-11eb-bf05-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The first ship will be available immediately, while the second and the third are obtained by completing a chain of combat missions.[/i][/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63b82b84-022c-11eb-884b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

When Update 0.9.11 goes live, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b] will be available for all players to research.

[h2][b]Clan Battles: "Northern Waters" Season[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3b61cd1e-018e-11eb-8c61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Wed. 07 Oct. 13:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Mon. 23 Nov. 06:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format:[/b] 7 vs. 7 playing Tier X ships
[b]Restrictions:[/b] up to two battleships, or one battleship and one aircraft carrier per team
[b]Rewards[/b]: up to [b]11,000[/b] Steel and many other rewards
[b]Maps[/b]: Islands of Ice, Sleeping Giant, Warrior's Path, North, Greece, and Northern Waters, in Domination mode
[b]Season features[/b]: in the new Season, all maps may feature a cyclone
[list][*]The cyclone settles over the sea at the very start of a battle. Players should choose the most appropriate tactics in response to the conditions.
[*]Cyclones reduce the viewing radius of aircraft to 8 km.
[*]At the fourth minute of a battle, the viewing radius of ships starts to shrink, too. After 30 seconds, it gets reduced to 14 km.
[*]After 15 and a half minutes of battle, the cyclone will start to fade away. Its effects will vanish completely after a further 30 seconds.[/list]

Essentially, the cyclone is designed to reduce the reconnaissance potential of aircraft carriers in Clan Battles. The option to add a maximum of two battleships or replace one of them with one carrier will make team lineups and battle tactics in the upcoming Season more diverse. For example, it's possible that destroyers might prove to be a popular choice.

[list][i]Full details of the Season will be released in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Mercenaries[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3b7b1e86-018e-11eb-ac2b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Division Commanders now have the option to invite "mercenaries," i.e. players from outside their Clan or from other Clans, to join their Divisions for Clan Battles.

The new feature will allow Clan leaders to test candidates who want to join their Clans in real combat scenarios, or fill roster gaps without having to actually accept new players into the Clan.

[h3][b]Rules[/b][/h3]
[list][*]To add a mercenary to the team, simply invite them to join your Division. You can search for players via the "Divisions" tab in the game client.
[*]After a battle, the mercenary receives rewards based on the current league of the Clan they went into battle with.
[*]The mercenary may also receive achievements and emblems for Clan Battles, based on the current league of the Clan they went into battle with.
[*]However, the mercenary will not receive the associated economic bonuses of the Clan they fought for.
[*]A mercenary from a different Clan will be able to enter battle during the Prime Time of the inviting Clan. The selected Prime Time of the Clan that the mercenary belongs to will not change.[/list]

[list][i]During the "Northern Waters" Season of Clan Battles, only one mercenary can be invited to a Division.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Research Bureau[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba7676f4-018e-11eb-9fe4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]We've added a victory bonus of [b]200[/b] Research Points for Tier V ships.
[*]The following achievements have been added: Junior Shipbuilder, Senior Shipbuilder, Shipbuilding Inspector, and Chief Shipbuilding Inspector. The achievements will be issued for 10/50/100/150 ship branches that you have reset.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0a83b098-0226-11eb-8394-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Only ship branches that you reset after Update 0.9.9 goes live will count towards your progress for the new achievements and the bonus for Tier V ships.[/list]

[list][i]More details about the Research Bureau will appear in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Changes to Game Mechanics[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/babd2144-018e-11eb-b66a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

We've updated the mechanics behind the interactions between shells and main battery barbettes / turrets.

Previously, when a shell hit the main battery turret, damage was dealt only to the module itself, and the player received a "Penetration" ribbon without any actual damage having been dealt to the enemy ship. Now, hitting the main battery turret also entails a reduction in the ship's hit points.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/750165da-022d-11eb-b625-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The change will significantly reduce the number of no-damage penetrations.
[list][*]Any damage dealt to a main battery turret also entails damage to the ship in the amount of 1/10 of the maximum damage of the shell.
[*]The amount of damage dealt to the main battery turret modules in case of a penetration has been reduced 3.3 times.
[*]The number of hit points for main battery turret modules has been reduced by half.
[*]Damage affecting a ship's HP from a shell hitting any of the ship's main battery turrets can be restored completely using the Repair Party and Specialized Repair Teams consumables.
[*]The barbette models have been updated.[/list]

[h2][b]Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba9b062c-018e-11eb-b0e3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]We've improved the sea rendering quality for all graphics settings. Sun glare on the water's surface now looks more realistic; the horizon is now rendered at a higher quality; and water will now appear in a range of different shades, depending on the map. This change will improve game client performance. The changes will be most visible at low and medium graphics quality settings.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a0ee9f8c-022d-11eb-a627-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[*]The Spaceport has been updated to accommodate the new lighting model and enhanced HDR technology.
[*]We've changed the visual appearance of the aiming reticles for carrier squadrons, and also reworked the aircraft camera performance. This change will affect only the visual component of a squadron's interface, making it easier to aim with all types of armament without affecting gameplay.
[*]Aircraft aiming reticles will no longer adjust to changes in the terrain of islands. A special indicator will notify you that your armament is about to hit terrain, and the reticle will become slightly more transparent. The new feature will also help prevent scenarios when a player is fully aimed at a target ship, but there are still terrain obstacles in the path of the payload release trajectory.
[*]Aircraft operating as part of a squadron will now change positions in a smoother way; the trajectory of bombers moving in on a target will change slightly, and any damage taken by the aircraft in the process will cause it to shake.
[*]The visibility of aircraft aiming reticles on sunlight-reflecting water has been improved.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/aabb953c-0224-11eb-bc28-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b51b82a-0224-11eb-bebc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/aabeff7e-0224-11eb-8394-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Technical Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba704cfc-018e-11eb-981a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

With the release of Update 0.9.9, players will be able to play on all World of Warships servers within a single game client, without the need to install separate game instances for each region. The game server will be determined by the currently selected account in the Wargaming Game Center.

We recommend that you delete all additional game instances installed on your computer before the release of Update 0.9.9. Please note: you will still need a separate game client for Public Tests.

We've seen drops in game client performance and aiming reticle distortions on devices with graphics cards that don't support DirectX 11 features. For this reason, we are discontinuing support for graphics cards that don't meet the minimum system requirements.

[h1][i][h3][b]List of unsupported graphics cards[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*][b]NVIDIA:[/b] all graphics cards older than the GeForce 400 series.
[*][b]AMD:[/b] all graphics cards older than the Radeon HD 5000 Series.
[*][b]Intel:[/b] all graphics cards older than Intel HD 3000.[/list]

[list][b]Support for the macOS operating system will cease with the release of Update 0.10.0. We made this decision due to the low popularity of this OS among our players. Supporting macOS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance.[/b][/list]

More details are available [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/15628/]in this article[/url].

[h2][b]Content additions and changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/109724a2-018f-11eb-b791-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Armory[/b][/h3]
The following ships will become available in the Armory with the release of the Update:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b]X Franklin D. Roosevelt[/b][/b]—available in exchange for [b]33,000[/b] Steel. A Midway-class aircraft carrier that can boast of having solid armor protection. The extensive HP pools of her aircraft and large squadron size allow her to carry out continuous powerful attacks, even when her aircraft, which lack the Repair consumable, fall under heavy AA enemy fire.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe882794-0228-11eb-b23f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Paolo Emilio[/b][/b]—available in exchange for [b]43,000[/b] Research Points. This destroyer was initially designed as light cruiser intended for use in reconnaissance operations of the Italian Navy. She's fast, and equipped with good artillery that's capable of firing SAP and HE shells, all at the cost of a long reload time. The ship's powerful torpedo armament, coupled with access to the Emergency Engine Power and Exhaust Smoke Generator consumables, make her ideal for lightning-fast attacks at short ranges.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe186968-0228-11eb-868d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Other changes[/b][/h3]
We're continuing our work on enhancing the Daily Shipments: two new options will be added in Update 0.9.9. We'll test the new mechanics as the Update goes live. To ensure that we get credible test results, some players will collect their rewards via the "old" version of Daily Shipments, while others will receive the new ones. This research will also require a random reference group, which is why certain players will unfortunately not have access to Daily Shipments during this Update.

A "Gothic" permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Bismarck[/b][/b] has been added to the game. Details on how to get it will follow a bit later.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Mainz[/b][/b] has been added to the Tech Tree, and will be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]11,000[/b] doubloons.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Tirpitz[/b][/b] has temporarily been removed from the Tech Tree. However, she will still be available via the Armory.

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Hizen[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Z-44[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Strasbourg[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Plymouth[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Mysore[/b][/b].

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
Check under the spoiler for more information regarding balance-related changes, content changes and additions, and other improvements.

[h1][i][h3][b]Improvements to the combat mission interface[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/104a8db8-018f-11eb-b0e3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]We've re-enabled the option to jump to the Combat Missions section by clicking on the icon of a combat mission that drops from a container.
[*]A list of combat missions that you've scrolled down will now automatically scroll back up when switching between tabs.
[*]A combat mission hint that pops up on the post-battle results screen will now show the progress you've made towards the conditions of that mission in a battle.
[*]When navigating to the Directives tab, the currently active Directive will be selected by default.[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Game balance changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1095c9ea-018f-11eb-8c61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.9, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

[h3][b]Tier V British cruiser Hawkins[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 12.6 to 12.1 s[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VIII U.K. aircraft carrier Implacable[/b][/h3]
Changes to HE bomb characteristics:
[list][*]Maximum damage increased from 4,700 to 4,900
[*]Chance to cause fire on a target increased from 27% to 28%[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X Soviet cruiser Petropavlovsk[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea increased from 14.9 to 15.4 km. Other detectability values have been increased accordingly[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IX Soviet cruiser Riga[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 15.0 to 14.5 s
[*]Detectability range by sea increased from 14.74 to 15.04 km. Other detectability values were increased accordingly[/list]

[h3][b]Engine Boost Modification 1 upgrade[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus to the action time of the Engine Boost and Emergency Engine Power consumables reduced from +40% to +30%[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Other changes and improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/104f8f02-018f-11eb-ac2b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[list][b]Please note: running Overwolf application may cause World of Warships client collapse. To fix the issue, update Overwolf to the latest version. If the issue still persists, please contact the Customer Service Center.[/b][/list]

[list][*]Fixed a mistake in the description of Task 6 of Mission 4 in the "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign.
[*]Fixed a bug in the autopilot voiceovers for the following Commanders: Kaguya, Chang'e, and Hou Yi.
[*]The names of modules of attack aircraft now contain an HE or AP designation for their rockets.
[*]Reduced the frequency of a situation that caused the game client to crash during authorization.
[*]Reduced the frequency of a situation that caused a ship with autopilot enabled to leave her charted course.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the Expert Marksman skill to provide incorrect bonuses to the traverse speed of main battery guns.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the game client to crash after navigating to the Dockyard before the ship being built appeared.
[*]Fixed an issue that, in certain cases, made it impossible to authorize in the game after minimizing the client window and then maximizing it again.
[*]Other improvements and changes. For a complete list, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

[*]You can start a Clan Battle on the Public Test server at any time.[/list]

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]Every participant of the Public Test will have all researchable Tier VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 15 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]Players will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]
If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.9.9, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] doubloons; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Premium Account[/b].
[*]50 signal flags of all types (except special signals) will also be added to your PT account.[/list]
If you played at least one battle on the Public Test server during the 0.9.6–0.9.8 Public Tests, your account will be copied from the live server to the Public Test server.

[h2]How to Enter[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin 0.9.9[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.[/b][/list]
[table][tr][th][b]U.S. Battleships: Part 1 ● Mercenaries ● Other Changes[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]U.S. Battleships: Part 1[/b][/h2]
Update 0.9.9 kicks off an event with the new U.S. battleships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] right in spotlight! These ships will become available in Early Access on the Live Server only when the Update is released. Meanwhile, we invite you to take part in the testing of the event.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f7a80758-f19f-11ea-98b3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][b]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the live server. The new U.S. battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Features of the Ship Branch[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and decent firing range, which comes at the expense of longer gun reload times.
[*]The ships enjoy great maneuverability for their type, as well as good anti-torpedo protection, but are rather slow.
[*]Their decent AA defenses are reinforced by the availability of the Defensive AA Fire consumable.[/list]
[b]Early Access[/b]: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] can be obtained by completing Directives. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] can be obtained from random bundles that are available in the Armory in exchange for doubloons.

[b]Rewards for completing Directives[/b]: a new temporary resource called American Tokens.

[b]Rewards in exchange for American Tokens[/b]: sequentially available bundles with Gold Eagle permanent camouflage patterns for the new U.S. battleships, as well as other rewards.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f7ac1190-f19f-11ea-ab04-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The Naval Base Port has been updated.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7512124c-f1a0-11ea-9d49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Mercenaries[/b][/h2]
Division Commanders will now have the option to invite "mercenaries," i.e. players from outside their Clan, to join their Divisions for Clan Battles.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c937e80a-f1a1-11ea-a814-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The new feature will allow Clan leaders to test candidates who want to join their Clan in a real combat scenario, or fill any roster gaps without having to actually accept new players into the Clan.

The following rules apply to mercenaries:
[list][*]To add a mercenary to the team, simply invite them to join your Division. You can search for players via the "Divisions" tab in the game client.
[*]After a battle, the mercenary receives rewards based on the league of the Clan they went into battle with.
[*]However, the mercenary will not receive the associated economic bonuses of the Clan they fought for.[/list]
[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
The barbettes and main battery guns have been updated for all ships. Previously, when a shell hit the main battery turret, damage was dealt only to the module itself, and the player received a "Penetration" ribbon without any actual damage having been dealt to the enemy ship. Now, any damage dealt to the main battery turret also entails a reduction in the ship's hit points in the amount of 1/10 of the maximum damage of the shell. This way, hitting a turret will no longer result in a penetration without inflicting actual damage.

We've changed the visual appearance of aiming reticles for carrier squadrons and reworked the aircraft camera performance. This change will affect only the visual component of a squadron's interface, making it easier to aim with all types of armament without affecting gameplay.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7733cca8-f1a2-11ea-a814-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7733e9c2-f1a2-11ea-8800-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/76e46c26-f1a2-11ea-bf3f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Any aircraft operating within a squadron will now change position in a smoother way; the trajectory of bombers moving in on a target will change slightly, and any damage taken by the aircraft in the process will cause it to shake.

We've improved the visual display of water for all graphic settings. In particular, the visual noise applied to the sea has been removed entirely on the horizon. This change will improve game client performance.

The Spaceport has been updated to accommodate the new lighting model and enhanced HDR technology.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4fb8715a-f1a3-11ea-af28-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7514a99a-eb82-11ea-831e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

With Update 0.9.8, World of Warships is celebrating its Fifth Anniversary! The festive Update offers a bunch of gifts and in-game activities: a permanent Campaign titled "Five Epochs of the Navy," plus a collection of the same name; fresh first-win bonuses, a revamped Designer's Table Port, and a new battle type—Asymmetric Battles.

[h3][b]Permanent "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2e1ac68-e93f-11ea-99bf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign comprises 50 tasks grouped into five missions, each of which is dedicated to a specific shipbuilding epoch. To finish the Campaign, you'll need to complete tasks playing ships of various tiers: starting from Tier II–IV ships for the first mission, and progressing to Tiers VIII–X for the final mission.
[list][b]Reward for finishing the Campaign:[/b] Epoch permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships.[/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

[h3][b]"Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55568bba-e93d-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection is made up of five sections, with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific period in the history of shipbuilding.

Only [b]"Five Epochs of the Navy" containers[/b] drop collectibles.
[list][b]The reward for completing the entire collection:[/b] Epoch permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2cd7342-e93f-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The Epoch permanent camouflage can be mounted on any Tier IX ship, except for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX AL Sov. Rossiya[/b][/b]. Once mounted on a ship, the camouflage remains assigned to that ship. Another copy of the camouflage can be assigned to a different ship.[/i][/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

[h3][b]Victory Bonuses[/b][/h3]
During Update 0.9.8, you can expect a festive bonus for your first victories of the Update with certain ships. It can be secured on ships starting from Tier V:
[list][*]Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage patterns
[*]Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
[*]Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
[*]Tier X: 1x supercontainer[/list]
[h2][b]Asymmetric Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/754588f8-eb82-11ea-8e7d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:  [/b] [b]Thu. 03 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 17 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[list][*]In an Asymmetric Battle, a team of five to seven Tier VII–VIII ships will confront a team of nine to twelve ships of Tiers V–VI.
[*]To enter battle with Tier VII–VIII ships, you'll need to spend a new temporary resource—Battle Tokens. The cost of entering a battle playing Tier VII–VIII ships is 500 Battle Tokens.
[*]Battle Tokens can be earned in Asymmetric Battles:
[list][*]Tier V: 250 Tokens per battle
[*]Tier VI: 150 Tokens per battle
[*]Tier VII: 200 Tokens per battle
[*]Tier VIII: 25 Tokens per battle
[*]You'll receive 1,000 Tokens each day upon logging in to the game.
[*]Tokens are earned irrespective of the battle results, but players will not be awarded them if they are inactive.[/list]
[/list]
[list][i]Please note: Battle Tokens are only used to participate in Asymmetric Battles. With the release of Update 0.9.9 all Battle Tokens will be converted into credits at a rate of 1:50. Asymmetric Battles become available after reaching Access Level 12.[/i][/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

[h2][b]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7571f4d8-eb82-11ea-9630-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Another new feature of Update 0.9.8 is the Dockyard, where you'll be able to construct [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b]. The rules of the new Dockyard are in many ways similar to those applied to the Hamburg Dockyard, but the list of rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases has changed. For example, completing phase 12 will bring you [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Free XP.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94edaef8-eb8f-11ea-a8f7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The construction process of the Dockyard comprises 20 phases.
[*]Each shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing the Directives of the event, or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] doubloons per phase.
[*]The Directives will span two updates—0.9.8 and 0.9.9, and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the end of Update 0.9.10.
[*]You can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by accomplishing Directives. In order to complete the 19th and 20th phases, in addition to completing all the Directives, you'll need to purchase any two shipbuilding phases by spending doubloons.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b] and her National camouflage, along with a 10-skill Commander, Port slot, and commemorative flag, await you upon completing the 20th phase.[/list]
[list][i]The full details will be published in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/96fdae8a-eb87-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/74dc091e-eb82-11ea-9a23-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.8, the customary Daily Shipments will be replaced with free daily random bundles in the Armory:
[list][*]You can only obtain one bundle per day.
[*]A total of 15 bundles will be available during the period of three weeks, so you can skip up to 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8045936-eb8c-11ea-973b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h1][i][h3][b]Bundle contents[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*]1 day of Warships Premium Account—1x bundle
[*]50,000 credits—5x bundles
[*]50 doubloons—1x bundle
[*]3x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage patterns—4x bundles
[*]1x Gift container—3x bundles
[*]1x King of the Sea container—1x bundle[/list]
[h2][b]Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/754bd94c-eb82-11ea-96a6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Wed. 16 Sep. 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Tue. 13 Oct. 10:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Rewards:[/b] up to [b]5,500[/b] Steel and many additional rewards.
[b]Maps and modes:[/b] North, Sea of Fortune, and Greece in Domination mode; Sleeping Giant and Warrior's Path in Arms Race mode; and Tears of the Desert in Epicenter mode.
[list][i]The Season's details will be published in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/756285de-eb82-11ea-a1c3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The visual display of fog in the game has been enhanced by adopting an updated spacial distribution system and adding a scattered sunlight effect. Apart from improving the visual component, this change will also provide a slight improvement in the game client's performance.

[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f103a0c0-eb86-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f103a0c0-eb86-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f0faf240-eb86-11ea-bcb7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f0faf240-eb86-11ea-bcb7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr][/table]

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/74e81bd2-eb82-11ea-a21d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[list][*]Freedom Fighter permanent camo for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Montana[/b][/b], Gold Bug permanent camo for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]X Gearing[/b][/b], Messenger of Oblivion permanent camo for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b][/b], and the Crush’n’Destroy permanent camo for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]X Khabarovsk[/b][/b].
[*]Decepticon Disguise and Autobot Ark expendable camouflage patterns.
[*]Commanders with special voiceovers: [b]Optimus Prime[/b], [b]Bumblebee[/b], [b]Megatron[/b], and [b]Rumble[/b].
[*]Cybertronian containers.
[*]Themed patches and flags.[/list]
[list][i]Details about the ways in which you can obtain content dedicated to [b]"Transformers: Generation 1"[/b] will be announced later.[/i][/list]
In honor of the holiday, the Mid-Autumn Festival permanent camouflage pattern for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VI Warspite[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VI Dunkerque[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VIII Kaga[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Prinz Eugen[/b][/b] has been added, as well as the following unique Commanders:
[list][*][b]Chang’e[/b] with a specialization for Pan-Asian and Japanese ships
[*][b]Hou Yi[/b] with a specialization for Pan-Asian ships
[*][b]Kaguya[/b] with a specialization for Japanese ships[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/256745be-eb88-11ea-a1c3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8714ad2-eb8c-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The Anniversary commemorative flag and the For Meritorious Service patch have been added into the game.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/25576ac2-eb88-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Details on how to get these items will be published later.[/i][/list]
To make the process of researching ships simpler, the following changes have been made to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VIII Admiral Hipper[/b][/b]'s modules:
[list][*]Hull A has been removed from the game.
[*]Hulls B and C have been renamed "A" and "B," respectively.
[*]If you have already researched Hull B, you'll receive compensation in the amount of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]22,000[/b] ship XP.
[*]If you have already researched Hull C, the new Hull B will be mounted on your ship instead. In other cases Hull A will be mounted on the ship.
[*]If you've already purchased one of the replacement hulls, you'll receive compensation in the amount of credits you paid for it.[/list]
The stock hull of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]V Königsberg[/b][/b] has been replaced with a new one, created on the basis of the researchable hull with a changed composition for the AA and secondary guns.

English-language audio for Naval Legends has been added into the game client:
[list][*]To listen to Naval Legends directly in battle, you need to enable the "Listen to your own music" option in the sound settings.
[*]If you already use your own music as background sound, then Naval Legends will be added to your playlist.
[*]In case you opt to remove Naval Legends from your playlist, you need to remove the respective audio files from the [b]bin/<VERSION_ID>/res/userMusiс[/b] folder in the game client.[/list]
Ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Belfast '43[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]V Oklahoma[/b][/b] have been added for testing by developers, volunteers, and community contributors.

[h2][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/756595d0-eb82-11ea-8246-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Occurrence of a synchronization error has been reduced. This bug caused the incorrect display of ships' positions in battle.
[*]Thunderstorm Front and Snowstorm are available in the game again.
[*]Plus other improvements and changes. The full list is available from [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/en/products/wows/hot-issues/33372/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

[b]Ends[/b] [b]Tue. 18 Aug. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h2]Special Features of the Test[/h2]
During the Public Test of 0.9.8, everyone will be able to test a new temporary battle type—Asymmetric Battles.
[list][*]Select the Asymmetric Battle type.
[*]Two teams will face off against each other in these battles, with differing numbers of ships and different ship tiers: 4–6 Tier VII–VIII ships, against 8–12 Tier V–VI ships.
[*]To take part in Asymmetric Battles playing Tier VII–VIII ships you'll need [b]Battle Tokens[/b].[/list]

For the purpose of testing, the conditions of the "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign have been made easier. We've changed the reward for completing the 20th shipbuilding phase at the Dockyard. Anchorage won't be available on the Public Test server.

[h2]Summer Season[/h2]
Public Test 0.9.6 opens the Summer Season, which is scheduled to run across three updates.

[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Completing two Directives will reward you with the season emblem.
[*]Completing three Directives will reward you with a unique flag, patch, and Premium Ship VI container.
[*]Those in possession of all four different season emblems will be rewarded with the unique Ultimate PT Warrior emblem.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b]Summer Season #3[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]
Complete any six missions of the "Summer Season #3" Directive.

[b]Reward on the live server:[/b] 2x Five Epochs of the Navy containers

[list][i]The missions can be completed only once, playing Tier VIII–X ships in Random and Ranked Battles.[/i][/list]
[/td][/tr][/table]
Completing the above mission unlocks access to the Summer Season #2 mission from the previous Public Test. Once you are through with the Summer Season #2 mission, the Summer Season #1 mission from the Public Test of Update 0.9.6 will be unlocked for you. If you already started working your way through the Summer Season mission during the Public Tests of Update 0.9.6 and 0.9.7, your progress will have been saved.

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]Every participant of the Public Test will have all researchable Tier V and Tier VII ships, helmed by Commanders with 15 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]Players will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]

If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.9.6, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] doubloons; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Premium Account[/b].
[*]50 signal flags of all types (except special signals) will also be added to your PT account.[/list]

[h2]How to Enter[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin 0.9.8[/b][/h1]
[i]The World of Warships Anniversary, new Dockyard, Season 18 of Ranked Battles, and other features![/i]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.[/b][/list]
[table][tr][th][b]World of Warships Anniversary ● Ranked Battles ● Other Changes[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
With the release of Update 0.9.8, World of Warships passes the threshold of its fifth year!

This time, the festive frenzy is inspired by naval history. The game will feature plenty of new and engaging content to mark the occasion, including a revamped Designer's Table Port, a permanent campaign titled "Five Epochs of the Navy" plus a collection of the same name, a new Dockyard, and fresh first-win bonuses. You can also try out a new battle type—Asymmetric Battle!

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46204f10-dbdb-11ea-9ae3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The collection and new permanent campaign are both dedicated to the history of shipbuilding.

[b]The Five Epochs of the Navy permanent campaign[/b] features 50 tasks spread across 5 missions.

[list][b]Reward for completing the campaign:[/b] an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be applied to the majority of Tier IX ships.[/list]
[b]The Five Epochs of the Navy collection[/b] is made up of five sections, with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific era in the history of shipbuilding. Elements of the collection can only be obtained from the same-name containers. The exchange rate of duplicates for missing elements is 1:1.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09d523c8-dbd6-11ea-bf4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[b]Five Epochs of the Navy containers[/b] will be available during the campaign of the same name. Each container will drop an element from the Five Epochs of the Navy collection, as well as other rewards.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a6118892-dbd8-11ea-a905-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][b]Reward for completing the collection:[/b] an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be applied to the majority of Tier IX ships.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d4138024-dbd8-11ea-a905-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Asymmetric Battle[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1e357130-dbd9-11ea-a5ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]During the first two festive weeks of the World of Warships Fifth Anniversary, you can try out a new temporary battle type—Asymmetric Battle—with a differing distribution of ships and tiers between teams.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/41dc5988-dbd8-11ea-b2c5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Historically, encounters at sea have typically involved opposing sides with an unequal number of ships on each side. The new battle type offers a new gameplay experience in near-real naval combat conditions.

In an Asymmetric Battle, a team of four to six Tier VII–VIII ships will confront a team of eight to twelve ships of Tiers V–VI. Helming Tier VII–VIII ships in an Asymmetric Battle will require a new temporary resource called [b]Battle Tokens[/b].

Battle Tokens can be obtained by participating in Asymmetric Battles. The number of Tokens you get from each battle depends on the tier of ship you helm—the lower the tier, the more Tokens you can get.

This way, you'll be able to participate in an Asymmetric Battle with lower and higher-tier ships for a more immersive experience in the new battle type.

[h2]Dockyard[/h2]
In Update 0.9.8, players will be able to build a new U.S. Tier VIII cruiser—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b]. The rules of the new Dockyard are in many ways similar to those applied to the Hamburg Dockyard, but the list of rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases has changed. For example, completing phase 12 will bring you [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Free XP.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4172ed90-dbd8-11ea-bf4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*]The construction process of the Dockyard comprises 20 phases.
[*]Each shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing the Directives of the event, or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] doubloons per phase.
[*]Event Directives will span two updates—0.9.8 and 0.9.9, and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the end of Update 0.9.10.
[*]In total, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by finishing Directives.
[*]Anchorage and her National camouflage, along with a 10-skill Commander, Port slot, and commemorative flag, await you upon completing the 20th phase.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46384e12-dbdb-11ea-9d9a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

If you decide to complete shipbuilding at the Dockyard by using doubloons, you can still progress through the Directives. However, in that case, instead of the usual rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases, you'll get [b]600[/b] Research Points for each completed phase. If you have not yet opened the Research Bureau, you'll get access to it immediately with the first Research Points you earn.

[h2]Victory Bonuses[/h2]
In Update 0.9.8, players will be able to receive a festive bonus for their first victory in the Update, secured on every ship starting from Tier V.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/461007d6-dbdb-11ea-8ee6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]List of Rewards[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflages
[*]Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
[*]Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
[*]Tier X: 1x supercontainer[/list]
[h1][i][h3][b]Gift Container[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
A Gift container holds five special signals of one type (Dragon, Red Dragon, Wyvern, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan).

[h2][b]Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
Update 0.9.8 kicks off a new Season of Ranked Battles. You can expect to play Tier X ships in an 8 vs. 8 format.

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
The visual display of fog in the game has been enhanced by adopting an updated spacial distribution system and adding a scattered sunlight effect. Apart from improving the visual component, this change will also provide a slight improvement in the game client's performance.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8690630-dbd6-11ea-bb82-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Naval Legends audio recordings have been added to the pool of in-battle soundtrack options.

German carriers are now available for all players to research! The new ships carry high-speed aircraft that have small HP pools. Their armament includes armor-piercing rockets and AP bombs, as well as fast torpedoes.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ad30996-d2ae-11ea-82e1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b4065ea-d2ae-11ea-bdfa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The [b]new “German Navy” collection[/b] comprises six sections, with six elements in each. Learn about the history of the German Navy during the first half of the 20th century—the ships and aircraft; personalities and emblems; awards and uniforms. The reward for completing the collection is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships.

You can find the first element of the collection in [b]German Navy containers,[/b] which in turn can be obtained by progressing through Directives or picked up from Daily Shipments.  You can continue collecting elements from daily containers by activating a subscription on the collection page. Another container can be obtained by clicking the button in an article about the collection that will be published next week.

[h2][b]Ranked Sprint[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c078d1ac-d59f-11ea-bc7c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
