[b]Maps:[/b] Hotspot, Mountain Range, Shatter, Warrior's Path, and Northern Waters with reduced combat areas.

[list][i]Details of the Ranked Sprint will be published in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Setting the Order of Consumables[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c1683ee0-d59f-11ea-963f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

An option to set a custom order of the consumables for each ship has been added. Any customizations are saved on the server, so you won't need to set them again if you play on different computers.

[h2][b]Unique Upgrades[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0bec608-d59f-11ea-b1ad-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

New unique upgrades for [b][b]X Daring[/b][/b], [b][b]X Kléber[/b][/b], [b][b]X Harugumo[/b][/b], [b][b]X Kremlin[/b][/b], [b][b]X Audacious[/b][/b], [b][b]X Midway[/b][/b], and [b][b]X Hakuryū[/b][/b] have been added to the "Research Bureau" tab of the Armory. They are each exchangeable for [b]19,200[/b] Research Points. The current concept provides an additional opportunity to mount upgrades with special-but-balanced bonuses in comparison with the regular upgrades.

[h1][i][h3][b]New upgrades[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[h3][b]Daring (fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−10%[/b] to the torpedo tube reload time
[*][b]+15%[/b] maximum torpedo damage[/list]

[b][b]X Daring[/b][/b] is currently a versatile ship with a slight focus on artillery. With the upgrade, the destroyer can stay some distance away from a Key Area and focus on torpedoes and attacks from within a smoke screen.

[h3][b]Kléber (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−20%[/b] to the ship's detectability range by sea
[*][b]+80%[/b] to the main battery reloading time[/list]

The unique upgrade provides an alternative to artillery focused gameplay. When mounted, [b][b]X Kléber[/b][/b] becomes a torpedo-carrying destroyer for close quarters combat with her high speed, fast reload time, and detectability that's equal to that of other same-tier destroyers. The upgrade allows for more effective torpedo attacks at the cost of losing a significant amount of potential artillery damage per minute.

[h3][b]Harugumo (fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+30%[/b] smoke screen dispersion time
[*][b]+100%[/b] Smoke Generator action time
[*][b]+1 [/b]charge for consumables[/list]

This unique upgrade offers some improvements for gameplay that involves the use of smoke screens, at the cost of detectability and reduced effectiveness in battles for Key Areas. Thus, the ship can escape at ¼ speed while setting a smoke screen and reach the optimal distance for firing.

[h3][b]Kremlin (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−18%[/b] to the main battery reloading time
[*][b]−12%[/b] maximum main battery firing range
[*][b]−1[/b] charge for consumables[/list]

The upgrade allows for a more aggressive gameplay style, with the ship sacrificing her survivability in return for a bonus applied to her main battery firing rate.

[h3][b]Audacious (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−15%[/b] to the ship's detectability range by sea
[*][b]+20%[/b] Engine Boost action time
[*][b]−50%[/b] to the time it takes to reach full power when accelerating
[*][b]−30%[/b] rudder-shift time[/list]

The upgrade allows the ship to get close to an opponent and thus increase the frequency of her aircraft attacks. At the same time, the risk of being detected by the opponent, as well as the risk falling under heavy fire, increases.

[h3][b]Midway (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+10%[/b] bomber cruising speed
[*][b]+5.5%[/b] bomber minimum speed
[*][b]−4.5%[/b] bomber maximum speed
[*][b]+10%[/b] HE bomb damage[/list]

Instead of generally increasing the power of squadrons of all types, this upgrade offers gameplay with a focus on bombers with increased damage and speed.

[h3][b]Hakuryū (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+15%[/b] aircraft maximum speed
[*][b]−20%[/b] engine boost action time[/list]

The upgrade provides the biggest effect when you're starting an attack approach. It significantly increases the speed of the aircraft and reduces the time they spend within the enemy's AA defense range. At the same time, the overall distance travelled with engine boost remains the same.

We are continuing to update the existing unique upgrades. These changes will balance their effectiveness, and at the same time, preserve the unique gameplay of each ship. Their names and icons have also been updated.

[h1][i][h3][b]Updates to the existing upgrades[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[h3][b]Z-52 (fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added a bonus that reduces the detectability range of torpedoes by 10%.[/list]

The upgrade will make [b][b]X Z-52[/b][/b] a more capable torpedo destroyer, but at the same time make her less effective in Key Areas due to the reduced bonus to concealment compared with the concealment upgrade.

[h3][b]Grozovoi (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The penalty applied to her torpedo tube reload time increased from +10% to +20%.[/list]

The upgrade offers improvements for main battery gun-focused gameplay. It was too effective, and reducing the traverse speed of her main battery guns didn't affect it significantly because of the already high base value. For this reason, the penalty applied to her torpedo tube reload time was increased instead.

[h3][b]Moskva (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus that reduces the maximum dispersion of her main battery shells was reduced from –11% to –7%.
[*]The penalty applied to her main turret traverse speed increased from –13% to –20%.[/list]

The changes offer a choice between the unique upgrade with its bonus to accuracy, and the standard bonuses to the guns' reloading time or firing range.

[h3][b]Minotaur (fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a bonus that increased the dispersion of incoming enemy shells by 10%.
[*]Added a bonus that reduces the reload time of ship consumables by 10%.[/list]

The upgrade allows the ship to stay in a smoke screen for an extended period of time when moving at ¼ speed. The bonus to the reload time of consumables will increase the overall survivability and effectiveness of the ship, and will be useful with any equipment.

[h3][b]Zaō (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a bonus that reduced her rudder-shift time by 20%.[/list]

The upgrade was too versatile and improved the ship in many ways. In the current state, it's effective when playing in open waters and engaging from long distances.

[h3][b]Yamato (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a bonus that reduced the main battery reload time by 6%.
[*]The penalty to the main turret traverse speed was reduced from –19% to –13%.[/list]

The upgrade was too effective because it provided two bonuses at once—greater damage per minute and accuracy. After the changes, the upgrade offers a choice between these two parameters.

[h2][b]Naval Base[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0ee0aa8-d59f-11ea-aaa8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Added improvements for the Treasury that will allow Clan leaders to regularly exchange Oil for Clan rewards.
[*]The Research Center, which provides a bonus to the amount of received XP, has been renamed "War College." A new building named "Research Institute" has been added. It increases the amount of Research Points a Clan receives.
[*]To show the result of the Clan's activity, the water area of the base will fill up with warships and auxiliary vessels, with their number depending on the number of battles played. The more Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles that have been fought by Clan members over the last month, the more vessels that will appear in the waters of their Naval Base. The number of warships depends on the number of Clan Battles played over the last 3 months.[/list]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/clans/naval-base-update/]Read more>>>[/url]

[h2][b]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/42f5474a-d5a1-11ea-84be-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Added two new battle signals, which can be obtained in exchange for credits, Coal, and Research Points.
[list][*][b]X-Ray Papa Unaone[/b]: increases the action time of Smoke Generator by 15%.
[*][b]Sierra Bravo[/b]: increases the action time of Hydroacoustic Search by 10% and reduces the cooldown period of Defensive AA Fire by 10%.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9efd6252-d5a6-11ea-9578-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]They will be added to the "More Signals and Camouflages" daily container at a later point in time.[/i][/list]

The following bundles will become available with the release of the Update:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b] for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]228, 000[/b] Coal, and from bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons. Pommern is a variant of the H-class battleship project that's armed with twelve 380 mm guns. Decent armor, powerful secondary armament, the Hydroacoustic Search consumable, and torpedoes allow the ship a high degree of confidence in close quarters engagements.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f0bfe52-d5a6-11ea-a8bb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VI Erich Loewenhardt[/b][/b] in bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons. Her bombers, unlike the aircraft of researchable German aircraft carriers, are armed with HE bombs, and her torpedoes have a longer range but lower speed.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9ed14064-d5a6-11ea-945f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Slava[/b][/b] for [b]63,000[/b] Research Points. She was an implementation of a battleship project that was developed after the end of World War II to counter the American Iowa- and Montana-class ships. Due to the high accuracy and excellent armor-penetrating capabilities of her AP shells, Slava is most efficient in artillery duels over greater distances. Her armor is not strong enough to be effective in close quarters combat.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9ec9b394-d5a6-11ea-8c73-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*]Unique British historical Commander [b]Andrew Cunningham[/b] with 10 skill points for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]175,000[/b] Coal. The Commander possesses unique talents that increase the speed of his ship and aircraft, provide an additional charge for the ship's consumables, or increase the reload speed of the armament.[/list]

[list][i]Ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VI Erich Loewenhardt[/b][/b] will also be available in the Premium Shop.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
Check under the spoiler for more information regarding balance-related changes, content changes and additions, and other improvements.

[h1][i][h3][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0e843e8-d59f-11ea-b8cf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.7, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow, should they be required, in future updates.

[h3][b]Attack aircraft on Hermes, Furious, Ark Royal, Implacable, Indomitable, Audacious, Graf Zeppelin, Graf Zeppelin B, Hōshō, Ryūjō, Shōkaku, Kaga, Hakuryū, Lexington (with Tiny Tim missiles), Saipan, Midway (with Tiny Tim missiles)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The missile crosshair was rotated 90 degrees, and is now stretched horizontally.[/list]

This change will unify all missile crosshairs and will allow the destroyers to stick to a set of common tactics to avoid the attacks of attack aircraft.

[list][*]The bonus to continuous AA damage provided by the Defensive AA Fire consumable increased from +75% to +100%.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X Italian cruiser Venezia[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 20.5 to 21s.

[h3][b]Tier IX British destroyer Jutland[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 4.3 to 4.5s.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VII battleships Colorado and Nagato[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The Fighter consumable can now be mounted on their standard hulls.[/list]

[list][*]The Spotting Aircraft consumable can now be mounted on their standard hulls.[/list]

[list][*]The Hydroacoustic Search consumable can now be mounted on their standard hulls.[/list]

[list][*]The Hydroacoustic Search consumable can now be mounted on both hull A and B.[/list]

This change allows for a more consistent transition from her standard hull to the researchable variety.

notes.title: Sound Changes in Update 0.9.6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/478cf65304925d2061fdba6380ae16ac2ffbf84a.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.9.6 has brought some major changes to the in-game audio. We’ve updated the [b]Wwise[/b] sound engine, added new sound effects, and changed a number of audio settings.[/b]

Today we'll explain in detail how to customize the in-game audio to meet your preferences.

[table][tr][th][b]Basic Audio Settings ● Fine Audio Settings ● Other Settings[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Basic Audio Settings[/b][/h2]
We recommend using default volume settings, where all the parameters are set to maximum volume. With these settings, you'll experience every detail of the sound effects and get the best experience from the game.

If the sound seems too loud, navigate to [b]General volume level[/b] to adjust the volume of all in-game sounds.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d555557c-c759-11ea-8033-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Fine Audio Settings[/b][/h2]
If the general volume controls are insufficient, you can change the [i]fine settings[/i] in the audio customization window. These controls manage the different sound effects in our game:
[list][*][i][b]NEW[/b][/i] [b]Damage audio volume:[/b] covers the sounds that indicate hits of the ship, aircraft, water, islands, and other surfaces, as well as sound effects for fire and flooding.
[*][b]Gunfire volume:[/b] is the volume of all shots.
[*][b]Interface volume:[/b] is the volume of the sound effects that are produced when you click icons, tabs, and notifications, as well as when you activate equipment, etc.
[*][b]Music in the Port[/b] and [b]Music in Battle:[/b] regulate music volume in the Port and in battle correspondingly, as well as the volume of the horn when you launch the game client.
[*][b]Ambient sound volume:[/b] accounts for the sounds of nature on maps and background sounds in the Port.
[*][b]Engine sounds:[/b] determines how loud ship and aircraft engines are.
[*][b]Voice message volume:[/b] accounts for voice messages during battle, such as phrases from the quick commands chat, notifications about the remaining battle time, and other voice messages.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d55c7974-c759-11ea-acb3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Please note: we've removed the [b]SFX volume[/b] setting. It managed all non-music sounds in the game, except voice messages, thus duplicating certain fine settings options and causing confusion.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Other Settings[/b][/h2]
Let's take a look at some additional options that also deserve your attention.
[list][*][b]Sound quality[/b]: the default value of this parameter is set by the game automatically, depending on your PC's characteristics. This parameter affects the game's performance.[/list]
Setting the sound quality to [b]High[/b] is optimal for most devices. [b]Low[/b] quality supports all the key sound elements of the game, leaving out minor details and reducing the load on the system. When the sound quality is set to [b]Ultra[/b], your sounds will be at their most intense and detailed. However, make sure your PC is powerful enough to handle it. It's also advisable to have high-quality speakers or earphones; otherwise you won't be able to appreciate the game's sounds on maximum settings.
[list][*][b]Voiceover language[/b]: from this list, you can select any voiceover language that’s available in the client. The default choice is the selected language of the client.
[*][b]Voiceover modifications[/b]: from this list, you can select one of a few modifications for the voiceover. There are user modifications and those offered by the game's developers. The latter include Alexander Ovechkin, ARP Commanders, Bad Advice: Cap, and other modifications with Commanders who have unique voiceovers. If you select one of these modifications, the Commander's voice will be used as the voiceover for all your battles.[/list]
[list][i]If you pick the [b]National[/b] modification, your Commander will speak the language of the ship's nation, provided that this language is supported by the client. With [b]National voiceover +[/b], this rule is applied to all Commanders in battle. Commanders with unique voiceovers (i.e. those from the Fleet of Fog, Ovechkin, and others) speak only one language.[/i][/list]
[list][*][b]Music mode[/b]: allows you to switch the modes of music played during battle.
[list][*][b]Original[/b]: in this mode, you'll hear only brisk battle tracks, played one after another.
[*][b]Dynamic[/b]: in this mode, you'll hear custom-made tracks that evolve dynamically, depending on the distance to the enemy and battle situation.
[*][b]Mixed[/b]: is the most diverse mode, which combines the advantages of both the Original and Dynamic modes.
[*][b]War Drums[/b]: is a special music mode for those who prefer an epic yet laconic music experience.[/list]
[*][b]Choose audio source[/b]: shows the available sound sources. The audio settings are slightly different in the [b]Earphones[/b] and [b]Speakers[/b] modes.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f90d5802-c759-11ea-bb1d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f9201104-c759-11ea-98c8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f9167d10-c759-11ea-acc2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f91ef896-c759-11ea-b72d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f91717f2-c759-11ea-a604-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]If you use a surround sound system (5.1, 7.1, or higher), the game's audio settings will adapt to it automatically. But this audio setting must be selected at the operating system level.[/i][/list]
[list][*][b]Quick messages voiceover[/b] [b](enabled by default):[/b] turn this option off if you don't want Commanders to pronounce quick messages in the game.
[*][b]Wide dynamic range[/b] [b](enabled by default):[/b] turn this option off if you want all sounds to be equally loud. Dynamic range is the difference between the loudest and the quietest sounds in the game. The broader the range, the more natural and realistic the game will sound. We advise you to disable this option if you use internal laptop speakers or small speakers that can't reproduce the full audio frequency range.[/list]
[list][b][b]Note:[/b] if you disable the [b]Wide dynamic range[/b] option, don't forget to return all fine settings regulators back to 100%, as all the sounds will have the same volume, and the regulators will only turn a certain group of sounds on or off.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Loudness compensation[/b] [b](disabled by default):[/b] use this option if you want to play with a low audio volume and hear the sounds more distinctly.
[*][b]Voice Assistant (enabled by default):[/b] turns the announcer in the Port on or off. The announcer helps you understand new interface elements and informs you about achieving new Access Levels.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2a7c8624-c75a-11ea-98c8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[b]Voice Chat[/b]: in this menu section, you can customize the settings of the in-game voice chat.

Take note of the [b]Radio communication effect[/b] setting, which also affects the voice chat. You can also select a radio effect variant in the [b]Voice chat processing[/b] drop-down menu.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867
[h1]Developer Bulletin 0.9.7[/h1]
[i]German carriers leave Early Access, a new collection, Naval Base update, and other improvements.[/i]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT[/b]! Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.[/b][/list]
[table][tr][th][b]German Carriers: Part 2 ● Ranked Sprint ● Changing Keys for Consumables ● Unique Upgrades ● Naval Base Update ● Other Improvements[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]German Carriers: Part 2[/b][/h2]
[list][i]The branch of German carriers will become available for all players to research with the release of Update 0.9.7.[/i][/list]
[list][b]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the live server. German carriers are not available to research on the Public Test server.[/b][/list]
The game event in Update 0.9.7 is presented by Directives, Daily Shipments, and a new collection dedicated to the German Navy.

You can get [b]German Navy containers[/b] as rewards for completing Directives, as well as from Daily Shipments. Each container contains two elements of the new collection, as well as other rewards.

[b]The "German Navy" collection[/b] consists of six sections, with six elements in each. Elements of the collection can be obtained from the event containers, and also daily containers if you've activated the subscription. The reward for completing the collection is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a2a35414-c5e5-11ea-872a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The Port of Hamburg has been updated.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/403e59e6-c5e9-11ea-b91b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Ranked Sprint[/b][/h2]
Update 0.9.7 brings with it a new Ranked Sprint with a 3 vs. 3 format, playing Tier IX ships.

[h2][b]Changing Keys for Consumables[/b][/h2]
An option to set the order of consumables for each ship is going to be added in 0.9.7. The order of consumables is saved on the server, so you won't need to set it again if you're playing on different computers.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/92a9a924-c5e4-11ea-944c-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Unique Upgrades[/b][/h2]
We're continuing to work on making changes to the existing Unique Upgrades, and also adding some new ones.  The current concept provides an additional opportunity to mount an upgrade with special-but-balanced bonuses in comparison with regular upgrades.

These changes will balance the effectiveness of unique upgrades, and at the same time preserve the unique gameplay of each ship.
[list][i]You can view the detailed list of changes on the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/44]Development Blog[/url], and in the article about Update 0.9.7.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Naval Base Update[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Added improvements for the Treasury, which will allow Clan leaders to regularly exchange Oil for rewards for the Clan.
[*]The Research Center, which applies a bonus to the amount of received XP, has been renamed "Naval institute." A new building named "Research Institute" has been added. It increases the amount of Research Points received.
[*]Depending on the Clan's activity in Clan Battles, the water area of the Naval Base will be filled with a proportionate number of ships. As more Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles are played by Clan members, more vessels will appear.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0fe9c88e-c5e9-11ea-80b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0fbcd0d6-c5e9-11ea-b91b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0feab8d4-c5e9-11ea-b1ca-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0fb90c76-c5e9-11ea-a333-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Other Improvements[/b][/h2]
Two new battle signals, which can be obtained in exchange for credits, coal, and Research Points, have been added to the Armory.
[list][*][b]X-Ray Papa Unaone[/b]: increases the action time of Smoke Generator by 15%.
[*][b]Sierra Bravo[/b]: increases the action time of Hydroacoustic Search by 10% and reduces the cooldown period of Defensive AA Fire by 10%.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e987c914-c5e5-11ea-8cf6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
They will be added to the "More Signals and Camouflages" daily container at a later point in time.

When entering the game for the first time after the update, a short video will play back. It can be skipped by double-clicking any keyboard button. Another video will play back on the login screen. This video can be paused.

Updated the upgrade icons.

[b]Rewards available in exchange for Tokens in the Armory:[/b] the Iron Cross permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]X Z-52[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]X Hindenburg[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b]X Manfred von Richthofen[/b][/b]; "Black, White, Red" expendable camouflage patterns; credits; and signals.

[list]You can get up to five additional German Carriers containers for participating in the official World of Warships streams—activate bonus codes and complete special combat missions![/list]
[h3][b]Features of the German carriers[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The aircraft have a high cruising speed, but somewhat small HP pool.
[*]Attack aircraft are equipped with a new type of ammunition—AP rockets. These are capable of inflicting heavy damage to enemy citadels. However, they may also ricochet or fail to penetrate armor when hitting a target at acute angles. When striking the thin armor of destroyers at 90-degree angles, they will often overpenetrate and deal 1/10 of the maximum damage.
[*]The torpedoes dropped by German aircraft are fast, but have a short range and cause moderate damage.
[*]German bombers carry armor-penetrating bombs. Squadrons fly at high altitudes, and an attacking flight immediately goes into a dive. As it is rather difficult to adjust the position of the target reticle during an attack, their bombs are most effective when dropped on slower targets.
[*]German carriers are armed with accurate long-range secondary guns.[/list]

[list][i]The entire branch of German carriers will become available to research for all players with the release of Update 0.9.7.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Changes to the Modules tab[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b88bd2b4-bfa1-11ea-8493-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The Modules tab in the Port has been reworked. Configuring warships prior to battle was previously too difficult and inconvenient due to the large number of ships and their available enhancements. The process of outfitting a ship before entering battle is now clearer and will take less time.
[list][*]The tab has been renamed "Equipment."
[*]You can manage the upgrades, consumables, and modules of a ship in the same window, without having to switch between different tabs.
[*]The visual appearance of the Modules tree has been improved. We've updated the visuals for the module statuses:
[list][*]Not researched
[*]Not purchased
[*]Available for mounting
[*]Mounted[/list]

[*]You can mount modules with a single click. Modules can be researched and purchased with the click of a button, similar to camouflages, signals, and flags.
[*]You can view any ships you haven't yet purchased in the new "Ship Preview" mode. To do so, click on the icon depicting a camera in the Modules block of the Equipment tab, or on the button in the ship parameters section of the Tech Tree.
[*]The dependencies between modules of different types have been removed, which has simplified the research process. Modules of different types are now intercompatible.
[*]Links between elements of the Modules tree are highlighted if the next module or ship is available to research.
[*]Each aircraft carrier squadron is displayed in a separate block with its specific armament and equipment.
[*]Pop-up windows for mounting and replacing upgrades no longer display integral characteristics.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2b51ee0e-bfb7-11ea-916c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Audio Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b5e9a69a-bfa0-11ea-89d4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.6, we've updated the Wwise audio subsystem version and sound parameters.

[h3][b]List of changes:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Improved sound quality for all settings.
[*]Improved sound quality for multi-channel sound systems (5.1; 7.1; and others).
[*]Updated sounds for ship engines. Sounds are divided into two types—steam turbine and diesel, each with its own distinctive tone.
[*]Updated sounds for aircraft engines.
[*]Updated ambient sounds with the Ultra sound quality setting selected.
[*]The SFX volume slider has been removed from the audio settings. Previously, the slider was used to control all non-musical in-game sounds, with the exception of voice messages. Thus it duplicated the other sliders located in the audio settings tab on the right-hand side of the screen.
[*]A new "Damage audio volume" slider has been added. This is used to control the sound of shells' interaction with all surfaces and ships, and the effects they cause.
[*]Added an option to adjust the volume of the horn that sounds when launching the game. It can be adjusted with the "Music in the Port" slider.[/list]

[h3][b]New sound effects:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]When aircraft fly near the camera and when a squadron approaches a ship.
[*]When turning the camera, and removing fires and flooding in the Binocular view.[/list]

[list][*]With the Ultra sound setting enabled, new sound effects will be heard when selecting 1/2 and 1/4 speeds; reaching speed marks; and when shifting gears to reverse thrust while moving forward at full speed, and vice versa.
[*]Added new sound effects for hits that depend on the type (ricochet, penetration, over-penetration) and degree of damage caused or received.
[*]After the release of Update 0.9.6, you may need to set the sound parameters in the Game Settings. We’ll talk about how to best configure them in a dedicated article.[/list]

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
Check under the spoiler for more information regarding balance-related changes, content changes and additions, and other improvements.

[h1][i][h3][b]Low-Tier Matchmaker Changes [/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b1aa07e6-bfa0-11ea-ac36-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

When playing low-tier ships (Tiers I through V) in Random Battles, teams often entered battle with an incomplete roster. Such a situation could occur due to the fact that most of the activity in our game take place at higher tiers. Now, if the waiting time spent by the first player in the queue exceeds 3 minutes, the remaining places in the teams will be occupied by bots.
[list][*]In Tier I–IV battles, bots are equal in strength to the bots in Co-op Battles.
[*]In Tier V battles, bots have received improved AI and fight at the skill level of those in Operations.[/list]

[h3][b]Matchmaker Changes for Newcomers[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The number of battles a player needs to fight in order to be placed in the general queue for Random Battles has been increased from 69 to 200. Thus a new player will gain more game experience before moving on to general Random Battles. If any newcomers decide they are ready to fight with experienced players, they will be able to enter battle playing Tier V ships:
[list][*]A player who has played 200 battles or less and enters battle playing Tier I–IV ships will be placed in the queue for newcomers only.
[*]A player who has played 200 battles or less and enters battle playing a ship of Tier V or above will be placed in the general queue.
[*]Players who have played more than 200 battles will always be placed in the general queue.[/list]

[*]If the waiting time spent by the first player in the queue exceeds 3 minutes, battles are possible where there is only one live player mirrored by a bot. In this case, the rest of the player’s team will be filled out with bots, and the opposing team will also be filled with bots, mirroring the player’s team in terms of ship tiers and types.[/list]

[h3][b]Matchmaker Changes in Low-Tier Random Battles[/b][/h3]
[list][*]In Tier I–V Random Battles, bots will be added until complete teams are formed if the waiting time spent by the first player in the queue exceeds 3 minutes. A battle will only be matched if the general queue contains at least one pair of players playing ships of the same tier.
[*]If players have ships of different types, then after 3 minutes of waiting in the queue, they will be mirrored by bot ships of the same types and tiers, and the teams will be complemented with bots within the limits for ship types and tiers for this particular battle tier. It means each team will have the same number of bots.
[*]A visual notification about the maximum waiting time and possibility of matching bots to the battle has been added to the battle loading screen.[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b2033cb2-bfa0-11ea-871c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.6, we've made changes to the parameters of certain ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow, should they be required, in future updates.

[h3][b]List of changes:[/b][/h3]
Damage from the armor-penetrating bombs of carrier aircraft has been reduced by an average of 17%:
[table][tr][th][b]Aircraft Carrier/Aircraft[/b][/th][th][b]Before[/b][/th][th][b]Now[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td][b]VI Ryūjō[/b]: researchable bombers
[b]VIII Graf Zeppelin B[/b][/td] [td]7,000[/td] [td]5,800[/td][/tr][/table]
AP bombs require greater player skill than HE bombs, but when correctly used, their effectiveness is higher. The revamped aircraft carriers are a relatively young ship type, and most players have only recently learned how to use them effectively. Since the damage they caused became excessively high, we decided to systemically reduce the maximum damage dealt by AP bombs without reducing their armor penetration capabilities.

[h3][b]Tier VIII Japanese aircraft carrier Shōkaku[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Armor penetration of bombs dropped by researchable bombers increased by 8%.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VIII German aircraft carriers Graf Zeppelin and Graf Zeppelin B[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bomber aiming speed increased by 15%.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier V–X U.S. destroyers Nicholas, Farragut, Mahan, Benson, Fletcher, and Gearing[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus to continuous AA damage provided by the Defensive AA Fire consumable increased from +50% to +75%.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X Italian cruiser Venezia[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The angle value that is used as the starting point for checking an SAP shell hit for a ricochet reduced from 75 to 70 degrees.
[*]Main battery reload time increased from 20 to 20.5 s.
[*]Rudder-shift time increased from 11.6 to 12.6 s.[/list]

[h3][b]Engine Boost Modification 1 upgrade[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus to the action time of the Engine Boost consumable reduced from +50% to +40%.[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Turning Circle Radius Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b599384a-bfa0-11ea-86c7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

For certain ships, there were discrepancies in the actual values of their turning circle radius and those indicated in the ship parameters sections.

Based on the degree of difference in these values, as well as on the current efficiency of these ships and their features, we made changes to the turning circle radius parameter of some ships, bringing them to the values indicated in the parameters section. For some ships, we made changes to their parameters sections.
[table][tr][th][b]Ship[/b][/th][th][b]Actual turning circle radius before change[/b][/th][th][b]Turning circle radius value indicated in the parameters[/b][/th][th][b]Final turning circle radius value[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td][b]VII Colorado[/b][/td] [td]604.24[/td] [td]640[/td] [td]610[/td][/tr][/table]
Regarding ships for which the discrepancies between the actual turning circle radius values and those indicated in the parameters were insignificant, we made system changes that brought their actual turning circle radius values to those indicated in the ship parameters section.
[table][tr][th][b]Ship[/b][/th][th][b]Actual turning circle radius before change[/b][/th][th][b]Turning circle radius value indicated in the parameters[/b][/th][th][b]Final turning circle radius value[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td][b]V Kongō[/b]
[b]V ARP Kongō[/b]
[b]V ARP Hiei[/b]
[b]V ARP Kirishima[/b]
[b]VIII Atago[/b]
[b]VIII Tirpitz[/b]
[b]IX Lion[/b][/td] [td]819.6[/td] [td]830[/td] [td]830[/td][/tr][/table]
[list]We would like to thank [b]AprilWhiteMouse[/b], a participant of our Community Contributors Program, for drawing our attention to this issue.[/list]
[h1][i][h3][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2b036af4-bfb7-11ea-ac7c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[list][i]Cruisers [b]15,000[/b].[/i][/list]

The icons, descriptions, and names of some types of ship consumables with special parameters have been changed. For example, the Smoke Generator consumable mounted on British destroyers of Tier VII and above, with its shorter reload and smoke screen dispersion times in comparison with ships of other nations. This change will emphasize the differences between these types of consumables and the standard ones.

We've updated the contents of supercontainers. The following items have been added:
[list][*]Ships: [b]V Kirov[/b].
[*]50x expendable camouflages: Hunter, Victory Salute, Blue Lagoon, Storm Wind, Happy Pi Day, gamescom Blue, Lunar Warrior, Regia Marina, and European.[/list]

The requirements for obtaining the Aircraft Carrier Commander emblem at all levels have been changed. Despite the fact that the average damage dealt by aircraft carriers per battle was different from that of cruisers and battleships, the requirements for obtaining the emblems were higher than those for cruisers and battleships. The new requirements have been brought in line with the average damage dealt by aircraft carriers per battle. To obtain these emblems, it is now necessary to have inflicted 60,000; 71,000; 84,000; and 113,000 average damage per battle in the last 100 battles. The emblems will be awarded to all players who meet the new requirements.

The designs of the Collector emblems have been updated to distinguish the emblems of different levels.

Due to the simplification of the research process, the following modules have been removed from the game:
[list][*]H8 torpedo module on [b]VI Monaghan[/b]. The improved torpedoes for these ships will now be mounted simultaneously with hull (B).
[*]Hull (C) on [b]VI Nürnberg[/b].
[*]If you have already researched any of the removed modules, you will have the XP spent on this research returned as compensation.
[*]If you have any of the removed modules in your Inventory, you will receive compensation equal to the module's value in credits.
[*]If you have any of the removed modules mounted on your ships, they will be replaced with the previous module and removed from your account. You will receive compensation for the module in the form of credits.
[*]If a replacement module is available in your Inventory, you will receive compensation for its value in credits. Because the stock torpedo module of [b]30,000[/b] credits.
[*]If there is no replacement module available in your Inventory, you will receive a replacement free of charge; if the module has not yet been researched, it will automatically be researched.[/list]

[list][b]Please note: compensation will not be provided for [b]VI Monaghan[/b], as it is not necessary to research or purchase her modules.[/b][/list]

[b]X Midway[/b]'s attack aircraft modules are now researched sequentially. The first module to be researched will be attack aircraft with HVAR 127 mm missiles, the next—with Tiny Tim missiles.
[list][*]If you have not researched attack aircraft armed with Tiny Tim missiles, you will not receive compensation.
[*]If you have researched attack aircraft with Tiny Tim missiles, and have not researched attack aircraft with HVAR 127 mm missiles, then these attack aircraft will automatically be researched.
[*]If you have researched both types of attack aircraft, you will receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]18,000[/b] ship XP for [b]X Midway[/b].[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Visual and Technical Enhancements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b693eeca-bfa0-11ea-8918-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The following Ports have been updated to accommodate the new lighting model and enhanced HDR technology: Naval Base, Azur Lane, Dragon, and Sarushima Base.
[*]Improved graphics quality at maximum settings.
[*]Improved quality of reflections in water at low settings.
[*]Added animated tooltips in the Tech Tree with descriptions of the ship types for new players.
[*]The relevant ship tier is now displayed in the naming of permanent camouflages.[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b180133c-bfa0-11ea-bc17-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Improved the geometry and textures of the following ships: [b]VI Warspite[/b].
[*]A mention has been added to the tooltip for some Commanders' talents, stating that these talents do not apply to air group consumables.
[*]The yellow ribbon is no longer displayed on unique Commanders without improved skills or talents.
[*]Removed an extra separator in the Minimap settings window in battle when operating an aircraft carrier.
[*]Changed the description of the pop-up tooltip when hovering over the Armory banner on the cargo ship.
[*]Changed the order of displayed ship-type icons and tooltip descriptions in the Training Room.
[*]Fixed a bug where the emblem of the Ranked Season was displayed when selecting statistics for all seasons.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused collisions with islands on the Trident map to occur at a considerable distance away from the land.
[*]Fixed a bug where the reduced reload time for weapons in battle was not displayed after a unique Commanders' corresponding talents had been activated.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused video memory consumption to increase after changing the size of the client window.
[*]Fixed a bug where an allied ship's HP bar was not displayed when observing the battle.
[*]Fixed a bug where the names of the rear and front plates of the main battery turrets on cruisers [b]VII Zara[/b] were swapped.
[*]Fixed a bug which caused locked targets to not be displayed on the Tactical Map.
[*]Fixed a bug where the banner of rewards for achieving access levels did not display the next reward.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it possible to receive an invitation to join a Division from a player on the black list.
[*]Fixed a bug where some camouflages were not displayed in the list of camouflages in the Captain's Logbook.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused certain special camouflages for Black Friday ships to be displayed incorrectly on MacOS and systems without full DirectX 11 support.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the text under the Warships Premium Account icon in the personal offer pop-up window to be displayed incorrectly.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the "BATTLE ON" button to disappear on the battle statistics screen when restarting the client during a battle.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the engine sound to be played on ships with space camouflages after incurring an instance of flooding.

[*]Fixed a bug that caused a completed chain of missions to be displayed as incomplete on the battle statistics screen.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Clan chat received the same message twice when fixing the Prime Time.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the ESC button to overlap the title of the window for purchasing and mounting modules.
[*]The text about the possibility of selling consumables has been removed from the description of the Inventory in the Access Levels.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a button with the description of the features of the Soviet cruiser branch to not be displayed in the Tech Tree.[/list]

[h2][b]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/05ce0598-a97b-11ea-be66-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Updated Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e2721726-aa40-11ea-b369-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.5, we've significantly improved the combat missions.
[list][*]The interface has been revamped.
[*]Added combat missions with an "or" condition. In such missions, one of two given conditions needs to be fulfilled in order to get the reward. E.g. earn 10,000 Base XP "or" destroy 10 enemy ships. Thus, you will be able to choose which of the conditions you prefer, and fulfill the requirement playing the most suitable ships.
[*]Changed the way combat missions are displayed on the post-battle statistics screen: the interface has been revamped, and the possibility to track combat mission progress in a separate window has been added.[/list]

[h2][b]Unique Upgrades[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0515cbcc-a97b-11ea-9b0e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In 0.9.5, we're starting the process of updating the unique upgrades. The current concept provides an additional opportunity to mount an upgrade with special-but-balanced bonuses in comparison with regular upgrades.

These changes will balance the effectiveness of the various unique upgrades, while preserving the unique gameplay of each ship.

[h1][i][h3][b]List of changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[h3][b]Enhanced Armaments (Yueyang, fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus that reduces the main battery reload time has been increased from 10 to 15%.
[*]Removed penalties on the action time of ship consumables.
[*]Added a bonus increasing the action time of Surveillance Radar.
[*]Added a bonus increasing smoke screen dispersion time by 20%.
[*]Removed a bonus that reduced the torpedo tube reload time.[/list]
The older version of this upgrade was unpopular because of low competitiveness with other upgrades in the slot. The new variant of the upgrade offers more aggressive gameplay with an accent on consumables and main battery instead of the concealment upgrade which involves a safe playstyle.

[h3][b]Heavyweight Artillery (Khabarovsk, fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a penalty that reduced the traverse speed of her main turrets.
[*]The bonus applied to the main battery’s firing range increased from 8 to 10%.
[*]Added a 20% penalty to the action time of the ship’s consumables.[/list]
The upgrade now places much stronger emphasis on aggressive gameplay due to the enhanced main battery guns and reduced effectiveness of consumables.

[h3][b]Enhanced Countermeasures (Worcester, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Moved from the fifth to the sixth slot.
[*]Removed all bonuses on the action time of her consumables.
[*]Added a bonus reducing the reload time of the Priority AA sector by 20%.
[*]Added a bonus reducing the reload time of ship consumables by 20%.
[*]Added a bonus increasing the number of the ship's consumable charges by one.[/list]
The upgrade moved from the fifth to the sixth slot, which means that it no longer has to compete with other upgrades that provide bonuses to maneuverability and detectability. The new parameters emphasize the role of this ship as a versatile cruiser.

[h3][b]Enhanced Propulsion (Des Moines, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Reduced the bonus to engine power. Now, with the unique upgrade and the “Propulsion Modification 1” upgrade, it’ll take the cruiser 21% more time to reach maximum forward speed, and it’ll take three times more time to reach maximum backward speed. The ship will still be gaining speed faster with these two upgrades compared to having just one of them. At the same time, the time it takes the ship to reach 1/2 and 3/4 of her speed remains almost the same.
[*]Removed a penalty on the action time of Surveillance Radar.[/list]
The bonus to engine power was lowered to reduce the excessive effectiveness of the upgrade. The penalty to the duration of Surveillance Radar didn’t affect the use and effectiveness of the upgrade. Players will now choose between this unique upgrade and an upgrade that increases firepower.

[h3][b]Enhanced Main Armaments (Großer Kurfürst, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus reducing the main battery’s reload time has been decreased from 15 to 10%.
[*]Removed a penalty that reduced the traverse speed of her main turrets.[/list]
[h3][b]Enhanced Damage Control System (Montana, fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus reducing fire extinguishing time has been decreased from 15 to 10%.
[*]The bonus reducing flooding recovery time has been decreased from 30 to 10%.[/list]
[h3][b]Additional Main Battery Loader (République, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a penalty that reduced the traverse speed of her main turrets.[/list]
[h3][b]Accelerated Torpedo Tube Reload (Shimakaze, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The penalty reducing the torpedo tube traverse speed has been decreased from 80 to 70%.[/list]
[list][i]Concerning [b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b], [b]X Montana[/b], [b]X République[/b], and [b]X Shimakaze[/b], balance changes designed to compensate for the excessive or insufficient effectiveness of their unique upgrades were made.[/i][/list]
Expect changes to the unique upgrades of other ships in the coming updates.

[h2][b]Changes in the Soviet Cruiser Branch[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8877e198-a99a-11ea-aa34-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.9.5 will see the Soviet cruiser branch split into two sub-branches. [b]X Moskva[/b] is a heavy cruiser, and she is going to leave the light cruiser branch and acquire the status of special ship that's available in exchange for Coal. She'll be replaced in the tech tree by light cruiser [b]X Alexander Nevsky[/b]. [b]V Kirov[/b] will also leave the branch to become a Premium ship. She'll be replaced by [b]V Kotovsky[/b]. The Premium version of Kirov is based on her standard hull that historically existed. The ship’s AA armament is the same as for her standard hull, while all of her other characteristics are same as for her researchable hull. At the same time, it will be possible to choose between the Spotting Aircraft and Fighter consumables.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/452a0bc2-aa5e-11ea-98f7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h1][i][h3][b]Details on changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*]Cruiser [b]X Moskva[/b] will acquire the status of being a special ship. This means that the base cost of the post-battle service of this ship will be reduced from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]180,000[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b] credits, and Commanders from other ships of the same nation can be assigned to her without any penalties or retraining requirements.
[*]You'll receive cruiser [b]X Moskva[/b] under the following circumstances: if you've already researched but haven't yet purchased her; if you sold her; or if you’ve had the branch reset through the Research Bureau.
[*]If your progress through the Soviet cruiser branch has been reset, the Research Point bonus will be transferred to [b]X Alexander Nevsky[/b].
[*]The unique upgrade and combat mission for cruiser [b]X Moskva[/b], as well as any permanent camouflages you’ve purchased, will be preserved. If the Type 20 permanent camouflage hasn't yet been purchased, it will be added.
[*]The Commander of cruiser [b]X Moskva[/b] will preserve his specialization.
[*]Cruiser [b]X Alexander Nevsky[/b] can be obtained only after she has been researched and purchased in the Tech Tree.
[*]The same rules apply to cruiser [b]V Kirov[/b] and her tech tree replacement [b]V Kotovsky[/b], except that Kirov will become a Premium ship instead of a special ship.[/list]

[h3][b]Features of the new Tech Tree branch[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Effective AP shells with excellent armor penetration capabilities, good ballistics, fewer over-penetrations, and enhanced ricochet angles.

[*]The combination of their accuracy settings and the Surveillance Radar consumable they carry, which has a 12 km operating range, makes the new cruisers most efficient in medium-range encounters.[/list]

[h2][b]Submarine Battle[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0777f4c6-9297-11ea-9b1a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Wed. 27 May 06:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Wed. 24 Jun. 06:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Submarines are arriving and will be playable in a separate battle type! This will enable us to continue testing the new ship type while we adjust the balance and mechanics on the live server by involving more participants, and won’t affect the other battle types. Only once we're done with all these steps will we be able to decide on the final fate of the new unit type.
[list][i]Players will be able to enter Submarine Battles playing submarines and Tier VI ships.[/i][/list]
Submarines are fragile but stealthy hunters, capable of traveling not only horizontally, but also diving into the depths. The diving depth of a submarine affects her detectability, viewing range, and range of possible interactions with other submarines and ship types.

The main armament carried by submarines is acoustic homing torpedoes. You can launch an attack from any depth, and submarine-specific mechanics—sonar pings—will help you increase the potential effectiveness of your torpedo salvos. Keep an eye on your battery charge and use sonar pings wisely. Torpedoes can ascend from the depths and hit an enemy only with the help of an active effect from a sonar ping. If you run out of battery charge, reduce your speed to 1/4 or ascend to the surface level to recharge it.

Keep an eye on enemy destroyers and cruisers. All destroyers, as well as cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Dallas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Budyonny[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Leander[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Perth[/b][/b] carry depth charges. These are an effective weapon that can hit submarines hiding underwater.
[list][i]You will find more details about the new event, features of submarines, and ways to counter them in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/775b39c8-929d-11ea-b019-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/775a3d98-929d-11ea-a6e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/788873f6-929d-11ea-b513-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/777334f6-929d-11ea-9bc3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/77eb41c6-929d-11ea-988f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Enhanced Consumables[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0719ea98-9297-11ea-b4a1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[b]Enhanced consumables are set to become free, while standard consumables will be removed entirely. Consequently, all battles will be fought with ships utilizing enhanced consumables, and players no longer need to spend credits on them.[/b]
[list][i]Enhanced consumables mounted on ships and kept in the Inventory will automatically be exchanged for credits at a rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]22,500[/b]. “More Consumables” containers will no longer be obtainable, and any such containers that you already have on your account will each automatically be exchanged for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]160,000[/b] credits. For other rewards, enhanced consumables will be replaced with signals.[/i][/list]
Since aircraft carriers have no enhanced consumables, their parameters won't change, and the cost of servicing aircraft carriers has been adjusted to make it equal relative to other ship types. For example, the cost of servicing Tier X aircraft carriers will be reduced from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]240,000[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]180,000[/b] credits.

[h2][b]Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/06fb395e-9297-11ea-b5dd-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Wed. 20 May 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]End:[/b] [b]Tue. 16 Jun. 10:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format:[/b] 7 vs. 7 playing Tier VII ships
[b]Rewards:[/b] up to [b]4,700[/b] Steel and many additional rewards
[b]Maps: [/b]Archipelago, Ring, Big Race, New Dawn, Trident, Neighbors, and Riposte
[list][i]The Season’s details will be published in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Interface, Graphics, and Audio[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7e8dbc42-92bc-11ea-9d06-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The design of the Modules tab has been updated. Under this tab, you can now view all upgrades and consumables for any ships that you haven't yet obtained.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/180c69ae-9394-11ea-bf15-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Ships can be researched and obtained via the Tech Tree screen. Click on a ship once to open the Spec Sheet with Purchase/Research buttons. Click on a ship twice to open the Modules tab. Clicking on an empty area of the Tech Tree will hide the Spec Sheet.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/182e3bd8-9394-11ea-a1cf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The consumable and armament icons have been updated.
[*]The Northern Lights, Shatter, Sleeping Giant, Loop, Greece, and Crash Zone Alpha maps have been reworked to accommodate the new lighting model and enhanced HDR technology.
[*]A special animation is now displayed when a shell ricochets off armor.
[*]We’ve enhanced the visual display of boat handrails, as well as rigging, in Ports and on maps.
[*]Updated the national voiceovers for Polish, Dutch, and Austro-Hungarian ships. The presence of any unique Commander voiceovers is now taken into account when the "National+" voiceover is selected.[/list]
[h2][b]Game Maps and Modes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e69a0c60-9392-11ea-8815-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The following maps have been reworked:
[list][*]Loop: the location of islands has been updated. This will make approaching Key Areas and maneuvering within them easier.
[*]The Atlantic: an island located in square A7 at the map border has been removed.[/list]
[h3][i]The starting number of points in Domination mode in Co-op Battles has been increased:[/i][/h3]
[list][*]from 300 to 400 points in the mode with 3 Key Areas.
[*]from 200 to 300 points in the mode with 4 Key Areas.[/list]
[b]This will help reduce the number of battles that end due to one of the teams reaching zero points.[/b]

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
Check under the spoiler for more information on balance-related changes, content changes and additions, and other improvements.

[h1][i][h3][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0737b26c-9297-11ea-89a4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.4, we've made changes to the parameters of certain ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow, should they be required, in future updates.

[h3][b]Tier VIII European destroyer Öland:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Standard torpedo tube reload time reduced from 70 to 59 s.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier VIII U.S. cruiser Cleveland:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fighter consumable added to the slot with Surveillance Radar.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier IX Seattle and Tier X Worcester U.S. cruisers:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fighter and Spotting Aircraft consumables added to the slot with Surveillance Radar.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier VIII U.S. battleship North Carolina:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Deck armor thickness increased from 37 to 38 mm.[/list]
[h3][b]Destroyers Nicholas, Farragut, Mahan, Benson, Fletcher, and Ognevoi:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Defensive AA Fire consumable is now available for mounting on any hull.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier III Soviet cruiser Aurora:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Gun traverse speed increased from 5.3 to 5.5 deg/s.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier IV Soviet battleship Gangut:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Base main battery firing range increased from 12.3 to 12.4 km.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier III U.K. destroyer Valkyrie:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 5.4 to 5.6 s.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier IX U.K. destroyer Jutland:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 4.2 to 4.3 s.
[*]Torpedo tube reload time increased from 124 to 125 s.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier X U.K. destroyer Daring:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 2.7 to 2.8 s.
[*]Torpedo tube reload time increased from 124 to 125 s.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier II U.K. cruiser Weymouth:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added the Repair Party consumable.
[*]Main battery reload time increased from 8.57 to 8.9 s.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier V U.K. cruiser Hawkins:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 13.5 to 13 s.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier V German destroyer Т-22:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Hydroacoustic Search consumable added in a separate slot.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier VI German destroyer Ernst Gaede:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Hydroacoustic Search consumable is available for mounting on a standard hull.[/list]
[h3][b]Aircraft:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The spotting range of all aircraft has been reduced from 17 to 16 km (spotting range being a parameter that determines the distance at which an aircraft can detect a hostile target).[/list]
[h1][i][h3][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/06970114-9297-11ea-ad66-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The Armory now offers containers with elements of the "Resolute and Rapid" collection. The containers can be obtained in exchange for 6,000 Coal. The reward for completing the entire collection is the unique Italian historical Commander, Luigi Sansonetti.
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.9.4, all European Tokens will be exchanged for credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]7,500[/b].[/i][/list]
The Victory Day permanent camouflage, which is available in exchange for doubloons, has been added to the Camouflage tab of the Exterior section for the following ships: [b]VIII Alabama[/b], [b]V Texas[/b], [b]VII New Orleans[/b], [b]VII Duke of York[/b], [b]VIII Implacable[/b], [b]VI Aigle[/b], [b]VII Minsk[/b], and [b]V Oktyabrskaya Revolutsiya[/b].

The following expendable camouflages have been added: Recruiting Station, Trophy, Awarded, Deserved, and Triumphant.

More details on how to get these items will be announced later.

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: [b]IV Rhein[/b], [b]VI Weser[/b], [b]VIII August von Parseval[/b], [b]X Manfred von Richthofen[/b], [b]VIII Z-35[/b], and [b]VIII V. I. Lenin[/b].

[h1][i][h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/07d9ffa4-9297-11ea-8344-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Increased the game client loading speed when a large number of Commanders are present in the Port.
[*]Account Levels have been renamed Access Levels. Reaching a new level is now accompanied by a voiceover.
[*]A ship’s detectability range by air is now equal to the firing range of the ship's AA guns for a period of two seconds after her AA guns cease firing. This affects detectability only in situations where enemy aircraft are within the range of your AA defenses.
[*]Updated the algorithm that selects recommended Clans and updated the design of the Recommendations tab in the Clans section.
[*]Reworked the animation of the torpedo-aiming cone. Now the aiming cone moves more smoothly near the target position.
[*]The word “Flag” has been removed from the names of flags.
[*]Fixed bugs in the descriptions of the features of ship branches in the Tech Tree.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which the fore and aft athwartship bulkheads of [b]VIII Graf Zeppelin[/b] and [b]VIII Graf Zeppelin B[/b] had a thickness of 20 mm. Now the thickness of part of the bulkheads is 60 mm.
[*]Small corrections have been made to textures and models of the following ships: [b]VIII Mainz[/b], [b]VI Guépard[/b], [b]VII Skåne[/b], [b]X Småland[/b], [b]X Venezia[/b], [b]VIII Vladivostok[/b], [b]X Daring[/b], [b]X Hayate[/b], [b]X Ohio[/b], [b]IX Brindisi[/b], [b]I Eritrea[/b], [b]X Halland[/b], [b]VI Trento[/b], [b]IX Georgia[/b], [b]VII Sims[/b], [b]VIII Amalfi[/b], [b]VII Zara[/b], [b]X Minotaur[/b], [b]V Visby[/b], [b]VIII Siliwangi[/b], [b]V Raimondo Montecuccoli[/b], [b]X Marceau[/b], [b]II Enseigne Gabolde[/b], [b]VIII Lightning[/b], and [b]IX Östergötland[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a string of lights of the New Year permanent camouflage on aircraft carriers to be lit up from bow to stern, when they should light up from stern to bow.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused [b]X Smolensk[/b] to be displayed as a Premium ship, and not as a special one.
[*]Fixed bugs on maps Archipelago, Estuary, Polar, Haven, and Tears of the Desert; and in Ports New York, Marseille, and Fjords.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which, when inserting text with characters [b]<[/b], [b]>[/b], or [b]^[/b] into a chat message in the Port, cause the text to be cut off. Now these characters will be removed.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused players to not automatically be disconnected from the server after 3 hours of inactivity.
[*]Fixed the display of tooltips when hovering over the “Ready” and “Not Ready” buttons in the Training Room and on the Division screen.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused battle modes in the Training Room to be called "Battle Type."
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the sizes of windows to be changed incorrectly when the value of the Increase UI Scale setting was higher than 100%.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game client to shut down when pressing the [b]ESC[/b] button while opening the window displaying patches.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused talent and skill icons to overlap each other in the Personal File window of Commander Günther Lütjens.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the reticle to show incorrect information about the readiness of guns for firing with the Reduce GUI Refresh Rate option enabled.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused autopilot to switch off when dragging autopilot waypoints on top of each other.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it impossible for the overview camera in the Port to switch from one gun to another gun of the same type.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the interface text to be partially blurred.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the secondary/AA guns indicator, information about fixing guns, and fire and floo[b]din[/b]g timers to not be displayed after reentering a battle.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it impossible to plot an autopilot route on a specific area of the Tactical Map.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the reload timer to reload for a second longer when the reload time was longer than 1 minute.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the icon of a completed mission of a Campaign to move down if the mouse was hovered over it.
[*]Fixed a bug where secondary guns could shoot at the enemy through allied ships.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it possible to confirm the "Ready" status in a Division for Clan Battles with an unsuitable ship selected.
[*]Fixed a bug where the torpedo alarm indicator, collision alert indicator, and the Radio Location indicator didn’t allow players to select a priority target for their secondary battery guns.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the buoys indicating the boundaries of Key Areas to be displayed only at close range.
[*]Fixed a bug where a squadron’s reticle before the start of an attack was not displayed in the spot where it was fully aimed.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented players from mounting the Ship Consumables Modification 1 upgrade on [b]VII Belfast[/b] and [b]VII Z-39[/b].
[*]Fixed the incorrect naming of the AA guns on [b]III Romulus[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the names of items in collections to be written in capital letters.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a marker above a torpedo to appear before the torpedo was armed.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which, when switching to another ship, ships with the “Coming Soon” field displayed the “Test Ship” field.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented a squadron from attacking immediately after taking off.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which, with the 1366x768 resolution selected, icons of unavailable missions were displayed incorrectly in the Campaigns window.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused aerial bombs to deal damage later than the point when they hit the target.[/list]

The Update is bringing our new [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Hayate[/b][/b] to the game, and she’ll be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]2,000,000[/b] Free XP.
[h2][b]History[/b][/h2]
Hayate is a variant of a Japanese destroyer project developed during World War II. The ship is imagined with a main battery consisting of the modern 127 mm Type 1 dual-purpose guns in twin-turret mounts. In reality, Japanese designers only managed to produce one such gun before the end of the war, which was found by the Americans among the debris of the gun mount workshop at the Kure Naval Arsenal in December 1945.

In World of Warships, we’ve recreated this mount in 3D and designed a ship based on a Shimakaze-class destroyer to carry it.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7412d7be-888c-11ea-9499-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Modeling the Ship[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/344b4488-887b-11ea-a205-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]Dual-purpose guns:[/b] six 127 mm/50 Type 1 dual-purpose guns in three twin mounts.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/34c1a10a-887b-11ea-8a4d-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]Torpedoes:[/b] two 610 mm quintuple-tube torpedo launchers.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3444192e-887b-11ea-a39f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]Anti-aircraft armament:[/b] five twin 40 mm/60 Type 5 (Model 1945) AA guns and eight 25 mm/60 type 96 mod.1 guns.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/899e8582-8888-11ea-a060-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Commanding Hayate[/b][/h2]
One of Hayate’s standout features is that she can be customized to suit two different playstyles. Both are quite effective—the choice of which path to go down is yours.

[h1][i]Artillery Option[/i][/h1]
[h3][b]Commander with 10 skill points[/b][/h3]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/PriorityTargetModifier_ffcc52036d210f6f22c4ea7ad44db3baf8ec256b54f5a471c3b342e852599a59.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_LastEffortModifier_df0ca0625c66be31566cb59352647b0a7a6347d8b6042eb4344bb5c1d208c129.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_AIGunsEfficiencyModifier_b1df07b4e1c6734ecda424abd8097f5821ab72eb70bb40d7c71848861e71d72a.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/VisibilityModifier_59d3bb84996e8f66039e6103dd58dccad99fa0c607b3e3375afcfc35fbb9fe71.png[/img]
[list][*]Priority Target

[h3][b]Commander with 19 skill points[/b][/h3]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/PriorityTargetModifier_ffcc52036d210f6f22c4ea7ad44db3baf8ec256b54f5a471c3b342e852599a59.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_LastEffortModifier_df0ca0625c66be31566cb59352647b0a7a6347d8b6042eb4344bb5c1d208c129.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_AIGunsEfficiencyModifier_b1df07b4e1c6734ecda424abd8097f5821ab72eb70bb40d7c71848861e71d72a.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/VisibilityModifier_59d3bb84996e8f66039e6103dd58dccad99fa0c607b3e3375afcfc35fbb9fe71.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_SurvivalModifier_ed5be93ece41dcbe30b65408b8437ac3c7313a11c9cf6f573a95a1d79c1f3a3d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/SuperintendentModifier_377444942b28914f815944fd2a86e21a23387d4b743827a79ac2813d8011282a.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/LastChanceModifier_08c69996db12c0caa1dacc5aa9c2c9dc1139371a3248c9d0c98a79822ec3b103.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_MeticulousPreventionModifier_bdab0122be3f41c4449309fd653987c254326c92a894bde26c7712be3b454e44.png[/img]

The ship has great tactical flexibility—through configuring her upgrades and Commander’s skills, she can be specialized either for torpedo attacks or artillery duels.

[h3][b]Key features:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Six 127 mm guns in three mounts. With HE shells, her guns can deal considerable damage for their caliber and have a good rate of fire and aiming speed. The ship enjoys flat-trajectory ballistics.
[*]Two quintuple-tube torpedo launchers. Torpedo range—12 km. Like other Japanese destroyers, Hayate can deal heavy damage to the enemy with her torpedoes. The Torpedo Reload Booster consumable allows players to launch torpedo salvos with a minimal interval, but players will have to discard Smoke Generator in order to mount this consumable.
